### PrepCast Ai
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/prepcast-ai-a75a) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/VV071/Prepcast_Ai) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://prepcast-ai.vercel.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/8-JcsUGwXmI) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Technocrats%20Hackathon-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://technocrats-hackathon.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-23-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> “Turning Raw Data Into Ready Insights.”

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Data Mining](https://img.shields.io/badge/Data%20Mining-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![BERT](https://img.shields.io/badge/BERT-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

PrepCast addresses one of the biggest challenges in modern data-driven work: the difficulty of cleaning, analyzing, and forecasting large datasets without technical expertise.

1)Most individuals, researchers, and organizations struggle with:

2)Messy datasets that require extensive manual cleaning

3)Time-consuming analysis pipelines that slow down decision-making

4)No centralized platform to manage sessions, collaborate, and track analytics progress

5)Complex tools that demand coding knowledge or advanced statistical experience

6)Difficulty generating consistent, professional reports for stakeholders

7)No built-in forecasting capabilities to plan ahead or identify trends

PrepCast solves all of these challenges in one unified platform.

With AI-powered analytics, automated predictive forecasting, rich session management, and an intuitive 3D-enhanced UI, PrepCast enables anyone—from students to analysts to businesses—to instantly transform raw datasets into insights, visualize trends, collaborate effectively, and generate ready-to-use reports.

The platform integrates with Google’s Gemini AI along with BERT and NLP for intelligent data processing and uses Supabase for secure, scalable database operations, authentication, and storage. This combination ensures high performance, reliability, and ease of integration.

Smart Features

1)AI-Powered Analytics: Advanced data interpretation powered by Google Gemini,BERT,NLP

2)Predictive Forecasting: Identifies future trends and patterns with ease

3)Comprehensive Session Management: Collaborate, track progress, and manage data sessions

4)Interactive 3D UI: Modern, immersive interface for a better user experience

5)Secure Backend: Supabase-powered authentication, database, and storage

6)Custom Reporting: Generate detailed, publication-ready reports automatically

7)Dynamic Theming: Toggle between light and dark modes for better usability

PrepCast makes data work faster, simpler, and more intelligent.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building PrepCast, we faced several technical and architectural challenges:

1. Integrating Google Gemini for Real-Time AI Processing

The biggest challenge was managing large payloads and streaming responses efficiently.
We solved this by optimizing our API request flow and implementing async service layers to avoid UI blocking.

2. Session Management & State Persistence

Creating a reliable session system—where users could save, resume, and collaborate—required careful design.
Using Supabase’s Auth + Database + Storage combination helped us build a seamless and secure workflow.

3. Designing the 3D Interactive UI

Adding 3D components without compromising performance was tricky.
We handled this by using lightweight rendering, memoized components, and Framer Motion for smooth animations.

4. Database Schema Complexity

Managing forecasting data, reports, user sessions, and AI processing logs required a well-structured schema.
We iterated multiple times and used SQL migrations to stabilize the structure.

5. Forecasting Service Optimization

Our forecasting algorithms initially slowed down for large datasets.
We optimized them by batching computations and caching intermediate results.

6. Environment Setup & API Keys

Ensuring a smooth developer experience with multiple API keys (Supabase + Gemini) required clear environment variable handling and documentation.

These difficulties helped us build a more scalable, stable, and polished product, and each challenge ultimately strengthened the architecture of PrepCast.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Deep Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Deep%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![XGBoost](https://img.shields.io/badge/XGBoost-333333?style=flat-square) ![JSX](https://img.shields.io/badge/JSX-333333?style=flat-square) ![YOLOv3 Algorithm](https://img.shields.io/badge/YOLOv3%20Algorithm-333333?style=flat-square)

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the key challenges was training YOLO for wildlife detection. Finding suitable datasets for Indian wildlife species was difficult, as many publicly available datasets did not sufficiently match the species relevant to our use case. Preparing suitable training data and getting reliable detection performance required significant experimentation.

We also faced challenges in sourcing location-based datasets that could support meaningful risk intelligence for wildlife conflict-prone areas.

Another major hurdle was integrating the complete technology stack. Connecting the trained YOLO model with our ML-based risk intelligence, backend, and frontend required careful handling of data flow and APIs so that detection results could be processed and displayed correctly.

We overcame these challenges through iterative dataset preparation, model training and testing, and step-by-step integration of the YOLO, ML, backend, and frontend components into a single working system

**The problem it solves**

Human-wildlife conflict poses a significant safety challenge for communities located near forest and wildlife habitats. Existing monitoring and response mechanisms can be difficult to manage across large areas, often resulting in delayed awareness and response when wildlife enters human-populated zones.

KAVACH addresses this challenge by providing a centralized platform for monitoring wildlife activity, identifying potential conflict-prone areas, and supporting timely decision-making.

The system can be used to:

Monitor wildlife activity across vulnerable areas.
Identify locations with a higher likelihood of human-wildlife encounters.
Provide timely alerts to relevant authorities and stakeholders.
Visualize wildlife incidents and risk-prone zones on a geographical interface.
Maintain historical information to identify recurring conflict patterns.
Support forest officials in planning preventive measures and allocating resources more effectively.

By bringing monitoring, location-based information, alerts, and historical insights into a single platform, KAVACH aims to make wildlife conflict management more proactive, organized, and effective.

**Wildlife Protection**

KAVACH directly addresses human-wildlife conflict by providing a technology-driven platform for wildlife monitoring and risk intelligence. The system uses YOLO-based wildlife detection to identify animals from images/video and combines detection results with location-based risk intelligence to identify and understand conflict-prone areas. By integrating wildlife detection, ML-based risk analysis, backend services, and a user-facing dashboard, KAVACH supports earlier awareness and more informed decision-making for wildlife protection and human safety.

**The problem it solves**

The websie offers a straightforward solution: it allows users to upload an image and receive a classification prediction. While the site itself doesn't provide detailed information about its underlying model or specific capabilities, its primary function is to demonstrate how AI can be utilized for image classification tasks.

Such applications are valuable for developers and learners aiming to understand the basics of integrating AI models into web platforms. They serve as foundational tools for building more complex systems, such as those that can differentiate between real and AI-generated images, identify objects, or categorize images based on content.

For those interested in exploring similar applications or delving deeper into AI-powered image classification, resources like Vercel's AI templates or tutorials on building image recognition apps with tools like Hugging Face and Pinecone can be beneficial.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges while building the project:

- Using TensorFlow.js with MobileNet: Integrating the model correctly in the browser was tricky, especially handling async model loading and prediction.
- Image preprocessing: Resizing and normalizing the uploaded image to match MobileNet's expected input (224x224) was essential — wrong formatting led to inaccurate results.
- Performance issues: Since everything runs in the browser, performance varied across devices, with slower inference on low-end systems.
- Error handling: Managing errors during model load, image upload, or prediction was important to ensure a smooth user experience.

### PayShield
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/payshield-8449) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/deveshreddyp/paysheild) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://payshield-dashboard.onrender.com/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/99fMDsyHzA4) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack--Nocturne%202.O-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hack-nocturne-2.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-14-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Real-time ML defense against API tampering

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Financial technology is engaged in a continuous arms race. While traditional security focuses on authenticating who is making a request, sophisticated attackers exploit what is in the request. Modern platforms are highly vulnerable to Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) API Tampering and complex, multi-node Fraud Rings.

Attackers routinely bypass standard authentication to intercept and modify in-flight API payloads—for example, altering a checkout price from $500.00 to $5.00, manipulating payout routing numbers, or inflating refund quantities. Traditional rule-based Web Application Firewalls (WAFs) fail because the requests themselves are structurally valid and properly authenticated; they simply lack the contextual intelligence to recognize that the intent of the data has been maliciously altered.

PayShield is a real-time, ML-powered defense layer that solves this critical vulnerability.

Deep Payload Inspection: It doesn't just check tokens; it actively analyzes the integrity of incoming API parameters against historical user baselines.
Intelligent Network Defense: By leveraging GraphSAGE (Graph Neural Networks), PayShield maps complex transaction networks to identify and dismantle coordinated, multi-account fraud rings before an exploited transaction can settle.
Zero-Trust Transactions: It provides a lightweight middleware gateway paired with an intuitive Next.js dashboard, transforming naive APIs into zero-trust, tamper-proof endpoints.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building a low-latency security gateway that relies on heavy machine learning inference presented several significant technical hurdles:

⚡ Latency vs. Security (The Real-Time Dilemma): We initially implemented GraphSAGE inferences inline with our API traffic. This introduced unacceptable latency overhead (500ms+) for standard transactions, which ruins the user experience in modern fin-tech.
The Fix: We completely re-architected our pipeline. We implemented a split-architecture approach. We built a lightning-fast, highly optimized anomaly detection heuristic (using Random Forests and FAISS similarity matching) at the synchronous gateway level to instantly block clear tampering attempts. We then pushed the computationally intensive GraphSAGE node-embeddings inference to an asynchronous background worker that flags suspicious graph interactions (like high-velocity cyclical transfers) without blocking the critical path.
⚔️ Constructing a "White-Hat" Attack Vector: To train our models and empirically prove that our gateway intercepts tampered requests, we had to become the attacker. We needed a reliable way to execute MitM attacks on our own localhost environments without building a sprawling, custom malicious proxy.
The Fix: We integrated Requestly into our development loop. This allowed us to quickly author exact HTTP modification rules and reliably intercept, dissect, and poison our own frontend requests before they hit the backend, providing robust validation for our Tamper Alerts.
🔄 Stateful WebSockets in Next.js: Ensuring our TamperAlert.tsx dashboard accurately reflected real-time blocking events from the Node.js middleware required strict state management. We had to implement robust WebSocket reconnect logic to prevent dropped packets during localized server restarts.

**Creative Use of Requestly**

Track: Creative Use of Requestly - The "White-Hat Attack Simulator"

To demonstrate the power of a security product, you have to prove it stops an attack. We creatively deployed Requestly not just as a developer utility, but as the core Attack Simulation Engine for our entire project demonstration.

PayShield is designed to catch invisible, in-flight API tampering. To showcase this during the hackathon, we utilized Requestly's Modify Request Body rules to simulate a targeted Man-in-the-Middle exploit.

The Workflow:

A user attempts a standard checkout (e.g., Transfer $100.00) via our React frontend.
The Requestly Extension intercepts this legitimate XHR/Fetch request in transit.
According to our custom rule, Requestly maliciously alters the payload structure (e.g., changing the amount to $1.00 or swapping the destination_account_id).
The poisoned request hits the PayShield Backend API.
Our ML models instantly recognize the structural anomaly, block the transaction, and fire a WebSocket alert to our Live Tamper Dashboard.
Requestly was absolutely critical to our success. It allowed us to flawlessly, repeatedly, and visibly trigger PayShield's core machine learning defenses on-demand, transforming an invisible backend process into a highly visual, winning demonstration.

Team **ORBIT** -- [Devesh Reddy](https://github.com/deveshreddyp), [Nihal DR](https://github.com/NihalDR), [tanusree reddy](https://github.com/m-tanusree-reddy)

> Because your skin feels what you feel.

![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![Deep Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Deep%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![React Native](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Native-333333?style=flat-square) ![Computer Vision](https://img.shields.io/badge/Computer%20Vision-333333?style=flat-square) ![Azure Custom Vision](https://img.shields.io/badge/Azure%20Custom%20Vision-333333?style=flat-square) ![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-333333?style=flat-square) ![Multimodal AI](https://img.shields.io/badge/Multimodal%20AI-333333?style=flat-square) ![Voice Agent](https://img.shields.io/badge/Voice%20Agent-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Chronic skin conditions like **eczema**, **psoriasis**, and **vitiligo** don't just affect your skin—they're deeply tied to your mental health and environment. Yet patients face fragmented care:

- Dermatologists treat symptoms without addressing emotional triggers
- Mental health support ignores the physical reality of flare-ups
- Environmental factors like weather and UV exposure are tracked separately, if at all

**The data is clear**: Up to *33% of dermatology patients experience psychiatric symptoms*, and research shows stress, weather, and UV exposure directly impact skin health. The connection exists, but the tools to manage it holistically simply don't.

Dermora.ai is the **first platform that connects all three**—your skin, your mind, and your environment:
- **AI-powered diagnosis** using fine-tuned *DINOv2 ViT* models for accurate detection
- **Mood tracking** and analysis stored over time to identify emotional patterns
- **Solace**, a voice-based mental health agent that adapts to your emotional state
- **Environmental monitoring** that factors weather conditions into your care
- **Weekly photo comparisons** that visualize your skin's progress

Early detection can prevent up to **80% of flare-ups**—but only if you understand the full picture.

Dermora.ai makes that picture visible for the first time.

**Challenges we ran into**

- Making AI Work in the Real World:
Ensuring** reliable skin condition predictions **across diverse skin tones, lighting conditions, and image quality while avoiding *bias* and *overfitting*.

- Building a **Full-Stack Mobile Health Product** from Scratch:
Developing our first Android app and integrating ML inference, voice-based mental health support, secure auth, and databases into a smooth, production-ready experience.

### LitmusML
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/litmusml-fdd6) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://huggingface.co/spaces/pruh-12/LitmusML-Upgraded) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://vimeo.com/1156030824?share=copy&fl=sv&fe=ci) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Winter%20of%20Code%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://winter-of-code-5.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-12-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> The litmus test for ML papers

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Streamlit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Streamlit-333333?style=flat-square) ![HuggingFace](https://img.shields.io/badge/HuggingFace-333333?style=flat-square) ![Groq](https://img.shields.io/badge/Groq-333333?style=flat-square) ![PDF parsing](https://img.shields.io/badge/PDF%20parsing-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The problem it solves:**

Peer review and self-evaluation of machine learning papers is slow, inconsistent, and opaque.
Researchers often wait months for feedback, and when they receive it, the comments are subjective, unstructured, and hard to act on. Existing AI review tools tend to produce long narrative feedback that can be overconfident, hallucinated, or non-actionable, making them risky to trust during research iteration.

*This project addresses the lack of a trustworthy, structured, and actionable diagnostic tool for ML research papers.*
**Primary use cases:**

Pre-submission self-review for ML researchers
Rapid sanity-check of experimental rigor
Teaching tool for understanding reviewer expectations
Early detection of reviewer-style weaknesses

**How it makes existing tasks easier:**

Replaces vague reviewer intuition with explicit rubrics
Converts long papers into structured diagnostics in minutes
Separates absence of evidence from negative evidence
Prevents overconfident or hallucinated critiques
Produces ranked, concrete, fix-oriented feedback
Makes reviewer logic transparent and auditable


**Stand-Out Features:**

Deterministic rule engine layered over LLM extraction
Mode-aware evidence handling (presence vs absence)
Paper-type–aware critiques (empirical vs conceptual)
Sanity checks and overrides that correct the model
Confidence calibration that mirrors real reviewer uncertainty



**Functioning:**

The tool allows researchers to upload an ML paper PDF and receive a structured reviewer-style analysis covering:
Contribution clarity (what the paper claims and how clearly)
Baseline adequacy (strength and fairness of comparisons)
Evaluation quality (metrics, breadth, statistical rigor)
Evidence strength (support for claims, consistency, ablations)
Concise reviewer summary
Prioritized actionable suggestions (what to fix next and why)


Unlike narrative AI reviewers, this system:
Uses explicit rubrics instead of free-form judgment
Provides deterministic, auditable outputs
Avoids hallucinated related-work claims
Produces ranked, concrete revision guidance


**It is especially useful for:**
Iterating on research papers before submission
Debugging reviewer concerns early
Teaching junior researchers what strong ML papers require
Faster self-review without violating conference policies

The system breaks the review task into orthogonal dimensions and evaluates each independently, rather than generating a single holistic opinion. Each dimension is assessed against a fixed rubric with constrained outputs, making the results comparable across papers and resistant to overconfident hallucination.

A key capability is paper-type awareness. The system distinguishes between empirical, conceptual, theoretical, and position-style papers and adjusts expectations accordingly. Empirical critiques such as missing baselines or insufficient statistical rigor are automatically suppressed for non-empirical work, preventing unfair or misleading feedback. This avoids a common failure mode of existing AI review tools, which implicitly assume all papers are empirical.

The tool also includes a deterministic override and sanity-check layer that treats language model outputs as provisional. When extracted judgments contradict the document structure or the inferred paper type, they are downgraded, marked as not applicable, or suppressed entirely. Every such adjustment is recorded and surfaced, making the system’s behavior transparent and auditable.

The reviewer summary is not a paper summary. It is a synthesis of the extracted review signals, written in a neutral academic tone, and explicitly constrained to avoid inventing information or making acceptance decisions. This makes it suitable for internal iteration without misrepresenting the paper or overstating conclusions.

Overall, the system reduces the cognitive and time cost of self-review by transforming a subjective, slow, and opaque process into a structured diagnostic workflow. Instead of guessing how a reviewer might respond, authors receive concrete signals about clarity, evaluation, and evidence quality, along with prioritized guidance on what to improve next.

**Challenges we ran into**

**1. Overconfident and unstable LLM outputs**
Early versions produced inconsistent or overly confident feedback across runs.

Solution:
I redesigned the pipeline to:
Force strict structured outputs
Normalize labels
Move judgment aggregation into deterministic post-processing
Separate reasoning (LLM) from decisions (rules)

This significantly improved reliability and reproducibility.

**2. Making feedback truly actionable**
LLMs are good at critique but bad at telling users what to fix next.

Solution:
I introduced a rule-based actionable signals layer, where revision suggestions are derived directly from structured rubric outputs.
This guarantees that every suggestion is grounded, explainable, and consistent.

**3. Avoiding hallucination while still being helpful**
Tools that scrape or retrieve related work often hallucinate comparisons or misrepresent prior research.

Solution:
I intentionally avoided retrieval and instead focused on local evidence from the uploaded paper, extracting short text snippets to justify judgments. This improves trust without adding complexity or cost.

> AI based Risk Prediction Traffic Control System

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenCV](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCV-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![JSON](https://img.shields.io/badge/JSON-333333?style=flat-square) ![Streamlit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Streamlit-333333?style=flat-square) ![Reinforcement learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Reinforcement%20learning-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The Problem: The Flaw of Reactive Governance**

Road and transport safety is one of the most critical civic challenges in India, claiming over 1.5 lakh lives every year. Traditional municipal traffic management is fundamentally crippled by a reactive loop. By the time the issue is resolved, the damage is already done, lives are lost, and hours of citizen productivity are wasted. Traffic lights operate on dumb, static countdown timers oblivious to real vehicle queues, and police deployment happens after a hotspot has already turned fatal.


**The Solution: Answering the Proactive Question**

RoadSense AI flips this paradigm entirely. Instead of waiting for disaster to strike, our system acts on the proactive side. Based on live vehicle kinematics, temporal patterns, and environmental factors, it determines and predicts where the next critical accident hotspot or bottleneck will emerge, and how do we dynamically intervene right now to prevent it from ever happening?

**RoadSense AI answers this through an end-to-end intelligence ecosystem:**

**Real-Time Vision & Kinematics**: Using YOLOv11 detection and ByteTrack multi-object tracking on live CCTV streams, the system monitors  traffic flow, calculating true ground-plane speeds and spatial density via calibrated 4-point perspective homography.

**Dynamic Adaptive Signal Control (DTSC)**: Rather than relying on rigid fixed-timer green lights, our dynamic algorithm calculates real-time green lights to track and monitor traffic violations, serving as a data parameter.

**Longitudinal ML Risk Forecasting**: A leakage-free Supervised ML Risk Forecaster (Random Forest with strict chronological temporal validation) analyzes 50 municipal zones over 52 weeks to forecast future accident probabilities, alerting authorities to deploy preventative patrols and speed-calming measures days before accidents occur.

**Autonomous AI Safety Briefings**: An integrated LLM briefing engine (Llama-3.3-70B / Gemini-2.5-Flash) translates complex kinematic matrices and predictive probabilities into plain-English action-ready guidelines and briefings.

**Flexible Architecture (The highlight of our project)**: 
To bridge the gap between municipal authorities and everyday commuters, RoadSense AI features a flexible public API promoting code visibility. We empower external developers, urban researchers, and civic hackers to build commuter alert apps, navigation aids, and third-party civic tools without reinventing the underlying vision or predictive infrastructure. To show an example we built a civilian frontend as well. 

**Local Admin Command Center (Streamlit)**: An analytical powerhouse built for traffic controllers and municipal planners. It delivers deep telemetry, live CCTV calibration controls, DTSC signal overrides, machine learning diagnostics, and predictive zone ranking leaderboards.

**Civilian Transparency Portal (Web Frontend)**: A lightweight, fast, accessible interface built for the general public. It provides citizens with transparent, real-time visibility into crossroad telemetry, current signal phases, queue states, and road safety indices without overwhelming administrative complexity.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Scarcity of Public Indian Road Datasets**: Unlike Western cities with granular open-data portals, structured zone-by-zone Indian traffic accident and speed telemetry is virtually non-existent in the public domain. We had to invest immense effort researching municipal patterns to establish baseline benchmarks.

**Simulating Databases for Chaotic Indian Road Realities**: Indian roads cannot be modeled using generic simulators designed for lane-disciplined Western traffic. We had to build a custom simulation pipeline (sim.py) that models high-density two-wheeler swarms, auto-rickshaws, erratic lane adherence, festival surges, and monsoon weather severity across 50 municipal sectors.

**Calibrating Predictive Factor Weightage**: Balancing feature weights was a major machine learning challenge. Determining how much influence variables like vehicle density, average speed delta, heavy-vehicle ratio, road surface condition, and weather severity should hold required extensive correlation analyses, SHAP evaluations, and hyperparameter tuning to avoid bias.

**Perspective Homography Calibration**: Converting 2D CCTV pixel coordinates into accurate real-world metric speeds required mapping arbitrary camera angles to a bird's-eye ground plane via 4-point quad homography transforms across varying roadway geometries.

**Eliminating Temporal Data Leakage**: Standard random cross-validation catastrophically leaks future trends into past training on time-series panel data. We engineered a strict chronological split along with rolling and lagged temporal feature extractors to ensure the risk forecaster remains strictly causal and predictive.

Half Engineer addresses this problem by creating an interactive platform where users can upload waste images and locations, helping connect them with proper disposal solutions. **The problem it solves**

# The Why?
We want to model the stock market in such a way that we can capture indirect correlations of each stock with others. This helps us find domino effects in the market and helps us stay ahead of the game

# The How?
Qriya makes use of Granger Causal relations of all 2101 equity stocks on the National Stock Exchange (NSE). This method makes use of pure Mathematics to find real world correlations of stocks.

# The What?
We want to convert this project to an end-to-end product featuring additional analysis tools. Even thought the causal graph is the heart of our project which took 143 mins to compute and with the data collection that took 211 mins.

**Challenges we ran into**

Our hardest challenges were:
1) Getting real-time stock data for screening.
2) Modeling stock cause and effect dynamics using mathematical techniques only.

**GEN AI&ML**

The project makes use of AI and ML concepts to model correlations between stocks in the market. It also makes use of Llama 3 model for its generative needs.

**Best use of GitHub**

### We made use of Agile development using GitHub.
- We divided our work into separate branches for each part of the project including front-end, back-end, and model branches.
- Also, each commit was well written for others to understand.
- This helped us push our codes and merge to the main branch without conflicts.

**Description of your solution**

**TREZI** is an agentic AI companion that helps under-served, early financial life users *plan*, *start*, and *stick* to sensible savings & basic investment behaviors through explainable suggestions and tightly-scoped agentic actions controlled by the user.


**Our Plan of Action**

- Build **Onboarding UI** for risk, income tax questionnaire and store responses for personalization.
- Implement **Emergency Fund Calculator** with a visual progress tracker.
- Create **Goal Management System** to input amount + target date and auto-calculate monthly saving targets.
- Develop **Budget Tracker** with manual entry forms and CSV import parser with automatic categorization.
- Implement **SIP** and **retirement** simulators with formula-based projections and visual charts.
- Integrate **AI chat** interface using RAG + planner module to provide suggestions with explainability.
- Build **Agentic Actions System** with permissions, HITL (*Human-in-the-Loop*) approvals, and dry-run simulations.
- Develop **Dashboards** showing goals, budget, and SIP progress, along with push/email notifications and audit logging.
- Add *compliance* and *safety screens* for disclaimers, privacy info, and KYC placeholders, ensuring secure data storage.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Key pain points addressed**

- **Financial literacy gaps**: Chat assistant and microcopy explain concepts in plain language, with scenario demos showing tradeoffs.
- **Decision paralysis**: TREZI provides one-click goals and monthly targets.
- **Irregular income planning**: Gig workers can set flexible SIP rules based on incoming payments.
- **Low trust in opaque AI advice**: TREZI enforces explainability, shows assumptions, and uses HITL approval for agentic steps.
- **Lack of habit formation**: Actionable nudges and permissioned agentic actions help users follow through.
- **Complexity of tax and time planning**: Simple tax buckets and retirement calculators translate concepts into clear monthly steps.
- **Safety concerns**: No autopilot money movement in MVP; actions are suggested with audit trails and opt-in KYC for future upgrades.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Our Target Audience**

TREZI targets the large, tech-savvy youth and early-professional population in India, with initial pilots focused on students and early-career users.

***College Students***: Need guidance for saving, budgeting, and building emergency funds; reached via campus ambassadors.

***Early-Career Professionals***: Seek automated savings, SIP tracking, and retirement planning; reached via professional communities and referrals.

***Gig Workers / Freelancers***: Require flexible, goal-based saving rules for irregular income; reached via gig platforms and fintech partnerships.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Go-To-Market Strategy**

TREZI will enter the market as a **freemium** AI finance companion, targeting young professionals and first-time investors seeking automated, personalized money guidance. The initial launch will focus on ***Tier 1 & 2 Indian cities*** through college finance clubs, fintech communities, and LinkedIn influencer collaborations, building trust via real-world financial literacy drives and interactive demo workshops.

A **Viral Referral Model** — “Invite a Friend, Earn SmartPoints” — will accelerate user acquisition. Early users gain AI insights free for 3 months, creating stickiness through habit formation. Integration with UPI, Zerodha, Groww, and insurance APIs enables real-time financial tracking and auto-recommendations, enhancing everyday relevance.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Revenue Streams**

💎 Freemium to Premium Subscriptions (AI-driven portfolio management & advanced insights)
🪙 Affiliate Partnerships with investment & insurance platforms (commission-based)
🧩 White-labeled API licensing to banks and fintechs seeking AI-agent integration

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

TREZI is an agentic AI-powered personal finance assistant that transforms financial planning into an interactive, explainable, and automated experience. It helps users build emergency funds, set and track savings goals, simulate SIP growth, estimate taxes, and receive tailored investment recommendations, all within a secure, permissioned environment. TREZI’s planner + RAG + rules-based AI engine enables the system to reason, plan, and act safely with human-in-the-loop approval. With dry-run simulations, compliance layers (KYC, AML, audit logs), and contextual explainability, TREZI bridges the gap between financial awareness and financial action, empowering students, gig workers, and young earners to take control of their financial future with confidence and clarity.

> From Upload to Approval in Moments.

![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square) ![langchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/langchain-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

**Problem Statement:**
Traditional KYC (Know Your Customer) processes are time-consuming, labor-intensive, and prone to human error. Financial institutions, banks, and fintech startups spend significant resources on document verification, liveness checks, and identity validation, often causing delays in onboarding.

**The Problem:**
- Manual KYC takes hours to days.
- Human verification introduces subjectivity and errors.
- Fraudulent document submission and identity spoofing are hard to detect.
- High operational cost for organizations.

**Our Solution:**
Kyra provides a fully automated, agentic KYC platform with two dashboards

1. Admin Panel: For initiating KYC and monitoring user status
2. User Panel: For users to submit details and documents

**Workflow:**
**1. KYC Initialization by Admin:**

   - Admin creates a KYC request by entering the user’s username, email, and phone number.
   - The user receives an email invitation to start the KYC process.

**2. User Onboarding:**
   
   - The user clicks the link and opens the user panel.
   - Step 1: Submit basic personal information: name, DOB, gender, address, etc.
   - Step 2: Upload proofs for permanent and correspondence addresses (e.g., Aadhaar, Passport, Voter Card, etc).
   - The system checks for document tampering.
   - If tampered, an error is shown, and the user is prompted to re-upload documents.

**3. Liveness & Selfie Verification:**

- The user submits a selfie.
- Liveness detection ensures that the selfie is authentic.
- If liveness fails, the user is prompted to re-upload a valid selfie.

**4. Form Preview & Consent:**

- User reviews the submitted information.
- Provides consent to proceed with KYC verification.

**5. AI Agent Processing**:
- Multiple AI agents validate the submission:
- Data Extractor & Validator: Extract and cross-verify details from documents.
- Photo Extractor: Extract ID photo for matching.
- Photo Matcher: Compare document photo with the selfie.
- Aadhaar Masker: Mask sensitive Aadhaar details for privacy.
- Liveness Checker & Tamper Detector: Ensure document integrity and live user.

**6. KYC Outcome:**
*Pass:*
- User receives an instant success email.

*Fail:*
- Admin reviews the failed KYC and decides whether to trigger a re-KYC (user resubmits) or proceed with a manual KYC.
- The corresponding email is sent to the user based on the admin’s decision.
- The admin resolves the issues highlighted by AI agents within 3–4 working days.
- Admin panel shows potential issues for each failed KYC to assist in decision-making.

**Key Advantages:**

- Fully automated end-to-end KYC for valid submissions.
- Instant feedback to users on errors.
- Manual intervention only for exceptions, reducing operational load.
- Detailed insights for admins to quickly resolve failed cases.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Kyra is a perfect fit for the FinTech + Agentic AI theme because it leverages autonomous AI agents to solve a core financial services problem: digital onboarding and KYC verification.

**FinTech Relevance:**

KYC (Know Your Customer) is a mandatory regulatory requirement in banking, payments, insurance, and other financial services.

Traditional KYC processes are manual, slow, and costly, creating friction for both users and businesses.

By automating KYC, Kyra directly enhances customer onboarding, reduces operational costs, and mitigates fraud risks in FinTech operations.

**Agentic AI Integration:**

Multiple AI agents autonomously handle tasks such as:
- Document tamper detection
- Data extraction and validation
- Liveness detection for selfie verification
- Photo matching and sensitive data masking
- These agents make independent decisions without human intervention, exemplifying agentic AI.
- Admin intervention is only needed for exceptions, allowing the system to self-manage routine operations.

**Impact on Financial Services:**

1. Faster onboarding: Users can complete KYC in minutes instead of hours/days.
2. Fraud prevention: AI agents detect tampered documents and spoofing attempts automatically.
3. Operational efficiency: Significantly reduces manpower required for manual KYC.
4. Scalability: Agentic AI enables financial institutions to onboard large volumes of users simultaneously.

**Innovation in FinTech:**

Kyra demonstrates autonomous decision-making agents in a regulated financial domain.

It blends AI, compliance, and security, solving a real-world pain point in digital finance.

Represents the next-generation KYC solution where human effort is minimized, but accountability and compliance remain intact.

**The problem it solves**

Obscurix – AI-Powered Data Redaction & Leak Prevention Platform

- Obsturix tackles the critical issue of data and code leakage by detecting and redacting sensitive information in real time — whether shared as text or image — across platforms like Twitter, Reddit, Stack Overflow, and ChatGPT.

- The model proactively blocks the sharing of sensitive code or credentials to any AI model (like ChatGPT) or social platforms, while ensuring no data is stored or logged at any stage — making it one of the most secure leak-prevention systems available.

- With Strict and Creative Modes, Obsturix uses Generative AI to either redact or intelligently rephrase text to preserve tone, reduce negativity, and protect privacy in user communication.

- Complete with an admin dashboard, OCR-based browser extension to social platforms like Twitter or Reddit, and enterprise-ready safeguards, Obsturix is deployed via AWS EC2 and maintained on GitHub for secure, scalable, and collaborative development.

**Challenges we ran into**

- Building models that detect and block sensitive code or text without storing a single byte of user data was a major challenge — requiring custom pipelines that operate in-memory with strict privacy boundaries. But we came over it using GitHub and it pipelines.

- Ensuring smooth, real-time detection across platforms like ChatGPT, Reddit, Stack Overflow, and Twitter demanded complex integration logic, OCR support for images, and deep pattern recognition to avoid false positives. But it was successfully resolved.

- We unfortunately were facing issues integrating multiple languages("Spanish", "Hindi" and "Telugu") but still managed to successfully overcome them.

**GEN AI&ML**

**1. Context-Aware Redaction:** Instead of using static patterns or regex, Obscurix uses Generative AI models (like Gemini) to understand and redact contextually sensitive information — such as API keys, passwords, or even proprietary logic — across natural and programming languages.

**2. Language-Agnostic Understanding:** By leveraging GenAI’s multi-lingual understanding, Obscurix can intelligently redact text in Hindi, Telugu, and more — a capability beyond rule-based NLP.

**3. Code Transformation via GenAI:** Your system doesn’t just redact — it transforms code into pseudocode with explanations using generative reasoning. This means your AI isn’t just censoring; it’s reconstructing meaningful and shareable alternatives to sensitive content.

**Best use of GitHub**

- Used GitHub for full-stack project management — frontend, backend, and deployment.

- Leveraged GitHub Actions to set up a CI/CD pipeline that auto-deploys backend to AWS EC2.

- Followed proper Git workflow — forking, cloning, branching, and pull requests.

- Utilized GitHub Desktop for easy local commits and version control.

- Managed all code collaboration, history, and issue tracking via GitHub.

**Best Use of AWS**

-  Comprehensive CI/CD with GitHub Actions + EC2 Integration
- We have set up a fully automated CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions to be able to push backend changes to our Amazon EC2 instance, enabling zero-downtime deployment and ensuring we have rapid iteration.
- Secure and Scalable Infrastructure with  EC2 + EBS
- Backend is hosted on Amazon EC2 (t2.micro) with Amazon EBS attached for persistent and durable storage. We’ve configured a custom security group, ensuring secure monitored inbound/outbound traffic and data integrity.
- Proactive Monitoring with Amazon CloudWatch
- We use CloudWatch alarms to monitor critical metrics like CPU usage, enabling quick alerts and scaling decisions. This ensures uptime and performance reliability under high user loads.
- Fine-Grained Access with IAM Roles
- AWS IAM roles and policies are used to restrict access to EC2 and EBS resources, ensuring that only authorized services and scripts can interact with our infrastructure securely.
- Scalability & Resilience Built-In
Our architecture leverages serverless-friendly practices (stateless front end on Vercel, persistent storage on EBS, scalable compute on EC2), making the system scalable, resilient, and ready for production traffic without reengineering.

# Drishti – AI Assistant for the Blind

HackOdisha 5.0 Submission | Assistive AI that sees, understands, and acts for you

Drishti (meaning “vision” in Hindi) is an accessible AI assistant designed to empower blind and visually impaired users. It enables hands-free interaction with a PC via voice, describes the world and the screen in real-time using multimodal AI, and helps communicate through email and WhatsApp.

---

## Why This Matters
- Current reality: Many blind and visually impaired users face barriers in independently using mainstream computers and applications. Screen readers are powerful but can be slow, verbose, and struggle with dynamic or poorly labeled interfaces. Visual context such as images, charts, and on-screen states often remains inaccessible.
- Scale of the challenge: Global estimates indicate that more than two billion people live with some form of vision impairment, with hundreds of millions experiencing moderate-to-severe vision loss. A significant portion of this population encounters daily barriers in education, employment, and digital communication.
- Gaps today:
  - Complex, dynamic UIs are difficult to navigate solely through keyboard and screen readers
  - Visual-only content (images, PDFs, unlabeled buttons) lacks accessible descriptions
  - Fragmented workflows across messaging, email, browsing, and utilities
  - Cost, language support, and connectivity constraints limit access to advanced tools

### How Drishti Helps
- Multimodal understanding: Describes the screen and webcam view on demand, making visual context accessible in plain language
- Voice-first control: Hands-free interaction for speed and ease
- Unified assistant: Email, WhatsApp, web search, and on-screen descriptions from one place
- Safety and clarity: Confirmation for sensitive actions; concise and direct responses tailored for screen readers
- Privacy-aware: Secrets and tokens ignored by version control; local audio generation and cleanup
- Practical and affordable: Built on widely available tooling and services with simple setup

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/030afbb4dd0b472c8971857ce520e55d/3d6aea86-094d-432e-bcb3-3990313f3bbd.jpeg)

## Highlights
- Built for HackOdisha 5.0 with a strong focus on accessibility and independence
- End-to-end workflow: Voice in → Intelligent actions → Voice out
- Multimodal Gemini integration: understands both text and images (screen and webcam)
- Privacy-first defaults: secrets and tokens are git-ignored

---

## Full Feature Set
- Voice Interaction
  - Speech-to-Text via a lightweight web recognizer (automated with Selenium/Chrome)
  - Robust handling of pauses and silence, simple language selection (default en-US)
- Natural Voice Output
  - Edge TTS (en-US-JennyNeural) with offline audio playback using Pygame
  - Automatic MP3 cleanup after playback
- Describe What’s Around You
  - Webcam capture with OpenCV → short, focused descriptions from Gemini
- Describe What’s On Your Screen
  - Full-screen capture with mss → concise screen summaries from Gemini
- Gmail Integration
  - Read latest emails (sender + subject)
  - Send emails to known contacts via Gmail API (OAuth flow handled)
- WhatsApp Support
  - Send messages instantly to known contacts (pywhatkit)
  - Initiate voice/video calls via UI automation (pyautogui)
- Web Search
  - Google search with top results summarized (title, snippet, URL)
- Conversation Memory
  - Persistent conversation_log.txt with automatic summarization when large
- Safety & Confirmation
  - Sensitive actions can be gated behind explicit confirmation
- Configurable
  - .env for secrets, contact maps in code, adjustable limits and timeouts

---

- Python, Selenium (Chrome), OpenCV, mss, Pillow
- Google Gemini (google-generativeai / google-genai)
- Edge TTS + Pygame
- Gmail API (google-api-python-client + auth libs)
- pywhatkit, pyautogui, googlesearch-python

- Software: Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, WhatsApp Desktop

**The problem it solves**

For millions of people living with severe motor **disabilities, paralysis, or conditions like autism** something as simple as moving a mouse cursor or typing on a keyboard can be incredibly difficult or impossible. It's heartbreaking to think about how this cuts people off from basic digital interactions that most of us take for granted things like sending a message, browsing the web, or even just playing a game.
The assistive technologies that do exist often come with their own problems. They're usually expensive (They be talking thousands of dollars), complicated to set up, and frankly, out of reach for the average person who needs them. This leaves too many people stuck without viable options for communicating, learning, or simply maintaining their independence in our increasingly digital world.
That's exactly why we created BLINK OS. We saw this gap this real need for something that was both affordable and actually worked well and knew we had to do something about it. Our goal was simple: give people a tool that lets them interact with technology as naturally and effortlessly as possible, without breaking the bank or requiring a computer science degree to figure out.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building **BLINK OS** wasn't easy we ran into quite a few roadblocks along the way. The biggest challenge? Getting precise eye tracking to work without expensive, professional-grade equipment. We quickly discovered that things like changing lighting conditions and varying camera quality could throw off the accuracy, which was frustrating but taught us a lot.
We also had to figure out how to make the system work for everyone, regardless of their eye shape, how they position their head, or their unique circumstances. This meant countless hours of testing and tweaking until we got it right. Then there was the technical hurdle of eliminating lag and jittery movements nobody wants a cursor that jumps around or makes their eyes tired from overcompensating.
Perhaps the trickiest part was striking the right balance in our interface design. We needed something that people with severe motor disabilities could use effortlessly, but we also wanted to pack in powerful features. It took a lot of careful planning and user feedback to create something that felt both simple and sophisticated.

**Groq track**

AutoAgentDesk leverages Groq's high-performance LLM inference capabilities to power its intelligent log analysis system. The integration is designed with careful consideration of Groq's unique advantages:
- Optimized Token Management: The system implements specialized compression and truncation logic specifically for Groq models (if self.provider == "groq") to maximize performance while staying within token limits. This includes smart prioritization of critical database and system error logs.
- Fallback Architecture: Your system intelligently handles API authentication issues by implementing fallback mechanisms, ensuring reliability when using Groq's services.
- Multi-Model Support: The project seamlessly integrates Groq's Llama-3 models alongside other providers, allowing users to choose the best model for their specific needs while maintaining a consistent interface.

**InfinyOn/Fluvio Track**

AutoAgentDesk seamlessly integrates with InfinyOn's Fluvio streaming platform to enable real-time log ingestion and analysis capabilities:
- Real-time Streaming Architecture: The system uses Fluvio's producers and consumers (fluvio_producer.py and fluvio_consumer.py) to handle continuous streams of log data from various sources, enabling real-time monitoring and alerting.
- Decoupled Processing: By implementing the Fluvio consumer pattern, AutoAgentDesk can process incoming log data asynchronously, ensuring the system remains responsive even under high log volumes.
- Multi-source Integration: The Fluvio streaming backbone allows AutoAgentDesk to ingest logs from diverse sources (databases, cloud services, local files) and normalize them into a unified format for consistent analysis.

**Challenges we ran into**

# Technical Challenges

Building Pounce was far more than creating another e-commerce website. It required solving engineering challenges across **real-time graphics, networking, AI, machine learning, and distributed systems**. Every feature from a living 3D shopping world to AI employees and secure background automation had to work together seamlessly while remaining responsive and scalable for thousands of concurrent users.

- **Building a Living 3D World**  
  Creating a realistic shopping experience using **Three.js** was one of the biggest challenges. We had to build an optimized 3D environment with interactive stores, realistic lighting, animated products, and NPCs that continuously walk around, browse items, and perform natural actions so the world feels alive instead of static.

- **Character Animation & Movement**  
  Designing player avatars with smooth walking, running, idle, and interaction animations required careful animation blending and synchronization. Every movement had to feel natural while remaining responsive across different devices.

- **Real-Time Multiplayer & Voice Communication**  
  Synchronizing multiple players inside the same virtual world with minimal latency was a major challenge. Player positions, animations, interactions, and **real-time speech-to-speech communication** all needed to stay perfectly synchronized to create a natural collaborative shopping experience.

- **Multi-Agent AI System**  
  Instead of relying on a single chatbot, we built a **multi-agent architecture** where each AI employee specializes in a specific tasks - greeter, sales associate, stockroom assistant, and cashier. Managing agent coordination, conversation context, and smooth handoffs between them required careful orchestration.

- **Real-Time AR Try-On**  
  Unlike traditional virtual try-on systems that rely on uploading an image, our goal was a **live AR experience**. This required machine learning models capable of real-time body and foot tracking, accurate product alignment, and low-latency rendering while users move naturally.

- **Scalable Background Workers**  
  Features like **Pounce Watcher** continuously monitor product availability and pricing. Designing a background worker architecture capable of processing thousands of monitoring jobs simultaneously without impacting user-facing services was a significant engineering challenge.

- **Redis, Queues & Distributed Processing**  
  Managing large-scale asynchronous workloads required careful use of **Redis**, distributed queues, caching, job retries, duplicate prevention, worker recovery, and queue prioritization to keep the system reliable under heavy traffic.

- **Performance & Scalability**  
  Bringing together real-time 3D rendering, multiplayer networking, AI agents, AR processing, voice communication, and background automation while maintaining a smooth experience for thousands of concurrent users required extensive optimization across the entire stack.

**The problem it solves**

# The Problem

Online shopping today is a **solitary experience**. You scroll through endless product images with no shopkeeper to consult, no friend beside you, and little confidence that a product will meet your expectations. Most decisions rely on **anonymous reviews and ratings**, which can be misleading or manipulated.

Meanwhile, AI shopping agents expect users to trust them with purchases and payment credentials, hoping they choose the right product without overspending. That isn't true trust.

## What is Pounce?

**Pounce** transforms online shopping into a **shared 3D retail experience**. Enter a virtual store with friends, interact with AI-powered staff, explore products from live merchant catalogs, try products in AR, and pay securely through **Prava**, ensuring every purchase stays within the limits you approve.

## Key Features

- **Shop Together** — Walk through the same virtual store with friends, discuss products in real time, and make purchase decisions collaboratively instead of shopping alone.

- **Real Reviews from Real Owners** — Talk directly to people who already own a product and hear genuine first-hand experiences instead of relying only on anonymous ratings.

- **AI Store Staff** — Meet specialized AI assistants including a greeter, sales associate, stockroom assistant, and cashier, creating the experience of a real retail store.

- **AR Try-On** — See products such as shoes or accessories on yourself in real time before making a purchase.

- **Secure Payments with Prava** — Approve purchases with a passkey while your card details remain hidden. Prava issues a **single-use credential** limited to one merchant and one approved amount, preventing unauthorized spending.

- **Pounce Watcher** — Set conditions like *"Buy this when my size is back in stock,"* and Pounce automatically monitors availability and completes the purchase when your condition is met.

## Why Pounce?

Pounce makes shopping **social, trustworthy, and secure**. Instead of replacing human decisions, it combines real conversations, immersive shopping, AI assistance, and secure payments  by keeping users fully in control while making online shopping feel like visiting a real store.

**Best Visa Intelligent Commerce Implementation**

Pounce's checkout is powered by **Visa Intelligent Commerce through Prava**, enabling AI agents to complete purchases without ever exposing a user's payment credentials. At checkout, users approve the purchase with a **passkey**, after which Prava issues a **single-use Visa payment credential** that is strictly **scoped to one merchant and one approved amount**. The AI agent completes the transaction using this credential, while the user's actual card details never reach either Pounce or the merchant.

The same security model extends to **autonomous purchasing** through **Pounce Watcher**. During setup, users authorize a **Visa-backed Prava mandate** with a one-time passkey, defining the maximum amount and the specific merchant the agent is allowed to purchase from. When the user's condition such as a price drop or product restock is met, the watcher securely executes the purchase within those predefined limits. Prava again generates a **single-use Visa credential**, allowing the AI agent to complete the checkout automatically without requiring another approval.

## Why It Matters

Traditional AI shopping agents require users to trust the model with their payment information. Pounce removes that trust assumption by building on **Prava's implementation of Visa Intelligent Commerce**, where security is enforced by the payment infrastructure itself rather than the AI agent.

Through **Prava**, users benefit from:

- **Card details are never shared** with either Pounce or the merchant.
- **Single-use Visa payment credentials** that expire immediately after a successful transaction.
- **Merchant- and amount-scoped credentials**, ensuring payments can only be used for the approved merchant and spending limit.
- **Visa-backed Prava mandates** for autonomous purchases, allowing payments only within the limits the user has pre-approved.
- **Passkey-based authorization**, ensuring users remain in control while AI agents securely complete the shopping workflow.

By combining Pounce's AI-powered shopping experience with **Prava's secure payment infrastructure built on Visa Intelligent Commerce**, agentic commerce becomes both autonomous and trustworthy.

**Most Startup-Ready Product**

Pounce is built to be a **real product**, not just a hackathon demo. It is the **social, trustworthy front door for agentic commerce**, combining immersive shopping, AI agents, AR, multiplayer experiences, and secure payments powered by **Prava**.

## Why Pounce is Startup Ready

* **Production Ready Product**  
  Pounce already delivers a complete end to end shopping experience. Users can enter a 3D virtual store, interact with specialized AI staff, browse live merchant catalogs, try products on using AR, and complete secure purchases through Prava with passkey authentication. Features like **Pounce Watcher** automatically purchase products when user defined conditions such as price drops or restocks are met.

* **Clear Customer Segments**  
  Pounce serves two distinct audiences:
  * **Shoppers** looking for a social, immersive, and trustworthy alternative to traditional online shopping.
  * **Merchants** who want an AI powered 3D storefront connected to their existing catalog while using Prava's secure payment infrastructure without handling sensitive card information.

## Revenue Model

Pounce combines marketplace revenue with a token economy that continuously encourages purchases and user engagement.

* **Commission on Every Order**  
  Pounce earns a commission on every successful purchase completed through the platform using Prava.

* **Purchase Rewards Through Tokens**  
  Every successful purchase rewards users with **Pounce Tokens**. Since tokens are earned only through real purchases, the ecosystem naturally encourages more shopping, generating more merchant sales and increasing platform revenue.

* **Avatar Skins and Cosmetics**  
  Users can spend earned tokens on avatar customization, while premium cosmetic items are available for direct purchase, creating a high margin digital revenue stream.

* **Token Powered Discounts**  
  Users can redeem accumulated tokens for discount coupons on future purchases, encouraging repeat shopping and improving long term retention.

* **Merchant Platform Fees**  
  Brands can launch customized 3D storefronts inside Pounce and pay recurring subscription or setup fees for branded experiences, in addition to marketplace commissions.

## Why Users Keep Coming Back

* **Real Reviews from Real Owners**  
  Instead of relying on anonymous ratings, users can speak directly with people who already own a product inside the multiplayer world and receive genuine first hand feedback before making a purchase.

* **A Social Shopping Destination**  
  Pounce is more than a checkout page. Users can meet friends, discover new people, explore stores together, and spend time inside a living virtual world.

* **Rewards on Every Purchase**  
  Tokens, cosmetic unlocks, and discount coupons create continuous incentives for users to shop through Pounce instead of directly from a merchant's website.

* **A Platform That Continues to Grow**  
  Pounce can naturally expand with future experiences such as full VR support, interactive games, live events, and community spaces, transforming it into both a shopping platform and an entertainment destination.

## Virality and Network Effects

Pounce becomes more valuable as its community grows.

* More shoppers create a richer multiplayer experience.
* More verified product owners provide more trustworthy recommendations.
* Friends naturally invite friends to shop together.
* The token economy rewards engagement and encourages repeat participation.

Every new user makes the platform more social, more informative, and more engaging, creating strong organic network effects.

## One Line Pitch

**Shopping evolved from physical stores into lonely product pages. Pounce brings the store back with AI powered staff, multiplayer shopping, live AR try ons, authentic human recommendations, secure Prava payments, and a token economy that rewards every purchase, building the consumer front door for the agentic commerce era.**

**OpenAI**

OpenAI serves as the **reasoning engine** behind Pounce's multi-agent shopping experience. Rather than using a single chatbot, Pounce is built around **five specialized AI agents** that work together to recreate the experience of shopping inside a real retail store.

## How OpenAI Powers Pounce

- **Specialized AI Employees**  
  Every AI employee in Pounce has a dedicated responsibility. The **Greeter** welcomes users and understands their intent, the **Sales Associate** recommends products based on preferences, the **Stockroom Helper** checks availability and reserves inventory, the **Fitting Room Assistant** guides users through the AR try-on experience, and the **Cashier** prepares the final checkout. Each agent focuses on its own task while collaborating with the others to deliver a seamless shopping journey.

- **Natural Shopping Conversations**  
  Users interact with AI employees through natural voice or text conversations instead of navigating traditional filters. The agents understand shopping intent, answer product-related questions, compare alternatives, explain recommendations, and guide users through the store just like a knowledgeable salesperson.

- **Intelligent Agent Collaboration**  
  The shopping experience is powered by multiple agents working together rather than independently. As a user progresses through the store, conversations and context flow naturally between agents, creating a continuous experience from product discovery to checkout without requiring the user to repeat information.

- **Personalized Decision Making**  
  Every agent has access to the user's shopping persona and preferences through Senso. Recommendations are based on the user's style, budget, favorite brands, previous purchases, and shopping history instead of generic product rankings.

- **Action-Oriented AI**  
  The agents do more than answer questions. They actively search live merchant catalogs, verify product information, check inventory, reserve products, prepare checkout, and coordinate with Prava to complete secure purchases, making them active participants in the shopping journey rather than passive assistants.

## Why OpenAI Makes Pounce Different

Most AI shopping assistants function as conversational chatbots that simply answer questions. Pounce uses OpenAI to build a **true multi-agent retail ecosystem**, where AI employees collaborate just like staff inside a physical store.

- **Five specialized AI employees** instead of one generic assistant.
- **Natural conversations** that replace traditional product search and filtering.
- **Collaborative agent workflows** that mirror the experience of visiting a real store.
- **Personalized recommendations** powered by persistent user memory from Senso.
- **Real-world actions**, including product discovery, inventory management, checkout preparation, and secure purchasing through Prava.

OpenAI is the intelligence layer that enables every AI employee to reason, collaborate, and assist users throughout the complete shopping journey, transforming online shopping into an immersive, human-like retail experience.

**Agent Commerce Discovery & Trust**

Senso is the **context, memory, and knowledge layer** behind Pounce. It enables every AI agent to make decisions using verified information and persistent user context rather than isolated prompts. From powering the Drops feed to delivering personalized recommendations, Senso ensures every shopping experience becomes smarter over time.

## How Senso Powers Pounce

- **Verified Drops Feed**  
  Every new product drop, including its name, merchant, price, availability, and metadata, is ingested into Senso's knowledge base. When users browse the **Drops** tab, Pounce queries Senso to retrieve and verify each product, allowing every drop to display a **"Verified via Senso"** badge backed by a trusted source of truth instead of an unverified product listing.

- **Personalized From Day One**  
  During onboarding, users define their shopping preferences such as **style, budget, favorite colors, brands, and priorities**. This shopper persona is stored in Senso, allowing every AI agent to understand the user's preferences from the very first interaction and recommend products that genuinely match their taste.

- **Continuous Learning**  
  Every purchase, product interaction, and shopping decision is written back to Senso. This persistent memory enables the AI agents to continuously refine their understanding of the user, making future recommendations increasingly accurate and personalized.

- **Shared Context Across All AI Agents**  
  Every specialized AI employee, from the Sales Associate to the Cashier, accesses the same contextual memory stored in Senso. This allows conversations to remain consistent throughout the shopping journey without forcing users to repeat their preferences or previous decisions.

## Why Senso Makes Pounce Different

Most shopping platforms rely on **generic recommendation engines** that have little understanding of individual users and often surface products without meaningful verification.

With Senso, Pounce provides:

- **Verified product drops** backed by a structured knowledge base.
- **Persistent user memory** that carries across every shopping session.
- **Personalized recommendations** based on long-term preferences instead of one-time prompts.
- **Continuously improving AI agents** that become smarter after every interaction and purchase.
- **Graceful fallback support**, ensuring the experience remains responsive even if cloud-based knowledge services are temporarily unavailable.

By combining **verified knowledge**, **persistent memory**, and **continuous learning**, Senso enables Pounce to deliver a shopping experience that is significantly more **personal, trustworthy, and context-aware** than traditional e-commerce platforms.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/1d9a73e1b7a84cd0bbe94ea0a01b274f/8ee21a33-f08b-4346-875d-8a97efbdef96.png)

**Best Agentic User Experience**

Pounce is designed to make AI agents feel like **real store employees**, not just another chatbot. Instead of interacting with a single assistant, users meet **five specialized agents** - a **Greeter**, **Sales Associate**, **Stockroom Helper**, **Fitting Room Assistant**, and **Cashier** , each responsible for a specific part of the shopping journey inside an immersive 3D world.

The agents handle the repetitive work, from discovering products and checking inventory to reserving stock and preparing checkout, while the user always remains in control by approving payments with a **passkey**. Beyond AI assistance, users can **try products on in real time using AR** and **talk to real product owners** inside the multiplayer world to hear authentic first-hand experiences.

By combining specialized AI agents, immersive 3D interactions, AR visualization, and real human conversations, Pounce recreates the feeling of walking into a physical store with friends which makes online shopping more **natural, trustworthy, and engaging**.

**Agentic Commerce Hackathon**

Pounce is built as a complete **end-to-end agentic commerce platform**, where AI agents assist throughout the entire shopping journey while users remain in full control. From discovering products to completing purchases, every stage is powered by specialized agents working together securely and intelligently.

## How It Works

- **AI-Powered Shopping**  
  Specialized AI agents understand user preferences, recommend products, answer questions, and retrieve items from live merchant catalogs through **Shopify UCP**, creating a personalized shopping experience.

- **Secure Agentic Checkout**  
  During checkout, **Prava** issues a **single-use payment credential** that is restricted to one merchant and one approved amount. The AI agent completes the purchase on the user's behalf, while the actual card details never reach either Pounce or the merchant.

- **Autonomous Purchase Automation**
    With **Pounce Watcher**, users can set a persistent intent such as *"Buy these when my size is back in stock."* Setting this up requires a **one-time passkey authorization**, where the user approves a **Prava mandate** that is scoped to a specific merchant and capped at a maximum amount.
Once authorized, the watcher continuously monitors product availability and pricing in the background. When the specified condition is met, it automatically charges the **pre-authorized Prava mandate** without requiring another passkey. Prava then issues a **single-use payment credential** restricted to the approved merchant and amount, allowing the AI agent to securely complete the purchase on the user's behalf while the user's card details never reach either Pounce or the merchant.

## Why It Matters

Pounce demonstrates what **agentic commerce** is meant to be: AI agents handle product discovery, recommendations, monitoring, and checkout autonomously, while **passkey-based approval and Prava's secure payment infrastructure** ensure users always stay in complete control of their purchases.

**The problem it solves**

This project is a Human Skill Intelligence platform focused on improving communication and soft skills, especially for Gen Z. As digital-first interactions replace face-to-face communication, many people struggle with confidence, clarity, and professional expression.

The platform provides a safe, realistic environment to practice interviews and conversations, objectively evaluating how users communicate — not just what they say. Using a three-layer system (perception, cognition, and decision), it analyzes speech patterns, language structure, and presence to generate clear scores and actionable feedback.

By turning high-stakes human interactions into trainable, measurable skills, the platform helps users build confidence, improve clarity, and track real progress over time.

This is not a chatbot — it is infrastructure for developing human communication skills at scale.

**Challenges we ran into**

The biggest challenge was designing an objective system to evaluate inherently subjective human skills like confidence, clarity, and communication. Early approaches relying purely on language models produced generic or overly optimistic feedback, forcing us to rethink how human behavior should be measured.

Building a multi-modal perception layer introduced additional complexity — aligning text, audio, and video signals into a consistent feature format while keeping the system efficient and explainable required careful design and iteration.

Integrating real-time components (video sessions, speech analysis, scoring, and feedback) while maintaining low latency and stability was another major challenge, especially when working with limited hardware and without relying on heavy cloud infrastructure.

Finally, balancing realism with feasibility — particularly around AI avatars and real-time interaction — required several architectural pivots to ensure the platform remained practical, scalable, and hackathon-ready.

**Creative Use of Kiro**

Project Link: https://aura-emotion-client.netlify.app/

Kiro was used as an active co-creator throughout the project lifecycle, not just as a coding assistant. It played a key role in ideation, rapid prototyping, and vibe coding complex features that required fast iteration.

During early stages, Kiro was used for problem framing and system design, helping translate abstract ideas around communication, psychology, and soft-skills evaluation into a concrete multi-layer architecture. As development progressed, Kiro enabled rapid prototyping of perception, decision, and feedback pipelines by generating and refining code snippets, data formats, and scoring logic in real time.

For UI and interaction flows, Kiro supported vibe coding — quickly shaping user experiences, refining interaction logic, and experimenting with feature variations without breaking development momentum. This allowed the team to move faster, test assumptions early, and iterate confidently.

Overall, Kiro functioned as a thinking partner and accelerator, helping bridge high-level ideas with working implementation under tight hackathon constraints.

**ELeven Labs**

The project integrates ElevenLabs’ neural Text-to-Speech API to give the AI interviewer a natural, human-like voice, enabling realistic spoken interactions during practice sessions.

AI-generated responses are dynamically converted into high-quality speech using ElevenLabs’ multilingual neural voice models, with configurable voice parameters for stability, style, and similarity. Audio is generated in real time during live sessions and delivered with low latency to maintain conversational flow.

The system supports multiple voice profiles, session-based audio handling, and both streaming and file-based playback. To ensure reliability, the platform gracefully falls back to text-only interaction if voice synthesis is unavailable.

This integration significantly enhances immersion and engagement, transforming the experience from a text-based interaction into a realistic, voice-driven interview environment.
