https://medium.com/@jindalrakshit85/building-aura-what-i-learned-about-communication-ai-and-myself-while-building-this-project-e5408a3970a2

**Gemini API**

AURA uses Google’s Gemini 2.0 Flash model as its core conversational intelligence, accessed through OpenRouter to enable fast, context-aware interview interactions and structured feedback generation.

OpenRouter acts as a unified gateway, allowing the project to access Gemini models using an OpenAI-compatible SDK with a single API key. This setup simplifies provider management while ensuring cost efficiency and low-latency responses during live interview sessions.

Gemini 2.0 Flash is used for:

Generating realistic, adaptive interviewer questions during conversations

Producing personalized, structured feedback based on ML-generated communication scores

The model is optimized for real-time dialogue, providing natural responses without the overhead of heavier reasoning models. Conversation history is maintained to ensure continuity, while fallback mechanisms ensure the system remains functional even if the API is unavailable.

This integration allows AURA to deliver human-like, intelligent interview interactions while remaining fast, reliable, and scalable — making it well-suited for live soft-skill practice scenarios.

### Nextrace(CrossLink)
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/nextracecrosslink-bf35) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/chaudhuriahana2007-art/nextrace_crosslink) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://nextrace-crosslink.vercel.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/Y8NWG0rHaDg) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-DOMINION%202026-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://dominion2026.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-6-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Fast solution for critical moments

![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Crosslink solves the problem of delayed and disconnected missing-person searches. Today, information about a missing person may stay with one police station, so a sighting in another city or district may not be matched quickly. Crosslink connects these reports and sightings in one system and uses AI to identify possible matches in real time.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building CrossLink required solving several critical issues across vector mathematics, computer vision limitations, and frontend data handling.

Vector Metric Discrepancy: We initially configured pgvector and face-api.js to use Cosine similarity. We discovered that this metric ignores vector magnitude, crushing real human faces into a dangerously narrow band and causing massive false positives (22 out of 24 incorrect matches during testing). We had to drop the database index and migrate the entire matching architecture to Euclidean (L2) distance to achieve accurate cluster gaps.

Low-Resolution False Confidence: We found that small input faces lacked enough visual feature density, causing the recognition model to mathematically "guess" missing details and confidently match completely different strangers. We solved this by engineering a strict 110px dimensional guardrail that blocks low-quality crops before they hit the database.

Metadata Destruction: We originally planned to extract EXIF GPS data server-side, but realized our canvas re-encoding step (captureFrame()) permanently destroyed the tags. We had to shift EXIF extraction entirely to the client-side browser before processing. Furthermore, social platforms like WhatsApp strip metadata entirely, requiring us to build graceful fallback UI badges (no-gps, no-exif) instead of relying on guaranteed coordinates.

Atomic Deployment Synchronization: Overhauling the database structure—such as changing date inputs to timestamptz and rebuilding the HNSW vector index—required strict deployment sequencing. We had to carefully choreograph Supabase SQL migrations immediately before Vercel GitHub pushes to prevent the production app from crashing due to mismatched data types during live updates.

Edge Security Integration: Securing the admin dashboard and API routes without exposing credentials or leaving backdoors required running authentication at the network edge. We implemented Vercel Edge middleware utilizing HTTP-only cookies and HMAC-SHA256 signing to lock down the routes seamlessly.

Team **NexTrace** -- Aryan Jaiswal, AHANA CHAUDHURI, DHRITI GOYAL, Aditya Sharma

### IRIS Protocol

> Autonomous Capital. Intelligent Allocation.

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Neural Network](https://img.shields.io/badge/Neural%20Network-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Inefficiencies in Modern Financial Systems
Current capital deployment frameworks are inherently constrained by legacy structures. Today, capital is generally:

Static: Allocations lack the agility to adapt dynamically to rapidly shifting market conditions.

Human-Limited: Decision-making relies on manual interventions, which introduce latency and cognitive bias.

Opaque: Stakeholders lack real-time transparency into underlying strategies and evolving risk exposures.

Reactive: Traditional systems respond retroactively to market movements rather than anticipating them.

Systemic Consequences
These structural limitations create measurable friction in the market, leading to:

Missed alpha generation in high-velocity, fast-moving markets.

Suboptimal capital allocation and underutilized liquidity.

Heightened vulnerability to market volatility and outlier events.

A fundamental misalignment between performance outcomes and stakeholder incentives.

The Core Gap & Market Opportunity
The Gap: There is currently no institutional framework that allows capital to autonomously analyze, adapt, and optimize itself in real time.

The Opportunity: While global markets generate unprecedented volumes of data continuously, this information remains fragmented and underutilized. Traditional infrastructure is simply not equipped to translate this data into intelligent, immediate action.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Architecting a Real-Time Intelligent System
Developing a framework where autonomous agents continuously analyze, decide, and adapt required overcoming significant architectural complexities. Key hurdles included managing distributed state across multiple agents, optimizing for low-latency decision loops, and maintaining strict synchronization with live data feeds.

2. Implementing Continuous Learning via Active Regression
Transitioning from static training to a dynamic, on-the-fly learning model presented unique data science challenges. We had to design safeguards against system instability during frequent weight updates, mitigate the risk of overfitting to transient streaming data, and sustain computational performance during real-time model retraining.

3. Orchestrating Multi-Agent Coordination
Unlike traditional monolithic models, IRIS utilizes an ecosystem of competing AI agents. This required developing robust Multi-Weight Update (MWU) logic for equitable capital allocation, engineering conflict-resolution protocols to prevent execution collisions, and ensuring systemic stability despite internal agent competition.

4. Engineering a Low-Latency Data Pipeline
Processing high-velocity financial streams necessitated a highly robust data infrastructure. Challenges included establishing fault-tolerant ingestion channels via WebSockets and APIs, executing clean feature engineering with sub-millisecond latency, and guaranteeing absolute data consistency without lag.

5. Developing an Institutional-Grade Terminal Interface
Designing a client interface on par with industry-standard financial terminals required balancing information density with cognitive load. The challenge lay in rendering high-frequency live data and complex visualizations smoothly, ensuring a responsive, professional user experience without overwhelming the client side.

6. Cross-Stack System Integration
The protocol represents a complex convergence of diverse technologies. Harmonizing predictive AI models, a LangGraph-based agentic framework, decentralized blockchain logic, and a high-performance frontend terminal into a cohesive, seamless ecosystem was a primary technical undertaking.

7. Dynamic Model Deployment and State Persistence
Maintaining continuity required a robust pipeline to handle continuous model state serialization, facilitate seamless, zero-downtime updates, and ensure secure, real-time synchronization with our backend cloud infrastructure.

**Best Use of Gemini API**

In IRIS Protocol, Google Gemini functions as the cognitive layer that automatically assigns distinct "personalities" and strategic roles to our diverse suite of AI agents. By utilizing customized system prompts, Gemini transforms standard statistical models into specialized, autonomous decision-makers—such as momentum strategists, arbitrage optimizers, or volatility analysts. This automated persona assignment ensures that each agent operates with a unique behavioral profile, allowing them to independently reason through real-world market context, provide explainable logic, and execute highly differentiated trading strategies.

**Best Build on Solana**

In IRIS Protocol, we primarily leverage Solana's high-speed infrastructure to enforce agent accountability through a robust on-chain staking and slashing mechanism. Each autonomous AI agent is required to stake tokens, creating a trustless economic incentive model where underperformance results in immediate programmatic penalties. Beyond this core staking utility, Solana serves as our overarching execution and settlement layer, providing the ultra-low latency and near-zero fees necessary for real-time, non-custodial trade execution and capital allocation. By anchoring agent performance and financial state updates on-chain, Solana transforms IRIS from a standard predictive AI model into a fully transparent, verifiable, and economically aligned autonomous financial protocol.

**Best Build on Algorand**

Gemini said
In IRIS Protocol, we leverage Algorand as a highly secure, deterministic execution layer to facilitate our autonomous, AI-driven capital allocation. By utilizing Algorand’s near-instant transaction finality and robust security guarantees, we ensure that high-frequency decisions generated by our AI agents are executed immediately, without ambiguity or MEV-related unpredictability. We employ Algorand Standard Assets (ASA) to efficiently tokenize user deposits, agent stakes, and performance rewards, enabling the lightweight, low-cost micro-transactions necessary for continuous portfolio rebalancing. Furthermore, Algorand Smart Contracts seamlessly enforce our core vault logic and agent staking mechanisms, creating a trustless environment where economic accountability and capital flow are executed with absolute precision.

**Best Build on Stellar**

In IRIS Protocol, we leverage the Stellar network as our global settlement and fiat bridging layer. By utilizing Stellar's robust anchor ecosystem, IRIS seamlessly connects traditional financial rails with on-chain digital assets (like USDC), effectively eliminating onboarding friction and enabling borderless capital accessibility. Furthermore, Stellar’s near-zero transaction costs and instant settlement capabilities allow our autonomous AI agents to efficiently execute high-frequency micro-transactions, dynamically rebalance portfolios, and distribute real-world payouts in real time. Ultimately, Stellar bridges the gap between traditional finance and decentralized execution, transforming IRIS into a globally accessible and financially inclusive intelligence network.

**The problem it solves**

**The Problem**
In IVF, selecting the right embryo to transfer is the most critical decision in the entire procedure. Today, it's made by a single embryologist visually inspecting microscope images with no standardized scoring system, no second opinion, and no consistency across clinics or shifts. Fatigue, experience level, and subjectivity all affect the outcome, and a wrong selection costs the patient ₹3–5 lakh, 12 months, and another emotionally devastating cycle.

**What We Built**
Vitality brings AI-assisted embryo selection to any clinic, anywhere  using just a standard microscope photo. No new equipment. No massive upfront cost. Upload an image, get an objective viability score, a ranked list of all embryos, and a plain-English clinical explanation  all in under 2 seconds.

**How It Works**
An embryologist takes a microscope photo of each embryo and uploads it to Vitality . The AI analyses each image, scores it, ranks all embryos from best to worst, and generates a plain-English clinical explanation for each result — all in under 2 seconds, on any device.

**Challenges we ran into**

***Challenges:***

**Dataset Scarcity**  Embryo microscopic imaging data is extremely rare and sensitive. Sourcing a viable dataset was one of the hardest parts of the project  we eventually found the ICIPLAB dataset on Kaggle with 840 images.

**Single Image Constraint:** Unlike competitors who rely on 5 days of time-lapse video, vitality had to deliver accurate results from just one still image  a significantly harder problem that we solved without requiring any additional hardware.

**Model Architecture Decisions:** Choosing the right backbone was non-trivial. We needed something powerful enough to extract fine-grained embryo morphology from microscopic images, but lightweight enough to run on a free-tier cloud server. Settled on EfficientNetB3 after balancing accuracy vs inference speed.

**Best Use of Gemini API**

**Gemini API:**  Clinical AI Insights
Instead of showing raw numbers to embryologists, Gemini transforms the model's output viability score, fragmentation ratio, symmetry score, cell count — into a plain-English clinical explanation specific to each embryo. This bridges the gap between AI output and real clinical decision-making, making the tool usable by embryologists of all experience levels without needing to interpret raw probabilities.

**Best Use of Auth0**

**Auth0:**  Authentication & Clinic Access Control
Medical data is sensitive. Auth0 ensured that only verified, authenticated embryologists and clinic staff could access the platform  not just anyone with the link. It handled login, session management, and secure access without us having to build authentication from scratch, letting us focus on the core AI product.

**The problem it solves**

## The Problem It Solves

AI assistants and agents accept natural language input, which makes them vulnerable to prompt injection attacks. Attackers can manipulate prompts to override system instructions, extract sensitive data, or trigger unintended tool actions.

Wren acts as a **security gateway between applications and AI models**. Every request is inspected before reaching the model, allowing Wren to detect malicious prompts, enforce policies, and block unsafe actions.

This enables developers to safely deploy AI features without building complex security layers themselves.

### What People Can Use It For

- Protect AI chatbots and copilots from prompt injection  
- Secure AI agents that can call tools or APIs  
- Monitor AI security events through a dashboard  
- Enforce custom policies for AI interactions

**Challenges we ran into**

One challenge was **linking the gateway, authentication backend, and dashboard** so API keys, logs, and blocked prompts could sync in real time. Since the gateway intercepts every AI request, it had to validate keys and log events correctly, which required debugging multiple request flows.

Another challenge was **detecting prompt injection patterns**. Attacks can be phrased in many ways, so we built a large suspicious phrase rule set and trained a **fine-tuned DistilBERT model** to detect semantic similarities and assign a suspicion score.

**The problem it solves**

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/92dd443ee88d4305ab5657e221530284/aa3d3ea1-b752-4805-a111-b7e017fe8c75.png)


In many **rural and semi-rural regions,** housing condition surveys are conducted manually, which is time-consuming, subjective, and difficult to scale. 

We propose **GraminScore AI**, a mobile/web application that uses uploaded images to check rural house’s condition.
A local volunteer or official simply takes/upload a photo/multiple photos of a house, which are then analyzed using AI and computer vision techniques to generate a condition score and component-wise assessment (roof, walls, doors).
A lower score means the house is in poorer shape and should be prioritized for repair or rebuilding.
This provides objective, visual evidence for housing programs, reducing bias and speeding up decisions.
It produces a clear score (e.g. 0–100) and report from one photo.
The system helps government bodies(for example ), NGOs, and survey teams quickly identify houses that may require repair, renovation, or priority assistance, reducing manual effort and improving consistency in evaluations.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Current Challenges & Limitations**

**1. Accuracy limitations:**
The current scoring logic is a hybrid of pre‑trained image classification and OpenCV‑based heuristics (brightness, sharpness, edges). While it performs reasonably well, it can sometimes:
Give lower scores to good houses under poor lighting or blur
Misjudge partially damaged structures due to lack of domain‑specific training data

**2. No custom ML dataset yet:**

Due to limited time and lack of publicly available labeled rural housing datasets, we could not train a dedicated machine learning model. The system currently relies on ImageNet‑based models, which are not optimized specifically for rural housing conditions.

**3. Web‑only interface:**

The solution is currently limited to a web interface. Direct mobile camera integration (real‑time photo capture, camera guidance) is not yet implemented.

**4. Image quality dependency:**

The accuracy heavily depends on image quality (angle, lighting, resolution). Poorly captured images can affect component detection and condition scoring.


**Future Improvements & Roadmap**


**1. Custom ML model training:**

Build and train a dedicated model using a curated dataset of rural houses, roofs, walls, doors, and damage patterns to significantly improve accuracy.

**2. Mobile application support:**

Develop an Android/iOS app with direct camera access, guided photo capture, and automatic quality checks before analysis.

**3. Advanced damage detection:**

Incorporate crack detection, texture analysis, and structural anomaly detection using more advanced computer vision techniques.

**4. Better scoring calibration:**

Combine ML predictions with rule‑based scoring and confidence weighting to reduce false positives and false negatives.

**5. Offline & low‑bandwidth support:**

Optimize the system for rural deployment where internet connectivity may be limited.

**Closing Note**
This project serves as a strong proof of concept demonstrating how AI can assist in rural housing assessment. With additional time, data, and real‑world testing, GraminScore AI can evolve into a reliable, scalable, and field‑ready solution for government agencies and rural development programs.

**The problem it solves**

# 🏛️ जनSetu – AI-Powered Government Scheme Discovery

**Problem**
Government schemes are scattered, complex, and often inaccessible due to **language barriers, lack of awareness, and digital divide**. Citizens miss out on benefits they deserve.

**Solution**
**जनSetu** is a multilingual **AI platform** that makes scheme discovery **intelligent, inclusive, and accessible** — even on feature phones.

---

## 🌟 Key Highlights

### 🔍 Intelligent Discovery

* Vector-based semantic search with **MiniLM embeddings**
* Location & profile-based personalization
* Real-time eligibility checks via backend rules engine

### 🤖 AI Assistant

* Powered by **Google Gemini + Hugging Face Transformers**
* Trained for **Indian government schemes knowledge base**
* Multilingual support (IndicTrans2 + Google Translate API)

### 📞 Universal Access

* **IVR system (Twilio + Ngrok)** for feature phones
* Voice + DTMF navigation
* Indic TTS/ASR for natural conversations in Indian languages

### 📄 Document Intelligence

* **Tesseract OCR + Transformers (NER)** for field extraction
* AI-guided form filling & audio instructions for semi-literate users

### 👥 Community Platform

* Role-based access for Citizens, NGOs, Officials, Admin
* **AI moderation** using sentiment analysis & hate speech detection

---

## ⚙️ Tech Backbone

* **Frontend**: React + Tailwind (PWA ready)
* **Backend**: Node.js + Express + MongoDB Atlas (with Vector Search)
* **AI Services**: FastAPI + Transformers (NLP, OCR, CV)
* **Voice**: Twilio APIs + IndicTrans2 for speech/translation
* **AI Models**: state-of-the-art all-MiniLM-L6-v2, microsoft/dit-base-finetuned-rvlcdip, cardiffnlp/twitter-roberta-base-sentiment-latest, TF-IDF Vectorizer
* **Auth & Security**: JWT + bcrypt + role-based access

---

**Challenges we ran into**

## 🛠️ Challenges I Ran Into

Building **जनSetu** with multiple services and AI integrations came with some tough hurdles. Here are the main ones and how we solved them:

---

### 🔗 **CORS Errors in Microservices**

* **Problem**: With **3 services (React, Node.js, FastAPI)** running on different ports, we hit CORS errors when the frontend tried to call the backend or AI services.
* **Solution**:

  * Enabled **CORS middleware** in Node.js (`cors` package) and FastAPI (`fastapi.middleware.cors`).
  * Configured allowed origins (`http://localhost:3000` for React, and production domain later).
  * Used environment variables so CORS configs change automatically in dev vs. prod.

---

### 🤖 **Hugging Face Model Availability**

* **Problem**: Many Hugging Face models (especially multilingual embeddings & OCR-related) were **not available on Inference API (free tier)**, causing failures.
* **Solution**:

  * Installed models **locally with Transformers** instead of relying only on API.
  * Used lightweight alternatives like `Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2` for vector search (works directly in Node.js).
  * Cached embeddings in **MongoDB Atlas Vector Search** to reduce repeated inference.

---

### 📄 **Multilingual OCR with Pytesseract**

* **Problem**: Extracting text from Aadhaar, income docs, etc. in **multiple Indian languages (Hindi, Bengali, Kannada)** caused poor accuracy with default English OCR.
* **Solution**:

  * Installed **language packs (`hin`, `ben`, `kan`)** for Tesseract.
  * Used `pytesseract.image_to_string(img, lang='eng+hin+ben+kan')` for combined recognition.
  * Post-processed OCR output with **IndicTrans2 translation** to normalize into user’s preferred language.

---

**AI**

# 🤖 How जनSetu Leverages AI

जनSetu is a next-generation platform that harnesses the power of Artificial Intelligence (AI) at every level to make government schemes truly accessible, understandable, and actionable for every Indian citizen. Here’s how AI drives the heart of MySarkar:

---

## 🌐 1. Smart Scheme Discovery — AI That Understands You

- **Semantic Search:**  
  Our intelligent search uses state-of-the-art multilingual transformers (`Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2`) to understand the true meaning behind user queries in any language—not just keywords. This enables citizens to ask naturally ("farmer loan scheme West Bengal") and get precise, relevant results.
- **Personalized Recommendations:**  
  AI analyzes user profiles (location, occupation, income, etc.) and uses advanced vector similarity to surface schemes the user is most eligible for, along with real-time eligibility scoring.
- **Location & Profile Filters:**  
  By combining AI-powered language understanding with geo and demographic data, जनSetu ensures that citizens see only the schemes truly relevant to them.

---

## 🗣️ 2. Universal AI Assistant — Powered by Gemini & Hugging Face

- **Conversational Multilingual AI:**  
  Our assistant, built using Google Gemini and Hugging Face Transformers, provides instant answers about any government scheme, eligibility, required documents, and application steps—across domains like health, education, jobs, finance, and more.
- **Voice & Text on Any Device:**  
  Interact with the AI via modern web chat, or even over keypad phones using IVR. The assistant understands and responds in multiple Indian languages, breaking digital and linguistic barriers.
- **Real Examples:**  
  ```json
  {
    "query": "West Bengal health insurance schemes",
    "response": "Available schemes: Ayushman Bharat (₹5L coverage), Swasthya Sathi (₹5L state scheme)..."
  }
  ```

---

## 📞 3. Multilingual IVR with AI Voice Intelligence

- **Voice for Everyone:**  
  जनSetu's phone-based IVR system, powered by Twilio and AI voice models, guides users through scheme discovery and eligibility checks—no smartphone needed.
- **Natural Language & DTMF:**  
  Users can speak or use keypad input; AI models process voice prompts, convert speech to text, and reply with synthesized speech in the user's language (via IndicTrans2).
- **AI-Powered Accessibility:**  
  This ensures even those with basic phones or low literacy can benefit from government schemes.

---

## 📄 4. Document Intelligence & OCR Automation

- **AI-Powered Scanning:**  
  Upload a form or document—our pipeline (Tesseract OCR + AI field extraction) scans, recognizes, and intelligently extracts key information (name, Aadhaar, income, etc.).
- **Smart Form Guidance:**  
  The system provides step-by-step, context-aware help (text and audio) to reduce errors and confusion during form filling.
- **Example Output:**  
  ```json
  {
    "extracted_fields": ["name", "aadhaar", "income"],
    "help_text": "Fill Aadhaar as 12-digit number without spaces",
    "audio_url": "/audio/form_help_hindi.mp3"
  }
  ```

---

## 👥 5. Community Engagement & Moderation

- **AI Sentiment Analysis:**  
  Our platform uses AI to analyze posts and comments, recognizing feedback trends, urgent issues, and user sentiment at scale.
- **Automatic Moderation:**  
  Custom-trained models detect hate speech and inappropriate content across multiple Indian languages, ensuring a safe, inclusive space.
- **Real-Time Notifications:**  
  ML-driven systems alert users and officials to trending discussions, urgent scheme updates, or moderation needs.

---

**Open Innovation**

# 🌍 जनSetu& the Open Innovation Track

जनSetu is designed from the ground up to be a catalyst for open innovation in public service delivery. Here’s how our platform embodies the spirit and objectives of the Open Innovation track:

---

## 🚪 1. Open, Accessible Platform

- **API-First Architecture:**  
  जनSetu exposes its core functionalities—scheme search, eligibility checks, AI chat, and more—through easy-to-use APIs, enabling developers, startups, NGOs, and government bodies to build new solutions atop our foundation.

- **Multilingual & Multimodal Access:**  
  By supporting web, mobile, and IVR channels in multiple Indian languages, we break digital, linguistic, and device barriers—demonstrating openness to all citizens and innovators.

---

## 🤝 2. Community Collaboration & Co-Creation

- **Community Engagement Layer:**  
  Our platform fosters collaboration between citizens, government officials, NGOs, and developers. Features like community posts, discussions, and feedback loops enable collective problem-solving and rapid innovation.

- **Role-Based Ecosystem:**  
  Distinct roles (citizen, official, NGO, admin) with tailored privileges create a dynamic environment for cross-sectoral innovation and partnership.

---

## 🛠️ 3. Extensibility & Interoperability

- **Modular Microservices:**  
  जनSetu’s backend is built with modular, scalable microservices, making it easy for new features, data sources, or AI models to be plugged in by third-party innovators.

- **Standards-Based Data Models:**  
  Using open standards (JSON, REST, secure OAuth), we ensure seamless integration with other platforms, government APIs, and emerging civic tech solutions.

---

## 🌐 4. Data & Insights for Public Good

- **Open Data & Analytics:**  
  Aggregated, anonymized usage data and scheme analytics can be shared (in compliance with privacy norms) to empower policymakers, researchers, and civic hackers.

- **Transparent AI:**  
  Our use of open-source models and clear eligibility logic encourages trust, validation, and community-driven improvements.

---

## 🧑‍💻 5. Empowering the Innovation Ecosystem

- **Hackathon Ready:**  
  Teams can quickly build prototypes—be it chatbots, mobile apps, or voice assistants—using जनSetu’s APIs and datasets.

- **Encouraging Third-Party Integrations:**  
  We invite others to extend platform capabilities: new languages, additional scheme sources, or even novel UIs.

---

## 🚀 Impact on Open Innovation

By making government scheme discovery, access, and community collaboration open, modular, and transparent, जनSetu accelerates the creation of new public good solutions. We lower the barrier for innovators to solve real problems, encourage rapid iteration, and ensure that every citizen benefits from the collective intelligence of the nation.

---

**जनSetu—A true engine for open, collaborative digital innovation in governance.**

**The problem it solves**

**FitFlow.ai** democratizes fitness by providing an AI-powered personal trainer that delivers real-time form correction and adaptive workouts through any device camera. It makes exercise safer by preventing injuries with instant feedback, more accessible by eliminating costly gym memberships and rigid schedules, and more effective through personalized, data-driven guidance. This enables users to achieve their fitness goals confidently and correctly, anytime and anywhere.

**Our Users**

- FitFlow.ai serves:
- Home Exercisers
- Office Workers
- Rehabilitation Patients
- Health-Conscious Adults

**Benefits:**

- Personalized AI coaching with live feedback
- Accessible anytime, anywhere
- Promotes healthier lifestyles and reduces injury risk

**Challenges we ran into**

The initial integration of the MoveNet model caused critical latency, delivering form corrections like "lower your squat" several seconds after the user had finished the rep, rendering the feedback useless.

Solution: We implemented a three-part fix:

**Frame Throttling:** Processing frames at set intervals (e.g., every 150ms) to drastically reduce CPU load.

**Pose Smoothing:** Applying an algorithm to average keypoint data across frames, eliminating jittery joint tracking.

**Smarter Feedback Logic:** Cueing only persistent, high-confidence errors to avoid noisy and inaccurate interruptions.

> AI meets Indian Constitution

**The problem it solves**

The Indian Constitution is vast, complex, and often overwhelming for students, aspirants, and citizens who want to understand their rights and duties. Existing resources are either textbook-heavy or lack interactivity.

Our project solves this problem by creating an intuitive platform where users can:

1. Explore the Constitution in a part-wise, article-wise format with clean card UI.
2. Attempt quizzes to reinforce learning.
3. Chat with an AI bot trained on constitutional data to ask legal, civic, or rights-related questions in real-time.
4. And most importantly — allows users to upload scanned legal documents (PDFs/images) to get them analyzed and explained using Gemini + LangChain

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Parsing Government PDFs
- Used regex + LangChain PDFLoader to extract clean Article/Part mapping.
2. Gemini API with LangChain
- Gemini required different handling than OpenAI.
- Built a wrapper using ChatGoogleGenerativeAI in LangChain.
- Adjusted prompts, model configuration, and retries for factual accuracy.
3. OCR Document Handling
- Used Tesseract initially for local OCR.
- Also tested Google Vision API for cleaner output on real-world scans.
- Managed text cleaning, chunking, and embedding dynamically.
4. Multi-purpose MongoDB
- Used MongoDB Atlas URI for both:
- Mongoose schema data (articles, quizzes)
- LangChain vector embeddings (for Constitution + uploaded docs)
- Ensured collections were isolated and optimized.

**Authenticate with Civic Auth**

Our project fits the CIVICS Auth track because it emphasizes secure, personalized civic learning powered by authentication and user-specific data handling.

We integrated Civic Auth for user authentication, allowing users to sign in securely using trusted identity providers.

Once authenticated, we use the user’s unique ID to manage all database interactions — enabling a personalized experience.

This includes:

- Tracking user progress as they read Articles and Parts of the Constitution

- Generating custom quizzes based on what they've learned

- Storing quiz results tied to the user account for future insights

- Saving uploaded legal documents per user for private analysis

This approach ensures that every feature respects identity and privacy, aligning with the CIVICS theme of responsible tech for public benefit.

By combining Civic Auth with MongoDB and Gemini, we built a civic tech app that’s not just smart — it’s also safe, personal, and secure.

**Best use of Gemini API**

Our project showcases a powerful and practical implementation of the Gemini API by using it across multiple real-world civic and legal use cases:
- RAG-based Legal Chatbot:
We integrated Gemini with LangChain and MongoDB Vector Search to build a Retrieval-Augmented Generation chatbot that answers user queries about the Indian Constitution with high accuracy.
- Chat on Uploaded Legal Documents:
Users can upload scanned legal documents (PDFs/images), which are OCR-processed. Gemini then enables context-aware conversations based on the document content.
- Quiz Generation from Constitutional Content:
We use Gemini to generate intelligent quiz questions from constitutional articles, making learning interactive and AI-powered.
- Explanation & Simplification:
Gemini helps explain complex legal terms and rights in simple, conversational language, enhancing civic awareness.
This project proves how Gemini can power AI that is context-aware, educational, and impactful — making it a top contender.

**Best Use of MongoDB Atlas**

Our app uses MongoDB Atlas for every database operation, from storing articles to AI search. Its key features include :

- We used Mongoose with Atlas to store structured data like:

- Constitutional Parts, Articles, and Quizzes

- User quiz attempts and progress

- For AI chatbot functionality, we used MongoDB Atlas Vector Search with LangChain:

- Stored vector embeddings of articles

- Queried using Gemini API for contextual responses

- We built a document scanner feature:

- Users upload scanned PDFs/images of legal documents

- OCR is performed to extract text

- Text is embedded into a temporary vector collection in MongoDB Atlas

- Users can then chat with Gemini about their uploaded document

- From small UI fetches to advanced vector retrieval, every data interaction runs on MongoDB Atlas.

This project showcases Atlas’s flexibility and power in supporting both structured and AI-driven unstructured use cases.

**The problem it solves**

**Problem Statement:**
Millions of blue-collar job seekers in rural and semi-urban India struggle with limited access to verified job listings, digital illiteracy, language barriers, and widespread scam job postings. Most existing platforms cater to urban users and require technical literacy, making it nearly impossible for digitally-weak or semi-literate individuals to find suitable employment.

**How Our Project Solves This:**
Nayi Disha is an AI-powered, multi-agent job-matching ecosystem that aims to eliminate these barriers by creating an inclusive, automated, real-time platform for both job seekers and listers.

Here’s how it addresses the problem in a layered, tech-driven way:

**✅ 1. Automated Job Scraping & Categorization**

The platform fetches job listings from verified portals like NSDC and Skill India using advanced scraping and parsing tools. Jobs are then automatically categorized using NLP into common blue-collar roles like electricians, plumbers, drivers, security staff, etc.

**✅ 2. Personalized Matching with AI/ML**

Using Sentence-BERT for semantic search and clustering algorithms (KMeans, DBSCAN), the system matches users to job listings based on their skills, location preferences, experience, and salary range. It also learns from past behavior to make smarter future recommendations.

**✅ 3. Scam Detection Using Machine Learning**

To maintain trust, the platform uses a Random Forest classifier trained on metadata and linguistic cues to detect suspicious or scam listings. These are auto-flagged or removed, reducing the risk of fraud for job seekers.

**✅ 4. Voice-First Interaction for Accessibility**

Job seekers can use voice commands in regional languages (via Twilio or Bhashini) to search for jobs or receive alerts—perfect for users with low digital literacy. Employers can also list jobs via voice, making it truly inclusive.

**✅ 5. Real-Time Matching & Alert System**

When a new job listing enters the system, it’s instantly compared against existing job seeker profiles. If a match is found, users receive immediate notifications via WhatsApp, calls, or in-app messages, reducing time-to-placement.

**✅ 6. Insights for Governments, NGOs, and Recruiters**

The platform generates live dashboards using Streamlit/Dash, showing trends in job demand, regional hiring gaps, and user engagement. This helps policymakers and institutions make data-driven decisions about training programs or outreach efforts.

**✅ 7. Inclusive Design & Regional Language Support**

The UI/UX supports multi-language and mobile-first interfaces, ensuring accessibility even for users on basic feature phones or in low-connectivity regions. This expands the impact to Tier-2, Tier-3 towns, and rural belts.

**Impact Summary:**
Empowers rural workers with verified, accessible, and personalized employment opportunities.
Builds trust by fighting fraud through ML-powered scam detection.
Enables data-driven governance through analytics for NGOs and training centers.
Increases hiring efficiency by reducing the time between job listing and placement.
Drives inclusion by eliminating digital, language, and literacy barriers.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Challenges We Ran Into:**

**Data Accessibility & Scraping:**
Scraping job data from platforms like NSDC and Skill India often involved technical barriers such as CAPTCHAs, inconsistent HTML structures, and varied data formats (HTML, JSON, XML), making automation complex.

**Handling Low Digital Literacy:**
Designing a system that could be operated by semi-literate users—especially through voice commands in regional languages—was technically and linguistically challenging. Building a natural, user-friendly voice interface that works reliably was a key hurdle.

**Scam Detection Accuracy:**
Training ML models like Random Forest for scam detection required access to quality-labeled data. False positives (flagging real jobs) and false negatives (missing scams) were a constant tuning challenge.

**Trust and Adoption in Rural Areas:**
Convincing rural users to trust an automated system for job matching—especially over voice or WhatsApp—was a major UX and outreach challenge. Building for inclusivity without overwhelming the user was a delicate balance.

**GEN AI&ML**

**Why Our Project Is a Perfect Fit for the AI/ML Track**
Nayi Disha is deeply rooted in the application of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to solve complex real-world challenges, especially in the employment ecosystem for blue-collar workers. Here's how AI/ML is at the core of our platform:

**🧠 1. Semantic Job Matching with NLP & Sentence-BERT**

Traditional keyword-based job searches often fail for blue-collar roles due to inconsistent job titles and vague descriptions. We overcame this by using Sentence-BERT, a state-of-the-art NLP model that understands the semantic similarity between job descriptions and user profiles. This allows for:

Accurate role matching based on intent, not just keywords.
Recommendations that align with user preferences, skills, location, and past behavior.
A dynamic, adaptive recommendation engine that improves with every interaction.

**📊 2. Smart Clustering with KMeans/DBSCAN**

To make job discovery simpler and more relevant, we implemented unsupervised ML models (KMeans and DBSCAN) that cluster job listings by parameters like:

Salary range
Experience level
Skill requirements
This clustering enables the system to auto-generate descriptive tags (e.g., “Part-time delivery jobs under ₹10K in Pune”), improving discoverability and user experience.

**🚨 3. Scam Detection with Random Forest Classifier**

Blue-collar job seekers are frequent targets of fraud. We tackled this using a Random Forest model trained on linguistic and metadata patterns to detect:

Suspicious keywords or unrealistic salary claims
Poor-quality listings with missing information
Repetitive patterns common in scam listings
This AI-powered moderation system automatically flags or filters risky listings, ensuring a safe environment for users.

**📈 4. Continuous Learning & User Behavior Analytics**

The recommendation engine is not static. It tracks and learns from:

Click behavior
Voice command patterns
Historical matches and user responses
This behavioral learning enables context-aware and user-adaptive intelligence, where the system gets better at suggesting the right jobs the more it's used.

**📉 5. Real-Time ML-Driven Dashboards**

Our platform includes AI-driven analytics dashboards (built with Streamlit and Dash) that provide real-time insights into:

Job trends by region
User engagement patterns
High-demand roles and locations
Fraud detection statistics
These insights empower NGOs, government agencies, and employers to make data-informed decisions for workforce planning and outreach.

**✅ Summary**
AI/ML isn’t an add-on — it powers our core systems: recommendation, fraud detection, user behavior modeling, clustering, and decision support.
We use modern NLP (Sentence-BERT) and classic supervised/unsupervised ML (Random Forest, KMeans) in meaningful, scalable ways.
Our solution reflects the true spirit of the AI/ML track: applying machine learning to address grassroots challenges with measurable social impact.

**Open Innovation**

**How Our Project Fits into the Open Innovation & AI/ML Track**

Nayi Disha is a powerful demonstration of how Artificial Intelligence and Open Innovation can come together to drive large-scale, inclusive change. It doesn’t just apply AI/ML for technical novelty — it delivers real-world social impact by solving the pressing problem of employment accessibility for underserved communities, particularly blue-collar job seekers in rural and semi-urban India.

**🔍 AI/ML Integration for Personalized Job Matching and Fraud Prevention**

We’ve built a sophisticated AI engine that leverages multiple models:

Sentence-BERT for semantic job-user profile matching based on skills, preferences, and behavior.
KMeans and DBSCAN clustering algorithms to group job listings based on parameters like salary range, skill level, and location, auto-generating intuitive tags like “Entry-Level Security Jobs in Mumbai under ₹12K”.
Random Forest classifier to detect scam or low-quality postings based on linguistic patterns and metadata.
These models make job recommendations personalized, relevant, and secure, while also continuously learning from user interaction to improve over time. This AI system turns job hunting from a stressful, blind search into a smart, tailored experience.

**🌍 Open & Inclusive Innovation for the Marginalized**

Nayi Disha redefines what inclusive technology can look like:

We built voice-first interfaces using Twilio and Bhashini, allowing both job seekers and recruiters to interact with the system using regional language voice commands, eliminating the digital literacy barrier.
Users in Tier-2/Tier-3 towns and rural regions can use basic phones or low-end smartphones to access verified job information without ever needing to type or navigate apps.
Employers with minimal technical skill can list jobs over voice calls, making job outreach effortless and accessible.
This is innovation for real people—not just urban tech users. It’s inclusive by design, not just as an afterthought.

**⚙️ Real-Time Intelligence & Data-Driven Governance
**
Through a combination of real-time job matching and automated alerts (via voice, WhatsApp, or app), Nayi Disha dramatically reduces the lag between job listing and job placement. This increases hiring speed, engagement, and trust in the system.

**Additionally, the project features:**

Live dashboards built with Streamlit and Dash, showing dynamic job trends, regional demands, user activity, and scam flags.
NGOs, government bodies, and skilling agencies can use these insights to plan interventions, expand job categories, and tailor training programs for underserved regions.
This transforms the system into a tool for policy-making and social planning, not just job matching.

**🔗 Why It Belongs to the Open Innovation & AI/ML Track**

It’s open innovation because it builds bridges—between tech and rural India, between voice and digital systems, between users and verified opportunities.
It’s AI/ML not for buzzwords, but for solving real-life problems at scale: job mismatch, scam prevention, and digital exclusion.
It fits the spirit of innovation that is both technically advanced and socially impactful.
In essence, Nayi Disha embodies the ethos of the track—harnessing artificial intelligence to enable inclusive, equitable access to employment through smart, scalable, and human-first innovation.

**The problem it solves**

It is a next-generation endpoint monitoring and authentication platform built for enterprises demanding high-grade security without operational disruption. It focuses on passive surveillance and real-time behavioral analytics to proactively detect insider threats. Leveraging voice biometrics, keystroke dynamics, and hardware event monitoring (e.g., USB activity, NIC changes), VISTA ensures seamless, secure authentication on Linux-based systems.

Supports SDGs 9, 12, 13 & 16 via secure infra (9), efficient edge usage (12), low-carbon local inference (13), and ethical threat detection (16).

**1. Multi-Layered Endpoint Agent**
* Lightweight deployment via PyInstaller (Python)
* System fingerprinting: MAC, CPU ID, disk/RAM serials, OS version
* Hardware event logging with timestamps (USB, NIC, hardware swaps)
* Voice biometrics: 15s audio snippets, Wav2Vec2 embeddings, no raw storage
* Keystroke dynamics: timing, intervals, pressure analysis
* Mouse/app monitoring: X/Y movement, clicks, active apps and windows
* Offline buffering with auto-sync upon reconnection
* AES-256 encryption, agent self-checks, tamper detection

**2. Voice + Password Multi-Factor Authentication (Linux PAM)**
* CLI-based voice enrollment and challenge-response
* Real-time speaker verification with random phrases
* Configurable fallback to password-only mode

**3. Threat Detection & AI Engine**
* Anomaly detection via Isolation Forest on behavioral time-series
* Real-time risk scoring (0–100) based on voice, keystrokes, hardware activity
* Prototype matching using FAISS for similarity checks
* Adaptive per-user thresholds with EMA updates

**4. Surveillance Dashboard**
* System overview: session health, real-time alerts
* Live feed: USB events, failed authentications
* Forensic timeline: chronological logs with visual plots

**5. Visual Intrusion Detection**
*Integrated camera monitoring for presence and motion.
*Alerts for unauthorized access
*Visual logs with metadata for behavior correlation

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges We Ran Into While Developing VISTA
•⁠  ⁠Setting up recording on Linux posed some challenges, but we chose to navigate them because we didn’t want to compromise on user security.
•⁠  ⁠Combining biometric voice authentication, keystroke dynamics, and hardware event tracking into a seamless multi-factor system posed technical complexity and to calculate the score accurately(but we finally achieved it).
•⁠  ⁠Finding Keystroke Dataset was the massive challenge we faced, and even after finding such a huge data cleaning it was a problem, but our team successfully automated and completed the process.

> See the patterns. Understand the words.

![Android SDK](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android%20SDK-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Kotlin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kotlin-333333?style=flat-square) ![NLP](https://img.shields.io/badge/NLP-333333?style=flat-square) ![Mediapipe](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mediapipe-333333?style=flat-square)

**Challenges we ran into**

**Running Models Locally on Mobile Hardware:** Standard language models require massive cloud servers to operate. Getting natural language processing to run directly on an Android device without draining memory, causing UI lag, or demanding active internet connectivity required extensive optimization and lightweight architecture.

**Parsing Mixed Regional Dialects (Romanized version of Hindi and Telugu):** Standard NLP models are primarily trained on formal English and miss colloquial, code-mixed nuances. People regularly blend languages in everyday texts, so building pattern-detection rules that accurately interpret informal phrasing across English, Hindi, and Telugu without generating false flags was a major technical hurdle.

**Ensuring Explainability and Objective Feedback:** We had to make sure the app never acted as an arbitrary "black box" or assigned clinical psychological labels to people. Structuring the engine to extract and visually highlight exact textual evidence while providing calm, de-escalating response suggestions required careful prompt and UI design.

**Time-Constrained Build and Gradle Synchronization:** Building native Android UI across multiple tabs, configuring speech input, and integrating local inference within a strict 2-hour hackathon window meant resolving Gradle dependency conflicts and catalog errors rapidly under tight time pressure.

**The problem it solves**

**Hidden Toxic Dynamics:** Unhealthy communication patterns such as gaslighting, blame-shifting, and dismissive language frequently hide inside everyday, casual conversations. Because these phrases sound ordinary, they are difficult to recognize in the moment, cause intense self-doubt, and easily become normalized over time.

**The Privacy Barrier:** People want clarity and a neutral perspective on confusing messages, but personal chats are deeply sensitive. Users cannot, and should not, upload private conversations to cloud-based AI systems where personal data could be harvested, logged, or exposed.

**On-Device Clarity Without Compromise:** UNSAID solves this dilemma by keeping all language analysis 100% on the user's phone. It functions entirely offline, detecting manipulative dynamics across English and regional dialects like romanized versions of Hindi and Telugu while highlighting the exact words that triggered the alert. Users get objective clarity and psychological safety with zero cloud exposure and complete data privacy.

> Turn 60 hours of CCTV footage into a 5-minute miss

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenCV](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCV-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flutter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flutter-333333?style=flat-square) ![FFmpeg](https://img.shields.io/badge/FFmpeg-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

When a person goes missing, police must manually review hundreds of hours of CCTV footage — a process that takes days and often comes too late. Netra automates this by scanning footage using AI face recognition, instantly surfacing every moment the missing person appears across all cameras, with timestamps, confidence scores, and video clips — turning days of manual review into minutes.

**Challenges we ran into**

Engineering Challenges

CCTV Accuracy: Real-world footage is often blurry, low-light, side-angled, or partially obstructed. Extensive testing was needed to tune ArcFace similarity thresholds and balance false positives and negatives.
Performance: CPU-based InsightFace processing was extremely slow. Integrating CUDA with ONNX Runtime GPU reduced video processing time from nearly an hour to just minutes.
Android Compatibility: Android 16’s HEIC images caused Flutter preview crashes. We solved this by automatically converting selected images to JPEGbefore processing.
Privacy & Security: Netra was designed with privacy-first principles—non-matching faces are not stored, officer actions are audit-logged, and safeguards are built in to prevent misuse and mass surveillance.

### PHISHSHIELD
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/phishshield-c70f) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://phishshieldio.netlify.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-INNOVATEX%201.O-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://innovatex-gsamakaut.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-5-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Don't just detect phishing—defeat it.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

•Traditional security systems rely on static rules and often fail to detect modern, context-aware cyber attacks. 

•Phishing attacks are rapidly increasing, with a 300%+ rise in AI-generated phishing campaigns.

•A major “human gap” exists, as more than 60% of users cannot correctly identify phishing emails.

•Hidden links, shortened URLs, and redirection chains make threat detection difficult for average users.

•The lack of real-time threat analysis increases vulnerability to scams and cyber fraud.

•These security failures contribute to over $10B in annual global financial losses from cyber fraud.

**Challenges we ran into**

•Handling asynchronous Groq API requests initially caused UI unresponsiveness and latency issues.

•We implemented strict TypeScript state management and UI loaders to prevent duplicate user submissions during analysis.

•Standard browser extensions were interfering with our network requests during local testing and debugging.

• We overrode our default IDE settings to launch the Brave browser instead, ensuring a clean, isolated environment for accurate testing.

• Passing raw, unsanitized user URLs directly into the AI prompt occasionally caused formatting errors.

• Complex URL query parameters and encoded characters were triggering false positive phishing verdicts from the model.

• We developed an Express.js middleware utility to parse and strip unnecessary tracking queries before sending the URL to the Groq API.

Team **Priest Kings** -- [Sayantan Roy](https://github.com/Sayantan176), [Bikramjit Pakhira](https://github.com/CodewithBikram2025), [Rajnil Saha](https://github.com/rajnil9), [Debmallar Dasgupta](https://github.com/debmallardasgupta)

### Lethus
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/lethus-8b2d) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/0xteamCookie/Lethus) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://lethus.getmyroom.in/chat) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ph8Vugawndc) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackSRM%207.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hack-srm26.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-5-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Stop paying your LLM to re-read the conversation.

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

If you build LLM apps, you know the context window problem. As conversations get longer, you have to send the entire chat history back to the API on every single request just so the AI doesn't lose the plot. This burns through tokens, spikes your API bill, and actually degrades the AI's reasoning because the prompt gets bloated with irrelevant history.
Lethus solves this. It’s a drop-in proxy that sits between your client and LLM. Instead of blindly sending everything, it acts as an intelligent memory manager that dynamically cuts out the noise. Saving around 33% average cost. Example: 800M tokens/month, 80/20 input-output split, $5/M input pricing, Claude Opus 4.6, saving around $12k yearly.

**Challenges we ran into**

The "Time-Traveling" Context Bug: We used a modified version of Kadane’s algorithm to group highly relevant historical turns into continuous blocks of memory. But initially, if the vector search found high scores for Turn 3 and Turn 8, the algorithm stitched them together, completely ignoring the massive 4-turn gap in the middle. It resulted in incoherent prompts.

Lethus uses a "supersession" feature in its background Changelog to kill off old decisions when a user changes their mind (e.g., switching from PostgreSQL to SQLite). Originally, I used simple keyword overlap to detect these contradictions. But common words like "using" or "database" were triggering false positives, causing the AI to prematurely "forget" valid project constraints.

**Grand Prize**

Lethus tackles one of the most expensive and universal pain points in modern software development: LLM context bloat. Every company building AI apps is burning money and degrading model reasoning by blindly sending massive, bloated chat histories back and forth.

Lethus is a Grand Prize contender because it offers a complete, production-ready solution to this massive problem with zero integration friction. It’s not just a cool concept; it’s a fully functional, drop-in proxy. By simply changing a single URL string in the OpenAI SDK, developers get instant ROI-slashing token costs by up to 33% in average, eliminating hallucination from context fatigue, and gaining infinite AI memory.

### Senseway
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/senseway-5fd6) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/HimalGarg/SensceWay.git) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://www.canva.com/design/DAHAq0PXoFU/F24S9_H9cjcDOQCqc4h2rg/edit?utm_content=DAHAq0PXoFU&utm_campaign=designshare&utm_medium=link2&utm_source=sharebutton) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/cxe0SZki1xk) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackTU%207.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hacktu7.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-5-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Preserving intent when motion fails !

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenCV](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCV-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Mediapipe](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mediapipe-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Digital systems today are designed around precise and sustained motor control. Tasks such as clicking a button, typing a message, or keeping a cursor steady assume that users can reliably execute fine hand movements.

For people with motor disabilities—including those affected by ALS, Parkinson’s disease, stroke, spinal injuries, Carpal Tunnel Syndrome (CTS), and repetitive strain injuries (RSI)—this assumption does not hold. In these conditions, cognitive intent remains intact, but the ability to translate that intent into accurate physical actions gradually degrades due to tremors, muscle weakness, fatigue, or loss of motor coordination.

As motor control declines, traditional input methods fail first. Even simple interactions become exhausting, error-prone, or impossible, leading to loss of independence, reduced access to digital services, and increased reliance on others. Existing assistive tools often rely on expensive hardware, fixed configurations, or rigid interaction models that do not adapt to real-world variability or progressive motor decline.

The core problem is not a lack of intelligence or decision-making ability—it is the absence of interaction systems that can tolerate noisy, unstable, and fatigued motor signals while still preserving user intent.

Senseway addresses this fundamental gap by focusing on the failure point of modern interfaces: their inability to support users when movement becomes unreliable, but intent remains clear.

**Challenges we ran into**

A major challenge was achieving stable and accurate eye tracking using standard webcams, as variations in lighting, camera quality, and head movement introduced significant noise in eye landmark detection. Distinguishing intentional blinks from natural blinks was also difficult, requiring careful tuning of EAR thresholds, frame counters, and cooldown logic to reduce false positives without increasing user fatigue.

Another challenge was the lack of real-world, disability-specific datasets for eye-gaze behavior, which forced us to rely on manual calibration and iterative testing rather than large-scale training data. Integrating eye gaze, blink detection, and voice input into a single real-time pipeline introduced synchronization and performance challenges. Finally, executing system-level actions safely required additional confirmation logic to prevent accidental inputs, especially for critical actions.

**Google Gemini**

In Senseway, the Gemini API is integrated as a natural language intent classification layer for emergency-related interactions. Voice input from the user is first converted to text using a speech-to-text pipeline. The resulting transcript is then passed to the Gemini API for semantic analysis.

Gemini is used to classify and validate emergency intent rather than execute actions directly. The API processes unstructured natural language input and returns a structured interpretation indicating whether the intent corresponds to an emergency scenario (e.g., medical help, contacting emergency services, or notifying a predefined emergency contact).

Once an emergency intent is confirmed by Gemini, the system extracts relevant parameters such as the emergency type and target service. This structured output is passed to a controlled execution layer, where system-level API calls (messaging, dialing emergency numbers, or triggering alerts) are initiated only after an explicit confirmation step via gaze or voice.

This design decouples intent understanding from action execution, reducing false positives and preventing accidental emergency triggers. Gemini is used strictly for semantic intent validation, while all critical actions are handled by deterministic, rule-based system logic.

### MULTI-REPO ANALYSE AND INSIGHT GENERATOR
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/multirepo-analyse-and-insight-generator-b39c) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Srishanth-23/MULTI-REPO-INSIGHT-GENERATOR.git) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-IEEE%20ML%20presents:%20The%20Spark-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://ieee-ml-presents-the-spark.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-5-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Hybrid + Quantum Inspired ML Analysis with AWS

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![AWS](https://img.shields.io/badge/AWS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

![Uploading image...]()Modern organizations and open-source projects often maintain large collections of repositories that grow rapidly. This creates significant challenges:

    Fragmented and overwhelming data: Understanding codebases, contributor activity, dependencies, and health across many repos is complex and time-consuming.

    Risk of hidden issues: Without comprehensive insight, critical problems like low activity, high-risk code, or dependency conflicts can go unnoticed.

    Inefficient decision-making: Teams lack a consolidated, clear overview required for prioritizing code reviews, managing resources, and planning roadmap initiatives.
This system transforms the way users interact with massive multi-repository ecosystems by:

    Providing Clear Summaries: Instantly understanding repo purpose and key characteristics through automated natural language summaries.

    Tracking Activity Trends: Visualizing contributor and commit patterns over time to quickly spot growth, stagnation, or decline.

    Revealing Contributor Networks: Mapping collaboration patterns to identify key contributors and coordination clusters.

    Exposing Dependency Relationships: Displaying dependency graphs that highlight inter-repo connections and potential impact zones.

    Detecting Anomalies with Quantum ML: Flagging unusual repositories or risky modules faster and more accurately than traditional analytics.

    Supporting Real-Time Monitoring: Continuous updates ensure insights remain current, reducing blind spots.

    Simplifying Complex Data: Turning vast, disparate repository data into intuitive, actionable visuals and reports tailored for developers, managers, and community leads.

**Challenges we ran into**

Handling Large-Scale Data Collection

Collecting structured data from hundreds of repositories asynchronously posed significant challenges in API rate limiting and data consistency. Initially, the system encountered frequent GitHub API request throttling, resulting in incomplete or delayed data collection.

How It Was Solved:
Implemented intelligent request scheduling with exponential backoff and caching strategies. We also leveraged GitHub’s GraphQL API for more efficient batch data retrieval, reducing the number of requests and improving throughput.
Integrating Quantum Machine Learning

Quantum ML is an emerging field with limited resources and steep learning curve. The challenge was encoding classical repo data effectively into quantum states and integrating quantum kernels smoothly into the classical ML pipeline.

How It Was Solved:
Extensive experimentation with Qiskit and PennyLane frameworks helped find optimal quantum feature embedding techniques. We modularized the pipeline so that classical ML and QML components could be developed and improved independently, enabling iterative refinement without blocking progress.
Real-Time Incremental Updates

Ensuring low-latency updates while only reprocessing changed repositories demanded complex orchestration over Kafka messaging and asynchronous agent communication.

How It Was Solved:
Designed a robust event-driven architecture with Kafka topics partitioned by repository groups and idempotent processing guarantees. This minimized redundant data handling and kept insights fresh with manageable computational overhead.
Visualization and Dashboard Usability

Creating intuitive visualizations that combined multidimensional data including trends, network graphs, and quantum complexity scores required careful UI/UX design efforts.

How It Was Solved:
Incorporated user feedback in iterations and utilized React and Plotly libraries with flexible, interactive components. Decomposed complex visual data into digestible modules, enabling users to customize views based on their priorities.

**Ethereum Track**

Ethereum Development Ecosystems
Ethereum projects often comprise numerous interconnected repositories—smart contracts, developer tools, DApps, libraries, and protocols. This system can analyze and provide insights across these repos, enhancing transparency and maintainability.

Security and Risk Management
Ethereum smart contract ecosystems require high security standards. The system’s anomaly detection via classical plus quantum ML can help highlight potentially risky or inactive repos, aiding audit prioritization and risk mitigation in Ethereum projects.

Collaboration and Contributor Insights
Large Ethereum initiatives involve many contributors and teams. Visualizing contributor networks and activity trends supports better collaboration management and community health monitoring within the Ethereum ecosystem.

### Burrow
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/burrow-f16d) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/capy-on-caffeine/burrow-backend) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://burrow-frontend.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack%20On%20Hills%207.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackonhills7.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-5-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> The home for rabbit holes

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

tldr: it's a love baby of reddit and obsidian graphs

this project touches upon a problem of the modern internet. when the internet was made, it's main purpose was to share information. fortunately, it has stood the test of time and continued to serve this purpose. the problem that we face is that there's too much information now - to the point that we sometimes don't know what information to search for.

as an example, i search "how does electricity work" on youtube and my feed ends up with "top 10 facts about nikola vs edison". both are valid pieces of knowledge (which you can flex btw) but a lot of the times, when the going gets tough, you might fail to make a connection. 

roadmaps solve this issue for a single domain but for interdisciplinary topics, all the knowledge in the world can be modelled as a graph. in this graph, you can start anywhere and go down your fav rabbit holes, explore both depth and breadth wise.

hence to facilitate exploring these rabbit holes, we introduce "burrow". the main features for this hack mvp are:
- knowledge graph with appx 1000 topics
- posts related to multiple topics/tags
- search feature that traverses the graph
- feed that shows cool new ideas for you

tech stack:
- nextjs
- tailwindcss
- nodejs
- expressjs
- neo4j
- qdrant
- gemma embedding model
- BERTopic for graph clustering
- aws DynamoDB
- aws ElasticBeanstalk

the end goal of ours is to make an app which doesn't focus on consumption but curiosity. so stop scrolling, start digging!

**Challenges we ran into**

- neo4j: this was our first time working with a graph database so it took us a while to get used to its driver. eventually by utilizing docs we were able to fetch and transform data efficiently

- embeddings: we fed appx 55000 nodes and relations into neo4j (which was the okay part). however, while creating search we had to compute embeddings and store them into qdrant. this turned out to be a mammoth tasks as it exhausted multiple api keys. eventually through carefully dividing the job we were able to manage this.

- force graph: to create a graph that visualizes all the knowledge, we used force based graphs. however visualizing 55k relations with subgroups is no small feat and it made our app laggy. we trimmed out dangling nodes to reduce lag significantly. this can be further optimized by utilizing a web graphics library like webgl.

**Best AWS Hack**

we use 3 AWS services in our project:
- dynamoDB for storing the user and posts data
- elastic beanstalk for hosting the nodejs backend api
- lambda function to create embeddings of our node data

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/7a975f9c6bf94636a57e8be8383a030b/2fffd7e5-33bf-4377-bfff-80d208cb4a89.png)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/7a975f9c6bf94636a57e8be8383a030b/0bc60ace-0d17-4829-89d3-e2e28d0fad04.jpeg)

**Open Innovation**

burrow is a top contender for open innovation because:

- unique idea that maps the knowledge into a graph as a means to create a generalized "roadmap". learning is never linear, why should your tools be?

- democratizes knowledge discovery and creation by making the graph a breathing, live structure

- it invites community driven innovation

- interdisciplinary domain of expertise

**Sustainability**

burrow falls under the sustainability bracket because:

- promotes UN sustainability development goal 4 of quality education

- no knowledge gain is wasted. burrow helps connect all pieces of knowledge

**Description of your solution**

We are building a AI system that tackles the growing problem of multilingual misinformation in real-time. Our solution addresses the critical gap where fake news spreads rapidly across different languages and platforms, but existing fact-checking tools are either monolingual or too slow to respond. By combining advanced multilingual AI, automated clustering, and real-time verification, we've created a system that can instantly detect, verify, and correct misinformation in any language, delivering culturally-appropriate responses directly to users on the platforms where they encounter false information.

Key Features:
1)Understands All Languages: Reads and processes fake news in Hindi, English, Tamil, or any other language automatically.

2)Cleans Up Messy Content: Converts poorly written posts with typos and slang into clear, readable text for better analysis.

3)Groups Similar Lies Together: Finds all versions of the same fake story, whether shared as long posts or short messages.

4)Checks Facts Instantly: Compares claims against trusted sources like WHO and government websites within seconds.

5)Responds in Your Language: Provides simple, easy-to-understand corrections in the same language you speak.

6)Works on Popular Apps: Available directly on WhatsApp, Telegram, and social media where people actually share news.

7)Simple to Use: Just forward a suspicious message and get instant fact-checking - no downloads or sign-ups needed.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Our project is an AI-powered misinformation detection system that tackles the critical issue of multilingual misinformation in real time. It works by processing and analyzing fake news in a wide range of languages, from Hindi and English to Tamil and beyond. The system is designed to handle messy, real-world content, cleaning up posts with typos and slang to ensure accurate analysis.
