**Description of your solution**

**RhythmIQ** is an AI-led agentic financial advisor tailored for the **gig economy, freelancers, and informal sector workers** in India who face highly irregular income streams.  
The solution transforms chaotic and unpredictable cash flows into actionable insights, helping users **manage spending, save strategically, and prevent financial deficits.**

---

### **1. Data Intelligence Layer**

RhythmIQ processes a diverse range of **contextual and transactional signals**, including:

- **UPI and bank transaction history**  
- **Gig platform activity** (rides, deliveries, freelance assignments)  
- **Manual expense entries**  
- **Recurring obligations** (rent, EMI, subscriptions)  
- **External signals** like **weather, festivals, or local events** affecting income patterns  

This data diversity enables RhythmIQ’s agent to **understand the rhythm of each user’s financial life** and **predict potential shortfalls** well in advance.

---

### **2. Hybrid Intelligence Stack**

The backend runs on a **hybrid intelligence architecture**, combining:

- **Lightweight time-series forecasting** for short-term cash balance prediction and risk alerts  
- **Rule-based safety controls** to ensure reliability, compliance, and user trust  
- **Reinforcement learning (contextual bandits)** to optimize behavioral nudges and decide **when and how** to recommend actions  
- **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)** with **knowledge graphs** for historical and contextual awareness  

Together, these systems ensure that each recommendation is **accurate, safe, and explainable**.

---

### **3. Conversational Interface**

RhythmIQ interacts with users through a **chat-based or push-notification interface**, offering **proactive and personalized guidance** such as:

- *“The week ahead looks tight—save ₹3,000 today.”*  
- *“Festival season incoming—set aside essentials and micro-save the rest.”*  
- *“Your buffer is expanding—maintain a minimum balance to avoid overdraft charges.”*

These micro-recommendations empower users to **stay financially prepared** in a relatable and timely manner.

---

### **4. Financial Access & Transparency**

The agent can integrate with **Earned Wage Access (EWA)** platforms or **micro-lenders**, allowing users to access **short-term liquidity** without damaging their credit scores.  

All automation is **opt-in, transparent, and explainable**—users can always see **why a recommendation was made**, reinforcing **trust and financial literacy.**

---

### **5. Continuous Learning Loop**

RhythmIQ employs a **feedback mechanism** to adapt and personalize over time.  
User behavior, outcomes, and engagement data are continuously analyzed to refine future recommendations.

**Key success metrics include:**
- Growth in **median emergency buffers**  
- **Reduction in missed payments**  
- **Prevention of overdrafts**

---

### **6. Lean & Deployable Technology Stack**

Designed for **rapid prototyping and hackathon deployment**, the core stack includes:

- **Python** for backend logic  
- **AI with RAG** for contextual advice generation  
- **Reinforcement learning** for adaptive behavioral guidance  
- **Mobile-friendly UI** for user interaction  

Artificial datasets simulating UPI transactions and gig income will enable **real-time demos**, while **data privacy, encryption, and consent-first principles** ensure **compliance and user trust**.

---

### **7. Summary**

**RhythmIQ** isn’t a budgeting app—it’s a **proactive, intelligent financial ally**.  
It helps India’s gig and informal workers **anticipate cash flow challenges**, **build savings buffers**, and **enhance financial resilience**.  
The ultimate goal is **tangible improvement in liquidity and long-term financial well-being.**

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

**RhythmIQ** perfectly aligns with the **Fintech track**, reimagining how **financial literacy, coaching, and decision-making** are delivered to **underserved populations**—particularly **gig workers** and members of the **informal economy**.

---

### **1. The Problem with Conventional Finance**

Traditional financial tools are **reactive**—they step in **after** the financial damage is done.  
They track, analyze, and report—but never **prevent**.

---

### **2. The RhythmIQ Difference**

**RhythmIQ** is **agentic, proactive, and AI-powered**, blending **behavioral modeling** with **adaptive intelligence** to act **before** a user falls into deficit or makes an impulsive financial decision.  

It is not a static dashboard—it’s a **living financial ecosystem** capable of:
- **Observing** user behavior  
- **Understanding** income rhythm  
- **Acting autonomously** on behalf of the user  

Powered by **RAG-enhanced reasoning**, **transactional data modeling**, and **autonomous financial agents**, RhythmIQ becomes a **true financial co-pilot**, not just a tracker.

---

### **3. Why RhythmIQ Represents True Fintech Innovation**

#### **a. Bridging Accessibility**
Delivers **smart financial guidance** to the **90% of the workforce** without access to formal advisory systems.

#### **b. Responsible AI + Finance Integration**
Combines **explainable AI** with finance, ensuring **transparent and trustworthy recommendations**.

#### **c. Discovering Autonomy**
Uses **LangGraph** and **LangChain** to drive **agentic workflows**, enabling **real-time financial adaptability**.

#### **d. Empowering Inclusivity**
Transforms **complex financial reasoning** into **simple, conversational, and culturally adaptive advice**, meeting users where they are.

---

### **4. The Vision**

**RhythmIQ** turns **financial information overload** into **personalized, AI-guided financial wellness**.  
This directly fulfills the Fintech Track’s core mission:  
**to use technology to build smarter, fairer, and more flexible financial systems.**

**Description of your solution**

**PaisaPal: Guiding your money, Everyday**

PaisaPal is an innovative mobile application designed to empower users with a comprehensive personal finance management solution. Built with a user-centric approach, PaisaPal aims to simplify financial tracking, planning, and decision-making for individuals of all backgrounds. The app provides a seamless platform to monitor income and expenses, set and track savings goals, manage recurring bills, and gain actionable insights through intuitive analytics—all within a single, easy-to-navigate interface.

**Key features of PaisaPal include:**

1.Transaction Management: Users can log income and expenses with customizable categories and notes, with real-time balance updates.
2.Goal Setting: Set personalized savings targets (e.g., for vacations or emergencies) and monitor progress effortlessly.
3.Bill Tracking: Schedule and pay bills, with reminders for upcoming and overdue payments, including support for recurring bills.
4.Financial Analytics: Visualize spending patterns and savings growth through interactive charts for better financial awareness.
5.User Profile: Maintain and update personal details, including referral codes for community engagement.
6.AI-Powered Assistance: Leverage an integrated chat feature for personalized financial advice and tips (to be expanded in future iterations).

PaisaPal is envisioned as a scalable platform, with plans to integrate advanced features like investment tracking, budget forecasting, and multi-user family accounts. The app is designed to be accessible across Android and iOS devices, with a focus on security, usability, and real-time data synchronization. Future development will include robust backend support, cloud storage, and enhanced AI capabilities to provide a holistic financial ecosystem.
This project targets tech-savvy individuals, young professionals, and families seeking to take control of their finances, offering a modern alternative to traditional budgeting tools. With its sleek design and practical functionality, PaisaPal is poised to become a go-to solution for personal financial empowerment.

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

PaisaPal aligns closely with the problem statement by serving as an MVP foundation for an autonomous financial coaching agent, specifically tailored to the needs of gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens. While the current implementation focuses on core tracking and management tools, it incorporates adaptive elements through its AI chat feature and data-driven insights, enabling proactive decision-making based on user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability. Below, I outline how the solution fits the problem statement, highlighting key features and potential expansions for full autonomy.

**Adaptation to Real User Behavior and Spending Patterns**
PaisaPal tracks user behavior in real-time via transaction logging, categorizing income and expenses with notes and timestamps. For gig workers with irregular earnings, the app's balance updates and history view provide immediate visibility into spending patterns. The AI chat (accessible via the 'AI' tab) can analyze this data to offer personalized advice, such as "Your spending on food has increased 20% this month—consider budgeting Rs.1550 less to meet your goal." This adaptability is built on the store's state management, which updates dynamically as users input data, simulating autonomous monitoring.

**Handling Income Variability**
The app's flexible transaction system supports variable income sources (e.g., freelance gigs or informal jobs) by allowing users to add income entries as they occur. For users with unpredictable cash flows, PaisaPal calculates net balance changes and projects trends through the analytics tab, where charts visualize income vs. expenses over time. In a more autonomous iteration, the AI could use this data to predict cash flow gaps (e.g., "Based on your past 3 months, expect a Rs.1000 shortfall next week—here's how to adjust")—currently, it's user-initiated but lays the groundwork for proactive alerts.

**Proactive Financial Decision-Making**
PaisaPal encourages smarter decisions through goal setting and bill management. Users can create savings goals (e.g., emergency fund for gig workers) and track progress, with the app updating current amounts based on transactions. The bills feature handles recurring payments with reminders for upcoming and overdue items, helping users avoid penalties. The AI chat acts as the coaching agent, responding to queries like "How can I save more?" with suggestions based on stored patterns. For informal sector employees, this means practical advice on prioritizing essentials amid variable income.

**Targeting the Intended Audience**
Gig Workers and Informal Sector Employees: The app's lightweight, mobile-first design suits users with irregular schedules, offering quick entry for daily transactions and goals without complex setup.
Everyday Citizens: Simple navigation and tabs (Home, Bills, Goals, Analytics, Profile, AI) make it accessible, with the profile feature allowing customization for referrals and points to incentivize good habits.

While the current MVP is a hackathon prototype with local state management, it sets the stage for full autonomy by collecting the necessary data (behavior, patterns, income). Future enhancements could integrate machine learning (via tools like TensorFlow.js) for predictive modeling and push notifications for proactive tips, fully realizing the autonomous coaching vision.

**Description of your solution**

**Problem:**

- Indian MSMEs generate 50+ crore financial documents monthly - quotations, invoices, purchase orders, GST certificates, TDS forms. Businesses spend ₹5+ lakhs annually: developers waste 40-60 hours per complex report, accountants manually format documents, every GST rule change breaks systems. 

- Simple documents (quotations, sales orders) need drag-drop tools but lack framework integration. Complex compliance docs (GST invoices, TDS certificates) need intelligent validation. 

- No universal solution spans simple-to-complex needs across Tally, Zoho, custom ERPs. Financial documentation is fragmented and expensive.

**Solution**:

- **Templify** AI combines visual drag-drop design with agentic AI for complete financial document generation. Simple docs (quotations, sales orders, purchase orders): Non-technical users design via drag-drop interface, deploy across any ERP. 

- Complex compliance docs (GST invoices, TDS certificates): AI agents autonomously generate compliant templates, validate calculations, monitor regulatory changes, auto-update formats. Framework-agnostic API integrates with Tally, Zoho, custom systems.

 - Multi-format export (PDF/Excel/e-invoice). One platform: simple-to-complex, always compliant, 60 hours → 60 minutes.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Core Fintech Problems We Solve:

1. **High-VolumeSimple Documents (Quotations, Sales Orders, POs)**

- Problem:Businesses generate 100-500 quotations/month. Manual formatting in Word/Excel wastes 2-3 hours daily. Inconsistent branding. No ERP integration means double data entry.

-  Our Solution: Drag-drop designer for non-technical users. Design once, generate thousands. Auto-pulls data from ERP/CRM. Professional branding every time.

-  Impact: Save 60+ hours/month per business. Reduce errors. Professional appearance wins more deals.


2. **Purchase Orders & Vendor Management**

- Problem: Manufacturing/trading companies issue 50-200 POs monthly. Each needs approval workflow, vendor-specific formats, terms tracking. Manually managed in Excel or email.

- Our Solution: Template library for PO variations. AI suggests terms based on vendor history. Auto-numbering, version control.

- Impact: Streamline procurement. Better vendor relationships. Audit trail for compliance.


3. **Payment Documentation (Receipts, Credit Notes)**

- Problem: Every payment needs receipt. Returns need credit notes. Manual generation delays customer satisfaction. Accounting mismatches common.

- Impact: Eliminates compliance lag, prevents penalties. Zero manual intervention.

5. **Multi-System Invoice Generation**

- Problem: E-commerce sellers use 5+ platforms (Amazon, Flipkart, Shopify, own website). Each needs different invoice format. Manual work or expensive integrations (₹50k-2 lakhs each).

- Our Solution: One template, AI agents adapt to each platform's requirements automatically. Single integration, infinite variations.

- Impact: Save ₹3-5 lakhs annually on multi-platform invoice systems.

7. **MSME Financial Access**

- Problem: MSMEs can't get loans because they lack proper financial documentation. Manual report generation costs ₹20-50k from CAs. 80% of loan rejections due to poor documentation.

- Our Solution: Bank-ready statements instantly. Professional templates build credibility.

- Impact: Democratize access to credit through better documentation. Enable 50 lakh+ MSMEs to access formal financing.

**Description of your solution**

**MoneyFyi** is a personalized financial engine built specifically for India's diverse and often underserved population of gig workers, informal sector employees, and individuals with irregular income streams. The platform addresses a critical gap in financial services: while traditional banking apps offer generic investment advice that assumes stable monthly income, MoneyFyi recognizes that millions of Indians experience *fluctuating cash flows* and need recommendations that adapt to their unique circumstances.

At its core, the system combines multiple specialized AI agents that work together like a team of financial advisors, each bringing different expertise to the table. **FinAgent** analyzes English financial news and market signals using domain-specific language models, while **IndicAgent** processes regional language content to capture sentiment from vernacular news sources and social media that traditional platforms ignore. **TrendAgent** forecasts stock and mutual fund movements using temporal pattern recognition, and **FusionAgent** brings everything together by weighing market predictions against user risk tolerance and actual savings capacity.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/f534f278b73c407e982df48ff18f5c50/dbbc21c0-0464-4fad-a89f-87815fa8bd02.png)

What makes **MoneyFyi** different from existing investment platforms is its *continuous learning approach* combined with genuine accessibility. The system doesn't just tell users what to buy; it explains *why a recommendation makes sense* given current market sentiment, recent news trends, and the user's personal financial situation. When a regional news outlet reports concerns about a banking sector slowdown in Marathi or Hindi, IndicAgent catches that sentiment and adjusts recommendations accordingly. When users consistently reject high volatility options, FusionAgent learns their true risk appetite and recalibrates future suggestions. 

The platform speaks to users in their *preferred language* and even accepts *voice input through VoxAgent*, breaking down barriers that have kept many Indians from engaging with formal investment tools. Security remains paramount with **AES-256 encryption** protecting all personally identifiable information, while aggregated anonymized data helps improve recommendations across the user base. 

The entire system runs on a modular architecture using proven technologies like **FastAPI** for the backend, **Next.js** for responsive interfaces, and **PostgreSQL** for reliable data management, ensuring it can scale to serve millions while maintaining performance and security standards.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/f534f278b73c407e982df48ff18f5c50/b75f29e6-25a9-4d24-9819-925dad947610.png)

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

The challenge explicitly calls for an **autonomous financial coaching agent** that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability, and MoneyFyi delivers on every aspect of this vision through its agentic architecture. Unlike rule-based systems or simple robo-advisors that follow predetermined formulas, our platform embodies *true autonomy* through its **multi-agent design** where specialized models continuously observe, analyze, and adapt to changing conditions without requiring manual intervention. The system proactively monitors financial news across languages, tracks market movements in real time, and most importantly, *learns from each user's actual decisions* to refine its understanding of their preferences and constraints. When a gig worker receives payment for three projects in one month but nothing the next, MoneyFyi doesn't blindly suggest a fixed SIP amount; instead, it recognizes the income pattern and recommends *flexible investment strategies* that align with irregular cash flows.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/f534f278b73c407e982df48ff18f5c50/55da0d04-fee7-4eca-a5a6-3fe99c00988c.png)
The feedback loop layer ensures that every user interaction, whether accepting or rejecting a suggestion, feeds back into the system to improve future recommendations. This creates what we call a "**wealth loop**" where better recommendations lead to more confident decisions, which generate data that makes subsequent advice even more relevant, ultimately helping users build financial security despite income uncertainty.

The platform specifically targets the populations mentioned in the challenge brief: gig workers who lack access to employer-sponsored financial planning, informal sector employees whose income doesn't fit traditional banking models, and everyday citizens who find existing investment platforms intimidating or irrelevant. By combining sentiment analysis from both English and regional language sources, MoneyFyi captures market signals that monolingual platforms miss entirely, giving users a more complete picture of investment opportunities and risks. The multilingual interface and voice interaction capabilities mean that financial literacy levels or language barriers no longer prevent someone from receiving quality investment guidance. Rather than waiting for users to ask questions, the system **proactively** sends alerts when market conditions change, when portfolio rebalancing makes sense, or when news about their holdings requires attention. This proactive stance, combined with *explainable recommendations* that break down the reasoning behind each suggestion, helps users develop genuine financial understanding over time rather than just following instructions blindly. The *moderate-risk focus* ensures recommendations balance growth potential with safety, particularly important for users who cannot afford significant losses. Through this comprehensive approach, MoneyFyi transforms financial coaching from a luxury service available only to the wealthy into an accessible, intelligent companion that helps India's diverse workforce navigate investment decisions with confidence and clarity.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/slopscoreai-f50b) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-MumbaiHacks%202025%20--%20Round%201%20(Online)-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mumbaihacks25-round1.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-3-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> YouTube with context, not just content.

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![YouTube Data API](https://img.shields.io/badge/YouTube%20Data%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square) ![langchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/langchain-333333?style=flat-square) ![Convex](https://img.shields.io/badge/Convex-333333?style=flat-square) ![huggingface transformers](https://img.shields.io/badge/huggingface%20transformers-333333?style=flat-square) ![wxt](https://img.shields.io/badge/wxt-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

**SlopScore.ai**

SlopScore.ai will be a browser extension built with WXT, aimed **to provide user with a fact, citation and claim analysis of the YouTube content they are about to watch**. Instead of asking "Is this AI-generated?"—a question current detectors answer unreliably with lots of false positives—**we ask better questions**: "What claims does this video make? Can reputable sources verify them? Are the citations legitimate? Does this source cite AI-generated content as credible?"

**Our unique approach is rooted in lateral reading**, the gold standard technique professional fact-checkers use. This method is highly effective but manual and time-consuming, requiring expertise average users don't possess. **We aim to automate it in 30 seconds.**

___


**The multi-agent architecture**
SlopScore.ai deploys five specialized autonomous agents that work in parallel, each investigating a different dimension of content credibility:

**1. Claim Extraction Agent**
Extracts factual assertions (statistics, dates, causal relationships) from transcripts. Scans for AI linguistic patterns: M-dash overuse, parallel structures, buzzwords like "delve" and "innovative". OpenAI provides confidence scores stored in Convex.​

**2. Source Check Agent**
Automates lateral reading by querying Google's ClaimReview database (Reuters, AP, PolitiFact). Reports which claims were corroborated, contradicted, or lack coverage. Cached in Convex.​

**3. Author & Outlet Reputation Agent**
Checks domains against AI content farm databases, analyzes domain age (WHOIS), performs recursive AI text analysis on cited articles using OpenAI. Outputs credibility scores with evidence.​

**4. Image Analysis Agent**
Reverse image searches randomly selected frames from the video. Uses Hugging Face deepfake detection models to scan for anatomical impossibilities, inconsistent lighting, AI noise patterns. Flags context mismatches.​

**5. Synthesis & Supervisor Agent**
Supervises parallel execution of the four specialized agents and compiles findings into a coherent, actionable Trust Report using LangChain's StateGraph.

___

**Citation Chain Verification (2-3 Levels Deep)**
Our killer differentiator—no existing tool addresses the AI-citing-AI echo chamber.​

**Level 1:** Node.js fetches cited URLs, OpenAI detects AI patterns (87%), cross-references domains against Convex content farm database.​

**Level 2:** LangChain recursively analyzes citations in those articles, identifying circular reference networks. Convex stores citation graph relationships.

**Level 3:** Google Fact Check API verifies against authoritative sources for claims that pass Levels 1-2.

Smart Early Stopping: LangChain skips deeper investigation if Level 1 identifies trusted sources cached in Convex.

___


**How This Addresses Each Problem**

**Problem 1: Invisible Misinformation**
We give the user context: OpenAI-detected patterns, Google Fact Check verification results, Convex credibility scores, Hugging Face visual analysis. Students get 30-second fact-checks before citing sources.​

**Problem 2: AI-Citing-AI Echo Chamber**
We break the loop. Convex stores contaminated citation graphs. Next.js visualizes where human verification disappears.​

**Problem 3: Crisis Exploitation**
Parallel agents on Vercel's edge network provide verification in 30 seconds. Google Fact Check API distinguishes verified authorities from content farms.

___

**Frontend:** WXT browser extension with Next.js for responsive UI integrated into YouTube's interface. WXT handles Chrome APIs (tab detection, storage, content injection).

**Backend:** Node.js on Vercel's edge network for global low-latency, serverless auto-scaling.

**Agent Orchestration:** LangChain coordinates five parallel agents using LangGraph's supervisor architecture.

**Data Layer:** Convex real-time database stores analysis results and verified video database. Reactive queries enable instant cache retrieval (30-day window, zero API cost, sub-second response).

**External APIs:** YouTube Data API (transcripts), OpenAI Moderation API (pattern detection), Google Fact Check API (corroboration), Hugging Face Transformers (image artifacts).

___

**User Experience**
Users see progressive results (5s: transcript score; 12s: source verification; 20s: image analysis; 30s: full Trust Report) and choose whether to watch, skip, or explore alternatives.

___

**Why This Is Uniquely Defensible**
Not Detection-Based: Focus on verification infrastructure (Google Fact Check + citation analysis), not pattern matching.​

Augments Judgment: We leaves decisions to users. Our role is to help them make better of these decisions.​

Network Effects: Every analysis enriches Convex database. More users = faster results, better recommendations, richer content farm databases.​

___

**We're building verification infrastructure for the post-AI internet**, not another unreliable AI detector.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Low-quality media created on a large scale using gen-AI with little human labour, aka **AI slop**, is making its way into every platform. This AI slop contains both spammy content and professional looking content, with polished thumbnails, properly formatted citations, and fluid editing **all masking fake content underneath**. Its content, which prioritises volume and speed over accuracy and substance, is meant to draw in viewers and generate revenue **regardless of the truthfullness of the information.**

___


The **AI-citing-AI echo chamber** is an additional risk associated with this AI slop. AI-generated videos create endless loops of confident misinformation by citing other AI-generated articles and videos as "legitimate sources." The next AI researcher takes the transcript of that video and treats the false claim as confirmed truth when one AI script contains a hallucination, increasing errors exponentially with each iteration.

___


Students doing essay research, professionals looking for industry insights, and just learners in general take this information at face value without realising it is incredibly false, hallucinated misinformation. Furthermore, when **bad actors** are involved and disseminating false information widely, this AI slop becomes even more dangerous in times of crisis.

___


So the problem is like this - 
**1. Invisible Misinformation at Scale:** Content that appears authentic but is factually incorrect.
.

**2. The AI-Citing-AI Echo Chamber:** Videos produced by AI refer to other AI-generated articles as "credible sources," resulting in endless cycles of self-assured disinformation.
.
 
**3. Crisis Exploitation:** When there is a crisis, bad actors take advantage of the urgency to disseminate misleading information more quickly than fact-checkers can react. YouTube's algorithm amplifies both AI-generated panic content and verified emergency information based on engagement metrics, without making a distinction between the two.​

___


**How can we resolve this then?** By providing the user with information about the material they are going to view, they can utilise it to help them decide whether or not they want to watch the video.

**Description of your solution**

**Project Abstract: Med Perplexity**

**An Autonomous AI Co-pilot for Clinical Decision-Making in India**

**The Challenge: A Healthcare Frontline at its Breaking Point**

India's healthcare frontline operates under immense strain. Confronted with crushing patient loads and the escalating complexity of modern medicine, clinicians are forced to make high-stakes decisions under extreme time pressure. This environment leaves no room for the deep research which complex cases demand, elevating the risk of diagnostic error and fueling physician burnout. The result is a critical bottleneck where the sheer volume of information and patients threatens to overwhelm the expertise of even the most dedicated doctors.

**The Solution: Augmenting Clinical Intellect with an Autonomous Co-pilot**

Med Perplexity is an autonomous clinical co-pilot engineered to fortify the decision-making of Indian doctors. We move beyond simple search tools to deliver a platform that performs deep, multi-source research, personalizes it to an individual patient's context, and validates it for safety—all in **under two minutes**. Our system is built on a sophisticated multi-agent architecture, where three specialized AI agents execute in parallel to systematically deconstruct the challenges of information overload and diagnostic uncertainty.

**The Innovation: A Three-Agent Architecture for Clinical Excellence**

Our core innovation is an agentic AI framework orchestrated by **LangGraph** that mirrors and accelerates the ideal clinical reasoning process:

1. **The Research Agent** unleashes a deep research engine. It traverses a 138-million-document vector space, integrating global evidence from PubMed with hyper-relevant Indian guidelines from **ICMR and NMC**. Critically, it moves beyond keyword matching by navigating **Neo4j knowledge graphs** to discover non-obvious, multi-hop clinical relationships that are often missed by human researchers.
2. **The Personalization Agent** constructs a high-fidelity patient profile in real-time. By connecting to the **Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM)** network via **FHIR APIs**, it synthesizes a patient’s complete, longitudinal health record—including comorbidities, allergies, and lab data—to ensure all recommendations are perfectly tailored.
3. **The Safety Agent** acts as an essential clinical guardrail. It systematically validates every output against drug interaction databases, enforces **ICMR’s antibiotic stewardship protocols**, and flags contraindications based on the patient's profile. This agent provides a quantifiable **confidence score**, ensuring a rigorous layer of safety is applied to all AI-generated insights.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a2fd0e21ab0445a2a93057de90120477/4152ac2f-d521-400b-b0a7-5a06aab64331.jpeg)

**What Makes Med Perplexity Uniquely Impactful**

This platform is not merely a tool; it is a proactive partner in patient care, designed from the ground up for the Indian healthcare ecosystem.

- **Hyper-Localized Intelligence:** Our system is fine-tuned on Indian clinical data, prioritizes **cost-effective generic alternatives** from the Jan Aushadhi scheme, and provides multilingual support to bridge communication gaps with patients.
- **Proactive, 'Living' Knowledge:** A proprietary **"Living Updates Daemon"** continuously monitors over 100 global and Indian guideline sources, alerting physicians within 24 hours of any change to a critical treatment protocol. This transforms the platform from a static repository into a dynamic, ever-current source of truth.
- **Uncompromising Safety & Transparency:** We provide a fully auditable, **explainable AI** with step-by-step rationale for every recommendation. A mandatory physician approval gate ensures the clinician always remains the final authority in patient care.

**Our Path to Impact: Audience, Strategy, and Revenue**

Our platform is engineered for the **entire spectrum of Indian clinicians**—from specialists in high-volume urban hospitals to physicians in rural Primary Health Centers. Our **go-to-market strategy** is a deliberate **three-phase progression**, beginning with a **validation pilot in leading Mumbai hospitals** to build trust and prove efficacy. This will fuel our expansion through **strategic partnerships with state governments and institutional healthcare chains**, followed by the **launch of a multi-tiered subscription model for individual practitioners** and a **usage-based enterprise API for telemedicine platforms**, ensuring a scalable and diverse revenue stream.


By automating the cognitive heavy-lifting of research and validation, Med Perplexity restores the physician's most valuable resource: time for critical thinking and patient care. It is a leap forward in augmenting clinical intellect, designed to empower India's doctors and redefine the standard of care for millions.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Our project, Med Perplexity, is engineered to be a direct and compelling fit for the **"HealthTech: Bring Your Own Problem, Leveraging Agentic AI" track.** We believe our platform embodies the spirit of this theme by precisely addressing both of its core components.

**1. On "Bring Your Own Problem in healthtech":**
We didn't choose a generic problem; we identified a critical, high-stakes bottleneck specific to the Indian healthcare frontline: **debilitating cognitive overload.**

Our abstract opens by defining this challenge—clinicians facing immense patient loads are forced to make high-stakes decisions without the time for deep, evidence-based research. This leads directly to physician burnout and elevates the risk of medical error. This is not a theoretical issue; it is the daily reality for the doctors we aim to serve. Med Perplexity is our targeted solution to this self-identified crisis, designed to restore the clinician's most valuable resource: the time and mental space required for critical thinking and patient care.

**2. On "Leveraging Agentic AI":**
Our solution is not just an application of AI; it is a deliberate implementation of a **true agentic framework**. Med Perplexity is an autonomous co-pilot, not a passive chatbot.

Our innovation is the three-agent architecture, orchestrated by LangGraph, where specialized agents work in parallel to execute a complex clinical reasoning task:

- The **Research Agent** doesn't just search; it autonomously navigates a 138-million-document vector space and traverses complex knowledge graphs to uncover non-obvious clinical insights.
- The **Personalization Agent **actively constructs a patient profile by connecting to the national ABDM network via APIs in real-time.
- The **Safety Agent** acts as a validation engine, systematically enforcing ICMR protocols and running contraindication checks on every piece of output.

These are not just models; they are autonomous entities with specific goals, tools, and the ability to execute a plan. This multi-agent system—planning, executing, and validating in concert—is the very definition of leveraging agentic AI to solve a profound real-world problem.

> Building Truth One Layer At A Time

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Natural language processing (NLP)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Natural%20language%20processing%20(NLP)-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![BERT](https://img.shields.io/badge/BERT-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Apache Kafka](https://img.shields.io/badge/Apache%20Kafka-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

****ProofStack**** is an intelligent misinformation detection platform designed to restore clarity during information chaos. When global crises strike—pandemics, natural disasters, geopolitical conflicts—citizens are flooded with contradictory claims from countless sources. ProofStack cuts through this noise by mimicking the human instinct of knowing who to trust, powered by advanced AI architectures that verify claims in real time.
At its core lies the Trust Graph a dynamic knowledge network that maps the credibility landscape of online information sources. Unlike traditional fact-checkers that treat all sources equally, ProofStack continuously learns which voices remain accurate across different events. The system doesn't just tell you if something is true—it shows you why, with transparent evidence trails that anyone can understand.
**The Four-Layer Verification Architecture**
**Layer 1: Claim Intelligence – Understanding What's Being Said**
When a viral post or rumor enters the system, ProofStack doesn't process it as raw text. Instead, it uses Named Entity Recognition (NER) and dependency parsing to extract structured factual elements.
For example:
•	Input: "Breaking: Massive flood in Mumbai's Andheri area, 50+ casualties reported"
•	Extracted Claim: [Event: Flood | Location: Andheri, Mumbai | Impact: 50+ casualties | Time: Today | Status: Unverified]
This structured representation allows the system to perform precise semantic matching against verified databases. The claim extraction module uses transformer-based models fine-tuned on fact-checking datasets to identify check-worthy claims while filtering out opinions and subjective statements.

**Layer 2: The Trust Graph – Knowing Who to Believe**
The Trust Graph is ProofStack's intelligence backbone—a weighted directed graph where nodes represent information sources (news agencies, government portals, domain experts, NGOs) and edges represent verification relationships.
Each source node maintains a dynamic Trust Score calculated using:
•	Historical Accuracy: Track record of verified vs. debunked claims
•	Cross-Source Agreement: How often other high-trust sources corroborate their reporting
•	Transparency Metrics: Presence of citations, correction policies, and editorial standards
•	Temporal Consistency: Reliability maintained across different crisis events
The Trust Score isn't static—it evolves with every new claim. If a previously reliable source repeatedly publishes unverified information during a crisis, its score degrades. Conversely, new sources can build credibility through consistent accuracy.

**Layer 3: Cross-Verification Engine – Finding the Truth Trail**
Once a claim is structured, the Cross-Verification Engine launches a semantic search across multiple information streams simultaneously: 
•	Government Bulletins: Official disaster management agencies (NDMA, IMD)
•	News APIs: Real-time feeds from high-trust news organizations
•	Fact-Check Databases: IFCN-certified fact-checkers, Snopes, PolitiFact
•	Archived Content: Reverse image search, historical event databases
•	Social Verification: Expert verification from domain specialists
The engine uses sentence transformers (S-BERT) to compute semantic similarity between the extracted claim and evidence documents, going beyond keyword matching to understand context and meaning. This prevents the system from being fooled by paraphrased misinformation or recycled old content presented as new.

**Layer 4: Multi-Source Reasoning – Measuring Agreement**
ProofStack doesn't rely on a single source. Instead, it employs ensemble reasoning across the Trust Graph to reach a verdict:
•	Verified: 3+ independent high-trust sources confirm with semantic agreement >85%
•	False: Authoritative sources explicitly deny + evidence contradicts claim
•	Uncertain: Conflicting evidence or insufficient high-trust confirmation
•	Monitoring: Claim actively tracked until official statements emerge
The system weights each source's contribution by its Trust Score and domain relevance. A meteorological department carries more weight for weather claims than a general news outlet.

**Layer 5: Explainable Verdicts – Transparency by Design**
ProofStack generates human-readable explanations for every verdict using explainable AI techniques:
**Example Output:**
Claim: "Flood in Andheri with 50+ casualties"
Verdict: PARTIALLY FALSE
Confidence: 87%

**Evidence Summary:**
Mumbai Municipal Corporation confirms flooding in Andheri (Trust: 9.2/10)
NDMA reports no casualties as of 3:00 PM (Trust: 9.5/10)
Viral image traced to 2020 Bihar floods (Reverse Image Search)

**Conclusion:** Flooding confirmed, casualty claim unverified and likely false based on recycled imagery.

**Sources:** [BMC Official Portal] [NDMA Crisis Dashboard] [TinEye Archive]
This transparency builds user trust and educates citizens on verification techniques.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

**Proof Stack – Real Facts, When They Matter Most**
**How It Fits the Misinformation Track**
The Misinformation track asks for an AI agent that can continuously scan multiple sources, detect emerging misinformation, verify facts, and provide simple, clear updates to the public during crises.
Proof Stack is built exactly for that — an agentic system designed to work in real-world emergencies.
**1. Continuous Monitoring Across Sources**
Proof Stack keeps a constant watch on everything happening online:
•	Social Media: Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook
•	News Outlets: Reuters, PTI, NDTV, local channels
•	Official Portals: NDMA, IMD, PIB
•	Fact-Check Databases: IFCN, Google Fact Check Tools
•	Archived Content: Historical web repositories
Tech Stack:
•	Apache Kafka for real-time stream ingestion
•	Spike detection algorithms to identify trending claims
•	Autonomous prioritization based on virality (shares, retweets, cross-platform spread)
Example: During a cyclone, Proof Stack can detect multiple versions of a false evacuation claim spreading on WhatsApp, Twitter, and local news — all within minutes, without human input.
**2. Early Misinformation Detection**
The system doesn’t just watch — it understands what’s being said.
•	Claim Intelligence Module: Uses BERT-based NLP models to extract factual claims (who, what, where, when) and ignore opinions or jokes
•	Anomaly Detection: Graph-based models detect coordinated misinformation campaigns by analyzing:
o	Sudden spikes from low-trust accounts
o	Recycled images (via reverse image search)
o	Bot networks spreading the same false story
Trust Graph: The system learns which sources are reliable during crises. Suspicious or low-trust accounts making dramatic claims are flagged for fast verification.
Example: A viral image claiming “50+ casualties in Mumbai flood” is traced back to 2020 Bihar flood footage and flagged as false in seconds.
**3. Multi-Layer Fact Verification**
Proof Stack verifies claims like a professional fact-checker:
Layer 1 – Trust Graph:
•	Cross-references claims against 500+ verified sources with real-time trust scores (0–10)
•	Weighs official authorities higher than anonymous accounts
Layer 2 – Semantic Cross-Verification:
•	Uses S-BERT sentence transformers to find contextually similar content in news, government bulletins, and fact-check databases
•	Understands paraphrasing and subtle differences in language
Layer 3 – Multi-Source Reasoning:
•	Requires agreement from 3+ independent high-trust sources for “verified”
•	Explicit denials from authorities → flagged “false”
•	Conflicting evidence → “uncertain/monitoring”
Layer 4 – Evidence Quality Check:
•	Checks for primary sources (official statements, on-ground reporting)
•	Validates timestamps to avoid recycled content
•	Assigns confidence scores (0–100%) based on evidence strength
Example: Claim: “Government announces complete lockdown in Delhi” → checked across PIB, Delhi Government portal, ANI, PTI → verdict: FALSE (Confidence 91%) in 45 seconds.

 **4. Easy-to-Understand Updates**
Proof Stack explains results in simple, human-readable language:
Claim: “50+ casualties in Mumbai flood”
Verdict: PARTIALLY FALSE (87% confidence)
Findings:
•	Flooding in Andheri confirmed (Trust: 9.2/10)
•	No casualties reported by NDMA (Trust: 9.5/10)
•	Viral image traced to 2020 Bihar flood
Bottom Line: Flood exists, but casualty numbers are unverified and the image is old.
Delivery Options:
•	Web dashboard for journalists and crisis teams
•	Browser extension for real-time social media flagging
•	Public API for WhatsApp, Telegram alerts
•	SMS for low-internet regions
•	Multilingual NLP support (Hindi, English, regional languages)
•	Voice-enabled updates for accessibility
**Why Proof Stack Stands Out**
•	Agentic AI: Operates autonomously, continuously updating trust scores and learning from new information
•	Crisis-Optimized: Fast, scalable, and tuned for high-stakes situations
•	Transparent & Public-Focused: Provides clear evidence-backed updates to citizens, not just experts
•	Real Impact: Helps people know what to trust and act safely when misinformation spreads
Tech Stack Summary: Apache Kafka, BERT/NLP, S-BERT, Graph-based anomaly detection, Reverse Image Search, Multilingual NLP models, Web + API + SMS + Browser Extensions.

**The problem it solves**

**TripWhat** remedies the daunting complexity of organizing multi-city trips by reducing hours of research to minutes of AI-driven chat.  

---

## **What People Can Use It For**

### **Instant Trip Planning**
- Flights and hotel reservation integrated  
- Live events include feature  
- Create full multi-day trip plans for individuals or groups  
- Get customized suggestions based on travel type (adventure, cultural, relaxation, business)  
- Get budget-sensitive suggestions that honor budget limits  

### **Conversational Travel Assistant**
- Pose natural language queries such as "Tell me the top restaurants in Paris" or "What is the forecast in Tokyo next week?"  
- Receive real-time answers without having to flip between several apps  
- Refine travel itineraries via basic chat dialogue  

### **Detailed Travel Logistics**
- Look at day-to-day timelines with morning, afternoon, and evening events  
- Receive comprehensive flight and hotel recommendations within your plan  
- View travel paths and distances between locations on interactive maps  

## **How It Eases Travel Planning**
- Replaces over 10 apps (Google Maps, TripAdvisor, Flight Search, Weather, Budget Tracker) with a single smart platform  
- Trims planning time from 6–8 hours to less than 10 minutes leveraging AI-driven intent detection and LangGraph orchestration  
- Avoids decision fatigue by filtering thousands of attractions based on individual preferences and budget limits  
- Integrates with Google Calendar so your trips are automatically added to your schedule  
- Saves money with budget-aware recommendations that maximize experiences within your financial limits  

---

## **Why TripWhat is Different from Generic AI Services**

### **Specialized vs. General AI**

**Generic AI (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.):**
- Generic responses with no real-time data  
- No ability to search live flights, hotels, or attractions  
- Hallucinated information (restaurants that don't exist, wrong prices)  
- Static conversations that don't persist  
- No visual maps or interactive itineraries  
- You manually copy-paste everything  

**TripWhat:**
- Live integration with Amadeus (flights), Google Places (sights), OpenTripMap (tourist information)  
- Actual prices, actual availability — not AI fantasies  
- Persistent trip state — your itineraries are stored and editable  
- Interactive maps displaying all activities with coordinates  
- Budget tracking with automatic cost estimation per day  
- One-click export to Google Calendar  

---

## **Technical Advantages**

### **Multi-Tool Orchestration (Model Context Protocol)**
TripWhat employs 10+ expert tools (search for places, calculate distance, search for flights, find restaurants) that get triggered automatically depending on your inquiry.  
Generic AI can respond only with text — no API hooks.  

### **Smart Intent Recognition**
LangGraph state machine parses your message and identifies what tools to invoke (e.g., "I want to go to Rome" → invokes destination search + attractions nearby + hotel search + budget calculation).  
90%+ accuracy in interpreting travel-related requests.  

---

## **Ideal For**
- Independent travelers looking for effective planning  
- Families planning multi-city trips  
- Digital nomads coordinating frequent travel  
- Travelers finding off-the-beaten-path gems  
- Anyone frustrated with conventional travel planning

**Challenges we ran into**

## 1. Duplicate Activities Across Days 
### The Problem:
When generating multi-day itineraries, Days 1, 2, and 3 were showing identical activities. Users would get the Eiffel Tower repeated three times instead of a diverse travel experience.

### Root Cause:

Each day was making separate API requests without tracking what had been used
No global state to prevent activity repetition
Distribution algorithm was naive and didn't share context across days

### How I Fixed It: 
Caching for 24 hours responses and filtering

## 2. API Rate Limiting Issue
### The Problem:
OpenTripMap API was returning 429 (Too Many Requests) errors during itinerary generation, causing the entire flow to fail.

### Root Cause:
Making rapid-fire requests (one per category per day)
No retry mechanism
No exponential backoff

### How I Fixed It:
Exponential backoff and first category analysis and identification through ML

### Impact: 
Rate limit errors dropped from ~40% to <1% of requests.

## 3. Google Places API Migration Complexity

### The Problem:
OpenTripMap had limited data quality and outdated information. Migrating to Google Places required mapping user intents to 100+ place types.

### The Challenge:

Google Places has 122 different place types (museum, art_gallery, tourist_attraction, etc.)
User queries like "show me art in Paris" needed to map to multiple types
No built-in category detection

### How I Fixed It:

Created google-places-types.ts with comprehensive type mappings
Used GPT-4o-mini for intelligent intent-to-type detection
Fallback to default types if LLM fails
### Impact: 
Search relevance improved by 85% with real-time, accurate place data.

## 4. Socket.io Real-Time Sync Issues 📡
### The Problem:
Chat messages were out of order or duplicated due to race conditions between Socket.io and REST API calls.
Frontend was making both REST POST and listening to Socket.io events
No message deduplication
Multiple socket connections per user
### How I Fixed It:
Frontend: Deduplicate messages by ID
single socket per connection
### Impact: 
Message sync issues reduced from ~15% to 0%.

## 5. LangGraph State Management 
### The Problem:
State wasn't updating correctly between LangGraph nodes. The searchResults field was being overwritten by subsequent nodes.

### Root Cause:
Misunderstanding of LangGraph's reducer functions
Using reducer: (left, right) => right for arrays
Not returning partial state updates correctly

### How I Fixed It:
Used concatenate and partial state updates were fixed

### Impact: 
State flow became 100% predictable with no data loss.

## 6. Image Fallback Problem
### The Problem:
Activity cards were showing random Unsplash stock photos instead of real place images from Google Places API.

Root Cause:

Multiple fallback layers (Google → Unsplash → placeholder)
Old code still generating Unsplash URLs
Frontend had aggressive fallback logic
### How I Fixed It:
Google Places plus OpenTripMap fallback

### Impact:
100% authentic Google Places photos displayed. No more confusing stock images.

## 7. Flight API Integration Complexity 
### The Problem:
Amadeus Flight API required IATA codes (JFK, CDG), but users enter city names. Also, their access token expires every 30 minutes.

### How I Fixed It: 
OpenAI LLM basedweb-search fallback for lookuo

### Impact:
IATA lookup success rate: 98%.
Token refresh errors: 0. API cost reduced by 80% with caching.

![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![NumPy](https://img.shields.io/badge/NumPy-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenCV](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCV-333333?style=flat-square) ![pandas](https://img.shields.io/badge/pandas-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![YOLOv3 Algorithm](https://img.shields.io/badge/YOLOv3%20Algorithm-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Problem It Solves

*Falcon Safety Sentinel* tackles the challenge of maintaining *crew safety and operational efficiency* in high-risk, enclosed environments — such as space stations, industrial plants, and research facilities. In these places, missing or obstructed safety equipment can turn small oversights into life-threatening emergencies.

What People Can Use It For

* *Space Operations:* Automatically detect and verify the presence of critical safety tools — fire extinguishers, oxygen tanks, emergency phones — ensuring readiness for emergencies.
* *Industrial Safety:* Monitor factory floors or energy plants to confirm that first-aid boxes, safety switches, and alarms are accessible and functional.
* *Training Simulations:* Help astronauts or safety officers practice emergency responses within digital twin simulations powered by Falcon’s synthetic data.
* *Remote Facility Monitoring:* Enable continuous, AI-driven inspection for remote or hazardous environments without requiring constant human supervision.

How It Makes Tasks Easier and Safer

* *Automated Safety Audits:* Replaces manual, error-prone equipment checks with continuous real-time detection.
* *Reduced Human Risk:* Minimizes the need for personnel to physically inspect dangerous areas.
* *Faster Incident Response:* Provides instant alerts when a safety object is missing, misplaced, or obstructed.
* *Cross-Domain Adaptability:* The same detection model can be deployed in submarines, power plants, or cleanrooms with minimal adjustments.

 Impact

By combining advanced YOLOv8 detection with synthetic digital twin data, Falcon Safety Sentinel ensures *zero blind spots* in safety monitoring — improving reliability, reducing downtime, and protecting lives in extreme environments.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into

Building *Falcon Safety Sentinel* came with a unique mix of technical and data-driven challenges. Here are the most impactful ones and how we solved them:

 1. Model Crashing Due to Missing or Empty Labels

*Problem:*
During early validation, the training pipeline crashed because some .txt annotation files were empty or missing. YOLOv8 requires each image to either have valid labels or no corresponding file at all.

*Solution:*
I wrote a custom *dataset verification script* (verify_dataset.py) that scanned for missing or empty labels before training. It automatically removed or flagged invalid files, ensuring the dataset integrity and preventing training interruptions.

---

 2. False Positives in Low-Light and Cluttered Scenes

*Problem:*
The model often misclassified bright surfaces or reflections as safety devices — particularly *EmergencyPhones* — in dimly lit or cluttered scenes.

*Solution:*
Tuned the *Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS)* threshold (0.4 → 0.6) and added *brightness augmentations* to help the model learn better under low illumination. This cut false positives by over 25%.

---

 3. Low Recall for Occluded Objects

*Problem:*
The *OxygenTank* class had poor recall when partially hidden behind other equipment.

*Solution:*
Introduced *Mosaic Augmentation* to help the model learn contextual patterns from partially visible objects, and applied *Focal Loss* to give more weight to hard examples. This improved recall significantly.

---

 4. Dependency and Environment Setup Issues

*Problem:*
The training scripts initially failed due to missing packages like ultralytics and mismatched Python environments.

*Solution:*
Created a clean *Anaconda EDU environment* and an automated setup_env.bat installer that ensures all dependencies (PyTorch, Ultralytics, OpenCV) are properly installed before running the scripts.

---

 Outcome

Each of these challenges forced careful debugging and experimentation. Overcoming them not only stabilized the pipeline but also led to higher *mAP (from 61.3% → 88.2%)* and reliable real-time performance.

**AI**

How This Project Fits Into AI

**Falcon Safety Sentinel** is a prime example of how **Artificial Intelligence**—specifically **Computer Vision** and **Deep Learning**—can be applied to enhance real-world safety and automation.

 Core AI Concepts Used

* **Object Detection (YOLOv8):**
  The project leverages a deep convolutional neural network (CNN)-based model to detect and classify multiple safety objects within images or video streams.
* **Transfer Learning:**
  Pretrained YOLOv8 weights on the COCO dataset were fine-tuned using the Falcon synthetic dataset, allowing the model to learn specialized space-station objects efficiently.
* **Data Augmentation & Regularization:**
  Techniques like Mosaic, brightness/contrast adjustment, and Focal Loss improve the model’s generalization—making it robust to occlusions, lighting changes, and cluttered environments.
* **Inference Optimization:**
  Techniques such as FP16 precision and NMS tuning ensure real-time detection speeds (22ms per frame) suitable for live monitoring.

 Real-World AI Impact

* **Safety Intelligence:** Automates safety audits, replacing manual visual inspections with AI-driven monitoring.
* **Digital Twins & Simulation:** Uses AI to train on synthetic data generated by Falcon’s digital twin simulations—demonstrating how AI can learn from virtual environments to perform better in the real world.
* **Edge AI Applications:** Designed for low-latency performance, making it deployable on edge devices within space habitats, factories, or remote facilities.

 Why It Matters

This project embodies the **AI transformation of safety operations**—turning passive monitoring systems into intelligent, proactive safety assistants. It shows how AI can help humans **anticipate, detect, and prevent** critical failures in high-stakes environments like space missions.

**The problem it solves**

The Problem Driply Solves

Let’s be honest — scrolling reels is fun, but finding that exact outfit you just saw? Total nightmare.

**Picture this:**

- You spot a 🔥 outfit in a 15-second reel.
- You screenshot it.
- You Google it.
- You open 10 different tabs trying to track it down.
- You get frustrated.
- Maybe you even give up and settle for something else.

Sound familiar?

And it’s not just you — creators and brands feel the pain too.

Influencer collabs? Expensive, unpredictable, and often don’t convert.
Ads? People swipe past them in seconds. ROI? Basically a guessing game.
Brands are spending big, but engagement and actual sales? Meh.

**Enter Driply**

Driply flips the script and makes scrolling reels feel like a shopping spree—without the headaches.

- Spot it → Shop it

See an outfit you like? Add it to your cart instantly. No screenshots, no endless searching, no Google rabbit holes.

- Real vibes, real fits

Our AI scans the reel, detects the clothing, and matches it with the best products online. Your style, your rules.

- Effortless for creators

Just make content — Driply handles the shopping magic. Every reel you post can earn money, no sponsorships required.

- Smart for brands

Products land in front of the right audience — people who actually want to buy. You only pay when sales happen. True efficiency.

**Why It Matters**

⚡ No friction for users — stop wasting time searching. Get exactly what you saw in seconds.
💸 Boosts creator income — every reel becomes a monetizable experience.
📈 Maximizes brand ROI — campaigns become targeted, trackable, and meaningful.

**TL;DR**

Driply turns:
“I wish I had that”
into
“I just got it.”

Seamless. Stylish. Instant. Every scroll, every flick, every reel becomes fun, frictionless, and shopping-ready.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building Driply was a wild ride. There were moments I thought, “This might never work,” but each hurdle taught me something new. Here’s the tea:

1. Outfit Detection Chaos 👗🎥

Reels are fast, messy, and full of movement. Lighting changes, busy backgrounds, and tiny details like patterns made the AI confused AF sometimes. Hats looked like shirts. Sneakers looked like bags. Classic.

Fix: I added data augmentation for lighting and angles, plus temporal smoothing so the AI could “remember” outfits across frames. Suddenly it started nailing the outfits most of the time.

2. Shopping Match Madness 🛒🎯

Detecting the outfit is one thing. Matching it to real products? Whole different beast. Colors, styles, and stock availability kept tripping us up.

Fix: Built a smart similarity scoring system using color, style, and category. Added fallback suggestions when no exact match existed. Now users can spot it → shop it without stressing.

3. Speed vs. Reality ⚡⏱️

AI is powerful, but real-time video processing is heavy. Users don’t want to wait — even 2 seconds feels forever.

Fix: Optimized with frame sampling, GPU acceleration, and async processing. Now it runs fast, smooth, and feels like magic.

4. Indian Fashion Diversity 🇮🇳👘👟

Indian fashion is insanely diverse — from saris to sneakers, kurtis to streetwear. The model kept mixing up traditional and modern outfits at first.

Fix: Curated a massive Indian fashion dataset, labeled everything, and fine-tuned the AI. Now it handles ethnic, fusion, and streetwear like a pro.

**TL;DR 🕹️✨**

Every bug was a mini-boss. Solving them taught me how to balance speed, accuracy, and user delight.
Driply now detects outfits, matches them instantly, and makes scrolling reels a legit shopping spree.

> Your digital buddy against burnout

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Working Flow ✅
 1. Start Program Launch the system in the background Initialize webcam and keyboard/mouse tracking 🎥 
2. Capture Webcam Image (Every 10 sec) Take a snapshot using the webcam Detect facial expression using an emotion detection model (e.g., FER) Outputs: Emotion label (e.g., "angry", "sad", "neutral") Emotion confidence score ⌨
 3. Track Typing & Mouse Behavior (Real-time) Record key press times and intervals Measure typing speed and pause duration Monitor mouse movement patterns Outputs: Avg typing interval (e.g., 0.85 sec) Max pause duration (e.g., 6.2 sec) Mouse idle time, burstiness ⚙ 
4. Extract Features From webcam: emotion, blink rate, eye/mouth ratio From behavior: typing speed, pause time, mouse speed 
5. Predict Stress Level Combine features from step 4 Input them into a: Lightweight ML model (e.g., Random Forest) (e.g., if sad + long pause → stress) Output: Stress level: 0 = Normal 1 = Mild stress 2 = High stress 🔔 
6. Trigger Micro-Break Notification (If Needed) If stress level ≥ 1: Show desktop popup (non-intrusive) Suggest quick break or activity (e.g., stretch, close eyes) 📝 
7. Log Data and User Feedback Log: Stress predictions User reaction (e.g., "Took break" or "Snoozed") Use this data to: Adjust thresholds over time Personalize break timing 🔁
8. Repeat Every Few Seconds Continue monitoring passively

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenge:

Training keystroke dynamics and facial fatigue analysis worked individually.

The real difficulty was in fusing both models into one system.

Existing datasets were not aligned for this combined task.

Our Approach / Solution:

We customized and curated a unified dataset specifically for MicroBreak Notifier.

Designed a fusion strategy where both behavioral (typing/mouse) and emotional (face cues) signals contribute.

This made the fatigue detection more accurate, adaptive, and context-aware.

Impact:

Instead of 2 separate detectors, we now have a holistic fatigue analysis engine that powers personalized break timing.

**Open Innovation**

MicroBreak Notifier Fits Open Innovation by blending AI + HCI + wellness in a novel way.

Goes beyond rigid timers → context-aware fatigue detection.

Combines keystroke dynamics + facial analysis for the first time.

Built a custom unified dataset since no prior resource existed.

Tackles a real, universal problem: digital burnout.

Scalable to students, coders, workplaces alike.

True example of cross-domain, human-centric innovation.

> From Confusion to Cure with AI

![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![ML Classifier](https://img.shields.io/badge/ML%20Classifier-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

🩺 The Problem Intellicure Solves:
Healthcare today is fragmented, complex, and intimidating for patients.

1. Medical Jargon Barrier:
Most patients can’t understand their own prescriptions, test reports, or clinical documents. This creates anxiety, confusion, and dependence on others for even basic comprehension.

2. Disconnected Diagnostic Pathways:
There is no streamlined system that connects initial symptoms or documents to advanced diagnostics like imaging-based disease detection (e.g., brain scans, chest X-rays).

3. Delayed and Directionless Care:
Patients often don't know what specialist to visit, whether a scan is needed, or how severe their condition might be. As a result, diagnosis and treatment are delayed, sometimes critically.

4. Lack of Intelligence in Health Navigation:
Even tech-enabled platforms rarely offer AI-powered insights that understand, interpret, and act on health data holistically.

🎯 Intellicure Solves This By:
1. Translating complex medical data into plain language so patients can understand their health.

2. Identifying possible diseases from prescriptions, reports, and symptoms using AI.

3. Triggering appropriate diagnostic routes such as MRI/X-ray-based analysis for pneumonia, Alzheimer’s, or brain tumors.

4. Guiding users to the right specialist and offering intelligent doctor appointment booking — all in one unified flow.

**Challenges we ran into**

⚙ The Challenges We Faced While Building Intellicure
1. Finding the Right Datasets — Not Just Any, But the Right Ones
We needed diverse and well-labeled datasets — not just for one disease, but for multiple like pneumonia, brain tumors, and Alzheimer’s. Getting high-quality medical imaging data that reflects real-world cases was tough. Most were either unbalanced, too clinical, or lacking metadata.

2. Choosing the Best Algorithms for Each Problem
Each disease behaves differently — so a one-size-fits-all model wouldn’t work.
We had to test and compare several architectures like EfficientNet for brain tumors, VGG19 for pneumonia, and custom CNNs for Alzheimer's — all while tuning them for maximum accuracy and generalization.

3. Bridging Backend AI with a Frontend That Makes Sense
Connecting powerful AI models with a clean and responsive UI was a real challenge.
Making sure users could upload scans, receive results, and understand them — all smoothly — took careful backend API design and real-time data handling.

4. Data Mapping — From Raw Reports to Structured Intelligence
Users upload prescriptions or clinical notes, often scanned or handwritten.
Mapping that unstructured text into structured inputs for disease prediction and AI interpretation was one of the most critical (and complex) steps.

5. Designing a Seamless End-to-End Pipeline
We didn’t just want to build multiple features — we wanted them to feel like one intelligent flow. That meant designing a user pipeline where everything connects:
Medical jargon translation → disease prediction → scan analysis → doctor booking — all while keeping the experience intuitive and patient-friendly.

### Foundry
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/foundry-0958) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/SrihariSr/Foundry) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Push%20to%20Prod%20Hackathon:%20Building%20at%20the%20Frontier-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://pushtoprod-india.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Taking frontier intelligence to the frontier.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![NumPy](https://img.shields.io/badge/NumPy-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![JSON](https://img.shields.io/badge/JSON-333333?style=flat-square)

**What is the deployed URL for this project?**

https://github.com/SrihariSr/Foundry

**How Did You Use Claude?**

Claude is the product, not an accessory. Remove it and there's nothing left to run.

As the intelligence layer: Sonnet turns one sentence of plain English into a structured task definition: label names, precise definitions, edge cases, and writer personas. Haiku 4.5 then generates several thousand labelled examples through parallel calls, each with a different persona and randomised length, formality, typo rate and code-mixing. That corpus is the six weeks of human annotation a small classifier normally needs. One reasoning system at build time, zero at run time.

As the benchmark: Haiku zero-shot is the reference our own model is measured against, on the same held-out sets, with matched latency, tokens and cost. That's the core evidence: 195 of 200 correct against Haiku's 195 of 200, at $0 versus $352 per million.

**How you are solving it?**

Approach: Use Claude to manufacture the labelled data that was the bottleneck, then compile it into a model small enough to go where Claude cannot. Claude is the factory, not the runtime.

What I built: Describe a task in one sentence. Claude writes the label scheme, generates the training corpus, and generates a separate held-out set from a different seed. We train a small network on it and emit a single Python file with int8 weights embedded, standard library only.
Four minutes. 690KB. 2.3ms latency. There's also a local browser user interface for building and testing models.

What I measured: Training on 50 examples gives 47% on a six-class triage task. 4000 generated examples gives 95%, statistically indistinguishable from Haiku across 200 held-out examples, at $0 against $352 per million. The same pipeline built three models across disaster triage, SMS intent and supermarket orders with nothing changed but the input sentence.

Every emitted model is verified in a fresh subprocess under a changed hash seed and must match the trained model exactly. We also hand-wrote an evaluation set outside the pipeline, which revealed our synthetic test set saturates at 200 examples while real-world accuracy keeps climbing to 4000.

Limits: It cannot reason and will never beat its teacher. Training data is synthetic. Devanagari input fails. No component is novel in isolation; what changed is one sentence and four minutes instead of an ML team and six weeks.

Prior use: All code was written during the hackathon from an empty directory. Nothing reused, not submitted elsewhere. Full commit history is public.

**What is the problem your project solves?**

Frontier models cannot go where most of the world's text lives: offline, on-device, inside data that legally cannot be transmitted, or in hot paths where 800ms of network latency is unacceptable.

The obvious answer is a small local classifier. The model is trivial to build. The reason companies do not have fifty of them is that each needs several thousand labelled examples, and that means annotators and six weeks. So most teams ship a regex instead, or nothing. It also puts this entire category of software out of reach of small teams and NGOs, who have the problem but not the ML budget.

Disaster triage where no dataset can exist yet. On-device fraud detection on messages that should never leave the phone. Moderation at tens of millions of messages a day. Any category newer than the data describing it.

The bottleneck was never the model. It was the data.
