[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/exhuma-d7ca) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/UTKI20/AI_Exoplanet_Detector) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/GKSu0Rkhf-w?si=BzzaMshDHrZAq8il) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-DUHacks%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://duhacks5.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Exoplanet Discovery

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

exHUMA addresses the data overload problem in modern astrophysics. Space telescopes like Kepler and TESS generate millions of light curves—far more than astronomers can analyze manually, causing many potential exoplanet signals to be missed or delayed.

The problem has two main parts: real planetary signals are often buried in stellar noise, and many AI models act as “black boxes,” making scientists reluctant to trust their results.

exHUMA solves this with a hybrid CNN–MLP pipeline that achieves 100% recall, ensuring no viable planet candidates are overlooked. It also integrates explainable AI tools and phase-folding checks, creating a transparent vetting system instead of an opaque predictor.

By reducing manual verification time by over 80%, exHUMA turns exoplanet discovery into a faster, collaborative process, letting researchers focus telescope time on the most promising targets.

**Challenges we ran into**

The Accuracy Paradox: Standard models often ignore planets because they represent less than 1% of the data. exHUMA uses custom weighting to prioritize finding rare signals (Recall) over simple accuracy.

The Explainability Gap: Unlike "Black Box" models, exHUMA uses SHAP Heatmaps to show exactly which photometric points triggered a detection, building trust with researchers.

False Positive Saturation: By using Phase Folding, the engine mathematically verifies periodic "U-shaped" signals, filtering out ~95% of false alarms (like sensor glitches) before a human ever has to see them.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Three.JS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Three.JS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Whisper](https://img.shields.io/badge/Whisper-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

## What Can People Use SignTube For?

SignTube is designed to make digital content accessible, inclusive, and easier to understand for deaf and hard-of-hearing users. It transforms spoken audio into real-time sign language through an on-screen avatar.

### 1. Online Learning & Education
- Understand video lectures on YouTube, Coursera, NPTEL, Khan Academy, etc.
- Follow recorded classroom sessions and webinars.
- Makes self-learning independent without relying on subtitles or interpreters.

### 2. Entertainment & Media
- Watch movies, web series, news, and documentaries with sign language.
- Enjoy content emotionally and naturally instead of only reading captions.

### 3. Live Meetings & Conferences
- Access sign interpretation during Google Meet, Zoom, and Teams.
- Helps deaf users participate equally in discussions and presentations.

### 4. Government & Public Information
- Understand public announcements, training videos, and awareness campaigns.
- Improves safety during emergency broadcasts and instructions.

### 5. Job Training & Skill Development
- Follow technical tutorials, coding videos, and skill courses.
- Reduces dependence on written language and improves comprehension speed.

---

## How It Makes Tasks Easier & Safer

### ✔ Faster Understanding
Sign language is the first language for many deaf users. Visual signing is easier and more natural than reading fast captions.

### ✔ Reduced Cognitive Load
No need to constantly switch between video and subtitles. The signing avatar conveys meaning directly.

### ✔ Better Inclusion
Allows deaf users to participate in digital spaces without external interpreters.

### ✔ Safer Communication
Important instructions (health, safety, emergency, workplace training) become clearly understandable, reducing risks caused by misinterpretation.

### ✔ Independence & Confidence
Users can access any online content on their own, anytime, without waiting for translated versions.

---

> SignTube turns every video into an accessible, sign-language-friendly experience — enabling education, communication, and entertainment for the deaf community with dignity and equality.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges We Ran Into

### 🎯 The GIF Scarcity Problem  
We only have **51 sign GIFs** out of thousands of common words. Our backend logs constantly showed warnings like:

⚠️ No GIF for 'INTERPRETER' (will use 3D animation)
⚠️ No GIF for 'THANK' (will use 3D animation)


**Solution:**
- Built automatic **3D sign animation generation** for missing words to maintain continuity  
- Created a **crowdsourced contribution portal** where the community can upload verified sign GIFs  
- Implemented **graceful fallback** to 3D animation while the sign library grows  

---

### 🔄 Audio-to-Sign Synchronization  
ASL grammar is structurally different from English.  
Example:  
> "I am going to the store" → **"STORE I GO"** in ASL  

**Solution:**  
- Implemented **NLP-based lemmatization and reordering using spaCy**  
- Converted English sentence structure into **ASL token order and timing** before sign rendering  

---

### 🚨 Accuracy Concerns  
We were inspired by real-world incidents of **fake sign language interpreters** at official press conferences.  
The risk of mistranslation can have serious consequences.

**Solution:**
- Designed a **community validation system**  
- Added **transparent fallback indicators** when confidence is low  
- Open-sourced the pipeline so **ASL experts can audit, improve, and verify** translations  

---

### 🎬 YouTube DOM Injection  
YouTube’s dynamic **Shadow DOM** kept destroying our overlay.  
Player controls also conflicted with our `z-index` layers.

**Solution:**  
- Used a **MutationObserver** to detect player reloads  
- Injected the signing avatar into a **fixed-position container outside YouTube’s DOM tree**  
- Maintained a stable overlay independent of UI re-renders  

---

### 🐌 Whisper AI Processing Speed  
Processing a 5-minute video took **30–60 seconds**.  
This was unacceptable for user experience.

**Solution:**  
- Implemented **aggressive caching in Chrome storage**  
- Each video is processed once; subsequent views load the sign stream **instantly**  

---

### 📦 File Naming Chaos  
Sign GIFs had inconsistent naming:

i.gif
Camera.gif
camera.GIF


This caused the backend to miss existing assets.

**Solution:**  
- Wrote a **batch renaming script**  
- Added **case-insensitive lookups**  
- Enforced **naming validation rules** in the contribution portal  

---

## Biggest Lesson

Accessibility is hard — and it cannot be solved in isolation.

SignTube works best as a **community-driven platform**, where:
- Deaf users validate signs  
- Linguists refine grammar rules  
- Developers optimize models  
- Educators guide real-world usage  

We are **not replacing human interpreters**.  
We are making the **99% of videos that will never get interpretation** at least *understandable* — turning silence into access.

**The problem it solves**

Developers using AI coding tools (Copilot/ChatGPT) often get insecure code without knowing it, risking data breaches and vulnerabilities.

NO API KEY IS USED . THIS IS FULLY LOCALLY .

Real Problems We Solve

For Developers:
"Is this AI-generated code safe to use?" ❌

"Did Copilot just give me vulnerable code?" 😰

"I can't manually check every AI suggestion" ⏰

For Security Teams:
"AI tools bypass our code review process" 🚫

"We need to trust but verify AI-generated code" 🔍

"How do we scale security with AI adoption?" 📈

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/5d4c04af90df420cb3ae1e369dea6a41/c6e06206-3fda-42b9-997d-8208ab884d15.png)

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Finding the Exact Regex Patterns for Vulnerabilities

One of the biggest hurdles was designing regex patterns that accurately detect insecure code without producing false alarms. For example, detecting hardcoded credentials or unsafe eval() usage required multiple iterations because simple patterns were either too broad or too narrow.
Fix: I tested each regex on dozens of real AI-generated snippets, refined them repeatedly, and built a small internal test suite to validate them.

2. False Positives From AI-Generated Code

AI tools generate highly variable code styles, making it hard to catch patterns consistently. Some vulnerabilities appeared across multiple lines or in unusual formats.
Fix: I shifted from single-line regex to multi-line/multi-context regex patterns and added logic to merge findings across the file.

**Ethereum Track**

1. Smart Contracts Demand Extreme Security

Ethereum smart contracts are immutable — one vulnerability can cause permanent financial loss.
Our tool scans code before deployment and helps developers catch dangerous patterns early, preventing insecure contract logic from ever reaching the blockchain.

2. AI Tools Are Now Writing Web3 Code

Developers increasingly use ChatGPT/Copilot to generate Solidity, Hardhat scripts, deployment scripts, and backend logic.
AI-generated code often contains:
1.Unchecked external calls
2.Reentrancy patterns
3.Insecure random number generation
4.Leaking private keys
Our scanner detects such patterns instantly.

3. Strengthens the Ethereum Developer Ecosystem

We provide a security layer for:
1.Solidity smart contracts
2.Node.js / Python backend scripts
3.Wallet integrations
4.Hardhat/Foundry projects

This directly improves the overall safety of Ethereum dApps, making deployment more reliable.

4. Prevents Real Web3 Vulnerabilities

Many Ethereum hacks happen due to simple coding mistakes.
Our tool flags issues like:
1.Unsafe eval() in deployment tools
2.Hardcoded private keys
3.Weak validation in off-chain code
4.Misconfigured API calls to RPC endpoints

These mistakes often originate from AI suggestions. We catch them before they lead to exploits.

5. Helps Teams Ship Secure Blockchain Products Faster

ETHIndia values tools that:
1.Improve developer productivity
2.Boost security
3.Reduce friction in shipping dApps

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/zulucash-5d31) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/edgeconsultinglabs/zulu.cash) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://zulu.cash/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/EYf4Ft7JE4Y) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Zypherpunk-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://zypherpunk.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Your intelligence. Your memory. Your machine.

![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Nodejs](https://img.shields.io/badge/Nodejs-333333?style=flat-square) ![Ollama](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ollama-333333?style=flat-square) ![Nillion](https://img.shields.io/badge/Nillion-333333?style=flat-square) ![MCP](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-333333?style=flat-square) ![Zcash](https://img.shields.io/badge/Zcash-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLCipher](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLCipher-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Modern AI tools quietly operate as surveillance systems. Every conversation, meeting, and piece of personal information you share is stored, analyzed, and used to train centralized models you do not control. Users don’t own their data, their memory, or even the behavior profiles created from their day-to-day use.

**Zulu.cash** solves this by removing the cloud entirely.

Zulu is a private, local-first AI agent that runs on your device. It listens, transcribes, reasons, and stores memory without sending any data to third parties. All processing—WhisperX transcription, diarization, LLM reasoning, and long-term memory—happens offline.

People use Zulu to:

- Capture meetings and conversations privately
- Extract tasks, insights, and summaries with no data leakage
- Organize personal knowledge in an encrypted vault
-  Run automation workflows without exposing their activity
- Build long-term AI memory that remains entirely user-owned

Zulu makes existing tasks easier and safer by eliminating surveillance, vendor lock-in, and cloud dependency.
It restores a simple principle: your intelligence belongs to you, not to a server farm.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building a fully local AI agent exposed every hidden assumption in today’s AI ecosystem. Most frameworks rely on the cloud for scale, speed, and model hosting. Removing that safety net forced a complete re-architecture.

**WhisperX Compatibility Issues**
The diarization model was trained on older versions of PyTorch and pyannote, which broke on modern environments. Diarization failed to load, alignment models crashed, and dependency mismatches halted the pipeline. I resolved this by isolating version constraints, pinning compatible dependencies, and rebuilding the WhisperX environment by hand.

**Performance Constraints**
Running transcription, alignment, speaker segmentation, embeddings, and LLM reasoning locally is resource-intensive. I had to tune model sizes, optimize CPU paths, and restructure the inference flow to keep the agent responsive in real time.

**Encrypted Memory Architecture**
Using SQLCipher introduced challenges with key handling, migrations, and write consistency. Because the database is fully encrypted, even subtle misconfigurations break read/write operations. I redesigned the memory layer to ensure reliable, secure, and deterministic storage.

**Agent Workflow Without Cloud Shortcuts
**Most agent systems depend on remote APIs or hosted vector databases. Zulu couldn’t. I had to build local replacements for reasoning, retrieval, and memory management, forcing a more deliberate and privacy-consistent architecture.

**Each hurdle reinforced the mission:** if you want true privacy, you must build the entire stack yourself. Zulu is the result of overcoming those challenges and proving that a private, local AI agent is not only possible—but practical.

**Privacy Infrastructure & Developer Tools**

Zulu.cash aligns directly with the goals of the Zcash Community Grants program because it extends Zcash’s core philosophy—privacy, autonomy, and user sovereignty—into the domain of artificial intelligence. Today’s AI systems depend on centralized cloud infrastructure that logs user activity, stores personal data, and erodes privacy. Zulu inverts that model by bringing all AI processing onto the user’s device, ensuring that their conversations, behavior, and personal information remain fully private.

The project creates a foundation for Zcash-native identity and reputation mechanisms. By pairing encrypted local memory with future integration into shielded pools, Zulu lays the groundwork for privacy-preserving proofs of knowledge, MPC workflows, and identity without disclosure—tools that deepen the Zcash ecosystem and expand its utility beyond payments.

Zulu.cash shows how Zcash can anchor a broader privacy stack: not only protecting financial transactions, but also the day-to-day flow of information people share with AI systems. This positions Zcash as the chain that supports a new class of private agents, private applications, and privacy-first developer tools.

In short, Zulu.cash demonstrates a practical pathway for bringing Zcash’s values into personal computing and AI—creating user-owned, private-by-default intelligence that strengthens the entire ecosystem.

Alula Zeryihun

### COMPLY

> Where compliance meets cognition.

![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Encryption](https://img.shields.io/badge/Encryption-333333?style=flat-square) ![Apriori Algorithm](https://img.shields.io/badge/Apriori%20Algorithm-333333?style=flat-square) ![The Graph](https://img.shields.io/badge/The%20Graph-333333?style=flat-square) ![Neo4j](https://img.shields.io/badge/Neo4j-333333?style=flat-square) ![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-333333?style=flat-square) ![langchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/langchain-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

In highly regulated industries like medicine, aerospace, and automotive, companies live in "documentation hell." They must manually prove to auditors (like the FDA) that every single product requirement is linked to a piece of code, verified by a test, and derived from a regulation. This is a slow, error-prone, and multi-million dollar bottleneck that relies on spreadsheets and consultants.

Certify AI solves this by acting as an intelligent, automated compliance co-pilot.

It makes tasks easier: It uses an LLM to automatically read unstructured documents (PDFs, Word docs) and extract all compliance artifacts (requirements, risks, tests). It then builds a "Knowledge Graph" (a connected database) to create a single source of truth. Instead of spending months building a traceability matrix, a manager can get an instant, auditable map of their entire project.

It makes tasks safer: The platform is proactive, not just reactive.

It uses data mining algorithms (Apriori) to discover hidden patterns and gaps (e.g., "90% of your risk-related requirements are tested, but these 10 are not").

It uses an AI-powered suggestion engine to propose fixes for these gaps, which a user can approve with one click.

Its most powerful feature is a "What If" Impact Analysis Engine. Before an engineer merges code, the system can simulate the change and warn them in real-time if it will violate a regulation or impact a critical safety risk. This prevents compliance failures before they ever happen.

**Challenges we ran into**

I faced two major challenges: one with the GNN (Graph Neural Network) pipeline and one with the graph visualization.

1. The GraphSAGE (GNN) Training Pipeline Failures

I wanted to use GraphSAGE to generate "fingerprints" for nodes, enabling a "find similar requirements" feature. This failed with a cascade of cryptic Procedure not found errors.

How I got over it: This was a multi-step debugging process:

First, I had to ensure the GDS (Graph Data Science) plugin was correctly installed in Neo4j Desktop.

Then, I had to fix the permissions in the neo4j.conf file. The database was blocking the procedures, and I had to explicitly allow them by setting dbms.security.procedures.unrestricted=apoc.,gds..

This led to a new error (Unexpected configuration key: filter). I discovered my gds.graph.project syntax was deprecated. I had to refactor the code to use the modern gds.graph.project.cypher method.

Finally, the training still failed because my parsers.py script was only creating nodes, not relationships. GNNs require relationships to learn. I had to fix my parsers to correctly create the [:VERIFIES] and [:IMPLEMENTS] edges, which finally allowed the GNN model to train.

2. The "Missing Edges" Visualization Bug

My graph visualization (using pyvis) showed all the nodes, but none of the connecting edges were visible.

How I got over it: After a lot of debugging, I found that the "on-hover" title attribute for the nodes contained special characters (like quotes or newlines) from the requirement text. This was breaking the underlying HTML/JavaScript of the pyvis library, which caused it to fail when rendering the edges.

The fix was to write a helper function that sanitizes this text, building a safe HTML string for the title attribute (e.g., replacing " with &quot;). This stopped the HTML from breaking and allowed all the edges to render correctly.

> AI-Powered Deepfake Detection for Social Media

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![Keras](https://img.shields.io/badge/Keras-333333?style=flat-square) ![Deep Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Deep%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

## 💡 The Problem It Solves

DeepShield can help people and organizations **verify the authenticity of videos** in an online world where deepfakes are becoming more common and convincing.

### 🔍 What It Does
DeepShield checks uploaded videos to determine whether they are **real or manipulated**, and provides a **confidence score** so users can understand the reliability of the result.

### 👥 Who Can Use It
- **Content Moderators** – Quickly review and flag suspicious videos before they reach the public.  
- **Media Platforms** – Automatically screen large numbers of uploads to prevent misinformation.  
- **Security and Forensics Teams** – Confirm the authenticity of digital evidence or reports.  
- **Researchers and Educators** – Explore how deepfake detection works in real-world cases.  
- **Everyday Users** – Test videos before sharing them to avoid spreading fake or altered content.  

### ⚙️ How It Makes Tasks Easier and Safer
- **Saves Time** – Automates video analysis that would otherwise take hours to do manually.  
- **Reliable Detection** – Combines spatial and motion-based analysis to spot subtle deepfake cues.  
- **Fast Results** – Processes short videos within seconds, even without high-end hardware.  
- **Clear Feedback** – Gives users easy-to-understand scores instead of black-box predictions.  
- **Promotes Safety** – Helps reduce the spread of fake media, scams, and non-consensual videos.  

DeepShield makes deepfake detection more **accessible, transparent, and practical**, empowering users to protect digital truth in everyday online interactions.

**Challenges we ran into**

## 🧩 Challenges We Ran Into

Building DeepShield came with a few tough technical and practical challenges, especially while working with limited resources and time.

### 🐛 1. Limited GPU and Training Constraints
Training deep learning models on **free-tier cloud GPUs** (like Google Colab) was a major hurdle. Frequent disconnects, limited runtime, and low VRAM made it hard to train a large hybrid model such as Xception + GRU.  
**✅ Solution:** We streamlined the model by reducing the number of frames, using smaller batch sizes, and relying on pre-trained ImageNet weights. Regular checkpoints helped us resume training smoothly whenever sessions ended.

---

### ⚙️ 2. Connecting FastAPI with TensorFlow
Getting the TensorFlow model to work smoothly inside a **FastAPI backend** wasn’t easy. We ran into dependency issues and occasional memory spikes when handling multiple requests.  
**✅ Solution:** To fix this, we used lazy model loading, background tasks for inference, and async-safe routes to make predictions more stable and responsive.

---

### 🎥 3. Video Frame Extraction Slowness
Processing every frame from a video created noticeable delays. OpenCV I/O operations slowed down predictions significantly.  
**✅ Solution:** We optimized the pipeline by extracting only **10 key frames per video**, which kept processing fast without losing much accuracy.

---

### 🔐 4. Authentication and CORS Issues
When integrating the React frontend with FastAPI, we faced repeated **CORS errors** and token verification issues during login and video uploads.  
**✅ Solution:** We added proper CORS middleware and switched to **JWT-based authentication**, which made requests consistent and secure across the app.

---

### 🧠 5. Dataset Bias and Model Generalization
The model initially performed well on the datasets it was trained on, but struggled with unseen deepfakes. The limited variety in our training data caused this bias.  
**✅ Solution:** We modified the threshold and applied data augmentation to make the model more robust and adaptable.

---

Each of these challenges helped us better understand **how to deploy machine learning models in real-world applications** and how to build reliable systems even with tight constraints.

**Best Use of MongoDB Atlas**

## 🧭 Track: MongoDB

We used **MongoDB** as the primary database for DeepShield (in Python backend)

### 💾 Why MongoDB
MongoDB’s flexible and scalable document-based structure made it ideal for storing:
- Save **video prediction results** (label, confidence, duration) in real time  
- Store **user info** (name, email, profile) fetched from Auth0 for each prediction 
- Logs for tracking usage and improving model accuracy over time  

### ⚙️ How We Used It
Each time a user uploads a video, the backend stores essential details in MongoDB - such as the video’s metadata, analysis results, and user ID.  
This data helps us:
- **Maintain user privacy** while securely tracking predictions  
- **Analyze usage patterns** to identify model weaknesses  
- **Retrain and improve** the deepfake detection model in the future using anonymized data  

### Code Snippet
```bash
# backend/database/schemas.py
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from datetime import datetime

class Prediction(BaseModel):
    filename: str
    label: str
    confidence: float
    duration: float | None = None
    user_email: str | None = None
    user_name: str | None = None
    user_profile: str | None = None
    timestamp: datetime = Field(default_factory=datetime.utcnow)
```

### 🌟 Impact
By using MongoDB, we ensured a **secure, scalable, and privacy-friendly** data layer that can grow with the application.  
It not only keeps user information safe but also provides a reliable foundation for **continuous model improvement** - making DeepShield smarter over time.

**Best Use of Auth0**

# 🛡️ DeepShield — Best Use of Auth0 (Major League Hacking)

**AI-Powered Deepfake Detection for Video Content Safety**

DeepShield is a full-stack web application that uses deep learning (Xception + GRU) to detect deepfakes in short videos.  
It allows users to securely log in, upload videos, and get instant predictions on whether the content is real or fake.

---

## 🚀 Why Auth0?

We used **Auth0** to make the login process simple, secure, and fast for users participating in our platform during the hackathon.  
It helped us skip complex backend authentication and focus on building the AI core of DeepShield.

### 🔐 What Auth0 Does in DeepShield

- Lets users **sign up or log in easily** using email or social accounts  
- Provides **secure authentication** through token-based access  
- Allows us to **store user under each prediction video they upload**  
- Enables users to **view only their own prediction history** safely  
- Keeps our app **secure and privacy-focused** without manual password handling  

Auth0 gave DeepShield a clean, secure authentication layer — ensuring that every uploaded video and prediction is linked to a verified user.

---

## 💡 Why This Is the Best Use of Auth0

- 🔐 **Secure Authentication** — handled fully by Auth0  
- 🚀 **Seamless Access** — users can log in instantly during demos or testing  
- 🧠 **User-Linked Predictions** — every uploaded video is tied to the right account  
- ⚡ **Smooth Integration** — works perfectly between React frontend and FastAPI backend  
- 💬 **Hackathon-Friendly** — saved time, improved security, and enhanced UX  

Auth0 helped us deliver a reliable and production-ready login system within the hackathon timeframe — making DeepShield safer, faster, and more trustworthy.

> Open source intelligence without the dystopia

![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![OCR](https://img.shields.io/badge/OCR-333333?style=flat-square) ![AWS](https://img.shields.io/badge/AWS-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![d3.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/d3.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![elasticsearch](https://img.shields.io/badge/elasticsearch-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The explosion of fake news, hate speech, and doctored media on social platforms has made it nearly impossible for authorities to distinguish truth from manipulation in real time.
By the time misinformation is verified manually, it’s often already viral — shaping opinions, inciting panic, or fueling unrest.

Our system changes that. It acts as a real-time digital radar for law enforcement — automatically scanning social media, detecting harmful content, verifying authenticity, and tracing the exact path of its spread.
It replaces hours of manual monitoring with instant, AI-backed intelligence, giving police evidence, context, and clarity the moment a post starts trending.

In short, it transforms reaction into prevention, helping authorities detect early, act decisively, and keep digital spaces safe and trustworthy.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Data Access Restrictions
Accessing real-time data from platforms like Instagram and X was challenging due to API limits and changing policies.
➡️ Solution: We used Instaloader for hashtag-based scraping (public data only) and built a modular ingestion layer that can easily switch to official APIs when access is approved.

2. Handling Multilingual and Code-Mixed Text
Posts often mix Hindi, English, and regional languages, confusing standard NLP models.
➡️ Solution: We fine-tuned IndicBERT and XLM-R models for code-mixed text, boosting accuracy significantly.

3. Reducing False Positives in Detection
Early models flagged many harmless posts as fake or hateful.
➡️ Solution: We introduced a two-stage pipeline — fast lightweight screening followed by deep forensic verification — to improve precision while keeping speed high.

4. Visual Misinformation Verification
Detecting edited or recycled images was technically tough.
➡️ Solution: Integrated OCR + reverse image search with a custom similarity scoring algorithm to identify reused or manipulated visuals.

**Digital Safety & Privacy**

Our project directly advances digital safety and privacy by giving law enforcement the tools to detect, verify, and contain harmful digital content before it causes real-world damage.

It protects online communities from the spread of fake news, hate speech, and malicious media — some of the biggest digital threats today.

It reduces exposure to manipulated or harmful content by automatically identifying and flagging it in real time.

It ensures responsible data use and privacy compliance by analyzing only publicly available posts and avoiding private user data or encrypted chats.

It enhances trust and transparency online, enabling the police to issue verified corrections quickly and maintain digital order.

In essence, our system doesn’t just secure the web — it builds a safer, more accountable digital environment where truth travels faster than misinformation.

The Problem We're Solving


Live Streams: The lack of accurate real-time captions excludes deaf and hard-of-hearing users from fully engaging with live streamed content.
Online Classes: Many online educational platforms do not include captions, resulting in major accessibility barriers for learners.
News Broadcasts: Uncaptioned news broadcasts restrict access to important and time-sensitive information for deaf and hard-of-hearing audiences.

Language Barriers: When content is available only in one language, it becomes difficult for non-native speakers to understand, limiting inclusivity and reach.

Realtime Transcription:
Realtime Transcription of audio was one of the major issue, but we solved that by chunking the audio and sending it to model and maintaining the time stamp to match the transcription

Low Latency:
Providing low latency for real time  running video can be solved by chunking and storing the audio in buffer.

> Spotting Alzheimer’s before it’s seen

![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![scikit-learn](https://img.shields.io/badge/scikit--learn-333333?style=flat-square) ![NumPy](https://img.shields.io/badge/NumPy-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenCV](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCV-333333?style=flat-square) ![pandas](https://img.shields.io/badge/pandas-333333?style=flat-square) ![Matplotlib](https://img.shields.io/badge/Matplotlib-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Pillow](https://img.shields.io/badge/Pillow-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

We are building an AI-powered diagnostic tool that analyzes retinal images to detect early signs of Alzheimer’s disease or cognitive decline.
Medical research shows that changes in retinal blood vessels and structure can reflect brain health. By using deep learning on retinal scans, we aim to provide a non-invasive, quick, and accessible screening method.

How It Works:

Image Input: A retinal scan (fundus image) is uploaded into our web application.

AI Analysis: A trained Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model processes the image to detect patterns associated with Alzheimer’s risk.

Prediction Output: The system displays the risk level along with a confidence score, helping doctors or researchers decide on further tests.

Accessible Platform: Built with Streamlit, the app can be deployed online, making it usable in hospitals, clinics, or even remote healthcare camps.

Why It’s Innovative:

Uses AI and medical imaging to target a disease that is usually diagnosed too late.

Non-invasive – no blood tests or scans beyond a simple retinal photo.

Can be scaled for mass screening, especially in rural or underserved areas.

This solution empowers early detection, which is crucial in slowing Alzheimer’s progression and improving patient outcomes — making it a valuable addition to Healthtech innovation.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Our project, "Retina-based Alzheimer's Risk Predictor", uses AI and deep learning to analyze retinal images and detect potential Alzheimer’s risk. This directly falls under Healthtech because:

Medical Imaging Analysis – We use retinal scans, a form of medical imaging, and process them with AI to provide health-related insights.

Early Disease Detection – Alzheimer’s is often diagnosed late. By analyzing the retina, which is linked to brain health, our system can provide early warning signs, improving chances of timely intervention.

AI in Healthcare – The core of the project uses deep learning models (TensorFlow) to make predictions. This aligns with the growing trend of Agentic AI systems in healthcare diagnostics.

Non-invasive Screening – Retinal image analysis is safe, painless, and cost-effective, making it a patient-friendly diagnostic tool in healthcare.

Scalable Solution – The app is built using Streamlit, meaning doctors, researchers, or even remote clinics could easily use it to screen many patients quickly.

**Description of your solution**

### FinFlow Coach: Ride the Wave to Financial Success 💡


 FinFlow Coach is a super-smart, AI-driven financial coaching app that's all about helping gig workers, informal sector hustlers, and regular citizens take control of their finances. Forget old-school apps with rigid budgets—FinFlow Coach learns from *your* real-life habits, spending quirks, and unpredictable income ups and downs. It's perfect for freelancers, ride-share drivers, or street vendors dealing with volatility. 📈

It works like a personal money mentor:
- **Grabbing Your Data**: Plug in bank info, transactions statements, or manual cash entries. It tracks spending (food, rides, bills), income streams, and fluctuations, spotting patterns like seasonal dips. 🔍
- **Smart Tips**: Predicts and suggests, e.g., "Income dropped 20%? Save 15% more for emergencies." Or, "Transport costs up? Try bulk passes to save 10%." Reduces stress by anticipating issues. ⚡
- **Gig/Informal Support**: Quick micro-loans for slow weeks, credit scoring from platforms like Uber, cash tracking, and mobile wallet links.(A feature that can be added after the base app is completed or in production) 📱
- **Ease of Handling**: The insights can be converted to **pdf** or **csv** format for any other uses.
- **Big Wins**: Boosts stability, sharpens decisions, and makes finance accessible. Research shows it helps save more amid irregular pay. 💰

Plus, it offers **insurance suggestions for working adults** using AI: Analyzes your age, income, health, and location for tailored policies like health, life, or disability coverage—key for those without employer perks from sites like LIC and PolicyBazaar! 🛡️

#### Cool Features, Including Insurance
- **Spending Breakdown**: Tracks habits and offers fixes with NLP. 📊
- **Income Forecast**: ML predicts fluctuations and suggests buffers. 🔮
- **Alerts**: Instant pings like, "Hold off on buys during dips." 🔔
- **Savings Goals**: Flexible plans based on trends. 🎯
- **Insurance Picks**:
  - Custom plans factoring risks (e.g., accident cover for drivers). 📝
  - Affordable options for variable incomes, like term life or low-premium health. 👨‍💼
  - What-if scenarios: "Health issue? This saves 30% on costs." 🤔
  - Perks: 20% happier users, 30% faster advice, 15% more sign-ups—private and compliant. 👍

#### User-Friendly Interface
A chill chat or dashboard, integrable with WhatsApp for easy access and well as an AI Coach section for telling you insights on your recent purchases and long-term investments. 😊

#### Tech Behind It
- **Frontend (Web/Mobile)**: React for web; Flutter for iOS/Android apps. 🌐
- **Backend**: Python with pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch. 🐍
- **AI Agents**: LangChain/LlamaIndex/LangGraph in Python for autonomous thinking and chats; LLM APIs for advice/policies. 🤖
- **Storage**: Secure databases (PostgreSQL/MongoDB) with privacy features like encryption and OAuth. 🔒
- **Proactivity**: Background jobs (Celery) for timely alerts. ⏰

##### The basic design of the app has been created so viewers and judges can easily look at and check it out.

**Description of your solution**

Project Name: NexusCFO  
Tagline: Your Autonomous Financial Operations Platform  

Overview  
NexusCFO is an AI-powered agent that acts as a full-time CFO, bookkeeper, and accountant for small businesses. It connects with bank accounts, payment gateways, and email to automate financial tasks, such as invoicing, bill payments, cash flow forecasting, tax preparation, and loan applications. This enables business owners to concentrate on growth while reducing manual and time-consuming financial work.  

Problem Statement  
Small business owners and freelancers spend 10-15 hours each week on administrative tasks like invoicing, expense tracking, and tax preparation. This not only decreases productivity but also creates financial blind spots. In fact, 82% of small businesses fail due to poor cash flow management. Furthermore, accessing capital can be difficult because of complicated processes and uncertainty around eligibility.  

How It Works  
Secure Connection: Users provide read-only access to their bank accounts using Account Aggregator APIs and connect their business emails.  

Data Processing: The AI categorizes transactions, scans invoices with natural language processing, and analyzes financial patterns.  

Autonomous Actions:  
  Generates and sends invoices automatically.  
  Schedules bill payments to avoid late fees.  
  Predicts cash flow and alerts users of shortages.  
  Prepares tax-ready reports.  
  Identifies loan options and helps with applications.  

User Interface: A straightforward dashboard or chat interface, similar to WhatsApp, gives actionable insights and answers to questions.  

Target Audience  
  Freelancers, such as designers and developers.  
  Small service-oriented businesses, like agencies and consultancies.  
  Local shop owners and tradespeople, including electricians and plumbers, who use digital payments.  

Business Model  
Subscription Plans:  
  Solo Plan (₹999/month): Invoicing and expense tracking.  
  Business Plan (₹2,499/month): Full suite, including cash flow forecasting, tax preparation, and auto-payments.  

Revenue Streams:  
  SaaS subscriptions.  
  Commission from loan referrals.  

Go-to-Market Strategy  
  Direct marketing through LinkedIn and Google Ads.  
  Partnerships with payment gateways such as Razorpay and PayPal, along with neobanks.  
  Collaborations with accounting firms to automate bookkeeping.  

Vision  
To become the primary financial operating system for small businesses, helping them achieve financial clarity and growth with ease.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

How NexusCFO is a Fintech Solution

NexusCFO isn’t just a fintech tool. It’s a platform that combines and automates multiple fintech services for small businesses.

Financial APIs & Open Banking

What: It securely connects to user financial data.

Fintech Link: It uses India’s Account Aggregator (AA) framework and approved APIs.

Usage: It pulls transactional data to automate processes, which eliminates manual data entry.

Payment Integration (Paytech)

What: It automates invoicing and bill payments.

Fintech Link: It connects with UPI and payment gateways like Razorpay or Stripe.

Usage: It initiates payments directly and acts as an intelligent layer on existing networks.

Lending & Credit Access (Lendtech)

What: It helps businesses secure loans.

Fintech Link: It uses APIs from digital lenders and neo-banks.

Usage: It analyzes financial data for creditworthiness and pre-fills loan applications via lender APIs.

Business Finance Management (PFM)

What: It provides cash flow forecasting and insights.

Fintech Link: It draws inspiration from personal finance tools like Mint or YNAB.

Usage: It customizes categorization, visualization, and predictive analytics for businesses.

Regulatory Technology (Regtech)

What: It automates tax preparation and compliance.

Fintech Link: It uses GST filing APIs and regulatory tech infrastructure.

Usage: It categorizes transactions for direct integration with GST portals, which reduces compliance work.

Insurtech (Future Scope)

What: It suggests insurance needs.

Fintech Link: It connects with digital insurance platforms.

Usage: AI can recommend insurance products based on business assets.

Conclusion:  
NexusCFO is a fintech aggregation platform. By combining AI with payments, lending, open banking, and regtech, it creates a seamless, automated financial operations experience for small businesses, moving fintech from tools to an intelligent financial assistant.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Deep Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Deep%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Neural Network](https://img.shields.io/badge/Neural%20Network-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

Idea Title:
AI-Powered Comparative Genomics for Rapid Vaccine Development

Problem Statement:
Emerging viruses pose a major threat to global health. Traditional vaccine development is slow because it requires long lab trials. However, many new viruses share genetic similarities with previously known viruses that already have vaccines. If we could quickly compare the genome of a new virus with those of existing viruses, we could accelerate vaccine design by leveraging existing vaccine knowledge.

Proposed Solution:
We propose an AI Agentic Model that:

1. Accepts genome sequences of a new virus (uploaded by researchers/health workers).
2. Analyzes the genetic code using AI-based sequence comparison methods.
3. Identifies the most similar known virus from a database of existing pathogens.
4. Highlights genomic similarities and differences between the new and old virus.
5. Predicts how the vaccine developed for the old virus could be adapted to fight the new virus.

Technical Approach:

Genome Upload: Users upload viral genome data (FASTA/GenBank format).

AI Analysis:
 1.Sequence alignment and similarity scoring using machine learning.
 2.Mutation detection and functional impact prediction.
 3.AI inference model for vaccine adaptability.

 Comparative Report:
 1. Shows genome alignment visualization.
 2.Explains functional protein similarities (e.g., spike proteins in coronaviruses).
 3.Suggests how an existing vaccine approach (mRNA, inactivated, vector-based) can be repurposed.

Example Flow (Demo Output):

1. User uploads genome of a new virus.
2. AI detects 80% similarity with SARS-CoV-1 (2003 SARS virus).
3. Output:

   * This new virus shows strong similarity to SARS-CoV-1, particularly in its spike protein region.
   * Since SARS-CoV-1 vaccines targeted the spike protein, the same strategy can be applied here with necessary adjustments.
   * This reduces the time needed for vaccine development, as the prior knowledge base is reused.

Impact:
1.Speeds up early-stage vaccine R\&D.
2.Helps scientists quickly understand emerging pathogens.
Provides a framework for preparedness in future pandemics.
3.Can be scaled with cloud-based AI and connected with global genome databases.

Uniqueness:
Unlike standard genome comparison tools, this system:
1.Uses AI agentic models to provide not just similarity scores but also actionable vaccine insights.
2.Provides a visual + gamified interface for ease of understanding.
3.Bridges the gap between raw genome analysis and practical vaccine design recommendations.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Our project fits this track because it combines real-world healthcare challenges with the autonomy and decision-making power of agentic AI, enabling faster and smarter responses to emerging diseases

**Description of your solution**

Silent Epidemic Detector is an Agentic AI-driven health intelligence platform designed to detect outbreaks before they spread. It integrates multi-source data pipelines—hospital intake & lab results, wearable health streams, social media signals, and environmental metrics—into a unified monitoring system.

At its core, we use AI/ML models (PyTorch) for anomaly detection and time-series forecasting. The Agentic AI layer (LangChain) autonomously cross-verifies anomalies across sources, filters noise, and triggers high-confidence alerts. These insights are stored in MongoDB, processed via a Flask backend, and delivered through a Next.js interactive dashboard deployed on Microsoft Azure.

Unlike traditional reporting systems, our architecture ensures real-time detection, city-wide scalability, and 7–10 day early warning capability. Authorities get actionable dashboards with hotspot mapping, severity scores, and predictive spread projections—empowering them to take proactive measures instead of reacting too late.

With this, we aim to transform epidemic response from reactive firefighting to AI-powered proactive prevention, saving lives and reducing economic losses.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/9f9749b384474354af1bffaaaaec57ec/040c0ff6-0a6f-4c0d-a5d1-53163255a11b.png)

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Silent Epidemic Detector is squarely in Healthtech + Agentic AI : it turns fragmented city-scale signals (hospital, wearables, social, environmental) into autonomous, cross-verified early-outbreak alerts—often 7–10 days sooner—with location, severity, and forecasts. By moving from passive monitoring to agent-driven action, it enables rapid public-health decisions, eases hospital load, and protects vulnerable communities before epidemics spread.

**Description of your solution**

Neytra – AI Glasses for the Visually Impaired and Personal Safety
For a visually impaired person, recognizing who is around them can be difficult, leading to dependence, awkwardness, or even unsafe situations. Neytra is an AI-powered wearable assistant that helps users identify people and stay safe—naturally and privately. A small camera on the glasses captures what the user sees, the AI recognizes familiar faces, and softly announces their names through an earpiece. If an unfamiliar face appears, Neytra asks whether to save it for future recognition. It also detects obstacles and critical objects through smart, trigger-based detection, alerting the user via audio or gentle vibrations.

For safety, Neytra includes an SOS mode that activates through voice, gesture, or emergency triggers—instantly sharing the user’s live GPS location and last camera frame with trusted contacts. All data stays securely on the user’s device, with blockchain-backed verification to prevent tampering. Future versions aim to connect with CCTV and smart city systems for enhanced awareness.

By combining edge AI, IoT, and human-first design, Neytra acts as an intelligent companion that not only sees but also thinks and protects—empowering independence, safety, and dignity for the visually impaired.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Neytra fits into the Healthtech track because it is designed as an assistive technology for the visually impaired. It directly addresses accessibility, independence, and safety - key aspects of healthcare beyond hospitals. By helping users recognize people around them, Neytra reduces dependence on others, improves social inclusion, and enhances mental well-being.

What makes it agentic is that Neytra is not just a passive tool. It proactively senses the environment through the camera, identifies faces in real time, and takes actions autonomously - such as announcing a known person’s name or prompting the user to register a new one. This proactive, decision-making behavior makes Neytra a true AI health co-pilot, restoring dignity and confidence to visually impaired individuals.

> Eye that discerns the Truth

![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![NLP](https://img.shields.io/badge/NLP-333333?style=flat-square) ![Chrome Extension](https://img.shields.io/badge/Chrome%20Extension-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

## Problem

The internet has created an “infodemic.” Information spreads faster than ever, but falsehoods spread even faster. Traditional fact-checking can’t keep up, and the average person lacks easy tools to judge credibility. The result is:

* **Speed & Volume:** False content goes viral before verification catches up.
* **Friction in Verification:** Checking facts usually means leaving the platform, searching manually, and cross-referencing sources — too much effort for most users.
* **Opaque Sources:** It’s difficult to see where claims come from or how reliable the source is.
* **Collapse of Trust:** People lose confidence in information ecosystems, leading to confusion, polarization, and apathy.

This environment benefits misinformation and harms public health, democratic processes, and social cohesion.

---

## Solution

**Veritas** is a truth-seeking platform that brings verification to where people consume information. Instead of forcing users to leave a platform, it overlays credibility assessments, provenance tracing, and warnings directly onto web content.

**Core Purpose:** Empower people with immediate, context-aware truth signals to reduce misinformation’s reach and restore trust in information systems.

---

## What We’re Building

A multi-platform ecosystem anchored by a real-time verification engine:

1. **Browser Extension (Chrome first, Firefox/Edge later)**

   * Inline credibility badges on posts, articles, and search results.
   * Color-coded truth signals (green = credible, red = likely false, yellow = uncertain).
   * Right-click “Verify with Veritas” on any selected text to instantly check provenance.
   * Popup dashboard: claim history, manual verification, and user preferences.

2. **Web Application (/verify, /dashboard)**

   * Standalone portal for deeper claim analysis.
   * Detailed credibility reports, source tracing, and misinformation trends.

3. **Admin Workbench (/admin)**

   * Advanced analytics and investigation tools for professionals.
   * Real-time monitoring of misinformation trends across platforms.
   * Collaboration tools for teams of journalists or moderators.

4. **Developer API (FastAPI)**

   * Exposes verification and credibility scoring to third-party applications.
   * Supports integration into news platforms, chat apps, and moderation tools.

5. **Backend (Supabase/PostgreSQL)**

   * Centralized data storage and real-time features.
   * Authentication, user preferences, and sync across devices.

---

## Pain Points Solved

* **Frictionless Verification:** No more copy-pasting into fact-checking sites — verification happens where the content lives.
* **Speed of Response:** Instant badges and overlays slow the viral spread of falsehoods.
* **Information Overload:** Simple, at-a-glance truth signals reduce noise and fatigue.
* **Transparency:** Easy provenance tracing makes sources and biases visible.
* **Rebuilding Trust:** Clear, contextual credibility cues empower users instead of confusing them.

---

## Target Users

* **Professionals (B2B2C):**

  * **Journalists & Researchers:** Quick checks during reporting and investigations.
  * **Content Moderators:** Early detection of misinformation on their platforms.

* **General Public (B2C):**

  * Everyday users who want to “check this real quick” while browsing social media, reading news, or searching online.

---

## Go-to-Market Strategy

1. **Bottom-Up Adoption (Viral Driver):**

   * Launch Chrome Extension in the Chrome Web Store for free discovery.
   * Encourage viral growth via word-of-mouth and visibility in social feeds.
   * Collect data on misinformation trends to improve models and reports.

2. **Top-Down Sales (Enterprise):**

   * Sell Admin Workbench and API access to media organizations, governments, and platforms.
   * Offer white-label solutions for large institutions that require trusted verification systems.

---

## Revenue Model

* **Freemium Browser Extension:**

  * **Free:** Basic credibility badges + 5–10 checks per day.
  * **Pro (\$5/month or \$50/year):** Unlimited checks, detailed provenance reports, ad-free experience, early feature access.

* **Professional SaaS Subscriptions:**

  * **Teams (\$45/user/month):** Full toolkit for journalists, moderators, researchers.

* **API Licensing:**

  * Tiered pricing based on request volume.

* **Enterprise Deployments:**

  * White-label and large-scale integrations with custom pricing.

---

## Why Veritas?

Unlike slow, after-the-fact fact-checking services, Veritas provides **real-time, embedded verification**. It meets users where they are, reduces friction, and balances professional-grade tools with mass-market accessibility.

*Impact*:

* Slows the spread of viral misinformation.
* Reduces noise and information fatigue.
* Restores trust in digital ecosystems by making credibility visible.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

## How Veritas Fits the Misinformation Track

**Continuous Scanning:** Veritas continuously ingests data from social media, news outlets, and the open web, monitoring real-time streams for emerging narratives. This allows misinformation to be detected at its earliest stages.

**Detection of Emerging Falsehoods:** Using AI-driven credibility scoring, provenance tracing, and anomaly detection, the system identifies suspicious claims, viral falsehoods, and unreliable sources before they reach critical scale.

**Fact Verification:** Veritas cross-references claims against trusted datasets and fact-checking resources, applying reasoning models to generate instant credibility assessments. These verifications are embedded directly into the browsing experience through badges, overlays, and warnings.

**Clear, Contextual Updates:** Complex credibility signals are simplified into color-coded badges, short explanations, and provenance insights. During crises, Veritas prioritizes rapid, contextual updates with links to authoritative sources, ensuring clarity and trust at critical moments.

**Agentic AI in Action:**
Veritas is not just a passive classifier—it is designed as an **agentic AI system** that takes proactive steps on behalf of users:

* **Autonomous Monitoring:** Continuously scans and updates without requiring user prompts.
* **Proactive Intervention:** Surfaces warnings directly in a user’s feed when high-risk misinformation appears.
* **Adaptive Reasoning:** Learns from evolving narratives, adjusting credibility signals as new facts emerge.
* **Context-Aware Delivery:** Presents insights differently for casual users (simple badges) and professionals (detailed provenance and analytics).

This agentic behavior transforms Veritas into an intelligent lens over the digital world—actively seeking out misinformation, verifying it, and delivering tailored truth cues in real time.

**Description of your solution**

***
> **Problem**:
***
In the digital age, information spreads at the speed of light, but so does misinformation. The modern consumer is left to navigate a constant flood of conflicting claims, eroding public trust and undermining informed decision-making. The sheer volume and velocity of unverified content on social media, messaging apps, and the web has outpaced the capacity for human fact-checking, leaving a critical void in our ability to find a source of truth.

This project addresses the urgent need for a scalable, real-time solution that empowers individuals to instantly verify claims from any digital source.

***
> **Solution**:
***
Our solution, FactCheckAI, is a multi-platform AI system that provides instant, verifiable truth checks to combat the spread of misinformation in real-time. It's a universal tool designed to be there wherever a user needs it, without disrupting their online experience.
***
> **Working**: *The Two-Tier Verification System*
***
FactCheckAI operates on a powerful two-tier system: a static knowledge base for historical facts and a dynamic, real-time pipeline for ongoing events.

- **Tier 1: Instant Verification of Past Facts**
Our AI is pre-trained on a massive database of historical facts that are already verified and cannot be changed. This allows the bot to provide an immediate answer without needing to search the internet. The entire process is instantaneous.

> **Example 1**: A user asks, Is it true that the Eiffel Tower was built in 1887? Our AI instantly recognizes this as a pre-verified fact and replies immediately with "FALSE. The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889."

> **Example 2**: A user asks, Did humans land on the moon in 1969? The AI retrieves the verified fact from its knowledge base and replies, "TRUE. The Apollo 11 mission landed on the moon on July 20, 1969."

- **Tier 2: Real-Time Verification of Ongoing Events**
For events that are currently unfolding, the AI's real-time pipeline is activated. The system performs a detailed, multi-step verification process on the fly.

> **Example** (Ongoing Tariff Wars):
**User Query**: A user on X posts, @FactCheckAI The government just announced a new tariff that will raise car prices by 20%!
**Claim Extraction**: The AI analyzes the tweet, identifying the core claim: "government announced a new tariff that will raise car prices by 20%."
**Source Query**: The AI immediately queries its real-time data pipeline, searching for any official press releases from the government or major news outlets that came out in the last 24 hours about new tariffs.
**Verification**: The AI finds a government press release that announced a new tariff on cars, but specifies it will be a 10% increase, not 20%.
**Verdict and Reply**: The bot concludes the claim is Misleading and replies to the user: @user Misleading. The government did announce a new tariff, but official sources state it will be a 10% increase, not 20%. Source: [Link to Official Government Press Release]
***
> **How It Works Across Platforms**
***
FactCheckAI provides a consistent user experience regardless of the platform, making verification as easy as a single mention.

**[WhatsApp & Telegram](https://shorturl.at/GKIJn)**: Users simply add the bot to a chat and can send a message like @FactCheckAI Is this true? with a pasted link or claim.

**X (Twitter)**: Users reply to or create a tweet with @FactCheckAI and their question. The bot replies in a new tweet within seconds.

**[Instagram](https://shorturl.at/fUcTg)**: Users can use the @FactCheckAI mention in the comments of a Reel or post. The bot will automatically reply with a concise verdict and a link to its website for more details.

**YouTube**: For video content, users can provide a link to the video in a comment to the bot. The AI uses speech-to-text to transcribe the video and verifies any claims within it.
***
**The Browser Extension**
Our browser extension provides a direct, non-intrusive way to fact-check content as you read it.

User Interaction: A user is reading an article and sees a suspicious claim. They highlight the sentence or click the extension icon.

Instant Check: The extension sends the highlighted text to the core AI system.

Real-time Verdict: In seconds, a small, discreet pop-up or sidebar appears, providing a verdict (e.g., "Verified" or "Misleading") and a link to the evidence. This allows users to get answers without ever leaving the page.
***
**The Website** ([See Prototype](https://fact-check-ai-red.vercel.app/)):
FactCheckAI also features a dedicated website, similar to a chatbot like ChatGPT. Users can directly type their questions into a chat box and get a detailed, comprehensive response. This is the ideal place for a user who wants to get a more in-depth explanation and see all the sources used for a particular verification.
***
> More information like System Architecture and Wireframe Designs are uploaded on [Drive](https://shorturl.at/unaLh)
***

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

**1. The Core Problem It Solves**
Misinformation spreads through two key channels that traditional fact-checkers fail to address effectively:

- **Velocity**:

 Fake news spreads far faster than the truth. A static website cannot keep up with a viral tweet.

- **Ubiquity**:

 Misinformation is everywhere—in a private WhatsApp chat, an Instagram story, or a social media feed—not just on dedicated news sites.

**2. How FactCheckAI Directly Tackles the Challenge**

Our solution is an ideal fit because it directly counters these two challenges.

- **Real-Time Intervention**: Most fact-checking is reactive and passive. A user has to go to a separate website, type in a claim, and wait for a result. Your project is proactive and instant. By bringing the verification engine to the user's social media feed, you are combating the velocity of misinformation right where it spreads.

- **Platform-Native Solution**: Our bot is designed to live on the platforms themselves. It recognizes that most misinformation is encountered in an environment of casual conversation, not formal research. This is a highly innovative approach that integrates a critical service into the user's everyday digital life.

3. **Key Differentiators that Make the Project Stand Out**

- **Actionable Impact**: 
Instead of just identifying the problem, your project provides an immediate, actionable solution. The user gets a clear verdict and a link to the evidence, which they can then use to correct the misinformation in their own social circles.

- **Technical Sophistication**: Our use of a hybrid AI model (pre-trained knowledge base + real-time data pipeline) shows a sophisticated understanding of the problem's complexity. This is a far more robust approach than a simple keyword-matching bot.

- **Scalability**:

 By using a serverless backend like FastAPI and cloud infrastructure, your project demonstrates that it can scale to a global user base, proving its potential to make a significant impact beyond the hackathon.

**Description of your solution**

Millions of gig workers, freelancers, and informal sector earners live with unstable income patterns and impulsive spending behavior, making traditional financial tools ineffective.
Existing budgeting apps only analyze past transactions — they don’t think, reason, or act like a human advisor.

Ghost Banker aims to change this by introducing an Agentic AI-driven autonomous financial coach that continuously learns from real-time user data (income, expenses, and behavioral cues), proactively takes actions like auto-savings, investment adjustments, and risk alerts, and evolves its strategy through feedback — just like a real financial advisor, but smarter and always on.

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

Ghost Banker aligns perfectly with the Fintech track because it solves a real-world financial management problem for gig workers, freelancers, and individuals with irregular incomes. Unlike traditional budgeting apps that are reactive, Ghost Banker is proactive, autonomous, and adaptive, powered by Agentic AI. Using a robust, scalable tech stack, Ghost Banker can:

1. Perceive user financial behavior in real-time
- Apache Kafka / Kinesis streams transaction data from banking APIs, payment apps, and receipts to the system.
- MongoDB/PostgreSQL stores structured and semi-structured data, enabling flexible, large-scale data handling.

2. Reason and predict financial needs autonomously
- Time-series models (LSTM/GRU) forecast cash flow trends.
- XGBoost/CatBoost categorize transactions and assess financial risks.
- Multi-agent LLMs (LangChain/AutoGen) simulate autonomous decision-making, weighing trade-offs between liquidity, savings, and investments.

3. Act autonomously to optimize finances
- Banking/Investment APIs + Celery enable fund allocation, micro-savings, and proactive alerts in real-time.
- Workflow orchestration (Airflow/Prefect) ensures safe, coordinated multi-agent actions.

4. Learn and adapt continuously
- Reinforcement learning + streaming ML pipelines adjust strategies based on outcomes and user behavior, making Ghost Banker smarter over time.

5. Explain and visualize decisions clearly
- LLM summarization (GPT-4/LLaMA 3) provides human-readable explanations.
- React.js + D3.js / Chart.js dashboards present trends, projections, and AI actions intuitively.

**Description of your solution**

**What We Plan to Build**
We are developing an autonomous AI agent that can anticipate and manage patient surges stemming from large crowd events. Our first iteration leverages closed-circuit cameras (CC cameras) and event APIs to monitor crowd density, movement, and behavior in real time. Machine learning models process video and event signals to predict changes in crowd mood and forecast occurrences of stampede and thereby patient inflow, delivering early alerts that help nearby hospitals mobilize resources proactively.

**What Specific Pain Points It Addresses**
•	Manual Monitoring Barriers: Manual crowd monitoring is time-consuming, error-prone, and cannot scale for large events or urban environments resulting in either loss of life or injuries to event attendees.
•	Reactive Emergency Response: Hospitals typically react to surges after they begin, leading to overcrowding, resource shortages, and delayed patient care.
•	Lack of Proactive Decision Tools: Existing dashboards display current stats, but don't provide predictive analytics or automated surge/stampede  recommendations.

**Who the Target Audience Is**
•	Event Organizers: Organizers who have taken permission from local authorities to conduct the event. They can ensure that the event happens smoothly in the intended fashion while safeguarding the interest of their attendees.  
•	Insurance Providers: Of late there have been incidents that resulted in loss of life and multiple injuries to attendees in badly managed evenest. Insurance companies using STASY can predict high risk events thereby enabling proactive measures. This not only helps in increasing their revenue but also safeguards involved attendees. 

**What the GTM and Revenue Streams Look Like**
	•	GTM Strategy:  
	     ◦	Pilot Deployment: Launch with small event management companies conducting frequent small events, emphasizing integration with existing CC cameras and event feeds.
	     ◦	Integration Partnerships: Collaborate with insurance providers and security vendors to enable seamless video and API connections.
	     ◦	Showcase Predictive Dashboards: Present real event results and improvements at healthcare tech expos and insurance providers.
	     ◦	Compliance & Safety Advocacy: Engage with city health and public safety bodies to promote AI-enabled surge readiness as a standard practice.

	•	Revenue Streams:  
	    ◦	Subscription Licensing: Charge per event for ongoing AI analytics, dashboard access, and staff notification modules.
	    ◦	Installation & Integration Fees: Bill for custom interface development, camera/API setup, and workflow automation integration.
	    ◦	Premium Analytics Add-Ons: Upsell multi-event modeling, historical insight tools, and tailored scenario simulators.
	    ◦	Consulting & Training: Offer onboarding workshops and readiness simulation packages for command centers and hospital partners.

**In-Use Example: Early Prototype**
	•	How It Works:  Our software currently ingests live camera feeds and event signals, analyzes video frames using deep-learning models (YOLO for visual cues, LSTM for movement and time-series patterns), and classifies crowd states (e.g., "Calm," "Alert", "Dispersing").
	•	Project Modules:  Scripts and models run the above mentioned predictions, which are visualized as dashboard alerts shared with a supervisor. The supervisor decides to either alert Authorities and Hospitals or teaches the system that it is not a risky situation.  
	•	Example Output:  During the demo in the Hackathon event we can show the dashboard that can immediately signal when crowds are calm, allowing hospitals to avoid unnecessary over-preparation while remaining vigilant for sudden shifts.

**Scalable Roadmap**
	•	Expansion: Add mobile data ad crowd sensors to extend prediction accuracy, and hospital resource tracking for decision automation.
	•	Continuous Learning: Refine models through feedback on actual scenarios and patient flows, dynamically improving readiness recommendations for future events.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Our AI Agent anticipates and manages healthcare system overloads caused by large crowds at events — aligning hospital operations and emergency response through predictive intelligence.

# **Veris: AI Crisis Response for Misinformation Attacks**

### *Detecting coordinated misinformation before it goes viral*

---

## **🚨 The Problem**

Misinformation spreads **6× faster than truth**, shaping elections, fueling violence, and destabilizing democracies within hours.

---

## **🎯 Target Audience & Pain Points**

**Election Commissions & Crisis Cells:**

* Must respond to viral misinformation in real time.
* Need multilingual coverage and cross-platform insights.
* Require auditable evidence chains for takedowns and legal actions.

**Political Parties , Corporates, VIPs:**

* Coordinated campaigns can damage reputation and market value.
* Existing monitoring tools detect mentions, not organized attacks.
* Require **24/7 monitoring**, forensic evidence, and rapid response.

**Media & Fact-Checkers:**

* Need fast, reliable detection across platforms.
* Limited by API access, manual verification, and language coverage.

---

## **✅ Our Solution: Autonomous AI Investigation System**

**Veris** autonomously detects, investigates, and maps coordinated misinformation attacks **globally, across languages and platforms, in minutes**, providing full forensic evidence.

---

## **🏗️ Technical Architecture**

![Architecture Diagram](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/6f426437e20d4a43809151daaa3c14fe/66c4a0c8-ac88-48fc-b1c9-35338e114c4b.png)

**View interactive:** [Figma Board](https://www.figma.com/board/eVft4pmuh6ztKu1e9Qsly5/Veris-Architecture-Diagram)

**Key Advantages:**

* **Agentic Orchestration:** LangGraph enables adaptive, multi-loop reasoning.
* **Massive Parallelism:** 100+ concurrent investigations, fault-tolerant.
* **Graph Intelligence:** Detects coordinated posting, bot networks, and reused media.
* **Multi-Modal Forensics:** NLP + computer vision + network analysis for deepfakes, propaganda, and emotional manipulation.
* **Platform-Agnostic Data Collection:** APIs, scraping, and browser automation.
* **24/7 Monitoring:** Continuous coverage for enterprises, agencies, and crisis teams.

---

## **💰 Revenue Streams**

1. **Enterprise Tier:** Large corporations, political parties, and government agencies

   * 24/7 monitoring, unlimited investigations, multi-modal analysis, real-time alerts

2. **Professional Tier:** Mid-sized organizations, smaller parties, journalists

   * Standard investigations, periodic monitoring, email alerts

3. **Influencer/SME Tier:** Social media influencers, small brands

   * Limited investigations, reactive monitoring, basic forensic reports

**Additional Revenue:**

* **API Access:** Developers, fact-checking platforms, newsrooms
* **Research & Data Partnerships:** Anonymized misinformation datasets for academic or industry studies

---

## **🚀 Go-to-Market Strategy**

**Phase 1: India (Proof of Concept)**

* Pilot with AltNews, BOOM, Factly during election cycles
* Demonstrate multilingual, cross-platform detection, and 15-minute investigations
* Build credibility with Election Commission and government crisis cells

**Phase 2: Global Expansion**

* Target international election commissions, NGOs, corporates
* Adapt models to local languages and regulatory environments

**Phase 3: Platform & Ecosystem**

* Open API for developers, newsroom integration, and global credibility network
* Establish Veris as a global misinformation defense infrastructure

---

## **📊 Competitive Advantage**

| Capability             | Traditional Fact-Checkers | Monitoring Tools | Veris                      |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------- | ---------------- | -------------------------- |
| Investigation Speed    | 2–3 days                  | Alerts only      | ✅ 15-min AI investigations |
| Coordination Detection | ❌                         | ❌                | ✅ Graph-based              |
| Deepfake Detection     | Manual                    | ❌                | ✅ Automated                |
| Cross-Platform Reach   | Limited                   | API-bound        | ✅ Multi-method             |
| Multilingual           | Limited                   | Partial          | ✅ All                      |
| Evidence Chain         | Weak                      | ❌                | ✅ Auditable                |
| 24/7 Monitoring        | ❌                         | ❌                | ✅ Enabled                  |

**Moat:** Multi-modal AI + graph forensics + autonomous orchestration is hard to replicate. Every investigation strengthens our credibility graph, reducing marginalcost and increasing detection accuracy over time.
