**What is your product’s unique value proposition?**

Of course. Here is an explanation of your product's unique value proposition.

Unique Value Proposition
The unique value proposition of the Next-Gen Prosthetic Mobility Enhancer (NGPME) is that it democratizes gait analysis for prosthetic users, transforming it from an expensive, lab-based procedure into a free, data-driven tool that anyone can use from home with just a smartphone.

What Makes NGPME Stand Out
While professional gait analysis systems exist, they are typically found in hospitals or specialized clinics, making them inaccessible for regular monitoring. NGPME stands out by offering:

Zero Cost & Accessibility: The primary differentiator is that the tool is completely free and web-based. There is no special hardware to buy and no software to install. This removes the significant financial and logistical barriers that prevent most prosthetic users from accessing regular gait data.

Data for Empowerment: NGPME provides users with objective, numerical data about their own bodies. Instead of just "feeling" like they are walking better, they can see tangible proof in their Knee Asymmetry, Vertical Stability, and Fall Risk scores. This empowers them to have more informed conversations with their clinicians and take an active role in their own rehabilitation.

Longitudinal Tracking: By providing a secure login and a persistent database, NGPME allows users to track their progress over weeks and months. This is something that is nearly impossible with traditional, infrequent lab visits. A user can see how a change in their prosthesis, a new exercise routine, or even just a good day impacts their stability and movement patterns.

How the Alpha Build Demonstrates This Value
The current alpha build, available at the provided Hugging Face link, directly validates this value proposition by delivering on these core promises:

It Works and is Accessible: The demo is live and functional. Anyone with the link can sign up, log in, and use the core analysis feature immediately, proving the accessibility of the platform.

Core Metrics are Implemented: The build successfully calculates and displays all the key metrics (Knee Asymmetry, Vertical Stability, Stride Length, and Fall Risk). This demonstrates that the product can deliver the objective data it promises.

User History is Functional: The ability to save and view past sessions is implemented, validating the concept of longitudinal tracking and empowering users to monitor their own progress over time.

In essence, the alpha build is a successful proof-of-concept that shows it's possible to package a complex, AI-driven analysis into a simple, free, and highly valuable tool for a community that can greatly benefit from it.

**Who is your target customer?**

Our Target Customer
Our ideal users are individuals who are directly impacted by lower-limb amputation and rehabilitation. We've identified two main groups:

Primary Users: Prosthesis Users
This is our core audience. They are individuals with lower-limb prostheses, ranging from new users who are just starting their rehabilitation journey to experienced users like my father who want to maintain or improve their mobility. Specifically, this tool is for those who:

Want to track their own progress between physical therapy appointments.

Seek objective, data-driven feedback to build confidence in their walking.

Lack regular access to expensive, clinical gait analysis labs due to cost, distance, or scheduling.

Secondary Users: Rehabilitation Professionals
This group includes physical therapists, prosthetists, and clinicians. NGPME provides them with a valuable tool to:

Remotely monitor the progress and stability of their patients.

Gather objective data to supplement their in-person observations.

Assign "homework" where a patient can record their walk and share the results, making therapy more continuous.

Confirmation of the Audience
The validation for this target audience came from a combination of direct, personal experience and iterative user-centric development.

First-Hand Research and Problem Validation: The entire project was inspired by my father, a below-knee prosthesis user for 18 years. Through years of observation, I confirmed the core problem: even after becoming proficient, the journey to achieving and maintaining confident mobility is a constant, ongoing challenge. His experience validated the need for an accessible, free tool that could provide the kind of objective feedback that builds confidence and helps identify subtle issues without requiring a hospital visit.

Iterative User Feedback during Development: Throughout the build process, I acted as the first "user." A key example was the "Vertical Stability" metric. My initial calculations produced incorrect and confusing results. This user feedback was critical. It forced me to research and implement a more statistically robust method—the Interquartile Range (IQR)—which is specifically designed to handle the noisy, real-world data from an AI model. This iterative cycle of building a feature, testing it against the user's needs, and refining it based on feedback was essential in creating a tool that is not just technically functional, but genuinely useful and accurate for the end-user.

**Who are your closest competitors and how are you different?**

Our closest competitors fall into two main categories: high-end clinical/research systems and other accessible software tools. NGPME's unique value is its focus on being a complete, free, and user-friendly product for personal progress tracking, rather than just a tool or an expensive medical device.

Main Competitors & How NGPME is Different
1. High-End Clinical & Research Systems
Example: Vicon (https://www.vicon.com/), Qualisys (https://www.qualisys.com/)

Description: These are the gold standard for motion capture. They use multiple specialized infrared cameras and reflective markers placed on the body to achieve sub-millimeter accuracy. They are found in hospitals, universities, and film studios.

How NGPME is Different:

Accessibility & Cost: Clinical systems cost tens of thousands of dollars and require a dedicated lab and trained technicians. NGPME is 100% free and requires zero specialized hardware, using only the camera on a user's phone or laptop.

Use Case: Clinical systems are used for infrequent, highly detailed diagnostic sessions. NGPME is designed for frequent, longitudinal tracking at home, allowing a user to monitor their progress week after week.

2. Wearable Sensor-Based Systems
Example: APDM Wearable Sensors (https://www.apdm.com/), Xsens (https://www.xsens.com/)

Description: These systems use small Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) sensors strapped to the user's body to track movement. They are more portable than clinical systems but still require purchasing and setting up hardware.

How NGPME is Different:

Convenience & Zero Hardware: Sensor-based systems require users to buy, charge, and correctly place multiple sensors on their body for each session. NGPME is completely non-invasive and frictionless—the user just needs to press record.

3. Other Vision-Based Software Tools
Example: OpenCap (https://opencap.ai/)

Description: OpenCap is a powerful, free, vision-based tool that allows researchers to get biomechanical analysis from videos. It's an incredible project but is primarily aimed at the academic and research community.

How NGPME is Different:

Product vs. Tool: OpenCap is a powerful tool for researchers who need to process data. NGPME is a complete, user-centric product. It includes a secure login system, a persistent database to save and compare personal history, a fall-risk assessment, and a simple, intuitive interface designed for the end-user (the prosthesis wearer), not a data scientist.

Simplicity: NGPME is designed to be as simple as possible: sign up, upload a video, and get results. This focus on a simple user experience is a key differentiator from more complex research-oriented software.

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

Our Distribution Strategy: Community-Driven Growth & Strategic Partnerships
Our distribution strategy is centered around reaching users authentically and at zero cost, aligning with the project's core mission to provide a free tool for the prosthetic community. We will not use paid acquisition or direct sales. Instead, we'll focus on two main channels:

1. Community-Driven Growth (Direct-to-User)
This approach focuses on reaching prosthesis users directly where they gather online.

How: We will share the project and the live demo link in online forums, social media groups, and communities dedicated to amputees and prosthesis users (e.g., Reddit communities like r/amputee, Facebook support groups). The personal story behind the project—inspired by my father—will be a key part of this outreach, as it creates an authentic and relatable connection.

Why it Fits: Prosthesis users are a tight-knit community that often relies on shared experiences and recommendations. A free tool built by someone from within that community has a much higher chance of being trusted and adopted than a corporate product. This approach fosters a loyal user base and encourages word-of-mouth growth.

2. Strategic Partnerships (Clinician & Organization-Driven)
This approach focuses on leveraging the trust and reach of established medical and support organizations.

How: We will reach out to rehabilitation centers, physical therapy clinics, hospitals (like NIMS, which was part of the project's inspiration), and non-profit organizations that support the disabled community. We will present NGPME as a free tool they can offer to their patients to supplement therapy and track progress between visits.

Why it Fits: This is the most effective way to reach our secondary audience of clinicians and, through them, a large number of primary users. A recommendation from a trusted physical therapist is a powerful endorsement. It provides a scalable way to introduce the tool to new users and integrates it directly into the rehabilitation ecosystem.

> Legal proof from everyday messages

![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![OnchainKit](https://img.shields.io/badge/OnchainKit-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Antonio solves the widespread issue of verbal subcontracting in Korea, which accounts for 9.3% of all B2B transactions. Most SMEs (97%) operate without dedicated legal teams, relying on chat messages or phone calls for orders. When disputes arise, they face:

Lack of evidence: Nearly impossible to prove original contract terms

High costs: 19.7% abandon disputes due to legal fees

Legal violations: 29.2% of subcontracts break the Fair Subcontracting Act
Antonio makes the process safer and easier:

Easier: Simply upload a chat screenshot or audio recording of the negotiation

Safer: Our AI pipeline extracts key terms, drafts a compliant standard contract, and flags unfair clauses before signing. The contract hash is then stored on the Base L2 blockchain, providing immutable, verifiable proof.

**Challenges we ran into**

The biggest challenge was getting the LLM to reliably extract structured contract terms from chaotic chat messages.

The KT Mi:dm 2.0 Base model struggled to consistently output valid JSON, often mixing conversational text or hallucinating formats, which broke our pipeline.

Solution: We defined a strict Pydantic model for contract terms, converted it into a GBNF grammar, and used llama-cpp-python to force the LLM output to strictly conform to our schema—achieving 100% valid and parseable results.
Another major hurdle was the complexity of the AI pipeline. A single, monolithic API route for OCR, extraction, and RAG verification was slow and prone to failure. We re-architected this into separate containerized Kubeflow Pipeline components (OCR, Extract, Verify), creating a robust, scalable workflow on Kubernetes.

**Link to the GitHub Repo of your project**

https://github.com/kyne0127/antonio

**What is your product’s unique value proposition?**

Antonio’s unique value is transforming unstructured chat and audio conversations directly into legally-sound, verifiable digital contracts.

- Existing e-contract services (like DocuSign) only handle signing of pre-made documents. Antonio solves the “zero-to-one” problem—creating the contract itself from real-world negotiations.

- Our alpha build demonstrates this: users upload chat screenshots, the Kubeflow ML pipeline is triggered, Mi:dm 2.0 extracts key terms, and a compliant contract draft is instantly generated and checked for legal issues.
- Unlike competitors who react after disputes occur, Antonio proactively prevents contract risks from the start.

**Who is your target customer?**

Our ideal users are SMEs in Korea—typically CEOs, project managers, and sales leads in manufacturing, IT, and construction—who lack in-house legal teams (97% of SMEs).

We validated this audience using government data: FTC found 9.3% verbal contracts and 29.2% violations; Ministry of SMEs reports 19.7% abandon disputes due to cost/evidence. These stats prove our market is large, underserved, and clearly needs our solution.

**Who are your closest competitors and how are you different?**

1. Traditional e-signature platforms (Modusign, Kontrak, DocuSign):

Only handle signing of existing documents—Antonio creates contracts from scratch using AI and real-world evidence.

2. Traditional legal services (Law firms, LawTalk):

Expensive, slow, and reactive—Antonio is cheap, instant, and proactive, acting as an AI legal assistant for real-time compliant contract drafts and risk checks. Blockchain verification provides trust beyond what law firms can offer.
Main competitors:

- https://www.modusign.com/
- https://www.kontrak.co.kr/
- https://www.docusign.com/
- https://www.lawtalk.co.kr/

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

We use a dual approach:

Direct B2B SaaS (freemium/subscription, e.g., 3 free contracts per month then monthly fee): targets SMEs via online marketing to quickly build a user base of high-intent customers.

Ecosystem partnerships:

Antonio integrates via API into platforms SMEs already use—banking apps (KB Star, Shinhan SOL), SME ERP/accounting software (Wehago, Douzone), freelancer platforms (Kmong, Soomgo).

This allows frictionless adoption and mass scale. We plan government collaborations as well, to promote fair contracting as a public-good solution.

**Description of your solution**

**Anya.fi** is a **proactive, conversational financial co-pilot** designed to help individuals - especially freelancers, gig workers, and young professionals - manage money effortlessly and build long-term wealth without the stress of traditional budgeting apps.

Instead of dashboards and charts, Anya lives where users already spend time  - **on WhatsApp**. It uses **Agentic AI** to analyze real-time financial data and engage users through **empathetic, natural conversations**, turning financial anxiety into actionable insight.


###  How It Works

Anya operates on our custom **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** - an LLM-native architecture that continuously loops through **Observe → Reason → Plan → Act**:

1. **Observe:** Detects transactions via the **Account Aggregator API** or UPI alerts.  
2. **Reason:** Uses an **LLM Core (GPT/Llama)** to interpret spending patterns, goals, and user psychology.  
3. **Plan:** Invokes the right plugin (e.g.,GoalTrackerPlugin,ExpenseAnalyzerPlugin, InvestmentAdvisorPlugin) based on the context.  
4. **Act:** Sends a proactive, human-like message on WhatsApp with financial advice or gentle nudges.


###  Real-World Use Cases

* **Anti-Impulse Plugin:** Detects emotional or impulsive purchases and offers supportive nudges before checkout.  
* **Future-Self Synthesizer:** Visualizes long-term financial goals (like owning a home) using AI-generated imagery for motivation.  
* **Social Currency Optimizer:** Helps users handle social spending pressures by suggesting budget-friendly alternatives without guilt.


###  Tech Stack & Frameworks

* **Frontend & Interface:** WhatsApp Business API, React.js (dashboard prototype)  
* **Backend:** Node.js, Express.js, Python (AI orchestration)  
* **AI Frameworks:** LangChain, OpenAI GPT / Llama 3, Pinecone (context memory), FastAPI (microservices)  
* **Finance APIs:** Account Aggregator (AA) framework, Plaid sandbox  
* **Infrastructure:** Docker, Firebase, AWS Lambda  
* **Security:** AES-256 encryption, OAuth 2.0 authentication


###  Vision

We’re building the **next generation of financial companions** - ones that don’t just track money but **coach behavior, understand emotions**, and enable smarter financial choices.  
With Anya.fi, we move from *“managing money”* to *“building wealth - mindfully and proactively.”*

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

Our project, Anya.fi, perfectly aligns with the Fintech track as it redefines personal finance management through an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability.
Unlike traditional financial tools that rely on static dashboards, Anya leverages LLM-driven intelligence and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to continuously observe, reason, and act on users’ financial activities in real time. It lives natively on WhatsApp, integrating seamlessly into users’ daily lives without demanding extra effort or financial literacy.
By providing personalized, contextual, and psychologically aware financial nudges, Anya helps gig workers, freelancers, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively, transforming money management from a stressful task into an empowering experience.
In essence, Anya embodies the Fintech theme by making AI-driven, human-centric financial guidance accessible to everyone, bridging technology, behavioral finance, and inclusivity.

**Description of your solution**

Description of Our Solution: FinTrack

FinTrack is an AI-powered personal financial coaching system designed to help individuals manage money effectively, save intelligently, and avoid overspending—especially gig workers, freelancers, and informal sector employees with irregular incomes. The solution is personalized, adaptive, and proactive, providing actionable insights and guidance tailored to each user.

1. Monthly Financial Form (Why it’s important)

Purpose: Establishes a baseline for the user’s financial behavior.

Details Collected:

Previous month’s actual earnings.

Expected earnings for the current month.

Daily average income (important for irregular earners).

Expected monthly expenses.

Why: This form allows the system to understand the user’s financial goals and limitations, so insights, warnings, and recommendations are relevant and personalized rather than generic.

2. Daily Cash Income & Spending Tracking (Why daily manual input is needed)

Purpose: Capture cash transactions, which are not automatically recorded by APIs.

Flow:

User logs daily cash earnings and spending.

The system compares it with the daily averages declared in the monthly form.

If a cash entry seems unrealistic (e.g., ₹50k when daily avg is ₹2k), the system triggers a flag and warning:

“⚠ The amount you entered seems higher than usual. Confirm to avoid inaccurate insights.”

Why: Manual daily cash input ensures complete tracking of all income sources, so the insights reflect the user’s real financial situation.

3. Online Transaction Integration

Purpose: Capture digital payments automatically (UPI, wallets, bank deposits).

Flow:

APIs fetch user’s online transactions.

Cash and digital transactions are aggregated together.

The system has a full picture of income and spending, enabling accurate suggestions.

Why: Automating online transactions reduces manual effort, ensures accuracy, and allows real-time monitoring.

4. AI-Powered Personalized Insights

Flow:

Combines monthly form, daily cash logs, and online transactions.

The system continuously analyzes patterns: overspending, savings, unexpected expenses, etc.

Provides actionable suggestions, for example:

If savings are lower than planned → suggest reducing discretionary spending.

If spending exceeds the expected category → send alert.

Recommend small investments based on surplus.

Hybrid Training Approach:

Synthetic Data: Pre-trained on simulated financial behaviors (e.g., irregular incomes, overspending cases).

User Data: Continuously fine-tunes on the individual’s actual data.

Why Hybrid: Ensures the model is intelligent from day one (thanks to synthetic scenarios) but becomes highly personalized over time as it learns each user’s unique patterns.

5. Multilingual & Voice-Enabled Chatbot

Purpose: Provides instant guidance for financial queries.

Capabilities:

Answers questions about budget, savings, and spending.

Explains why each recommendation is given (e.g., “Your groceries spending exceeded the planned amount, reducing it can help meet your monthly savings goal”).

Assists with chit fund queries, monthly form guidance, and daily cash logging tips.

Multilingual Support: Can communicate in multiple languages for wider accessibility.

Voice Input & Output: Users can speak queries, and the chatbot responds with generated voice solutions, making interaction fast and intuitive.

6. Digital Chit Fund 

What is it?
A digital chit fund is a community-based savings mechanism where a group of trusted individuals contribute a fixed amount monthly, and each member receives the collected sum in a pre-assigned month. It allows participants to save systematically and access lump sums when needed.

Why it is there:

Helps users access larger sums of money without taking loans.

Encourages community-based disciplined saving.

Provides transparency and fairness with digital tracking.

Flow:

Group Creation: A user (Admin) creates a chit fund group and shares a secure invite link.

Monthly Contribution Setup: Admin sets the fixed amount each member should contribute monthly.

Payout Scheduling: Each member is assigned a month to receive the pooled amount at the start.

Swap Feature: Members can request and mutually agree to swap payout months if needed.

Tracking & Transparency: Contributions and payouts are digitally recorded; members receive reminders for timely payments.

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

FinTrack is an AI-powered personal financial coaching system designed to help individuals manage money effectively, save intelligently, and avoid overspending—especially targeting gig workers, freelancers, and informal sector employees with irregular incomes. Unlike generic financial advice, FinTrack provides personalized, adaptive, and proactive guidance tailored to each user’s unique financial behavior, goals, and income patterns.

The platform integrates multiple financial data streams to build a complete picture of a user’s finances. Users provide a monthly financial form to establish a baseline of their earnings, daily averages, and expected expenses. Daily cash income and spending tracking captures offline transactions that APIs cannot record, while automated online transaction integration gathers UPI, wallet, and bank payments. Together, these inputs enable FinTrack to have real-time, holistic visibility into income and expenditure patterns.

At the core of FinTrack is a hybrid AI model that combines pre-training on synthetic financial behaviors with continuous fine-tuning on user-specific data. This allows the system to identify overspending, savings gaps, and unexpected expenses, and provide actionable recommendations such as reducing discretionary spending, saving surplus funds, or making small investments. Users receive proactive alerts whenever their behavior deviates from expected patterns, ensuring financial risks are addressed before they become problems.

FinTrack also features a multilingual, voice-enabled chatbot to make financial guidance accessible and intuitive. The chatbot answers questions, explains recommendations, guides users through chit fund participation, and assists with daily cash logging and monthly form entries, ensuring even non-tech-savvy users can benefit from AI-driven financial coaching.

To promote disciplined community-based saving, FinTrack integrates a digital chit fund. Users can create groups, contribute fixed monthly amounts, schedule payouts, and swap payout months as needed. All transactions are digitally recorded, providing transparency and fairness, and helping users access lump sums without relying on loans.

In essence, FinTrack directly addresses the Agentic AI challenge by continuously learning individual user behavior, integrating varied financial data streams, proactively analyzing income and spending patterns, identifying risks, and delivering personalized, actionable recommendations. It empowers users with irregular incomes to save systematically, spend wisely, and make informed financial decisions, bridging the gap left by traditional, one-size-fits-all advice.

**Description of your solution**

In today’s digital world, misinformation spreads faster than ever, often leading to confusion, fear, and mistrust. Most current approaches focus only on detecting misinformation, which still requires manual verification and technical knowledge, making it difficult for the general public to rely on them.

**TruthVerse is designed to solve this problem by creating a one-stop trusted news/information hub powered by AI.**

***AI-Powered News/Information Aggregation***

- TruthVerse collects news/information from multiple verified and reliable sources.
- Using AI, it filters out biased, misleading, or unverified content before it even reaches the user.

***Automated Fact-Verification***

- Instead of just detecting misinformation like other tools, TruthVerse cross-checks information with multiple trusted sources in real-time.
- This removes the burden of manual fact-checking, making it accessible for everyone.

***Simple, Accessible Interface***

- Non-technical users get a clean feed of trustworthy news/information without needing to worry about credibility.
- For techy users or users who are very much into asking proof for things, TruthVerse also provides details such as sources, confidence scores, and cross-verification reports—so they can fully trust and validate the system.

***Transparency & Reliability***

- Every news/information piece on TruthVerse comes with a “Verified by AI” tag, along with source links.
- This builds confidence while still allowing users to dive deeper if they want.

***Why It’s Different?***

- Unlike other solutions that only highlight suspicious content, TruthVerse delivers already-filtered, trustworthy news/information in one place.
- It combines aggregation + verification + accessibility—something current systems don’t provide together.

*👉 In short, TruthVerse makes credible news/information accessible to everyone—whether tech-savvy or not—while also ensuring transparency and reliability for those who want to dig deeper.*

**Main Question asked:-**

***1. What you plan to build?***
We’re building TruthVerse – an AI-powered misinformation-proof news/information hub. It aggregates news/information from multiple sources, auto-verifies claims using trusted fact-check databases, assigns credibility scores, and presents a clean, trustworthy feed. Users get either a simple verified feed or detailed sources, scores, and reports for transparency.

***2. What specific pain points it addresses***
- Overload of fake/confusing content during crises.
- Manual fact-checking is time-consuming and technical.
- Declining trust in media and sources.
- Lack of easy, accessible fact-checking for the public.

***TruthVerse solves this by delivering already-verified, reliable news/information to everyone.***

***3. Who the target audience is?***
- General public wanting safe, credible news.
- Fact-check enthusiasts, students, and researchers.
- Journalists/media houses to avoid publishing misinformation.
- NGOs/educators tracking misinformation trends.

***4. GTM & Revenue Streams***
*Go-To-Market: Start with a free web app → mobile app → partner with fact-check orgs & media.*
***Revenue:***
Freemium model (public feed free, pro reports paid).

- API licensing for media & platforms.
- B2B dashboards for NGOs/educators.
- Ethical sponsorships/ads.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

Our project, TruthVerse, fits perfectly into the “Combating Misinformation / Fake News” track because it focuses on tackling one of today’s biggest problems: the spread of misleading or false news online. Unlike other approaches that only create tools to detect fake news and still leave the effort of verification to humans, TruthVerse makes the process easier and more accessible.

It uses AI in the backend to filter, cross-check, and organize information from multiple trusted sources, and then delivers it in a simple platform where anyone—whether a tech expert or a normal user—can directly read reliable news without extra work. This means both everyday people and professionals can rely on it, making the fight against misinformation more practical and impactful.

**Description of your solution**

Suraksha-7 is a multi-domain, AI-driven threat detection and response system designed to evaluate any form of public crisis—from natural catastrophes (floods, earthquake, cyclones), to health crises (pandemics, outbreaks), social disorders (riots, protests), and even city incidents (accidents, fires, infrastructure failures).

The system operates by gathering information from multi-source sources like government databases, on-ground reports, CCTV feeds, satellite data, and even social media trends. The AI analyzes these signals against key factors:

Casualty & Injury Counts

Public Panic & Sentiment Levels

Geographical Spread & Intensity

Population Density & Local Vulnerabilities

According to this, it allots a threat level between 1 and 7, with an additional 3-level buffer space for ambiguous/unknown cases. Every stage is an explicit escalation step — ranging from modest disruptions to national emergencies.

Unlike point-domain tools, Surakha-7 is adaptive for all types of crises, providing authorities, agencies, and communities with a systematic approach to identifying, classifying, and responding to threats effectively and in a timely manner.

Instead of reacting to illness, **MindMirror AI focuses on early detection and proactive care** — scanning a user’s **face and voice daily**  to identify patterns of **stress, fatigue, or mental strain**. By analyzing these subtle cues, the **AI acts as a personal wellness companion,** helping users **make healthier decisions before problems escalate**.

This directly aligns with the **Healthtech goal of improving human well-being through technology**, while also addressing **India’s growing challenge of youth mental stress and burnout**.

The project also fulfills the **Agentic AI theme,** as the AI is not just a passive assistant — it’s **autonomous, context-aware, and proactive**.  It learns user **behavior, predicts potential issues, and initiates meaningful actions** (like suggesting rest, meditation, or lifestyle tips) to maintain both **mental and physical balance**.

**In short**
*MindMirror AI belongs in the Healthtech track because it merges AI-powered emotional intelligence with preventive health monitoring, offering a holistic, human-centered approach to personal wellness.*

**Description of your solution**

**Our Problem Statement**
Cars are one of the major contributers to the air pollution in the urban environments, especially in the localites adjacent to a busy road or one which experiences high traffic surges suddenly. Also, the pollutants emitted by these cars are in a state of constant transformation and motion due to dynamic changes in the local weather patterns. Though, few of the times no-traceable and unpredictable, but under specific conditions, any sudden rise in the AQI numbers or concentrations of specific pollutants in such areas can be attributed to an increased vehicular movements. But it has always been difficult to detect and keep track of the vehicles which are responsible, let alone to quantify what amount of environmental damages that it might be causing.

**Agentic AI Solution**
We want to create an agentic AI system that senses the live Air Quality Index data and specific pollutant concentrations to intelligently recognise and compare with previous weather patterns, pollution and traffic data obtained using multiple APIs. Then analyze these raw information to spatially mark an affected pollution zone between level 1 to 5 along with it’s major contributer. Finally adapting to these environment data by learning new patterns and predict the duration for future zones. Additionally, this agent will also provide alerts to the zone residents and frequent offenders (polluters) detected from an Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) setup, either to incentivize or charge them based on their health or car model info, after autonomously deciding whether their actions were helpful or deterioratory, respectively.

PICMICA stands for Predictive Intelligence via Computational Modeling of City's Air, another name I had in mind for this is Project S.A.vi.tr (Simulating AQI with traffic).

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Air Pollution is one of the major silently emerging threat to the public health sphere of India. What makes it even worse is the lack of awareness and not enough proper conversations around it in our society (For example, *Most peoples still get confuse and misunderstand this current problem with the future global warming that is being caused due greenhouse gases, and then choose to ignore it. Though it is true that the GHGs emissions have similar shared point sources to that of air pollution, but in reality, climate change is a whole different puzzle with it's own set of challenges and effects).*

The project that we're planning to build aims to kill two birds with one stone. Firstly, it will help the policymakers to keep track of the offender vehicles (even potential polluters) and the populations that is being affected due to longer exposures (*which again includes the polluter themselves too, what an irony!*), following the Healthtech track, but in a way of sort of preventing (NOT predicting) patient surges due to pollution spikes, before they even happen. Secondly,  it will also solve an additional problem of misinformation, when peoples will actually start to care about their locality's AQI numbers as if their money depends on it *('cause it really does!).*

We are also envisioning a world where citizens prefer the use of public transports or walking instead of private vehicles. So, our initiative is a first step to introduce such behavioural change.

Team **Picmica** -- Abhishek Sarbhukan, Vijay Kalore

**Description of your solution**

**Description :**
“Namami Jalam” is an AI-driven platform that ensures image recognition, data analytics, and community collaboration to identify, quantify, and act on waste pollution in real-time.

The system enables users to upload images of polluted areas through a web app, where an AI model analyzes the image to detect and calculate the amount of visible waste. Based on this, it generates a Pollution Severity Score, representing the cleanliness level of that location. If the pollution percentage crosses a predefined set limit, then the system will automatically sends alerts to nearby NGOs, municipal authorities, or volunteer groups to so they can quickly take action and clean the area.

Workflow : 

- User uploads an image

- AI detects the amount of waste present &  calculates the percentage of area  contaminated.

- If it is above safe range, the system alerts nearby ngo or government bodies & cleanup teams.

- Users can volunteer for cleaning drive

- We aim to build a community where users can express their opinion

- Live dashboard for analytics where citizens can see government and ngos work so it will improve civic sense among people.


We aim to build a community of socially responsible citizens by using technology to monitor environmental , human health and actively contribute to creating cleaner, safer, and healthier surroundings .

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

In Mumbai especially during anant chaturdashi at a beach like Girgaon Chowpatty or Juhu Beach a huge crowd gathers and huge amount of idols are immersed into the water . When citizens go for a morning stroll or for kids who play on beaches , they are all exposed to large volumes of waste (flowers, idol remnants, plastics, decorative materials etc) which remain on sand/shoreline. 
This waste includes plastics/metallic paints (heavy metals) which can dissolve into the sea or remain on the beach . This exposure can cause a risk to barefoot children , common citizens, and stray animals leading to - Injuries , Skin infections , Respiratory problems  .

Hence , our idea fits the track because it addresses preventive healthcare through environmental monitoring. By using an agentic AI system that detects waste in real time, we can identify : 
-  high-risk zones,
-  predict health hazards 
-  alert cleaning and health authorities  , before the situation worsens. 

This helps reduce exposure , prevents disease, and develops a healthier environment for citizens and animals, which fits the goals of the Healthtech track.

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![OAuth](https://img.shields.io/badge/OAuth-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Whisper](https://img.shields.io/badge/Whisper-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenAi](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenAi-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

**Problem** : In India, over 60% of the workforce earns irregular income — freelancers, delivery partners, and gig workers — yet most financial tools assume a fixed monthly salary. This leads to poor financial planning, frequent cash shortfalls, and low financial literacy.Existing apps only track expenses or show dashboards — they don’t think, adapt, or guide users in real time.

**Our Solution** :
FinGuru is an **AI-powered financial companion** that **understands your unique earning patterns, predicts income fluctuations, and creates adaptive financial strategies**. It doesn’t just track ,**it guides, educates, and acts intelligently** to make financial growth effortless and personalized by deploying a **network of specialized autonomous agents** working in synergy:

- **Difficult to capture and track irregular income and diverse expense formats** : We implement **Real-World Data Capture using SMS parsing, cash logging, and voice inputs** to provide highly accurate, personalized insights** even for users without formal bank accounts**.

-  **Fixed financial goals fail to reflect fluctuating income and expenses** : Our **Dynamic Goal & Budget Adjustment system recalibrates goals continuously** based on live income and expense data, keeping targets realistic and achievable.

- **Lack of preparation for predictable financial stress like festivals or EMIs** : **Adaptive Savings via Life Event Forecasting anticipates upcoming financial demands** and adjusts savings proactively for stress-free budgeting.

- **Financial advice is generic, complex, and not culturally accessible** : The **Multilingual Conversational Coach** offers simple, culturally relevant financial guidance that **adapts to user tone, mood, and behavior**, just like a trusted personal advisor.

**Agentic Approach**

- **Insight ( Perception Layer )** : FinGuru captures the **full picture of your finances** through SMS transactions, voice or chat inputs, and manual cash logs. It understands not just numbers but the **context behind them**, from gig income and festival spending to unplanned splurges,forming a holistic financial view.

- **Intelligence ( Decision Engine )** : Powered by a **persona-driven LLM (via LangChain + OpenAI)**, FinGuru analyzes patterns in income, spending, and sentiment. It **detects risks like overspending or irregular cash flow**, recalibrates goals dynamically, and crafts strategies that align with your evolving lifestyle.

- **Action ( Execution Layer )** : FinGuru doesn’t just advise, **it acts**. It **delivers personalized recommendations, and reminders** through a **multilingual conversational coach that adapts to your tone and goals**. The intelligent chatbot continuously educates, motivates, and guides you toward smarter financial habits.

- **Evolution ( Self-Improvement )** : FinGuru **continuously learns from outcomes and user feedback**, optimizing its advice and strategies. Your financial plan evolves with you, ensuring increasingly personalized and effective guidance over time.

**Target Audience**

- **Over 20 million gig workers in India**, including freelancers, delivery partners, and platform contractors, primarily in urban and semi-urban areas.
- Majority earn** irregular, fluctuating incomes with limited access to formal banking**, credit, and social security benefits.
- Includes diverse groups such as blue-collar delivery drivers and white-collar freelance professionals working via platforms like **Zomato, Swiggy, Uber, and Urban Company**.

**Go-to-Market Strategy** (GTM)

- Initial Stage : Launch a **500-user Mumbai Beta**.
- User Acquisition: Leverage local partnerships with **co-working spaces, universities, and professional networks** to reach early adopters.
- Marketing: Focus on word-of-mouth, social media, and **community engagement targeting young professionals and gig workers**.
- Expansion: Scale to **other Tier 1/2 cities** based on Beta insights and feedback.

**Revenue Models**

- **Freemium Model**: Core features free; premium features include advanced analytics and personalized coaching.
- Affiliate Partnerships: Collaborate with banks, investment platforms, and fintech services for referral commissions.
- Lead Generation: Provide anonymized, market-relevant leads to partner organizations while ensuring strict data privacy.
- Future Streams: Subscriptions for corporates, sponsored financial content, or value-added services like tax and insurance guidance.

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

**FinGuru** is our solution, developed as a straightforward and complete implementation of the proposed Fintech track, as it is created with the **intent to function as the autonomous financial coaching agent**. Here is where we fit perfectly:

- The track calls for an agent that **adapts to real user behaviour, spending patterns, and income variability**. FinGuru's core intelligence engine is built precisely for this. It continuously analyses fluctuating income from sources like cash logs and bank statements, recalibrates savings goals in real-time, and uses its agentic framework to learn and adapt, making financial plans that are always current and achievable.

-  The track specifically targets **gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens**. This is our primary audience. We address their core problem that is irregular income by moving beyond the fixed-salary model. By capturing data from informal sources like SMS transactions, FinGuru is accessible and relevant to the 60% of India's workforce that traditional financial tools ignore.

-  The goal is to help users **make smarter financial decisions proactively**. FinGuru achieves this through its Action Layer. Instead of just showing dashboards, it forecasts financial stress points (like upcoming festivals or EMIs), sends intelligent nudges, and uses a multilingual conversational coach to provide context-aware advice. It doesn't just track the past; it actively shapes a better financial future for the user.

**Description of your solution**

SwasthAI: Predictive Hospital Resource Management System

We plan to build SwasthAI, a Python-based intelligent software that helps hospitals in India proactively prepare for patient surges during festivals, seasonal pollution spikes, and epidemics. The system collects hospital records, local pollution and weather data, festival calendars, and epidemic alerts to forecast patient inflow using AI models. It then provides optimized recommendations for staffing, bed allocation, and medical supplies, visualized through a user-friendly dashboard with automated alerts for administrators. This addresses critical pain points such as overcrowded hospitals, staff shortages, supply deficits, and reactive management practices. The primary target audience includes hospital administrators, operational staff, and state health departments. For GTM, we plan pilot programs in metro hospitals, partnerships with health departments, and a SaaS subscription model, supplemented by consulting services and potential government health grants as revenue streams.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

> Turning Data into Truth, Not Deception

![langchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/langchain-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

Our project TruthMate is an Agentic AI-powered fact-checking assistant designed to fight misinformation spreading across WhatsApp, YouTube, and social media.

TruthMate acts as an autonomous AI agent that:

- Scans multiple information sources such as Google Fact Check API, NewsAPI, PIB India, and verified fact-checking sites to identify trending or suspicious claims.

- Cross-verifies facts from different databases to detect whether a message, headline, or video is genuine or misleading.

- Applies LLM reasoning (GPT / Llama + LangChain) to analyze context and generate a clear explanation in human-friendly language.

- Responds instantly to user queries through a web or chatbot interface where anyone can paste a message or link and get a verdict: True, Fake, or Unverified — with source links and reasoning.

During the hackathon, we plan to build a working AI Agent + Web Prototype that:

Continuously scans public data streams for trending topics.

Uses APIs to fetch real-time verified information.

Runs an autonomous AI reasoning pipeline to generate contextual fact explanations.

Displays clear verdicts and confidence levels on an interactive web dashboard or chatbot UI.


TruthMate will demonstrate how an Agentic AI can continuously monitor information streams, verify facts, and communicate the truth simply — enabling every citizen to understand what’s real, instantly.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

The track challenges participants to create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides clear, contextual updates to the public during crises.

- TruthMate aligns perfectly with this goal. It is designed as an Agentic AI fact-checking assistant that:

- Continuously scans multiple data sources using Google Fact Check API, NewsAPI, PIB data, and verified fact-checking sites to identify trending or suspicious claims.

- Detects and verifies misinformation by cross-referencing multiple reliable news databases and APIs whenever a user submits a post, message, or link.

- Provides simple and contextual explanations using LLM reasoning (GPT / Llama with LangChain) to explain in plain language why a claim is true, false, or unverified.
 
- Delivers real-time updates during crises such as elections, pandemics, or disasters, ensuring users get accurate and trusted information instantly.

In short, TruthMate acts as an autonomous AI agent that continuously verifies facts, explains them clearly, and restores public trust in digital information — fulfilling every objective of the Misinformation track at MumbaiHacks 2025.

**Description of your solution**

💡 Solution Description

**ReSumm — Where reports make sense** is a web-based AI platform that helps users instantly understand their medical reports.

How it works:
	1.	**Upload Reports**: Users upload images or PDFs of their lab/diagnostic reports.
	2.	**AI Processing via Gemini API**: The system extracts key metrics using multimodal AI — reading both text and charts.
	3.	**Interpretation & Summarization**: Gemini generates a plain-language summary, highlighting normal, high, or low values. It also provides simple recommendations or next steps for the user.
	4.	**Visual Insights**: Key parameters are color-coded and displayed in interactive charts, making health trends easy to track.

Key Benefits:
	•	**Converts medical jargon** into understandable language.
	•	Empowers users to **take informed health decisions.**
	•	Provides a **reliable and scalable solution** for patient engagement.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Most people receive **medical reports filled with technical terms, abbreviations, and numerical ranges** that are **difficult to understand** without medical training.
As a result, patients often **misinterpret** their results, experience unnecessary **anxiety**, or fail to act when abnormalities appear.
There is a **clear gap** between **diagnostic data and user comprehension**, especially for individuals in rural or **low-health-literacy regions**.

We propose an ***AI-powered Health Report Interpreter***, that allows users to simply **upload or click a picture of their medical report.**

An **integrated AI Agent** performs three key tasks:
	1.	**Extracts text** from the image using OCR.
	2.	**Identifies and interprets key** health parameters such as hemoglobin, cholesterol, and blood sugar.
	3.	**Explains the results** in plain language, highlighting whether each value is low, normal, or high, along with simple lifestyle recommendations.

This solution **aims** to:
	•	**Empower individuals** with clear, AI-generated insights about their health,
	•	**Bridge the understanding gap** between patients and medical data,
	•	**Encourage preventive healthcare** through awareness rather than panic.

**Description of your solution**

FinSight AI: Agentic Visual Intelligence for Fundamental Analysis
The Problem
Retail investors and fund managers spend hours analyzing company fundamentals across scattered sources—annual reports, quarterly filings, and screening platforms. Traditional tools provide either raw data dumps or superficial metrics without meaningful context, leading to analysis paralysis and suboptimal investment decisions.
Our Solution
FinSight AI is an intelligent agentic system that transforms fundamental analysis from a tedious, multi-hour process into an interactive, insight-driven experience taking under 2 minutes. Unlike conventional tools that simply display numbers, our AI agent understands, interprets, and visualizes financial data with human-like intelligence.
How It Works
Agentic Intelligence Engine
Our core innovation is an agentic architecture that reasons about financial data rather than just retrieving it. The agent:

Understands natural language: "Show me companies with improving ROE but declining PE"
Contextualizes metrics: Identifies why ratios changed (regulatory shifts, sector events)
Performs autonomous comparative analysis across competitors and sectors
Generates actionable insights: "Warning: Debt-to-equity trending upward for 3 consecutive quarters"

Visual Intelligence Layer
We've built charts that tell stories, not just plot data:

Annotated Timelines: Financial metrics with AI explanations for significant changes
Smart Comparison Dashboards: Multi-company analysis with automatic outlier detection
Interactive Heatmaps: Visual screening and ranking across parameters
Narrative Summaries: AI-generated investment thesis with supporting visuals

Multi-Source Data Fusion
Our system aggregates and reconciles data from comprehensive databases including annual reports, quarterly filings, and financial statements, ensuring accuracy through intelligent validation.
Key Features
✅ Natural language queries—no complex filters needed
✅ AI-annotated charts explaining metric changes
✅ Multi-company synchronized comparisons
✅ Smart screening with visual rankings
✅ Anomaly detection and alerting
✅ Sector benchmarking automatically
✅ Export professional PDF reports
Technical Stack

Backend: Agentic AI orchestrator with LLM-powered reasoning, custom financial knowledge base
Frontend: React with dynamic chart generation (Recharts)
AI Layer: NLP for query parsing, pattern recognition for anomalies, automated insight generation

Business Impact
Time Savings: Reduces analysis from 2-3 hours to under 2 minutes
Market Opportunity: India has 100M+ demat accounts, only 5% actively invest beyond trading
Revenue Model: Freemium + Premium subscriptions (₹299-999/month)
Innovation Highlights
🚀 Agentic reasoning that goes beyond rule-based systems
🎨 Visual intelligence with causal explanations on charts
🔗 Multi-source fusion for comprehensive analysis
💡 Contextual awareness of market events and their impact
Demo Example
User: "Compare Reliance and TCS over 5 years"
→ Agent generates dual synchronized charts
→ Highlights: "TCS margins compressed 2023 due to wage inflation"
→ Shows: Reliance diversification improved financial stability
FinSight AI democratizes institutional-grade analysis, empowering every investor to see beyond the numbers and make data-driven decisions with confidence.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

FinSight AI perfectly embodies this track by building an intelligent agentic system that solves a critical fintech problem: transforming hours of manual fundamental analysis into minutes of AI-powered insights.
Our Innovation:
We've developed an autonomous AI agent that doesn't just retrieve financial data—it reasons, interprets, and visualizes it with human-like intelligence. The agent understands natural language queries, performs multi-source data fusion from annual reports and quarterly filings, and generates contextual insights with visual annotations explaining WHY metrics changed, not just WHAT changed.
Agentic AI Architecture:

Autonomous reasoning engine that contextualizes financial metrics
Multi-modal intelligence combining NLP, pattern recognition, and visual generation
Self-directed analysis across multiple data sources with validation
Dynamic insight generation with causal explanations

Fintech Impact:
Democratizes institutional-grade fundamental analysis for India's 100M+ retail investors, reducing analysis time from 2-3 hours to under 2 minutes while providing deeper insights than traditional screening tools.
Technical Differentiation:
Unlike rule-based systems, our agent adapts to context, detects anomalies automatically, benchmarks against sectors dynamically, and generates interactive visual narratives that tell the complete financial story.

**Description of your solution**

FocusFlow is an agentic AI-powered focus companion that learns your personal distraction patterns — when, why, and how you drift from work — and autonomously activates Focus Mode before you lose concentration.

It uses lightweight, on-device intelligence to detect distraction signals such as rapid app switching, long idle periods, or repeated social app usage, and then gently intervenes through context-aware actions like screen dimming, app blocking, or auto-replying to friends (“I’ll be back in focus in 20 minutes”).

Unlike typical focus timers, FocusFlow doesn’t wait for you to decide — it acts proactively to protect your attention and mental wellbeing, making focus effortless and sustainable for students and professionals alike.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

FocusFlow fits into the Healthtech track by addressing the rising challenge of digital distraction and cognitive fatigue, which directly impacts mental wellbeing. Excessive screen time and constant context switching have become major causes of stress, anxiety, and burnout among students and professionals.

Our solution uses Agentic AI to promote digital wellness and mental health by autonomously detecting distraction patterns and activating Focus Mode before the user loses concentration. Unlike basic timers or manual apps, FocusFlow continuously learns each user’s behavior, creating a personalized focus companion that helps build healthier screen habits and better attention hygiene.

By blending behavioral psychology, adaptive AI, and real-time intervention, FocusFlow acts as a mental health co-pilot, helping users achieve focus sustainably — making it a perfect fit for the Healthtech domain.

# **MythBuster AI: Robust Agentic Fact-Checking Architecture**

## **The Challenge**

In an era where **misinformation spreads faster than facts**, the world faces an urgent challenge — how do we verify what’s real in an ocean of **manipulated text, images, and videos**? From **political propaganda** to **AI-generated deepfakes**, traditional fact-checking systems collapse under **multimodal deception**. Built mostly for **text analysis**, they fail when **visual or contextual data** goes missing, allowing **false narratives** to spread unchecked.  

**The core issues:** fragmented data reliability, **poor contextual modeling**, and **adversarial vulnerabilities** that exploit **AI reasoning pipelines**.

## **Our Solution**

**MythBuster AI (Robust Agentic Fact-Checking Architecture)** is a **next-gen intelligent verifier** that **understands claims**, **breaks them into sub-claims**, and **[verifies each via trusted sources](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.15793)**.  

Built on the **[Automated Fact-Checking (AFC)](https://cssesw.easyscience.education/cssesw2024/CSSESW2024/paper50.pdf)** pipeline and powered by **[Large Language Models (LLMs)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2505.03135)**, it retrieves credible evidence and delivers **transparent, reasoned verdicts**.  

Its strength lies in **Multimodal Mastery**, via **[MMLNet](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.05839)** — capable of analyzing **text, images, and videos simultaneously**. Even with missing inputs, its **collaborative reasoning** ensures **factual consistency**.  

For deeper context, the **[Epidemiology-informed Network (EIN)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2411.12949)** models **rumor propagation** using the **eUSD model**, predicting **coordinated misinformation campaigns** before they escalate.  

Security modules like **Justification Self-Correction Loop (JSCL)** and **[Retrieval Integrity Check (RIC)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.08945)** protect against **adversarial attacks like [FACT2FICTION](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2508.06059)** by continuously auditing reasoning chains.  

Together, these components make **MythBuster AI a self-healing, resilient ecosystem**, designed for **truth, transparency, and trust** in an age of complex digital misinformation.

## **Impact & Target Audience**

- **Citizens:** Access to verified, clear information, reducing confusion during crises. [Source: Pew Research Center, 2023](https://www.pewresearch.org/fact-tank/2023/06/06/misinformation-in-news-consumption/)  
- **Media & Fact-Checkers:** Faster detection and countering of false claims. [Source: García et al., 2022](https://aclanthology.org/2022.acl-long.313/)  
- **Governments & Regulators:** Actionable insights for early-warning interventions and informed decisions.  
- **Researchers & Academics:** Verified multimodal datasets for studying rumor spread.  
- **Social Platforms & OTTs:** Ensures content integrity, curbing visual misinformation. [Source: MIT Media Lab, 2021](https://www.media.mit.edu/projects/mitigation-of-misinformation/)  
- **Society at Large:** Builds trust, reduces misinformation-driven harm, and improves crisis response.  

## **Revenue Model with Market Validation & References**

- **SaaS Licensing:**  
  Annual subscription for media houses and fact-checking agencies with dashboards for claim tracking and AI analysis.  
  **Reference:** [Fortune Business Insights – SaaS Market Report](https://www.fortunebusinessinsights.com/software-as-a-service-saas-market-102697)

- **API Verification Services:**  
  Pay-per-call API for text, image, and video verification integrated with social platforms and news apps.  
  **Reference:** [Mordor Intelligence – Content Moderation Solutions Market](https://www.mordorintelligence.com/industry-reports/content-moderation-solutions-market)  
  **Pricing Benchmarks:** [Google Cloud Vision API](https://cloud.google.com/vision/pricing), [OpenAI API](https://openai.com/pricing)

- **Enterprise & Government Deployments:**  
  On-premise/private cloud installations with enhanced security and compliance for ministries and broadcasters.  
  **Reference:** [CHEQ & University of Baltimore Study](https://info.cheq.ai/the-economic-cost-of-bad-actors-on-the-internet)

- **Licensing & Integration Partnerships:**  
  White-label/OEM solutions for publishers, OTT platforms, and academic partners.  
  **Reference:** [International Journalists' Network (IJNet)](https://ijnet.org/en/story/how-fact-checking-organizations-are-scaling-their-work)

- **Consulting & Forensic Advisory:**  
  Specialized misinformation audits, AI traceability, and policy advisory.  
  **Reference:** [CHEQ & University of Baltimore Study](https://info.cheq.ai/the-economic-cost-of-bad-actors-on-the-internet)

### **Yearly Projection Summary:**  
Validated benchmarks project **MythBuster AI** to achieve **$2–4M ARR** within 3 years, scaling to **$6–10M ARR** as enterprise and institutional adoption grows globally.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

**MythBuster AI** directly addresses the problem of **overwhelming misinformation during global crises** by providing a **real-time, multimodal verification system** that analyzes **text, images, and videos simultaneously**. Its **Automated Fact-Checking (AFC) pipeline**, combined with the **Epidemiology-informed Network (EIN)**, **models how rumors spread online** and delivers **context-aware credibility assessments**, while the **Justification Self-Correction Loop (JSCL)** and **Retrieval Integrity Check (RIC) modules** ensure **resilience against adversarial attacks** targeting AI reasoning.  

This enables **citizens, media houses, governments, and social platforms** to access **trusted, accurate information**, effectively mitigating **misinformation-driven confusion, panic, and harmful decision-making**.

**Description of your solution**

VETNET is a digital platform that redefines the meaning of “retirement” by transforming retired professionals into mentors, contributors, and creators of impact.

Our platform builds a bridge between experience and ambition through four core pillars:

**1. Work Opportunities for Retirees**

A specialised job-work marketplace designed exclusively for retirees who wish to continue working without the pressure of full-time employment.
• Retirees can choose flexible, project-based tasks aligned with their past expertise.
• AI-driven matching system pairs retirees with relevant opportunities posted by businesses, NGOs, or individuals.
• Promotes dignity, inclusion, and continued productivity post-retirement.

**2. AI-Powered Knowledge Sharing**

Retirees can convert their experience into courses, micro-lessons, or mentorship programs.
• Our AI Curriculum Builder assists them in structuring content, simplifying language, and even dubbing it into regional languages.
• Learners gain access to real-world insights and industry-specific wisdom rarely available in academic settings.

**3. Retiree Entrepreneurship Hub**

VETNET helps retirees with entrepreneurial ambitions to ideate, start, and manage small businesses.
• Built-in AI tools assist in business planning, compliance, and marketing strategies.
• Retirees can collaborate with young professionals for tech, marketing, or operational support.
• Encourages senior-led innovation, supported by inter-generational collaboration.

**4. Community & Collaboration Network**

A dedicated social ecosystem where retirees can:
• Connect with each other for community projects, social work, or knowledge events.
• Participate in discussion forums, digital clubs, and mentorship meetups.
• Build a sustainable legacy by transferring knowledge, guidance, and opportunities to the next generation.

**Technology Backbone**

• AI-based recommendation system for course creation, job matching, and mentor-mentee pairing.
• Multilingual content engine for dubbing and accessibility.
• Blockchain-backed credibility verification for mentors and learners to ensure trust and authenticity.

**Impact Vision**

By empowering retirees and guiding youth, VETNET aims to:
• Preserve decades of professional experience that would otherwise go untapped.
• Reduce youth unemployment by improving real-world readiness.
• Foster inter-generational learning and innovation-driven collaboration.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Every year, millions of professionals retire with decades of hard-earned expertise yet their knowledge, skills, and networks fade into inactivity simply because society has no structured way to keep them engaged.

Despite being mentally active and professionally capable, retirees face age barriers, digital illiteracy, and a lack of inclusive platforms that value their contributions. Many of them wish to continue working, guide the younger generation, or even start small ventures but find no bridge between willingness and opportunity.

At the same time, students, freshers, and early professionals struggle to understand the real expectations of the industry, facing a huge gap between academic learning and professional realities. The result is a waste of experience on one side and directionless ambition on the other.

The absence of a common ecosystem that connects retired experts with emerging talent and start-up ecosystems creates a two-way loss of wisdom, mentorship, and national productivity.

This is the PPT which explains the project in some better format.

Agentic-AI is an autonomous AI agent designed to detect fake or misleading news using the power of Gemini LLM and multiple external APIs.

The agent works in a way that closely resembles how a human fact-checker would operate — it collects news data from various trusted sources and APIs, compares the information, and then decides whether the news is real or fake based on cross-verification results.

One of the unique aspects of Agentic-AI is that it has system-level abilities such as reading, writing, running, and retrieving file information directly within its working directory. These capabilities allow it to manage and process data files efficiently while performing complex reasoning tasks.

All the data, including user queries and system responses, are stored in a SQLite database. This gives the AI a form of memory, allowing it to recall past responses, understand previous contexts, and improve its accuracy over time.

By combining large language model reasoning (Gemini), multi-API news verification, and persistent memory, Agentic-AI becomes a self-improving intelligent system capable of analyzing, learning, and making informed judgments autonomously.

In simple terms :

Agentic-AI is an AI agent that checks if a piece of news is real or fake by gathering information from multiple news sources using APIs, analyzing it with Gemini, saving its past responses in a database, and improving its reasoning every time it runs.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

In today’s digital world, misinformation and fake news spread rapidly across online platforms, making it difficult to distinguish credible information from fabricated stories. Traditional fact-checking systems often rely on single-source verification or static datasets, which limits their accuracy and adaptability.

To address this challenge, Agentic-AI aims to develop an autonomous, self-improving AI agent powered by Gemini LLM that can intelligently verify the authenticity of news. The system is designed to read, write, execute, and retrieve file information dynamically within its environment, while integrating multiple APIs from diverse news sources to perform real-time, cross-source validation.

Additionally, the agent utilizes SQLite-based memory storage, enabling it to retain and learn from previous interactions. This persistent memory allows the model to refine its reasoning and improve the accuracy of its decisions over time.

Ultimately, the goal of Agentic-AI is to create a reliable, memory-driven, and autonomous fact-verification system that can analyze news content, assess credibility across various sources, and determine whether the information is true or false with minimal human intervention. **Description of your solution**

ChainBreaker: Agentic AI That Contains Rumors Across Chat Groups 
 

Problem Statement 
 
Closed messaging groups (like WhatsApp and Telegram) are the largest breeding grounds for misinformation. Because they are private and encrypted, false forwards can spread rapidly across hundreds of groups before anyone verifies them — often creating panic, hate, or confusion. 
Traditional fact-checking tools focus on public posts, leaving closed groups vulnerable. 
 
 
Description of Our Solution 
 
ChainBreaker is an agentic AI network that autonomously detects, clusters, and counters misinformation across multiple chat groups. Users or group admins can invite the ChainBreaker bot to their groups. When suspicious messages are forwarded, the bot analyzes their content and tone, verifies facts through trusted APIs, and generates concise clarification messages or “fact cards” that users can re-share. 
 
 
What makes ChainBreaker unique is its cross-group intelligence: 
 
If the same or similar rumor appears in multiple groups, the system detects the pattern and automatically sends a broadcast alert across all connected groups. 
“New Rumor Emerging: A false claim about government loan schemes is spreading. Here’s the verified information.” 
This turns ChainBreaker into an AI-driven early-warning system for misinformation. 
 
 
Agentic Edge 
 
Unlike regular chatbots, ChainBreaker is multi-agentic: 
• Detection Agent: Identifies whether the message resembles a rumor pattern (fear, exaggeration, incentive, etc.) 
• Verification Agent: Cross-checks content with trusted APIs such as Google Fact Check or NewsAPI 
• Responder Agent: Crafts multilingual, context-aware replies and clarification cards 
• Broadcast Agent: Detects repeated patterns and autonomously issues alert messages across all groups 
 
Over time, ChainBreaker learns from user feedback to improve rumor detection accuracy. 
 
 
Technologies Used 
 
Frontend: React + Next.js 
Backend: Node.js 
Agent Framework: LangChain JS 
AI Models: GPT-4 / Gemini / Claude 
Verification APIs: Google Fact Check API, NewsAPI 
Chat Integration: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API / Telegram Bot API 
 
 
What We Plan to Build 
 
• A real-time misinformation containment network. 
• A working prototype bot that can receive forwarded messages from simulated chat groups. 
• A dashboard that visualizes how similar rumors appear in multiple groups. 
• Automatic clarification broadcasts triggered by the AI when patterns overlap. 
 
 
Pain Points Addressed 
 
• Misinformation Velocity: Rumors spread faster than manual debunks; ChainBreaker automates detection and clarification. 
• Privacy Respect: Works only on voluntarily forwarded content - no mass monitoring. 
• Scalability: One alert can reach dozens of groups instantly, preventing viral spread. 
• Cultural Fit: Generates multilingual, tone-appropriate responses for different audiences. 
 
 
Target Audience 
 
• General WhatsApp/Telegram users 
• Community and housing society admins 
• NGOs, fact-checking organizations, and government communication teams 
 
 
Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy 

Pilot: Open beta Telegram/WhatsApp bot for user testing. 
Partnerships: Collaborate with digital literacy NGOs and media houses. 
Expansion: Offer as a verified rumor-control service to local authorities or state IT departments. 
Analytics Platform: Launch ChainBreaker Dashboard for real-time rumor tracking and sentiment analysis. 
 
 
Revenue Streams 
 
• B2B Dashboard Subscriptions for media, NGOs, or government agencies 
• API Access for integration into third-party moderation tools or chat platforms 
 
 
Summary 
 
ChainBreaker goes beyond verification - it contains misinformation like a virus, using a network of cooperating agentic AIs that detect, verify, and broadcast facts across private group ecosystems. It’s privacy-respecting, scalable, and highly relevant in today’s rumor-driven world.

> Make WA University Memes a Good Thing!

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-333333?style=flat-square) ![langchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/langchain-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vector Database](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vector%20Database-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

WhatsApp University is a WhatsApp-based Agentic AI system that empowers users to verify and understand misinformation directly within their daily chat environment.

Users can forward any message — text, image, or link — to the WhatsApp University - WhatsApp channel. The system then:

Analyzes the message using LLM-based semantic understanding.

Cross-references facts across multiple trusted fact-check databases and verified news APIs.

Generates a contextual response — explaining what’s true, what’s false, and why the message is misleading.

Adds educational context, like emotional tone (“fear-based message”) and spread patterns.

Learns autonomously — the Agentic AI refines its accuracy by self-evaluating outputs and incorporating feedback from verified fact-check sources and user inputs.

The goal is not just to “debunk” misinformation, but to teach users how misinformation works, promoting long-term media literacy and trust.

⚙️ How It Leverages Agentic AI

ConText uses Agentic AI principles — autonomous, self-improving, and context-aware systems — in the following ways:

🤖 Autonomous Agents: Multiple agents handle subtasks —

Source Agent → scans the web for fact sources.

Context Agent → summarizes verified information in plain language.

Tone Agent → detects emotion or manipulation cues in the message.

Feedback Agent → learns from user votes or community inputs to self-improve.

Self-Learning Loop: The system continuously updates its internal models and source credibility ranking based on feedback, making it smarter and more contextually aware over time.

Multi-Source Reasoning: Agents collaborate to cross-check claims across diverse datasets (fact-check APIs, WHO, Reuters Fact Check, PIB, etc.) before responding to users.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

This project directly addresses the misinformation problem by:

Bringing real-time fact verification to where misinformation spreads most — WhatsApp.
Using Agentic AI to autonomously monitor, reason, and generate contextual fact-checks.
Promoting critical thinking and media literacy through explainable, personalized responses.
Scaling easily during crisis events (e.g., health scares, elections, disasters) when misinformation peaks.

In essence, ConText is not just a passive chatbot — it’s an autonomous misinformation defense system, continuously evolving to keep pace with emerging false narratives.
