**Description of your solution**

Fin-Agent is an autonomous financial coach designed to empower India’s gig and informal workforce with financial stability and independence. Built on the emerging paradigm of agentic AI, Fin-Agent functions as a proactive digital steward that not only analyzes a user’s finances but also takes intelligent, automated actions to improve them — from saving and investing to managing cash flow and debt.

Unlike traditional budgeting apps that assume predictable monthly incomes, Fin-Agent is tailored to the volatility of gig earnings. It connects with a user’s gig platforms, UPI apps, and bank accounts via India’s Account Aggregator framework to provide Dynamic Cash Flow Intelligence, showing real-time earnings, expenses, and predictive liquidity forecasts. It automatically tracks work-related costs like fuel and data, revealing true profits and enabling better work decisions.

Through Automated Resilience Building, the agent implements behaviorally informed micro-savings — rounding up transactions, sweeping daily surpluses, and allocating funds to personalized goals such as emergency funds or insurance. Once stability is built, it guides users into safe, small-scale investments.

Finally, Proactive Risk Mitigation protects users from financial shocks by predicting bills, optimizing debt repayment, and recommending relevant micro-insurance products. All actions operate under user-defined permissions and full transparency — the user can view, approve, or revoke any automated activity.

In essence, Fin-Agent replaces passive financial tracking with intelligent, autonomous action — a scalable, ethical, and inclusive pathway to financial autonomy for India’s invisible workforce.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/fe493fdde7e545f9a00b32f1ba1f76a7/a63389af-9abe-4b6e-b5f1-1645d54395c0.png)

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

Fin-Agent directly addresses the challenge of building an autonomous financial coaching agent for India’s gig and informal workforce. It is designed to analyze real-time user behavior, income variability, and spending patterns, then take proactive, automated actions to improve financial outcomes.

Unlike static budgeting apps, Fin-Agent leverages agentic AI to function as a digital financial co-pilot — monitoring income across platforms, forecasting cash flow, automating micro-savings, and guiding users toward insurance or debt management. It adapts dynamically to each user’s financial rhythm using machine learning and behavioral economics, reducing cognitive load and enabling long-term financial stability.

By combining AI-driven personalization, UPI and Account Aggregator integration, and autonomous execution, Fin-Agent perfectly embodies the vision of Track 1 – Fintech: a scalable, intelligent, and inclusive financial coach that empowers gig workers and everyday citizens to make smarter, data-backed financial decisions.

**Description of your solution**

**Problem Statement**
Most people struggle with financial discipline, lack of awareness of their spending patterns, and confusion around how to start saving or investing. Traditional financial advisors are expensive, and budgeting apps only track expense. FinWise bridges the gap by providing an always-available AI coach that analyzes behavior, identifies inefficiencies, and guides users toward informed and healthy financial decisions.
**💡 Solution**
FinWise is a multi-agent AI financial coaching system that helps users take full control of their money.
It combines behavior analysis, budgeting insights, savings optimization, and personalized investment planning all generated automatically based on the user's income, spending patterns, goals, and available capital.

**AI Agent Architecture (3 Core Agents)**
Agent 1: The Expenditure Auditor

- Goal: To ingest raw transaction data, categorize it with high precision, and identify "financial leaks"
- Output: A Financial Report detailing burn rate and discretionary income.

Agent 2: The Liquidity Strategist

- Goal: To analyze the Financial Report and construct a safety net. It determines how much cash must be liquid versus locked away.
- Output: A Plan defining monthly savings targets and emergency fund milestones.

Agent 3: The Growth Catalyst

- Goal: To take the surplus capital identified by the Strategist and deploy it based on the user's risk profile.
- Output: An Investment Portfolio Proposal with risk analysis.

> FinSync — Chat. Plan. Prosper.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square) ![React Native](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Native-333333?style=flat-square) ![langchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/langchain-333333?style=flat-square) ![LangGraph](https://img.shields.io/badge/LangGraph-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

Project Idea: **FinSync – The Agentic AI Financial Coach**

**FinSync** is an **Agentic AI–powered financial coach** built for **gig workers, freelancers, and informal earners** who struggle with irregular income, unpredictable expenses, and limited access to financial guidance. Unlike static budgeting apps, FinSync analyzes real-time financial data, gives personalized insights, and performs actions such as creating budgets, automating micro-savings, or suggesting IPO investments — all with user consent and privacy protection through India’s **Account Aggregator (AA)** framework.

---

### **1. Problem We Aim to Solve**

People with variable income often lack adaptive financial tools. They need not only tracking but also proactive, context-aware coaching. Traditional apps offer generic insights without understanding income fluctuations or emotions behind spending.

FinSync solves this gap through an **autonomous, emotionally intelligent, and privacy-first system** that delivers adaptive budgeting, spending insights, savings automation, and personalized investment suggestions.

---

### **2. High-Level Architecture & Tech Stack**

* **Frontend:** React.js + React Native (web and mobile), Tailwind CSS.
* **Backend:** Node.js + Express, MongoDB, Redis, Pinecone.
* **AI Layer:** LangChain and LangGraph orchestration, OpenAI and HuggingFace models for reasoning, Whisper for voice input.
* **Integrations:** Account Aggregator (secure data), Razorpay (payments, micro-SIPs), Twilio/WhatsApp (chat).
* **Infra:** Docker and Kubernetes for scalable deployment.
few more ....

This setup ensures high security, modularity, and speed for building the MVP.

---

### **3. Agentic Design – Multi-Agent Roles & Tools**

FinSync is powered by a **multi-agent architecture** where each agent performs specific actions through tools and APIs, while the **Master Agent** orchestrates them to deliver contextual, explainable results.

* **Finance Agent:** Uses AA data to read balances, tag income, and compute cashflow.
* **Budget Agent:** Auto-creates and adjusts budgets when income changes.
* **Savings / SIP Agent:** Starts or pauses ₹50/day micro-SIPs using Razorpay.
* **Investment Agent (IPO Tab):** Tracks new IPOs, evaluates affordability and risk, and allows users to watch or get notified.
* **Coach Agent:** Detects tone, encourages habits, and explains financial choices.
* **Tax & Records Agent:** Uses OCR to capture bills and generate simple tax summaries.
* **Consent & Privacy Manager:** Manages AA tokens and displays what data each agent accesses.

For example, when the user asks *“Can I afford to eat out tonight?”* the Master Agent activates Finance, Budget, and Coach Agents. It analyzes income, spending, and tone, then replies:
“✅ Yes — you have ₹850 free this week. Dining budget left ₹300. Skip one coffee (₹80) and you can spend ₹380 tonight.”
This flow demonstrates explainable, data-backed decision-making.

---

### **4. Dashboard, Chat & IPO Tab**

FinSync merges conversational and visual interfaces to simplify finance management.

* **Main Dashboard:** Shows balance, expenses, goals, and AI recommendations with visual clarity.
* **Chat Window:** Lets users interact naturally via text or voice, asking questions like *“Show my spending trends”* or *“Any new IPOs?”*
* **IPO Tab:** Displays new IPOs with issue details, investment range, and risk rating. The Investment Agent cross-checks affordability, ensuring users invest only when financially fit.
* **Micro-SIP Widget:** One-tap savings automation (e.g., *“Start SIP ₹50/day”*) through Razorpay links.
* **Contextual Cards:** Each AI response can appear as an action card—*“Start SIP,” “Set aside ₹200,” “Bookmark IPO.”*

This hybrid UX offers **guidance through chat and clarity through dashboards**, turning advice into tangible financial steps.

---

### **5. Example User Journeys**

**Scenario A — “Can I afford to go out to eat tonight?”**
The Master Agent invokes Finance, Budget, and Coach Agents. It calculates disposable income and replies with actionable advice — showing exact spending flexibility and suggestions to balance it with savings.

**Scenario B — “Any new IPOs I should watch?”**
The user opens the IPO tab. The Investment Agent lists upcoming IPOs with ratings and checks affordability. The user can bookmark or receive alerts for suitable options.

Both journeys show how FinSync moves from **analysis → explanation → action**, embodying true Agentic behavior.

---

### **6. Privacy, Security & Transparency**

FinSync is **privacy-first by design.** It uses the **Account Aggregator framework** for consent-based data access, encrypts all sensitive information, and stores minimal metadata. Users can view what data the AI used for each suggestion and revoke consent anytime. Every recommendation includes an explanation, ensuring **trust, control, and transparency.**

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

Our project, FinSync, fits perfectly into the Fintech track as it builds an autonomous, Agentic AI-driven financial coach that adapts to each user’s real income, spending, and behavioral patterns. Unlike static budgeting apps, FinSync actively acts on insights using specialized tools — the Finance Agent fetches bank data securely via the Account Aggregator framework, the Budget Agent auto-adjusts budgets based on income changes, and the Savings Agent sets up micro-SIPs or auto-savings tasks using Razorpay integration. An Investment Tool keeps users informed about new IPOs, while the Coach Agent provides emotional and goal-based motivation. With conversational access via WhatsApp or voice and a companion dashboard for visualization, FinSync transforms passive financial tracking into proactive, personalized financial action — empowering gig workers, freelancers, and everyday earners to make smarter financial decisions with confidence.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

• Our project, “AI-Based Rural Health Diagnosis through Voice and Dialect Analysis,” is designed to bring accessible healthcare to every corner of rural India through the power of voice and artificial intelligence.

• In many villages, describing symptoms to doctors in English or Hindi is difficult, and sometimes there isn’t even a doctor nearby. As a result, illnesses that start small often go unnoticed until they become serious. Our solution solves this problem by allowing people to speak in their own language or dialect such as Tamil, Hindi, Marathi, Telugu or any regional tongue and receive an instant AI-based health assessment without any sensors, tests, or medical devices.

• The system listens to a person’s speech, breathing and cough sounds, then uses Agentic AI to understand, analyze and provide guidance. Powered by Whisper and IndicSpeech models for multilingual speech recognition, it converts voice into text, interprets meaning and identifies acoustic patterns such as tone, pitch and rhythm. These features are processed using deep learning models built with TensorFlow and PyTorch, trained on Coswara and local Indian dialect datasets to predict early signs of illnesses such as fever, throat infection, cold or asthma along with their urgency level.

• This solution acts as a virtual rural health assistant that can talk, listen and guide even without internet in advanced versions. It removes dependency on clinical tools and bridges the gap between rural patients and healthcare systems.

• Our vision is to build India’s first multilingual, voice-powered diagnostic AI that truly understands the voice of the people. In the future, we aim to integrate this system with government health portals and telemedicine networks, expanding it to detect chronic diseases and support regional healthcare workers.

• In short, we are giving healthcare a new language—the language of the people, powered by AI that listens, understands and cares.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

•Our project, “AI-Based Rural Health Diagnosis through Voice & Dialect Analysis,” aligns with the theme “Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.”

•In rural India, many people face difficulty explaining their symptoms to doctors due to language barriers and limited medical access. Our AI system directly addresses this problem by enabling voice-based health diagnosis in regional dialects such as Tamil, Hindi, Marathi, and Telugu — without requiring sensors or clinical equipment.

•The solution leverages Agentic AI by autonomously listening to voice inputs, analyzing tone, pitch, cough sounds, and breathing rhythm, and then reasoning to predict possible illnesses (like fever, cold, asthma, or throat infection) and their urgency level. The system acts as a self-learning digital health assistant that can understand, analyze, and respond in multiple Indian languages.

•By combining multilingual speech recognition (Whisper + IndicSpeech) with acoustic health analysis and autonomous decision-making, our innovation brings accessible and intelligent healthcare screening to underserved rural areas. It represents a new step in AI-driven, language-inclusive, and sensor-free health diagnostics, designed especially for India’s diverse population.

**Description of your solution**

**Pandemic Preparedness Through Agentic AI: Building India's Early Warning & Response System**

India's healthcare system faces critical challenges during pandemics and health emergencies. The COVID-19 crisis exposed severe gaps in:

Early detection of outbreak clusters before exponential spread
Real-time resource management across fragmented public-private healthcare networks
Misinformation control in multilingual, diverse populations
Equitable healthcare access for rural and underserved communities

Current systems are reactive rather than proactive, leading to delayed responses, supply chain failures, panic-driven behavior, and overwhelmed healthcare facilities.

**💡 Proposed Solution: SahāyakAI (सहायक AI)**
An integrated agentic AI ecosystem that proactively monitors, predicts, and responds to pandemic threats across India's unique healthcare landscape.
**Core AI Agents:**
1. **Sentinel Agent - Early Warning System**

Continuously monitors disease signals from multiple sources (government health data, social media sentiment, hospital admission patterns, pharmacy sales spikes)
Uses anomaly detection and pattern recognition to identify outbreak clusters 30-40% earlier than traditional surveillance
Generates region-specific risk scores and automated alerts to authorities and healthcare facilities

2. **Logistics Orchestrator Agent - Supply Chain Intelligence**

Real-time inventory tracking across government/private hospitals (beds, oxygen, PPE, medicines, vaccines)
Predictive demand modeling based on outbreak patterns
Autonomous coordination of resource redistribution and emergency procurement
Integration with India's existing supply chain infrastructure and vendors

3. **Satya Agent (सत्य - Truth) - Misinformation Combat**

Multilingual monitoring of social media, WhatsApp groups, and news outlets (22+ Indian languages)
Real-time fact-checking using cross-referenced verified sources
Automated generation and distribution of localized, culturally-sensitive health advisories
Proactive engagement through chatbots, IVR systems, and trusted community influencers

4. **Swasthya Mitra Agent (स्वास्थ्य मित्र - Health Friend) - Citizen Support**

AI-powered symptom assessment and home quarantine guidance
Personalized health monitoring and medication reminders
Virtual doctor consultations and automated contact tracing nudges
Integration with ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account), CoWIN, and UPI for seamless digital health access

5. **Vaccine Vahan Agent (वाहन - Vehicle) - Vaccination Drive Manager**

Predictive modeling of vaccination demand by geography and demographics
Dynamic scheduling of mobile vaccine units for rural/underserved areas
Crowd management at vaccination centers using live sensors
Appointment optimization to minimize wait times and maximize coverage.


🎯 **Target Audience**

**Primary Users:**

**Government Health Departments**(District, State, National level)
**Public & Private Hospitals** (Urban and rural healthcare facilities)
**Citizens** (Especially in Tier 2/3 cities and rural areas)

**Secondary Users:**

NGOs and community health workers
Pharmaceutical supply chain operators
Media organizations for accurate health communication

**📊Specific Pain Points Addressed**

**Delayed Outbreak Detection**
Current 7-14 day lag reduced to 2-3 days through AI-powered early warning

**Supply Chain Chaos**
Autonomous coordination replaces manual, phone-based inventory management
Prevents critical shortages through predictive restocking

**Misinformation-Driven Panic**
Real-time fact-checking in 22+ languages
Proactive communication replaces reactive damage control

**Healthcare Inequality**
AI agents bring expert guidance to remote areas via smartphones
Mobile vaccination units reach underserved populations efficiently

**System Overload**
Contactless triage reduces unnecessary hospital visits by 40-50%
Intelligent queue management prevents overcrowding


**🚀 Go-To-Market Strategy**

**Phase 1: Pilot Program (Months 1-6)**
Partner with 2-3 progressive state governments (Maharashtra, Karnataka, Kerala)
Deploy in 5-10 districts as proof of concept
Focus on one agent system (Early Warning or Supply Chain)

**Phase 2: Scale Within States (Months 6-18)**
Expand to full state coverage based on pilot success
Integrate all agent modules
Establish partnerships with major hospital chains

**Phase 3: National Expansion (Months 18-36)**
Engage with National Health Mission and ABDM
Deploy across India's 700+ districts
International expansion to similar emerging markets

**Distribution Channels:**
Government Partnerships (Primary channel)
Hospital Networks (Apollo, Fortis, government hospital networks)
Direct-to-Consumer (Mobile app for citizens)

**📈 Impact Metrics (3-Year Target)**
30-40% faster outbreak detection compared to traditional surveillance
Coverage of 100 million+ citizens with AI-powered health support
70% reduction in misinformation-driven panic incidents.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

SahayakAI deploys 5 AI agents to revolutionize India's pandemic response: Sentinel detects outbreaks 30-40% faster, Logistics Orchestrator prevents supply shortages, Satya combats misinformation in 22+ languages, Swasthya Mitra provides 24/7 citizen health support, and Vaccine Vahan optimizes vaccination drives—transforming reactive crisis management into proactive prevention.

**Description of your solution**

Mental health deterioration often hides behind a smile — going unnoticed until it reaches a breaking point. MindGuard is an AI-driven emotional wellness companion designed to detect early signs of mental distress before they escalate.

Powered by Agentic AI, MindGuard goes beyond passive monitoring — it actively senses, learns, and responds to human emotions in real time. Using multimodal analysis of speech tone, facial micro-expressions, typing rhythm, and journaling sentiment, it builds a dynamic emotional fingerprint for each user.

When subtle distress patterns are detected, MindGuard acts autonomously — suggesting mindfulness breaks, offering personalized coping strategies, or connecting users to trusted peers, mentors, or mental health professionals.

🧠 Core Modules

🧭 EmotionSense AI: Multimodal sentiment and stress detection through voice, facial cues, and text-based interactions.

💬 SafeSpace Chatbot: An empathetic, AI-powered journaling assistant that listens contextually and provides supportive reflections.

📊 MoodGraph Dashboard: A visual timeline that maps emotional highs and lows, helping users understand their mental patterns.

🔔 Early Alert Engine: Proactive notifications for emotional burnout, anxiety spikes, or relapse indicators.

⚙️ Built With

Frontend: Next.js, React.js, Tailwind CSS
Backend: FastAPI, Node.js, Express.js
Database: MongoDB
AI/ML: Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers, Librosa

**Our Vision**

MindGuard represents the next frontier of Agentic AI in mental health — technology that thinks, acts, and adapts to human emotions.
It reimagines mental healthcare as preventive, private, and proactive — turning everyday devices into silent guardians of emotional well-being.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

MindGuard perfectly aligns with the Healthtech track leveraging Agentic AI as it redefines mental healthcare from being reactive to preventive.
Traditional healthtech tools rely on post-diagnosis intervention — MindGuard, instead, uses Agentic AI that thinks, acts, and adapts in real time to protect mental wellbeing.

By autonomously detecting early signs of stress, anxiety, and emotional deterioration through multimodal data (speech tone, facial micro-expressions, typing rhythm, and journaling sentiment), MindGuard actively recommends mindfulness actions or professional support.

This agentic behavior — observe → reason → act — exemplifies the next generation of intelligent health systems that continuously evolve with each user.
In essence, MindGuard transforms emotional care into an autonomous, personalized, and preventive health companion, perfectly fitting the vision of Agentic AI in Healthtech.

**Description of your solution**

# DermAid - Intelligent Acne Treatment System

## The Problem We're Solving
If you've ever dealt with acne, you know the frustration: what works for your friend doesn't work for you. You spend a lot of money trying different products, following generic advice from apps that recommend the same treatments to everyone. Meanwhile, if you have darker skin, most solutions aren't even trained to understand your skin tone properly, leaving you to deal with post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation that nobody seems to care about.
The truth is, acne treatment today is still stuck in the trial-and-error dark ages. We think that's unacceptable.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/692dc8ca8e884d4088f807777ddc85f9/3671c725-f2b0-4535-814f-8d505fa41e1c.png)

## Our Solution
DermAid is the first truly intelligent acne treatment system that learns YOUR skin. Not someone else's. Yours.
Think of it as having a dermatologist who studies your skin every single day, remembers what worked and what didn't, and gets smarter about treating you with each passing week. But instead of costing ₹2000 per visit, it's right there in your pocket.

Here's what makes DermAid different:
**Personalized Learning Engine:** We don't give you generic advice. Our AI observes how your skin responds to different treatments and adapts your plan weekly. If something's not working, we switch it up. If something's working great, we double down on it.
**Treatment Response Prediction:** Before you waste money on a product, we predict whether it'll actually work for your specific skin type. We analyze patterns from thousands of similar skin profiles and tell you upfront: "This will reduce your acne by 60% in 4 weeks" or "This popular product will likely irritate you - try this instead."
**Skin Tone Intelligence:** We built specialized models for darker skin tones because we're tired of AI that only works for light skin. Our system understands post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, prevents scarring on melanated skin, and recommends products that actually work across all Fitzpatrick scales.
**Week-by-Week Adaptation:** In week 1, we start with a baseline. By week 3, we've learned your triggers. By week 6, we've found your perfect formula. And we keep optimizing from there.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/692dc8ca8e884d4088f807777ddc85f9/918126f8-ab66-4a02-ad9f-2182df3c122a.png)

## How It Works

1. Take a photo of your skin daily (you'd check the mirror anyway)
2. Log what you're using - products, lifestyle factors, everything
3. Watch DermAid learn - our AI analyzes your responses and adapts your treatment plan
4. Get predictions - we tell you what will work BEFORE you buy it
5. See real results - personalized treatment that actually understands your unique skin

The magic happens in the background. Our system is constantly comparing your progress, identifying patterns, and refining your treatment protocol. It's like having a clinical trial running just for you.

## Why This Matters
500 million people worldwide struggle with acne. The global acne treatment market is worth $15 billion. Yet most solutions are still one-size-fits-all. We're changing that.
More importantly, we're addressing a real equity issue in dermatology. Most AI models are trained predominantly on light skin, leaving people with darker skin tones underserved. 
**DermAid was built from the ground up to work for everyone**.

## Technical Approach
We're building DermAid as a Progressive Web App with React/Next.js frontend and TensorFlow.js for client-side AI inference. This means acne analysis happens directly in your browser - your photos never leave your device unless you choose to sync them.
Our computer vision model uses a MobileNetV2 backbone fine-tuned for acne detection across diverse skin tones, with custom classification heads for acne type identification and skin tone adaptation. Firebase handles the backend - Cloud Firestore for real-time treatment tracking and progress syncing.
Our agentic AI learning engine autonomously aggregates treatment responses across users to power predictive algorithms, while proactively adapting individual user profiles weekly based on observed skin reactions, making intelligent decisions without requiring user intervention.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/692dc8ca8e884d4088f807777ddc85f9/f8f1e2cc-aba1-4ead-b499-240692236056.png)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/692dc8ca8e884d4088f807777ddc85f9/cefb0da1-a6fc-48a2-98d4-3cfd803d2791.png)

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

DermAid leverages agentic AI that acts autonomously on behalf of users, continuously analyzing skin changes, predicting treatment outcomes, and adapting plans without manual intervention. We are addressing a critical gap in accessible dermatological care. With 500 million people worldwide suffering from acne and average dermatologist wait times exceeding 6-8 weeks in many regions, we're democratizing expert-level skin health guidance.

Our solution tackles three core healthcare challenges:
**Access Inequality:** Traditional dermatology is expensive and inaccessible for many. DermAid provides clinical-grade skin analysis and personalized treatment guidance at a fraction of the cost, reaching underserved populations globally.
**Health Equity:** Most existing AI healthcare tools are trained predominantly on light skin tones, creating diagnostic bias. We've built specialized models for darker skin tones, addressing post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation and scarring prevention - conditions often overlooked in mainstream dermatology.
**Preventive Care:** Beyond treating acne, our continuous skin monitoring can flag concerning changes early, reducing the risk of late-stage diagnoses and decreasing overall healthcare costs through early intervention.

DermAid transforms episodic dermatology visits into continuous, intelligent care. We're not just building a skincare app - we're creating a scalable healthcare solution that makes personalized dermatological expertise accessible to anyone with a smartphone.

**Description of your solution**

AyurSutra is a comprehensive software solution for Panchakarma patient management and therapy scheduling, developed by team NextGenn. Positioned under the MedTech/BioTech/Health Tech theme, it aims to streamline operations for Ayurvedic therapy centers, enhance practitioner efficiency, and improve patient outcomes through modern technology.


Proposed Solution & Core Features The platform is designed to digitize and automate the entire patient journey, from registration to post-therapy follow-up. Its key features include:


Unified Patient Record: A centralized dashboard that manages a patient's complete medical history, prescriptions, lab reports, therapy notes, and billing information.


Smart Scheduling: An automated system for booking appointments that considers therapist availability. It sends notifications and reminders and can sync with calendars like Google and Outlook to prevent conflicts.


Therapy Tracking: Enables practitioners to monitor patient progress session by session by recording notes, exercises, and outcomes.


AI-Powered Recommendations: The system uses Artificial Intelligence to provide personalized therapy plan adjustments based on ongoing patient progress and feedback.


Telehealth Integration: Offers capabilities for remote therapy, including video consultations, chat, and secure document sharing.


Multi-Role Access: Provides customized access levels for different users, such as patients, doctors, therapists, and administrative staff, ensuring data security and relevance.


Analytics Dashboard: Delivers valuable insights on patient progress, resource utilization, and predictive analysis to aid decision-making.

Technology Stack AyurSutra is built on a modern and scalable technology stack:

Frontend: Next.js, React.js, Tailwind CSS, Flutter, and TypeScript.

Backend: NodeJS, ExpressJS, Supabase, Firebase, and Socket IO.

Database: MongoDB and PostgreSQL.

AI Chatbot: Python, LangChain, and FastAPI.

Deployment: Vercel, GitHub, Render, and AWS.

Impact and Benefits The project is designed to have a significant positive impact on the Ayurvedic healthcare ecosystem:

For Practitioners: It saves an estimated 40% of administrative time, allowing them to focus more on patient care.

For Patients: Improves adherence to therapy and health outcomes through automated reminders and transparent progress tracking.

For Therapy Centers: Ensures a consistent quality of care and enhances operational efficiency.

Social & Cultural Benefits: AyurSutra aims to democratize access to authentic Panchakarma therapy, preserve traditional Ayurvedic knowledge through digital documentation, and bridge ancient wisdom with modern technology.

Economic & Environmental Benefits: The platform reduces healthcare costs by focusing on preventive care, creates jobs in the digital health sector, and promotes sustainability by reducing paper usage.

Panchakarma is gaining global recognition for detoxification, rejuvenation, and chronic disease management, contributing significantly to the projected USD 16 billion Ayurveda market by 2026. However, the lack of dedicated management software leads to: -Inefficient manual scheduling and documentation -Inconsistent therapy quality across centers -Limited digital patient management Advancements in healthcare IT and digital therapeutics present a timely opportunity to develop a software solution that integrates traditional authenticity with modern efficiency. Description:- The Panchakarma Management Software will feature automated therapy scheduling and provide notifications to patients regarding the necessary pre- and post-procedure precautions. Innovative Features:- -Real-Time Therapy Tracking: Allow patients and practitioners to view therapy progress, upcoming sessions and personalized recovery milestones. -Visualization Tools: Use graphs and progress bars to track improvements based on patient responses and feedback. -Integrated Feedback Loop: Enable patients to report symptoms, side effects or improvements after each session, refining schedules or precautions as needed. Expected solution:- The software should address both core functionality and innovative enhancements to ensure usability, efficiency and patient-centric care. **Description of your solution**

What We Plan to Build

SatyaShodhak (Shodh for Satya in the digital age) is a truth verification platform powered by AI. It allows users to check the authenticity of any statement within seconds. Using Agentic AI, it continually scans global content, including news, blogs, and social media. It detects claims, verifies them with trusted data sources, and offers clear, evidence-based explanations. 

The system operates with a group of intelligent agents: Collector, Claim Detector, Evidence Retriever, Verifier, and Explainer. They work together to classify statements as True, False, or Inconclusive, ensuring transparency and credibility.

What Specific Pain Points It Addresses

The rapid spread of misinformation and fake AI-generated content on digital platforms. 

The lack of accessible and trustworthy fact-checking tools for the general public. 

Challenges for elderly people and non-technical users when verifying online claims. 

An overload of unverified content during crisis situations like pandemics, conflicts, or natural disasters. 

The need for faster and more reliable verification systems for journalists and government agencies. 

Who the Target Audience Is

Journalists and media organizations need real-time, AI-supported fact-checking. 

Government agencies and NGOs seek to manage misinformation and improve crisis communication. 

Elderly individuals and the general public need a simple and guided way to identify truth vs. fake. 

Researchers and educational institutions require data transparency and truth literacy.

Go-To-Market (GTM) and Revenue Streams

API and SaaS subscriptions for media houses, government departments, and NGOs.  

Premium verification tools for journalists, researchers, and professional users.  

Community engagement through Truth Points and gamified learning.  

CSR and research partnerships that promote truth literacy and responsible information use.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

SatyaShodhak directly addresses the issue of misinformation by helping people recognize what is true and what is not in a time of overwhelming digital content. Today, with the increase of fake AI-generated content, it is even harder to tell the difference between truth and manipulation. During crises like pandemics, natural disasters, or conflicts, false information spreads quickly, causing fear, confusion, and mistrust.

SatyaShodhak serves as a reliable truth-checking tool that offers quick, clear, and verified updates to the public. Anyone can post a claim and instantly find out if it is true, false, or uncertain, along with straightforward explanations based on credible sources.

Our target users include journalists, government agencies, and older adults who may find it difficult to verify the authenticity of online information. For journalists and media organizations, it improves reporting accuracy and transparency. For government bodies, it aids timely crisis communication and public safety efforts.

By making fact-checking easy and trustworthy, SatyaShodhak helps restore trust in information, reduces the spread of fake news, and fosters a more informed and responsible society.

**Description of your solution**

## **Overview**
AI-generated videos from platforms like **Sora, Runway, and Pika** are increasingly realistic, fueling **misinformation**.  
**Aegis** is a **multi-agent authenticity detection system** that fuses **perceptual forensics**, **semantic reasoning**, **model attribution**, **provenance verification**, and **adversarial simulation**, unified by a **collective consensus layer**.  
Built on **Firebase**, **Vertex AI**, and **GenKit flows**, it produces an explainable authenticity score and human-readable reasoning.

---

## **Top-Level Architecture**
**Client UI / Upload**  
→ *(multipart POST → https://aegis.example.com/analyze)*  
**Nginx (TLS 1.2 reverse proxy)**  
→ **API Gateway / Flask CV Server** *(OpenCV, FFmpeg, TensorFlow)*  
↕ Internal API  
→ **Agent Orchestrator** *(GenKit / Vertex AI / Firebase Functions)*  
&emsp;├─ Perceptual Forensics Agent  
&emsp;├─ Semantic Coherence Agent  
&emsp;├─ Model Attribution Agent  
&emsp;├─ Provenance & Lineage Agent  
&emsp;├─ Adversarial Simulation Agent  
&emsp;└─ Collective Consensus Agent  
↓  
**Reasoning Explanation Agent (Gemini)**  
→ Final JSON + Human Explanation  
→ **Client UI Dashboard** *(visualization, anomaly frames, shareable report)*

---

## **Agent Responsibilities**

### **1. Perceptual Forensics Agent**
- Extracts frames (FFmpeg/OpenCV).  
- Computes **spectral slope (1/f)**, **noise residual variance**, **PRNU/SPN**, and **codec artifact consistency**.  
- Runs CNN/ONNX-based artifact detector.  
- **Outputs:** perceptualScore, forensicIndicators, anomalyFrames.  
- **Extensions:** camera-based baselines, JPEG/chroma checks, PKI-signed reports.

### **2. Semantic Coherence Agent**
- Uses **Gemini Vision + ASR** to analyze speech–scene alignment, AV sync, and content coherence.  
- **Outputs:** semanticScore, explanation.  
- **Extensions:** lip-sync via landmarks, attention maps, segment confidence.

### **3. Model Attribution Agent**
- Detects latent fingerprints to infer likely generator.  
- Compares residuals with known signatures (Sora, Runway, Pika, Synthesia).  
- **Outputs:** model name + confidence.

### **4. Provenance & Lineage Agent**
- Extracts EXIF, codec metadata, timestamps, and container history.  
- Checks **C2PA** or blockchain provenance, web traces, earliest appearance.  
- **Outputs:** provenanceConfidence + metadata.  
- **Extensions:** integrate C2PA verification & timestamping.

### **5. Adversarial Simulation Agent**
- Generates perturbed variants (downscale, recompress, jitter, GAN-denoise).  
- Re-runs perceptual checks to test robustness.  
- **Outputs:** robustness metrics + attack budget (PSNR/slope shift).

### **6. Collective Consensus Agent**
- Queries reverse search, trusted sources, and community verifications.  
- Aggregates cross-source corroboration.  
- **Outputs:** consensusScore + sources.

---

## **Fusion & Decision Logic**
- Weighted fusion: **Perceptual 65–85%**, **Semantic 15–35%**, dynamic for others.  
- Overrides:  
  - Valid provenance → confidence ↑  
  - Spectral/temporal anomalies → confidence ↓  
  - Fragile robustness → confidence ↓  
- **Reasoning Agent** produces final narrative + audit trail.

---

## **Example Output**

{
  "authenticityScore": 0.71,
  "classification": "Likely Real",
  "reasoningSummary": "Spectral slope deviation within camera range; semantic coherence strong.",
  "perceptual": {"score": 0.6},
  "semantic": {"score": 0.91},
  "modelAttribution": {"likelyModel": null, "confidence": 0.12},
  "provenance": {"signed": false},
  "consensus": {"score": 0.2}
}

---

## **Deployment Blueprint**

- **CV Server:** Dockerized **GPU Flask app** behind **Nginx (TLS 1.2)**.
- **Orchestrator:** **Firebase Functions** + **Vertex AI GenKit**.
- **Storage:** GCS/S3 (signed URLs, retention).
- **Pipeline:** **Async job flow** with polling/webhooks.
- **Security:** API keys, rate limits, PKI.
- **Monitoring:** **Prometheus**, **Grafana**, **Sentry**.
- **CI/CD:** **GitHub Actions → Cloud Run**.

---

## **Evaluation & Ethics**

- **Metrics:** ROC curves, Precision@K, FP audits, robustness score, human agreement.
- **Dataset:** Real camera videos, synthetic (Sora, Runway, Pika), adversarial variants.
- **Ethics:** **Probabilistic labels** (“Likely Real/AI”), manual review for edge cases, GDPR compliance, transparent labeling, abuse prevention.

---

## **Impact**

**Aegis** restores digital trust through transparent, explainable detection of synthetic media, blending **signal forensics**, **semantic reasoning**, and **provenance intelligence** into one verifiable system.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

### **How Aegis Fits the Misinformation Track**

The **Misinformation track** challenges teams to address the growing problem of false, misleading, or synthetic content. AI-generated videos from platforms like **Sora, Runway, and Pika** are becoming hyper-realistic, making it increasingly difficult for individuals, media outlets, and organizations to distinguish authentic content from synthetic manipulation.

**Aegis directly addresses this problem** by leveraging **Agentic AI** to create a **multi-layered, autonomous verification system**. Each agent specializes in a critical aspect of misinformation detection:

- **Perceptual Forensics Agent:** Detects visual anomalies in video frames that hint at manipulation.  
- **Semantic Coherence Agent:** Checks narrative and dialogue plausibility to spot inconsistencies.  
- **Provenance & Lineage Agent:** Tracks the origin and spread of videos to identify manipulated sources.  
- **Model Attribution Agent:** Recognizes the AI model responsible for generating the content.  
- **Adversarial Simulation Agent:** Continuously stress-tests the system to adapt to emerging generative models.  
- **Collective Consensus Agent:** Integrates all agent outputs into a unified, explainable authenticity score.  

By combining **multi-agent reasoning, self-learning, and cross-modal verification**, Aegis doesn’t just classify videos — it **actively understands and interprets them**, which is the essence of **Agentic AI**.  

**Summary:**  
- **Problem Alignment:** Targets a critical source of misinformation — AI-generated videos.  
- **Agentic AI Application:** Components act autonomously, collaborate, and adapt.  
- **Impact Potential:** Provides transparent, reliable, and scalable defense against misinformation in digital media, perfectly aligning with the track’s goal.

**Description of your solution**

**Description of Our Solution: AI-Powered Deepfake Video Detection**

For the hackathon, we plan to build an intelligent, web-based system designed to accurately detect and flag deepfake videos, specifically those involving face-swapping manipulations.

**The Idea:**
Our core idea is to create an accessible and reliable tool that empowers users to verify the authenticity of a video. The rise of sophisticated deepfakes poses a significant threat to media integrity, personal security, and public trust, as these forgeries can be used to spread misinformation, commit fraud, or create malicious content. Current detection methods often struggle to keep up with the increasing realism of these fakes. Our solution directly addresses this challenge by providing a robust, AI-driven system that can identify subtle manipulations missed by the human eye.



**How It Works: The GenConViT Model**
Our solution is a user-friendly web application where anyone can upload a video file for analysis. The system's architecture is designed for efficiency and accuracy.



**Preprocessing:** Once a video is uploaded, our backend system automatically splits the video into a set of distinct frames. For each frame, it uses the face_recognition library to detect and crop out human faces.




**Core AI Analysis:** The cropped faces are then passed to the heart of our system: GenConViT, a state-of-the-art hybrid deep learning model. This model is our key innovation because it combines two powerful architectures:



**Convolutional Neural Network (CNN):** The CNN component (specifically, a ConvNeXt architecture) excels at analyzing local, fine-grained details. It scans for subtle artifacts, unnatural textures, and pixel inconsistencies that are often tell-tale signs of a digital forgery.



**Vision Transformer (ViT):** The Transformer component (Swin Transformer) analyzes the entire face globally. It uses a self-attention mechanism to understand the relationships between different facial regions, allowing it to spot broader inconsistencies like mismatched lighting, unnatural shadows, or disjointed facial expressions that a purely local analysis might miss.



**Result Generation:** The GenConViT model outputs a prediction score for each analyzed face. These individual scores are then aggregated to produce a final, overall classification for the entire video: "Real" or "Fake". To provide clarity, we also present a confidence percentage that indicates the model's certainty in its decision.






**User-Friendly Output:** The final result is displayed on a clean and simple web interface, telling the user the verdict and the confidence level, thus offering a powerful tool for verifying video content.

**Project Goals**
Our primary goals for this project are:


**Accuracy:** To develop a highly accurate detection system by leveraging the advanced capabilities of the hybrid GenConViT model.


**Efficiency:** To optimize the video processing pipeline to ensure users get timely and quick results without sacrificing accuracy.

**Accessibility:** To build an intuitive web interface that makes this complex technology easy for anyone to use.

This project offers a practical and scalable solution to a critical modern problem, aiming to restore a measure of trust and integrity in digital visual media.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Our project, an AI-powered deepfake detection system, is a direct and robust solution for the "Misinformation: Bring your own problem" track. It tackles one of the most insidious and rapidly evolving forms of digital disinformation: AI-generated fake videos.

1. **Addressing a Critical Misinformation Problem:** The core of our project is to combat the spread of misinformation fueled by deepfake technology. These highly realistic, manipulated videos are a significant threat, used to create fake news, defame individuals, and undermine public trust. We are bringing a specific, high-impact problem—the verification of video authenticity—to this hackathon. Our system provides an automated and accurate solution to help users distinguish between genuine and manipulated content.





2. **Leveraging an "Agentic AI" Solution:** Our solution is built around **GenConViT**, a sophisticated AI model that acts as an intelligent agent to solve this problem. This isn't just a simple filter; it's a deep learning system that autonomously performs a complex analysis:

It **perceives** its environment by processing uploaded video data, breaking it down into frames and detecting faces.


It **reasons** by using its hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture to analyze both local pixel details and global facial inconsistencies—artifacts that are invisible to the human eye.

It **acts** by aggregating its findings to make a final, evidence-based decision, classifying the video as "Real" or "Fake" and providing a quantifiable confidence score to the user.


This project perfectly embodies the track's theme by applying a powerful AI agent to a self-defined, critical misinformation challenge. We are creating a tool to empower individuals and organizations to verify digital media, directly strengthening the integrity of our information ecosystem.

By processing data directly on the user’s device, WealthWise ensures sensitive financial information, like SMS alerts, emails, app notifications, and optional voice or receipt inputs, never leaves the user’s control.

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

# SmartFinance AI - Financial Coaching Agent

## Problem

Many individuals, especially gig workers and those with irregular incomes, struggle to manage money effectively. Traditional budgeting apps require manual input and provide generic advice that often misses personal financial habits and needs.

## Solution

**SmartFinance AI** is an AI-powered financial coach that silently tracks and analyzes finances, offering personalized guidance without manual effort. It collects passive data (SMS, emails, notifications) and optional inputs (voice notes, receipts) to detect spending patterns, predict cash flow, and provide dynamic budgeting and nudges.

## Target Users

* Young professionals with variable incomes
* Gig economy workers
* Busy families
* Financial advisors and corporate wellness programs (B2B2C)

## Technical Architecture

* **Data Collection:** SMS, emails, notifications, receipts
* **Local Processing:** Categorization and pattern recognition
* **Cloud AI:** Behavioral analysis, predictive analytics, anomaly detection
* **Decision Engine:** Adaptive budgeting, goal adjustment, context-aware nudges
* **User Interface:** Dashboard and insights
* **Security:** Encryption, read-only access, GDPR/DPDP compliance

## Track Fit

SmartFinance AI helps users with irregular incomes save, spend, and invest wisely by providing proactive, personalized guidance that adapts to individual habits and financial situations.

**Description of your solution**

## RecallMatrix

Every day, we consume thousands of bits of information articles, emails, chats, screenshots, random thoughts, and AI conversations. We try to bookmark them or jot them down somewhere, but when we actually need that one detail, it’s gone. Ironically, even AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini face a similar problem they can’t retain long-term memory or recall earlier interactions. This creates a major gap between human cognition and digital intelligence we both forget too soon.

**RecallMatrix** was born from that frustration.

- RecallMatrix was designed to bridge that gap. It’s a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-based personal memory engine that acts as an AI-powered long-term memory layer for humans and digital assistants. It remembers, organizes, and retrieves your ideas, notes, and files with contextual precision making your mind and your AI tools smarter together.

- RecallMatrix captures every meaningful piece of information notes, ideas, summaries, even media files converts them into embeddings using OpenAI’s text-embedding-large model, and indexes them automatically for precise recall later. Users don’t need to think about databases or vectors; they just ask, “What was that startup idea I had last week about drones?” and RecallMatrix instantly retrieves it with full context.

This Product is structured across five key modules:

1. **Dashboard**: Displays activity logs, embedding creation, memory counts, and backend processing metrics in real time.

2. **Memories**: Allows users to store thoughts, ideas, links(Page content will be extracted), and small media files (images/videos up to 10MB each, with a total limit of 100MB Storage can be Increased). Text is embedded, and images are indexed and embedded using their names and descriptions.

3. **Universal Search**: A natural-language, RAG-powered search system that retrieves forgotten data or memories instantly. Supabase full-text search enhances performance for file retrieval.

4. **MCP (Memory Control Protocol)**: Acts as a bridge connecting Ragnitive with other tools such as Gmail, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or voice assistants etc. This enables external applications to access or update your memories securely, extending the idea of memory beyond one platform.

5. **Knowledge Graph**:The Knowledge Graph is the intelligent layer that ties everything together. It visualizes and organizes how memories relate to one another—linking people, topics, locations, and emotions into a semantic network. For example, if multiple memories reference “AI projects,” “hackathon,” and “Supabase,” the graph automatically connects these nodes to reveal relationships between your ideas and experiences.

6. **Settings**: Manages user preferences, model selection (GitHub or OpenRouter models), API key handling, and privacy controls.

Unlike traditional note-taking or bookmarking tools, RecallMatrix doesn’t just store data it understands and recalls context. It gives both humans and AI assistants the ability to remember everything that matters.

With RecallMatrix , forgetting becomes optional your memories, thoughts, and insights are always one search away.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Misinformation often spreads because critical context is lost facts are detached from their sources, memories fade, and information fragments across different platforms. The same cognitive gap exists in how humans and AI tools handle knowledge we save ideas, notes, and data everywhere, but when we need accurate context, it’s missing or misremembered. RecallMatrix addresses that exact problem by introducing an agentic, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)–based memory system that preserves, connects, and recalls information with its original context intact.

At its core, RecallMatrix functions as a personal truth-preserving memory layer for both humans and AI assistants. Every note, article, idea, or file is embedded using OpenAI’s text-embedding-large model and automatically indexed for precise retrieval. Unlike traditional bookmarking or note-taking apps, RecallMatrix doesn’t just store data it understands relationships between memories through its Knowledge Graph, ensuring that each piece of information remains connected to its origin and meaning.

This directly combats misinformation at a micro level by maintaining contextual integrity inside personal and organizational knowledge bases, it prevents misinterpretation, half-truths, and forgotten sources from distorting understanding over time. The system’s agentic nature allows it to autonomously ingest, organize, and surface the most relevant, verifiable memories whenever the user or connected AI agent needs them.

For instance, when an AI assistant like ChatGPT or Gemini references a past discussion or fact, RecallMatrix can act as its verified memory source, retrieving the exact original content rather than relying on paraphrased or incomplete recall. In team or research settings, this ensures that shared knowledge remains accurate, consistent, and traceable  turning fragmented data into a trustworthy web of connected truths.

Through its six modules  Dashboard, Memories, Universal Search, MCP (bridge to external tools), Knowledge Graph, and Settings  RecallMatrix transforms the way humans and AI manage information. The Knowledge Graph plays a critical role here, revealing how concepts, events, and sources interlink, allowing the system to validate relationships and highlight inconsistencies that could lead to misinformation.

In the context of the hackathon’s Misinformation track, RecallMatrix represents a proactive solution that prevents misinformation before it begins  by ensuring memory continuity, contextual understanding, and verifiable knowledge recall. It leverages Agentic AI principles of autonomy, reasoning, and contextual action to make both human cognition and AI systems more truthful and reliable.

By bridging the gap between forgetting and remembering  between isolated facts and connected knowledge  RecallMatrix makes information trustworthy again.

**Description of your solution**

Problem Statement:
Consumers are often misled by brands that do not accurately depict their products in advertisements, packaging, or online descriptions. Misrepresentation can lead to poor purchasing decisions, financial loss, or safety concerns. Currently, consumer authorities struggle to efficiently monitor and verify the accuracy of product representations across numerous brands and platforms.

Solution Using Agentic AI:
Leverage agentic AI to autonomously analyze and verify product information across multiple channels. The AI agents can:
Collect data from e-commerce listings, social media ads, and brand websites.
Compare product depictions (images, descriptions, specifications) against official product information or regulatory standards.
Detect inconsistencies or misrepresentations and flag them for review by consumer authorities.
Generate reports or alerts automatically for brands with potential misleading depictions.
By using agentic AI, the monitoring process becomes scalable, faster, and more accurate, reducing the burden on human authorities and helping protect consumers.

How Agent Unveil Works
Data Collection:
Agentic AI agents continuously gather data from e-commerce sites, social media ads, and brand websites.
Information Analysis:
The agents analyze product details—images, descriptions, and specifications—using NLP and computer vision models.
Verification & Comparison:
Each depiction is compared against verified product data or regulatory standards to check for inconsistencies or exaggerations.
Flagging & Reporting:
When potential misinformation is detected, the system flags it and automatically generates a report for review by consumer authorities.
Continuous Learning:
The agents learn from feedback and improve their accuracy over time, making the monitoring process smarter and more efficient.
**Impact & Benefits:**
Protects Consumers:
Helps prevent buyers from being misled by false product claims, ensuring safer and more informed purchasing decisions.
Empowers Authorities:
Gives consumer protection agencies an AI-powered monitoring tool to detect brand misrepresentation faster and more accurately.
Boosts Brand Accountability:
Encourages brands to maintain transparency and accuracy in their marketing and product information.
Scalable Monitoring:
AI agents can analyze thousands of listings, ads, and product pages simultaneously—something that would be impossible manually.
Early Detection of Misinformation:
Identifies misleading depictions early before they spread widely, reducing consumer harm and misinformation impact.
Cost & Time Efficiency:
Automates manual verification work, saving significant time and resources for regulatory bodies.
**Tech Stack**
🧠 Agentic AI & Orchestration:
LangChain, AutoGPT – build and manage autonomous, task-driven AI agents for verification and analysis.
🌐 Data Collection & Scraping:
Scrapy, Selenium – extract product data and advertisements from dynamic websites.
APIs (Twitter, Meta, Shopify) – fetch data from social media and e-commerce platforms.
🗣️ NLP & Understanding:
Transformers, Sentence-Transformers – analyze text descriptions and detect misleading or inconsistent claims.
👁️ Computer Vision:
OpenCV, PIL – process and compare product images for visual discrepancies.
(Optional) Google Vision API / Azure Cognitive Services – accelerate large-scale image comparison.
🧩 Verification & Knowledge Management:
Pinecone / FAISS – store and compare product embeddings efficiently.
Rule-based validators – enforce compliance with regulatory or labeling standards.
🗄️ Data Storage:
PostgreSQL, MongoDB – store scraped data, analysis results, and flagged reports.
⚙️ Backend & Automation:
Python (FastAPI / Flask) – manage APIs, data flow, and AI agent communication.
Celery + Redis – handle distributed and scheduled AI tasks.
☁️ Cloud & Deployment:
AWS, GCP, Azure – provide scalable storage, compute power, and GPU instances.
Docker – containerize the full system for portable deployment.
**Next Steps for Agent Unveil**
Prototype Development
Build a working MVP using Scrapy, Selenium, and LangChain to collect and analyze data from selected e-commerce sites.
Model Training & Fine-tuning
Train NLP and vision models to detect product inconsistencies across text and image data.
Integration with Regulatory Databases
Connect to consumer protection or product standards databases to validate claims against official records.
Dashboard & Reporting System
Develop a web dashboard for authorities to visualize flagged brands, product accuracy scores, and trend insights.
Agent Collaboration Framework
Enable multiple AI agents (data collector, verifier, reporter) to coordinate autonomously for continuous monitoring.
Scalability Testing
Deploy on cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) and test with real-time data streams to ensure system robustness.
Pilot with Consumer Authorities or NGOs
Partner with regulatory bodies to validate the system in real-world monitoring scenarios.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Track Fit: Misinformation – Agentic AI for Truthful Product Representation

Agent Unveil directly tackles a form of commercial misinformation, where brands mislead consumers by presenting inaccurate or exaggerated depictions of their products through advertisements, packaging, or digital listings. This type of misinformation erodes consumer trust and can cause real-world harm—financial, ethical, and even safety-related.

By leveraging Agentic AI, the project introduces autonomous agents capable of continuously verifying product information across multiple platforms. These agents act as digital inspectors, gathering and analyzing product visuals, descriptions, and specifications to detect mismatches between marketing claims and reality.

The system aligns perfectly with the Misinformation theme because it:

Identifies and verifies factual accuracy in brand communications.

Uses autonomous AI agents to detect misleading or false representations.

Supports transparency and accountability, empowering consumer authorities to act on reliable AI-generated evidence.

Prevents the spread of deceptive content that manipulates public perception and purchasing behavior.

In essence, Agent Unveil expands the traditional scope of misinformation detection beyond news and social media—into the commercial and consumer space—where misinformation impacts millions of everyday decisions.

**Description of your solution**

**MyFinCoach**

An agentic AI finance coach that can enable not just India's gig and daily wage workers but also ordinary salaried employees, micro business owners, and freelancers to dream, save, and grow with confidence. Although the app's development draws heavily from the specific challenges gig workers confront, the adaptive coaching is offered to anyone who needs personalized, actionable financial advice in an uncertain economic world.

Most fintech apps presume that people are familiar with the fundamentals of budgeting and investing, but many are stuck with unpredictable incomes, variable expenses, or confusion. MyFinCoach begins otherwise—with emotional narratives and empathy. 

E.g. Picture Meera, a delivery partner, going through an interactive simulation of how saving ₹500 every month can add up to ₹2 lakh in 5 years, giving her the confidence to purchase a bike for work. Emotional engagement creates instant trust and incentive.

With the explicit consent of the user, MyFinCoach securely links their financial accounts through India's Account Aggregator (AA) ecosystem through this easy, transparent process:

- User Consent:

 Users are transparently told what information is being gathered, why, and how it is being utilized prior to agreeing.

- Choose FIPs:

 Users select which banks, wallets, or gig platforms (Financial Information Providers) provide data.

- FIU Request:

 MyFinCoach makes requests from these FIPs as the Financial Information User.

- Authentication:

 Users authenticate directly with every FIP using secure, privacy-preserving channels—MyFinCoach never sees passwords.

- Data Access:

 Authorized real-time income, expense, and transaction information flow into MyFinCoach, providing comprehensive financial insight.

This privacy-first, user-centric workflow provides users with complete control while allowing MyFinCoach's autonomous agentic AI to function effectively and continuously.

**How the agentic AI functions:**

It operates 24×7, independently tracking users' income variability, spending spikes, savings progress, and financial goals.

According to each user's degree of financial literacy and emotional maturity, the AI adjusts its teaching style—beginning with easy-to-digest advice for newcomers and progressively providing deeper strategic information for experienced users.

Multi-lingual conversational coaching is employed by the AI to clarify data insights in a gentle, contextual manner to prevent overwhelming users. The AI formulates recommendations as attainable, small steps—growing confidence incrementally instead of pressure.

It forecasts financial pressure or possibility, then actively encourages users with extremely personalized, actionable recommendations. For instance, if rains cut gig earnings but raise costs, MyFinCoach recommends budget adjustments and additional opportunities and lays out the reasoning in plain English. 

The AI continually learns from user behavior, adapting advice such that financial control comes across as the guidance of a familiar friend, rather than a chilly algorithm.

By intertwining emotional connection, safe real-time information, and highly adaptable agentic AI, MyFinCoach redresses difficult financial realities into an individualized odyssey of empowerment and development—for gig workers and beyond.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/f0ba0bc008f74ca189a917c5e987216d/fce21368-bfbf-4346-97f5-1a4c65e21b9f.jpeg)

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

1. Our agentic AI is the product’s core: it passively monitors consented transaction data, learns each user’s irregular income patterns, and autonomously turns insights into one-tap actions (save, insure, delay non-essential spend), so the app delivers real behaviour change without demanding time or financial literacy.

2. That autonomy directly answers the Fintech track’s brief helping people with unstable cashflows take practical steps rather than just view charts, so impact is immediate and measurable (more savings, higher micro-insurance uptake, fewer risky loans).

3. We use India’s Account Aggregator framework for secure, consented data access, which removes onboarding friction and builds trust critical for scaling among low-engagement users.

4. The agent is lightweight and hybrid (on-device personalization with selective cloud augmentation), keeping latency and costs low so the solution is affordable to deploy across millions of low-end devices.

5. The product design is passive-by-default and localized (vernacular nudges, simple action buttons), which raises adoption and retention among gig workers and small business owners who don’t want a finance textbook.

6. Commercially, the freemium + partner distribution (gig platforms, micro-lenders, insurers) path aligns with the track’s goals: broad inclusion first, sustainable monetization second, and measurable KPIs that judges/investors can verify quickly.

7. In short: agentic AI + AA security + low-friction UX = a practical, scalable fintech that turns irregular income into predictable financial behaviour—exactly the kind of solution the Fintech track is designed to reward.

Summary :-

Our agentic AI is the product’s engine: with user consent it quietly learns each person’s irregular income and spending patterns, then autonomously converts those insights into simple, timed actions—“set aside ₹200,” “buy micro-insurance,” or “delay this expense”—so users get real behavior change without extra effort or financial know-how.

That autonomy directly matches the Fintech track’s aim: instead of dashboards, we deliver practical interventions that produce measurable outcomes more savings, higher micro-insurance uptake, and fewer dangerous loans right when they matter.

We integrate with India’s Account Aggregator framework for secure, consented data access, which reduces signup friction and builds trust essential for adoption among low-engagement users.

The agent is lightweight and hybrid: most personalization runs on-device with selective cloud support, keeping latency low and costs predictable so the service is affordable at scale on basic smartphones.

The UX is passive-by-default and local-first: vernacular nudges, one-tap actions, and minimal inputs make the product natural to use for gig workers, freelancers, and small-business owners who don’t want to spend time learning a new app.

Commercially, a freemium core plus partner-led distribution (gig platforms, micro-lenders, insurers) lets us prioritize inclusion while unlocking sustainable monetization, so impact and revenue grow together.

In short: an agentic AI that acts for the user, AA-backed trust, and a low-friction, local UX combine into a practical, scalable fintech solution that fits the Fintech track exactly.

There’s an urgent need for an intelligent system that can sense cognitive overload, adapt in real time, and actively protect mental well-being.*
**NeuroMate** is an  **agentic AI-powered ** well-being companion that learns how your mind works — your focus patterns, stress signals, and daily rhythms — and proactively helps you stay balanced. It continuously *monitors cues from wearable sensors, facial expressions, voice tone, and typing rhythm to estimate your cognitive load*. When signs of mental fatigue appear, NeuroMate doesn’t just suggest — it acts: reschedules low-priority tasks, silences notifications, plays calming audio, or prompts a short mindfulness break. Over time, it evolves into a personalized co-pilot that understands when you need to rest, reflect, or recharge — bringing emotional intelligence and autonomy together.

**Description of your solution**

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/3e4a0ccf9db448859fb06c0a6704e5c1/10ceb233-b5ee-4257-9059-dcede26b15e2.png)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/3e4a0ccf9db448859fb06c0a6704e5c1/5b5dd384-9ae1-49cd-a9a0-ae2f1f3109d8.png)

**AURA (Agentic Underwriting & Risk Assistant)** is an Agentic AI system built to solve India's "Paradox of Access vs. Activation," where **142 million bank accounts** lie dormant and 70% of the population remains "credit-invisible".

Instead of a passive prediction model, AURA is a proactive, **dual-agent ecosystem** that serves both lenders and borrowers:

**Risk-Management Agent (For Lenders):** This AI agent acts as a proactive guardian for the lender's portfolio. It continuously monitors alternative data signals to flag at-risk borrowers before they default. Its core function is to autonomously generate specific, actionable intervention strategies (e.g., "Proactively offer a 7-day payment extension via SMS"), reducing default rates by an estimated 39%.

**Credit-Coach Agent (For Borrowers):** This agent acts as a personal financial mentor for the underbanked. Instead of a simple rejection, the agent provides a personalized **30-day action** plan (e.g., "Pay your utility bill on time for +15% score impact"). This transforms rejection from a dead end into an empowering growth opportunity.

Our solution is built to be **production-ready** by integrating with India's RBI-regulated Account Aggregator (AA) framework for consent-based data sharing. It features a privacy-first architecture using a simulation of Homomorphic Encryption, allowing our Random Forest model to perform inference on encrypted data, ensuring user data is never exposed in plaintext.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/3e4a0ccf9db448859fb06c0a6704e5c1/bab04f77-4b33-4168-8014-5fdaac6307be.png)

Our project, **AURA (Agentic Underwriting & Risk Assistant)**, is a perfect fit for the Fintech track because it fundamentally addresses the sector's most pressing challenges: financial inclusion, efficient credit risk management, and ethical innovation in lending, all powered by Agentic AI.


Here’s how AURA aligns perfectly with the Fintech track:


1. **Revolutionizing Credit Scoring for the Underbanked:**

- Core Fintech Challenge: Traditional credit scoring models are inadequate for assessing the creditworthiness of individuals and small businesses without extensive financial histories, excluding vast segments of the population in emerging markets.

- AURA's Fit: We utilize alternative data sources (telecom usage, digital behavior, utility payments, geospatial data) combined with advanced Machine Learning to accurately assess the credit risk of the credit-invisible population. This directly addresses the described market gap, extending credit to those previously denied.

2. **Driving Financial Inclusion through AI:**

- Core Fintech Mission: To leverage technology to make financial services more accessible and affordable.

- AURA's Fit: Our Credit-Coach Agent provides personalized financial guidance, converting loan rejections into actionable plans for improving creditworthiness. This empowers individuals to enter the formal financial system, actively driving financial inclusion, which is a key objective of modern Fintech.

3. **Advanced Risk Management for Lenders:**

- Core Fintech Pain Point: High default rates, inefficient recovery processes, and inaccurate risk assessment lead to significant losses for financial institutions.

- AURA's Fit: Our Risk-Management Agent actively monitors loan portfolios and uses predictive intelligence to proactively recommend interventions to lenders, aiming to reduce default rates by up to 39%. This sophisticated approach to risk mitigation makes lending to underserved segments viable and profitable.

4. **Leveraging Cutting-Edge Fintech Technologies:**

- Core Fintech Innovation: Embracing new technologies for efficiency, security, and scalability.

- AURA's Fit: We integrate Agentic AI as a core, autonomous decision-making and action-taking system. Furthermore, our focus on privacy-preserving computation (Homomorphic Encryption simulation) and interoperability with the Account Aggregator framework demonstrates an advanced, secure, and scalable approach to data handling—all critical areas of innovation in Fintech.

In essence, AURA isn't just another financial application; it's a transformative Fintech solution that uses Agentic AI to create a more inclusive, efficient, and responsible lending ecosystem for the future.

### SUSpect.AI
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/suspectai-b50e) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-MumbaiHacks%202025%20--%20Round%201%20(Online)-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mumbaihacks25-round1.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> If it’s sus, we’ll call it out

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![spaCy](https://img.shields.io/badge/spaCy-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![BERT](https://img.shields.io/badge/BERT-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

🚨 The Problem

The internet’s wild. Every day you see videos screaming “You won’t believe this!”, thumbnails with 🔥 faces, and titles that sound like a conspiracy theory.
Half the time, it’s pure clickbait — exaggerating or straight-up lying just to grab attention.
What’s worse? Even when you watch the video, it’s hard to tell which claims are facts and which are fluff.

🧩 The Solution

SUSpect.AI is your hype detector.
Drop a YouTube (or any video) link, and we go full detective mode:
🎬 Extract the title, thumbnail, and transcript.
🕵️ Run OCR + ASR + NLP to find bold claims.
🌐 Search the web for legit evidence.
🧮 Use AI models to verify each claim as Supported, Refuted, or Unclear.
📊 Finally, we give you a simple verdict — no cap, just facts.

With a browser badge, dashboard, and feedback loop, NoCap.AI turns the chaos of clickbait into an explainable, trustable report — perfect for creators, educators, or anyone tired of getting baited by “BREAKING NEWS 😱”.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

💡 How SUSpect.AI Tackles Misinformation
1️⃣ It starts before the lie spreads

Most fact-checking happens after a video goes viral.
SUSpect.AI jumps in at the attention stage — scanning thumbnails and titles before viewers even click.
If something screams “OMG SHOCKING TRUTH EXPOSED!! 😱”, we flag it right there.

2️⃣ It doesn’t just look at text — it goes multimodal

We combine what’s seen (thumbnails/keyframes) 👀, heard (audio transcripts) 🎧, and written (titles/descriptions) ✍️.
That means our agent doesn’t get fooled by flashy images or emotional voiceovers — it checks what’s actually being said or shown.

3️⃣ It extracts and checks actual claims, not vibes

SUSpect.AI breaks the video into atomic claims (who said what, about whom, when, where).
Then it hunts down evidence from reliable web sources, fact-checking databases, and visual clues — like an AI Sherlock Holmes 🕵️‍♂️.

4️⃣ It gives explainable verdicts, not black-box scores

For every claim, users see:
✅ Supported
❌ Refuted
❓ Unclear
Along with citations, snippets, and confidence — so users know why something was flagged.
No mystery AI judgments here. Transparency is key 🔍.

5️⃣ It keeps humans in the loop

When the system isn’t 100% sure (like high-risk political or medical topics), it escalates to human reviewers — ensuring accountability and avoiding overreach.

🌍 The Impact

By catching clickbait early, verifying content quickly, and explaining decisions clearly,
SUSpect.AI slows the spread of misinformation right where it starts — in the attention economy.
Fewer rage-clicks. More informed views. Internet, healed (almost). ✨

Team **Neural Sparks** -- [Siddhesh Dhumal](https://github.com/siddhxsh), Tanmay Patil, Devyani Pandey, Bhagyashree Mandal
