### StackAI
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/stackai-254d) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/q_zO9IuQvvs) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack%20This%20Fall%202025%20--%20Milestone%20Edition-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackthisfall.devfolio.co)

> Easy ML Collab

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Golang](https://img.shields.io/badge/Golang-333333?style=flat-square) ![Cobra](https://img.shields.io/badge/Cobra-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Artificial Intelligence development today is heavily centralized and controlled by a small number of large corporations. Access to essential resources such as high-quality datasets, pre-trained models, and compute power is restricted, creating significant barriers for independent developers, startups, and open-source communities.

Current ecosystems are closed and proprietary, limiting transparency in how models are built, trained, and evaluated. Collaboration opportunities are fragmented — while developers can version and manage code using tools like Git, there is no standardized versioning or collaboration system for AI models. This results in:

Slow and siloed innovation

Limited reproducibility and traceability of model changes

Lack of community-driven improvements

Difficulty maintaining model iterations and checkpoints

Absence of open governance and shared model development workflows

The absence of a Git-like platform for model version control and lifecycle management is a major bottleneck for scaling responsible and distributed AI advancement.

**Challenges we ran into**

While developing the core innovation of StackAI — model merging — we encountered significant complexities. AI models are not as straightforward to merge as code branches. Every model contains unique architectures, weight distributions, training datasets, and optimization histories. This introduced several key challenges:

Model Compatibility Issues
Even when two models serve the same task, they may differ in number of layers, neuron alignment, tokenizer settings, or parameter initializations. Ensuring structural compatibility before merging required automated schema analysis and conversion tools.

Performance Degradation Risk
Naively averaging model weights often reduces accuracy instead of improving it. We needed algorithms to selectively merge beneficial parameters while preventing destructive interference.

Hyperparameter & Config Conflicts
Two models come with differing learning rates, batch sizes, loss functions, and optimizer states. Deciding which configurations to preserve — or how to intelligently combine them — demanded a new configuration resolution strategy.

Leveraging Federated Learning Principles
We explored federated averaging and aggregation techniques to combine multiple independently trained models without requiring access to private datasets. But adapting FL for arbitrary AI model repositories required:

custom parameter alignment

dynamic weighting based on evaluation scores

secure aggregation to protect sensitive information

Evaluation & Selection Automation
After merging, testing model performance across diverse benchmarks is computationally heavy. We had to design automatic evaluation pipelines to identify whether the merged model truly gains accuracy or robustness.

Version Traceability
When multiple parent models contribute to a final merged model, lineage must remain transparent. Building a human-readable merge tree with full reproducibility logs was essential.

Team **Smooth Operators** -- [Joyvin Mendonca](https://github.com/Joyvin), [Iqra Khan](https://github.com/iqrakhan4), [Aashish Mhaske](https://github.com/aashish1601)

> focus on speed, simplicity, and privacy,

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenAi](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenAi-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

In a world where AI assistants are becoming essential, most users rely on third-party platforms that:

Store conversations on external servers

Track usage or analytics

Provide limited control over data

Lock users inside their ecosystem

Offer no customization for personal workflows

For developers, students, and everyday users, this creates a challenge:
How can we use powerful AI models while keeping our data private, secure, and fully under our control?

✅ How GPTIKA Solves It

GPTIKA provides a private, self-hosted AI assistant that brings the power of OpenAI models to the user without sacrificing control or privacy.

🔒 1. Full Privacy Control

All requests pass through your own backend.
No third-party dashboards, trackers, or hidden logging.

⚡ 2. Faster & Cleaner Experience

GPTIKA uses a minimal, optimized React frontend + Express backend to deliver:

Instant responses

No UI clutter

Low latency communication

🛠 3. Fully Customizable

You can modify:

Prompts

System instructions

UI elements

APIs

Authentication

Custom tools or workflows

Unlike commercial platforms, you’re free to shape the assistant completely.

🌐 4. Works for Anyone

People can use GPTIKA to:

Chat privately with GPT-4/GPT-3.5

Generate content (essays, code, emails)

Summarize articles

Draft documents

Brainstorm ideas

Automate tasks via custom extensions

Build specialized assistants (coding helper, study buddy, productivity bot)

🔐 5. Secure Environment Variables

API keys remain in .env (never exposed to frontend), ensuring safe usage.

🎯 In Simple Terms

GPTIKA makes AI usage safer, faster, and more personal by giving users complete control over how they interact with GPT models—without depending on external platforms.

**Challenges we ran into**

🧩 Challenges I Ran Into

Building GPTIKA came with a few technical hurdles that helped me learn and improve throughout the process.

1. Securing the API Key Without Exposing It

Initially, my frontend was accidentally making API calls directly to OpenAI, which exposed the API key in the network tab.
This was a major security issue.

How I solved it:
I moved all requests to an Express backend, used environment variables (.env), and created a secure /api/chat route so the key never touches the client.

2. Handling CORS Errors Between Frontend and Backend

The React frontend and Express backend ran on different ports, causing CORS errors and blocking API requests.

Fix:
Configured the cors() middleware properly in Express and added specific allowed origins. Once configured, the communication became smooth.

3. Streaming or Large Responses Breaking the UI

Some GPT responses were long, causing UI flickering or slow rendering.

Fix:
I implemented controlled state updates, added loading states, and optimized the message rendering logic. This made the chat smooth even for large responses.

4. Environment Variable Confusion

Placing .env in the wrong directory initially caused the backend to fail silently because the API key wasn’t loaded.

Fix:
I standardized the project structure, ensured .env was correctly positioned, and used dotenv.config() at the top of the server file.

5. Designing a Clean, Minimal UI

I wanted GPTIKA to feel simple yet polished. Creating a layout that works on all screen sizes while staying minimal was challenging.

Fix:
I iterated on the design using Tailwind CSS, added responsive utility classes, and cleaned up the component structure until the UI felt fast, clean, and lightweight.

🎯 What These Challenges Taught Me

These hurdles helped me understand real-world issues like API security, backend–frontend communication, state management, and clean UI/UX design — all of which strengthened the final version of GPTIKA.

### CHAMELEON COMPRESSOR
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/artizip-cb2d) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/shashwat1237/Chameleon-Generative-Compression-Engine) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/RLAZnwepa5M) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack%20This%20Fall%202025%20--%20Milestone%20Edition-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackthisfall.devfolio.co)

> Adaptive compression powered by AI

![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square) ![Streamlit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Streamlit-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Modern text compression tools like ZIP, GZIP, or BZIP rely purely on byte-level repetition.
They don’t understand the meaning or structure of language, so they hit a natural limit when compressing text-heavy datasets such as logs, reports, transcripts, documentation, or scraped web content.

As models and applications generate more textual data than ever, this limitation becomes a bottleneck:

Storage costs increase

Transfer times slow down

Archival pipelines grow inefficient

Large text corpora become expensive to move and back up

At the same time, developers need guaranteed lossless recovery — even a single character mismatch can corrupt downstream processing or invalidate data.

CHAMELEON solves this problem by using a generative AI model (GPT-2) to guide the compression process.
Instead of compressing raw bytes, it uses the model’s knowledge of language to predict token probabilities and encode text more efficiently.

This delivers:

Smarter, semantic-aware compression

Lossless reconstruction using the exact same model

A deterministic, binary-safe .bin format

Clear compression statistics for transparency

In short:
CHAMELEON brings model-aware, language-informed compression to real workflows — improving storage efficiency, speeding up transfers, and enabling AI-driven data pipelines.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building a generative-AI-driven lossless compressor came with several difficult and very technical challenges. Some of the biggest hurdles were:

1. Binary corruption during decompression

Early versions of the compressor produced .bin files that were too short or structurally incomplete, causing errors like:

struct.error: unpack requires a buffer of 4 bytes


This happened because the encoder sometimes produced an incomplete bit-stream.
I fixed it by adding:

strict validation checks (minimum 8 bytes)

safer bit-packing

clear separation between text bytes and raw binary bytes

binary-safe read/write logic

This completely eliminated corrupted output files.

2. Arithmetic coder desynchronization

Arithmetic coding is extremely sensitive — one mismatched update and the entire file becomes undecodable.

I repeatedly hit issues where the decoder and encoder diverged due to:

off-by-one cumulative frequency errors

token IDs exceeding frequency table size

precision overflow during interval renormalization

I fixed this by:

enforcing 64-bit precision

clamping token IDs

fully mirroring the encoder’s update logic

resetting GPT-2 past-key-values every 1024 tokens to prevent state drift

Once both sides were perfectly symmetric, decompression became fully lossless.

3. GPT-2 determinism problems

Generative models can introduce slight randomness unless everything is perfectly controlled.

If even one logits call differs between compression and decompression, the entire file becomes unrecoverable.

I solved this by ensuring:

deterministic inference (no dropout, no sampling)

fixed model, same tokenizer

identical start token on both encode/decode

disabling GPU-driven nondeterministic ops where needed

This guaranteed that probability distributions matched exactly.

4. Handling both text and binary uploads in Streamlit

Streamlit treats everything as text by default.
I had to redesign the upload logic so:

text files decode as UTF-8

.bin files stay raw (not auto-decoded)

pasted text takes priority over uploaded files

errors are shown cleanly

This made the UI reliable for real users.

5. Removing Fast Demo safely without breaking anything

The original app included a “Fast Demo” mode that used gzip internally.
This created conflicts, because .bin files produced by it were not compatible with the real generative compression format.

Removing it required:

deleting all fast-demo logic

removing UI options

adjusting the conditional logic

cleaning old code paths

ensuring nothing else depended on it

After cleanup, the entire app became simpler, safer, and 100% generative-based.

6. Performance challenges

GPT-2 compression is naturally slow. Running it token-by-token required:

caching past key values

careful device placement

providing users with progress bars, speed indicators, and status messages

offering GPU toggle options

This made the experience smooth despite the heavy model.

✅ Outcome

Each hurdle taught me more about:

low-level probability coding

binary-safe file formats

deterministic model inference

robust UI design

production-safe streamlit engineering

And overcoming these challenges led to a fully functional, fully lossless, AI-driven compression engine.

**Best Use of GitHub**

This project was fully developed, versioned, and managed using GitHub.
All source code — including the GPT-2 compression engine, arithmetic coder, Streamlit UI, and file comparator — is stored in a public GitHub repository.

GitHub played a central role in:

Managing multiple iterations of the compression engine

Tracking and resolving bugs through commits and diffs

Hosting the complete codebase for judges and collaborators

Providing a clean, structured, and open-source foundation for continued development

The project’s workflow depended entirely on GitHub for code organization, reproducibility, and collaboration, making it a strong fit for the GitHub partner track.

> saving and serving  for people

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB Atlas](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB%20Atlas-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![React Native, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB Atlas, OpenCV, MediaPipe, Python ML Models, WebSockets (Socket.io), Google Maps API, JWT Auth, Render/AWS Cloud, GitHub, Figma](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Native,%20Node.js,%20Express.js,%20MongoDB%20Atlas,%20OpenCV,%20MediaPipe,%20Python%20ML%20Models,%20WebSockets%20(Socket.io),%20Google%20Maps%20API,%20JWT%20Auth,%20Render/AWS%20Cloud,%20GitHub,%20Figma-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

During a medical emergency, every second matters — yet today’s ambulance and hospital systems still work in disconnected pieces. Patients struggle to book ambulances quickly, hospitals often receive incomplete information, and drivers lack optimized routes. This leads to delays, miscommunication, and unprepared emergency rooms.

Rakshak solves this by creating a single connected ecosystem between users, ambulances, and hospitals.

What People Can Use It For

Book the nearest ambulance instantly without calling multiple numbers.

Track ambulance arrival in real time with live ETA.

Send automatic patient details to the hospital through AI analysis (temperature, movement, distress level).

Allow hospitals to prepare early, reducing waiting time and speeding up treatment.

Give drivers an optimized route to reach the hospital faster, even in heavy traffic.

Manage hospital availability like beds, ICU rooms, and emergency capacity.

How It Makes Things Easier & Safer

Eliminates delays caused by manual calling or searching for available ambulances.

Reduces hospital unpreparedness by sending a preliminary AI-generated condition report before arrival.

Ensures patients reach the hospital via the fastest route, saving critical minutes.

Prevents overcrowding by directing ambulances only to hospitals that have capacity.

Enables smoother communication among all parties during high-stress situations.

Rakshak turns an unorganized, stressful emergency experience into a coordinated, life-saving workflow — improving speed, safety, and survival chances.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building Rakshak required connecting multiple complex systems — AI, mobile apps, routing, and hospital dashboards — and that came with several real challenges.

1. Real-Time Sync Between Users, Ambulances & Hospitals

Handling live updates for three different roles was difficult.
Messages were arriving out of order, and sometimes the hospital dashboard didn’t refresh instantly.
Solution: I implemented WebSockets with event-based architecture and added throttling + state caching to keep everything stable.

2. AI Vision in a Moving Ambulance

The OpenCV model struggled when the ambulance was moving, shaking, or had low light.
Solution: I introduced frame smoothing, brightness normalization, and confidence thresholds to make detection more reliable.

3. Route Optimization and Live Traffic Integration

At first, the driver map lagged and gave inconsistent ETAs.
Solution: I switched to a more optimized API call pattern, reduced map re-renders, and cached route segments.

4. Designing a Stress-Friendly UI

Emergency apps must be simple, fast, and distraction-free — but my early versions were crowded.
Solution: I redesigned the flow with fewer steps, big buttons, and clean screens that users can operate even under pressure.

5. Managing Hospital Data in Real Time

Hospital availability kept going out of sync when multiple updates happened at once.
Solution: I added role-based access and atomic updates in the backend to ensure accurate live data.

6. Deployment Issues

During deployment, some AI libraries and server dependencies caused errors.
Solution: I created a clean environment, used compatible versions, and added a Docker-like predictable setup.

**Best Use of GitHub**

GitHub played a central role in building Rakshak, both in development and collaboration. The project includes multiple interconnected components — the user app, driver app, hospital dashboard, backend server, and AI models — and GitHub allowed me to manage all of them efficiently.

Why This Project Matches the GitHub Track

Multi-Module Version Control
Rakshak consists of several codebases:

React Native mobile app

Node.js + Express backend

AI vision models (OpenCV, MediaPipe)

Real-time WebSocket services

GitHub helped maintain these modules cleanly with structured commits and branches.

Collaboration & CI/CD
GitHub Actions was used for continuous integration, automated testing, and deployment workflows.
This ensured every update to the backend or app was stable and instantly deployable.

Issue Tracking & Project Management
I used GitHub Issues and Projects to track bugs, feature requests, and development tasks.
This kept the complex build organized and easy to manage.

Open Source Mindset
Rakshak is built in a way that can be extended and improved by others. GitHub allows:

Code transparency

Community contributions

Future optimization or plugins

Documentation & Code Quality
Readme files, API documentation, and architecture notes were all maintained on GitHub, making the project understandable for reviewers and collaborators.

> Reducing cost and time by 12x in Logistics

![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![NumPy](https://img.shields.io/badge/NumPy-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![PyCharm](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyCharm-333333?style=flat-square) ![AWS](https://img.shields.io/badge/AWS-333333?style=flat-square) ![DynamoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/DynamoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Supply chain teams often struggle with unpredictable demand, unreliable suppliers, and unexpected shipment delays. Most small and mid sized companies still rely on manual spreadsheets, late reporting, and guess-based planning, which leads to:

Stockouts that stop production

Overstocking that wastes money

Late shipments with no prior warning

Poor visibility across suppliers and warehouses

Hours spent creating reports manually

These issues make supply chains slow, risky, and expensive to operate.

 What People Can Use It For / How It Helps

This AI-powered dashboard helps teams predict, monitor, and optimize their supply chain in real time.

 Predict issues before they happen

Forecast inventory demand

Detect unreliable suppliers

Predict shipment delays
This helps businesses act early and avoid disruptions.

 Get all insights in a single dashboard

Track inventory levels

Monitor supplier performance

Watch shipments and ETA updates
No more switching between tools or checking 5 different sheets.

Generate reports instantly

One-click downloadable PDF

Professionally formatted insights

Saves hours of manual work

Make operations safer and more efficient

Early warnings reduce risk of shortages

Reliable data reduces human error

Better visibility improves team coordination

**Challenges we ran into**

During development, I ran into several challenges, including model incompatibility issues where .pkl files wouldn’t load, CORS errors blocking frontend–backend communication, and bugs in PDF layout that caused overlapping text. I also struggled with file path inconsistencies on Windows and a deployment issue where AWS Elastic Beanstalk couldn’t start the FastAPI backend until I added the correct Procfile. I resolved these problems by retraining models with matching library versions, adding proper CORS middleware, fixing PDF formatting, using stable relative paths, and configuring Gunicorn + Uvicorn for smooth deployment.

**AWS Prize Track**

This project maps naturally onto AWS because every part of the system—machine-learning predictions, API handling, real-time dashboard data, and report generation—can be powered efficiently using AWS services. The FastAPI backend can be deployed on AWS Elastic Beanstalk or EC2, which automatically runs the API with high availability and handles scaling as traffic increases. The machine-learning models (supplier reliability, inventory forecasting, shipment delay prediction) can be stored and loaded from Amazon S3, making the backend lightweight and improving portability. For more advanced scaling, the models could also be hosted on SageMaker endpoints.

The dashboard frontend can be easily deployed using AWS Amplify Hosting or S3 + CloudFront for fast, global content delivery. If the system ever needs real-time updates or scheduled forecasting, AWS services like Lambda and EventBridge can automate model retraining, daily predictions, or periodic data ingestion. Logs, errors, and performance metrics are tracked with CloudWatch, making monitoring simple.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Natural language processing (NLP)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Natural%20language%20processing%20(NLP)-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![DBMS](https://img.shields.io/badge/DBMS-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

# Sahayak: Educational Video Revolution in 100 Words

## The Problem It Solves

Sahayak solves the critical challenge of creating educational videos at scale for 260 million Indian students. Traditional video production is prohibitively expensive and time-consuming, while existing AI solutions like Google Veo 3 lack educational focus and remain costly.

## How People Can Use It

Educators can instantly generate curriculum-aligned videos on any topic through our API. Sahayak creates videos by:
- Generating sequential image frames with educational accuracy
- Creating synchronized audio narration
- Assembling a complete video in under 60 seconds
- Reducing costs by 95% compared to manual production

This transforms educational content creation from weeks to seconds.

**Challenges we ran into**

# Challenges I Ran Into

The most significant hurdle was implementing audio synchronization in our video generation pipeline. Initially, videos were created without sound despite FFmpeg commands appearing correct. Investigation revealed two critical issues: insufficient audio normalization and incorrect audio stream mapping.

After extensive debugging, I discovered the solution required:
- Adding explicit volume boosting (`-af volume=4.0`) 
- Implementing proper audio normalization (`loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11`)
- Creating enhanced FFmpeg commands for video assembly

The breakthrough came by developing a comprehensive audio diagnostic tool that analyzed generated videos and fixed existing assets, ensuring perfect synchronization between educational visuals and narration.

![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Data Science](https://img.shields.io/badge/Data%20Science-333333?style=flat-square) ![Computer Vision](https://img.shields.io/badge/Computer%20Vision-333333?style=flat-square) ![Image Processing - Open CV](https://img.shields.io/badge/Image%20Processing%20--%20Open%20CV-333333?style=flat-square) ![Streamlit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Streamlit-333333?style=flat-square) ![yolo v8](https://img.shields.io/badge/yolo%20v8-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

In an era of increasing public safety concerns, traditional surveillance systems face critical limitations in proactively identifying potential threats. Current CCTV infrastructure primarily serves as passive recording devices, requiring human operators to manually monitor countless hours of footage, leading to delayed response times and missed threats. The system addresses the urgent need for real-time weapon detection and suspicious behavior analysis by leveraging artificial intelligence to automatically identify firearms, knives, and other dangerous objects in live video feeds. By integrating emotion recognition and behavioral analysis, it provides early warning capabilities that enable law enforcement to respond proactively rather than reactively, potentially preventing violent incidents before they escalate and creating safer public environments through intelligent, automated vigilance

**Challenges we ran into**

When we started this project, our biggest reality check was realizing we had virtually NO usable data. We thought we could just download a dataset and start building, but we quickly discovered that public weapon detection datasets were either: too small, poorly labeled, or completely unrealistic for real surveillance scenarios.

**Description of your solution**

# AI-Powered Medical Administrative Assistant for Doctors
## Problem Statement

Healthcare professionals, especially doctors, face a **growing administrative burden** that consumes valuable time and reduces the quality and quantity of patient interactions. To understand these challenges in the Indian context, a detailed survey was conducted (survey results in linked ppt) in collaboration with the Indian Medical Association (IMA). The responses revealed that doctors spend a **significant portion of their daily schedule** performing repetitive clerical tasks rather than clinical duties.

---

## Key Findings from the Survey

1.  **Prescription Writing**
    The most frequently mentioned pain point was manual prescription writing. Doctors reported that writing prescriptions often similar and repetitive takes substantial time. They expressed the need for:
    * Automation of spoken prescription writing and digital generation.
    * Individualized prescription templates for recurring cases.
    * Instant printing and integration with hospital systems.

2.  **Patient Records & History Management**
    A large number of respondents highlighted difficulties in updating, maintaining, and retrieving patient histories, as well as extracting past records during consultations.

3.  **Administrative and Registration Tasks**
    Routine administrative duties were identified as major bottlenecks, including registration, appointment scheduling, billing, insurance claim documentation, and discharge processes.

4.  **Patient Communication & Counseling**
    Doctors often repeat the same health instructions, follow-up guidance, and counseling sessions with multiple patients daily. Automation can help communicate routine post-consultation instructions and reminders.

5.  **Other Repetitive Tasks**
    Challenges like reminders for periodic check-ups, updating past medical history through short commands, and booking laboratory consultations were also mentioned.

---

## What Doctors Expect from AI

Doctors strongly support the adoption of AI to automate clerical and repetitive work, provided the system is accurate, intuitive, and easy to use. The key expectations are:
* Automation of clerical work like data entry and record updates.
* Real-time prescription generation with dosage, follow-up dates, and instructions.
* Quick patient history retrieval through name-based or voice search.
* Voice command interface with multilingual support.
* Automated reminders for follow-ups and appointments.
* Error checking and consistency validation in records.

---

## Proposed Solution

The proposed solution is an **AI-powered administrative automation system** that reduces the non-clinical workload of doctors by handling repetitive administrative and clerical tasks. Built with real-world feedback from practicing doctors, the system aims for immediate applicability in medical settings.

1.  **AI-Powered Medical Scribe**
    During patient consultations, the AI listens to doctor-patient interactions in real time through a Speech-to-Text (ASR) engine. Medical NLP models extract key medical data such as symptoms, diagnosis, and prescriptions, automatically drafting structured notes and prescriptions for doctor review.

2.  **Multilingual Voice Understanding**
    The system supports India's linguistic diversity, enabling speech recognition in multiple regional languages for better adoption.

3.  **Central Doctor Dashboard**
    A cloud-based dashboard provides doctors with tools for patient record management, prescription tracking, billing, insurance claim automation, and notifications.

4.  **Patient Mobile Integration**
    Patients access their prescriptions, records, and reminders through a mobile app or WhatsApp bot, promoting better engagement and care continuity.

5.  **End-to-End Workflow Automation**
    The AI automates the entire journey: registration, consultation, billing, discharge, and aftercare ensuring seamless and accurate operations.

---

## Key Benefits

**For Doctors:**
* Up to **70% reduction in administrative workload**.
* More time for patient interaction and diagnosis.
* Increased documentation accuracy.
* Voice-based, hands-free operation.

**For Patients:**
* Faster consultations and reduced waiting time.
* Easy access to digital records.
* Automated reminders for medication and follow-ups.

**For Hospitals/Clinics:**
* Improved operational efficiency.
* Enhanced patient satisfaction.
* Simplified insurance and billing workflows.

---

## Real-World Impact

This solution is designed for **immediate deployment** in Indian healthcare environments. By directly addressing doctors’ pain points identified through the IMA survey, it ensures high adoption, minimal training needs, and tangible time and cost savings. It represents a major step toward **AI-assisted healthcare operations**, ensuring doctors spend less time typing and more time caring for patients.

---

This project is the perfect fit for this track. Not only have we consulted 70+ real doctors while making it we have also seen the patient side of things. We not only make the doctors workflows more streamlined and productive but managing all their admin tasks for them. 
We help out in the patient side of things by managing a dashboard for reminders, patient files, test results etc so that the doctors and patients do no need to look everywhere for a single report.

**Description of your solution**

***FundNexus*** is an intelligent financial advisory platform that seeks to democratize access to personalized financial advice through artificial intelligence and machine learning. The platform fills the crucial space between professional financial advisory services and individual personal financial management needs by providing real-time data-driven advice that was previously available to **high-net-worth clients through expensive financial advisors**.

The major role of FundNexus is to offer users rich financial insight by examining their **cost habits, investment trends, and financial objectives in order to offer actionable ad**. In comparison to conventional personal financial software, which will only monitor spending or show account balances, FundNexus **learns users' habits and financial conditions** in order to give forward-looking information regarding potential financial situations, risk forecasts, and optimization techniques for wealth maximization.

The AI module is developed using TensorFlow.js to execute client-side and server-side machine learning inference, enabling the platform to execute complex financial calculations and provide instant feedback to users.
The platform's AI-driven suggestions allow users to **avoid common financial follies, optimize savings and investment strategies**, and make savvy decisions on large financial commitments such as home purchasing, education investment, and retirement planning.

**TECHNICAL ARCHITECTURE**
The frontend is built with **Next.js 15.3.3, React 18, and TypeScript** to offer a robust, type-safe UI for reliability and ease of maintenance, styling by Tailwind CSS for rapid development and consistent design patterns. State management is offered through **React's Context API** and custom hooks to maintain predictable state updates and best re-rendering throughout the application.
The backend is developed using **Node.js with TypeScript**, offering a server environment capable of supporting multiple users at once and intricate financial calculations. The main database is **Firebase Firestore**, offering real-time sync functionality that keeps users aware of their up-to-date financial information. **Firebase Auth paired with Google OAuth** is utilized as the authentication system.

The machine learning pipeline forms the core of FundNexus's smarts, with TensorFlow 2.15 and Keras 3.x used for model inference and training. The system is also capable of supporting a range of neural network architectures such as LSTM networks for financial time-series analysis, transformer models for detecting intricate patterns, and hybrid models that take advantage of the strengths of different architectures.
Data processing is accomplished using Pandas and NumPy, enabling simple manipulation of large financial data sets and real-time calculation of financial metrics.

**To-Do Implementation**
We have aimed to transform our FundNexus's main strategy to be a RAG model for financial engagement, delivering personalized counsel via a knowledge base of **user financial history, transactions, and goals**. Upload documents—**bank statements, portfolios, tax returns, insurance, loans**—for OCR and NLP-driven extraction into a user-specific repository. Deep analysis decodes contracts, prospectuses, regulations, uncovering fees, taxation, and optimization like a personal analyst. Vector embeddings detect patterns, linking data for strategies like salary deferrals, tax savings. Tailored plans offer debt consolidation, investment rebalancing, tax optimization from documents and goals. Supports complex queries, e.g., refinancing impacts. Ensures encrypted security, federated learning, granular control. Integrates real-time market data, evolving into a dynamic financial intelligence platform.

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

Our platform specifically addresses the needs of everyday citizens by democratizing access to sophisticated financial advice. Its core innovation, a planned Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system, will allow the AI to analyze users' personal financial documents—such as bank statements, tax returns, and loan agreements. This enables the agent to provide highly contextual and adaptive coaching that is grounded in the user's actual financial reality, making it ideal for managing the income variability common to gig workers and informal sector employees.

**Description of your solution**

**Take2Edge – Tackling Misinformation with Offline Agentic AI**

Our solution, **Take2Edge**, is an **AI-powered speech-to-speech (STS)** assistant built to **run fully offline on low-compute devices**, enabling **secure, private, and cost-effective deployment without cloud reliance.**

In the context of misinformation, **Take2Edge acts as a fact-grounded conversational agent.** By combining **speech-to-text, reasoning with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG),** and **natural voice synthesis**, the system can **listen, verify, and respond** to spoken or written claims in **real time**—even in settings with **no internet access.**

****Core Technology:****
- **STT (Speech-to-Text):** Whisper for low-latency, accurate transcription.
- **LLM Core (Reasoning + RAG):** Quantized LLaMA 3.2 3B model (~1.9 GB, Q4_K_M) using llama.cpp for contextual, knowledge-grounded responses.
- **TTS (Text-to-Speech):** OpenVoice for natural, human-like speech output.

****Why This Matters for Misinformation:****
- **Offline Verification:** Communities without reliable internet can still access fact-checking and trusted knowledge.
- **Contextual Explanations:** The agent doesn’t just label something as “true/false” but explains reasoning based on trusted datasets.
- **Customizable Knowledge Bases:** Organizations can embed their own verified corpora, tailoring the AI to fight misinformation in local or domain-specific contexts.
- **Resilience:** Works in crisis/emergency scenarios where connectivity is disrupted—precisely where misinformation spreads fastest.

****Key Use Cases in Misinformation Control:****
- **Cybersecurity Awareness Agents** – combat phishing and digital misinformation.
- **Hospital Emergency Assistants** – provide accurate, calming information during critical care.
- **Telecaller / Call Center Agents** – deliver verified responses instead of scripted, error-prone answers.
- **Lead Generation for SMEs** – ensure small businesses provide factually correct information to customers.


**👉 Why it matters:** Take2Edge **democratizes AI-driven misinformation defense** by **putting truthful, explainable, and agentic AI assistants** into the hands of businesses, hospitals, and communities—**without expensive cloud infrastructure.**

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Our project directly addresses **misinformation** by grounding **AI responses in verified documents through RAG** (retrieval augmented generation). Unlike generic chatbots that often hallucinate, our system always cites indexed content, ensuring accuracy and traceability.

The **agentic AI** layer comes through our **Speech-to-Speech Call Assistant**, which can autonomously handle **calls**, provide **contextual information**, and **respond in real-time.** This enables proactive fact-checking, misinformation correction, and guided support in high-risk domains (customer support, community info, SME operations).

Because the system is **lightweight, offline, and CPU-only**, it can be **deployed at scale without cloud dependency.** This makes it a **trustworthy, private, and low-cost solution**, especially for regions where misinformation spreads fastest and **infrastructure is limited.**

In short:

- ****Misinformation**** → prevented with RAG + trusted sources.
- ****Agentic AI**** → embodied in an autonomous, real-time STS assistant.
- ****Impact**** → democratizes reliable AI, empowering SMEs and individuals to combat misinformation at scale.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Computer Vision](https://img.shields.io/badge/Computer%20Vision-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

Every day in India, **thousands of patients** wait anxiously for **X-ray results** that could save their lives. But with only **10,000 radiologists** serving **1.5 billion people** and analyzing over **4 million scans** daily, the diagnostic system is breaking under pressure. Each radiologist analyzes **hundreds of X-rays** daily, leading to **fatigue, delayed reporting, and inconsistencies in diagnosis**. Patients often wait days for results, and even after receiving reports, many struggle to understand **complex medical language**. The result is a **broken diagnostic chain — slow, stressful, and inaccessible**.
**Radiologist’s Copilot** aims to transform this reality. It is an **Agentic AI-powered** platform that acts as a **team of intelligent digital coworkers** assisting radiologists in every step of the diagnostic workflow. With a single command — such as “Analyze this X-ray and generate a report” — the system activates multiple specialized AI agents that work together autonomously. The **Image Analysis Agent** detects and highlights abnormalities using advanced models like **CheXNet**. The **Report Generation & Validation Agent** (powered by **BioMedCLIP and MedGemma**) creates a clinically sound draft report with confidence scoring and automatic formatting. The **NER Agent** extracts and structures medical entities such as diseases, anatomical regions, and severity for precise record-keeping. A **Smart Task Routing Agent** ensures efficient workload distribution, while **Patient Management** and **X-ray Comparison** Agents store patient history and track disease progression. Finally, a **Chatbot Agent** explains the finalized report to patients in simple, understandable language — bridging the **communication gap between doctor and patient.**

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/395ce73cf0734c10909ceb8ef1af2d0b/7a76dfdb-3664-49ae-b8ae-d25f55c1774c.png)

Built using**LangGraph** for orchestrating multi-agent workflows, the platform functions like a **digital radiology team**, working under the radiologist’s supervision. It integrates seamlessly into existing hospital systems, supports standard image formats (JPEG/DICOM), and ensures a **human-in-the-loop approach** for safety and accuracy.

The **impact** is immediate and measurable:

- Significant reduction in report **turnaround time**.

- **Higher diagnostic consistency** and fewer manual errors.

- Improved **patient understanding** and trust through explainable AI communication.

- **Data-backed insights** through structured historical records and progression tracking.

From a business standpoint, **Radiologist’s Copilot** can be deployed as a **B2B SaaS platform** for diagnostic centers and hospitals, or integrated via **API** into existing medical record systems. It scales efficiently, requiring minimal infrastructure and easily **extending to pathology, CT scans, and MRI imaging** — enabling healthcare providers to standardize and automate diagnostics across departments.

In essence, **Radiologist’s Copilot** reimagines diagnostic medicine by merging **human expertise with Agentic AI autonomy**. It doesn’t replace the radiologist — it empowers them, reduces fatigue, and delivers faster, clearer, and more compassionate healthcare to millions.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Radiologist’s Copilot perfectly aligns with the HealthTech track as it directly addresses one of healthcare’s most critical and scalable challenges — the radiologist shortage and diagnostic backlog that impact millions of patients every year. In India and across much of the developing world, hospitals are overwhelmed with imaging studies but lack sufficient specialists to interpret them quickly and consistently. This leads to cascading delays in diagnosis, overworked doctors, and frustrated patients — a serious healthcare bottleneck that directly affects treatment outcomes.
Our solution leverages Agentic AI to transform this process into a seamless, human-AI collaboration. Instead of being a single monolithic model, the system is composed of multiple autonomous agents that act as intelligent digital coworkers under the radiologist’s supervision. Each agent — from image analysis and report generation to patient management and X-ray comparison — performs its task independently, communicates with others through a coordinated workflow (using LangGraph), and delivers complete, validated diagnostic reports within minutes.
Unlike traditional AI systems that simply automate predefined tasks, Radiologist’s Copilot demonstrates genuine agentic intelligence. Each agent operates with autonomy, selecting the most efficient workflow based on the image type, query, and case priority. The system applies reasoning through validation logic that cross-checks AI-generated findings against established clinical norms, ensuring accuracy and safety. It exhibits purposeful tool use, dynamically invoking specialized models, DICOM parsers, and medical databases as needed. Through collaboration, the Smart Task Routing Agent coordinates efforts among agents and radiologists, distributing cases based on urgency, complexity, and workload. Over time, the system displays adaptability, learning continuously from radiologist feedback to improve confidence scores, efficiency, and performance.
This approach fits the HealthTech + Agentic AI theme perfectly — it doesn’t just automate healthcare tasks but introduces intelligent, decision-making agents capable of acting, reasoning, and adapting based on context. Scalable across hospitals and easily adaptable to pathology, CT, and MRI, Radiologist’s Copilot represents the next generation of agentic healthcare innovation — where AI doesn’t replace doctors, but empowers them. By automating the mundane and amplifying human expertise, it enables radiologists to focus on critical cases, ensures patients receive faster and more accurate diagnoses, and brings healthcare closer to being both cutting-edge and profoundly human.

**Idea**
RegTech Copilot is a browser-based AI assistant that helps MSMEs and student startups in India stay compliant with government regulations. Users can simply upload official circulars (GST, RBI, SEBI, etc.) into the web app, and within seconds, the system translates dense legal language into clear, actionable tasks — all accessible directly from a laptop or phone browser.

**How It Works (Web Flow)**

1. Upload a Circular (PDF/Scan)
   - One-Click Actions

2. AI Processing
   - Backend extracts text (using PyMuPDF / OCR for scans).
   - LLM interprets rules and deadlines, cross-checks dates and fines with regex validators.

3. Simplified Output in the Browser
   - Dashboard shows a summary in plain English/Hinglish.
   - Action checklist (≤3 items) with due dates, clause excerpts, and confidence levels.

4. One-Click Actions
   - ✅ Mark as done
   - 📅 Add to Google Calendar (via API)
   - 📨 Draft an email/form (stretch goal)

**Why Web Application?**
   - Accessibility: No install required, works on any device with a browser.

   - Judge-Friendly: Hackathon demo runs instantly in Chrome — upload → get tasks → show calendar event.

   - Integrations: Easy connection with Google Calendar API, cloud storage, and notifications.

   - Scalability: From prototype to production, the same web stack can scale for thousands of MSMEs.

**Tech Stack (Web-Oriented)**
   - Frontend: React + Tailwind for clean, fast UI.
   - Backend: FastAPI (Python) for PDF parsing + AI pipeline.
   - LLM: GPT-4 via LangChain prompt orchestration.
   - Database: Postgres.
   - Storage: Local file storage (demo) → S3 in production.
   - Calendar: Google Calendar API integration.

**Description of your solution**

HospIntel is an Agentic AI-powered hospital management system designed to help Indian healthcare centers proactively prepare for unpredictable patient surges during festivals, pollution spikes, and epidemics.

Unlike existing systems that are reactive, HospIntel  brings a proactive, multi-agent approach:

A Data Ingestion Agent continuously collects information from air quality monitors, weather forecasts, festival calendars, government health advisories, and historical patient admission data.

A Prediction Agent applies AI forecasting to anticipate the number and type of cases hospitals are likely to face in the coming days (e.g., respiratory issues during smog, burn injuries during Diwali).

An Optimization Agent recommends the best staffing schedules, shifts, and medical supply orders (oxygen, medicines, ICU beds) to ensure hospitals don’t run short during peak demand.

An Advisory Agent communicates localized health alerts directly to patients and citizens in multiple languages via SMS/WhatsApp, encouraging preventive care and reducing unnecessary hospital visits.


By combining these AI agents, HospIntel transforms hospitals from reactive crisis responders into proactive planners, helping reduce overcrowding, optimize resources, lower wait times, and ultimately save lives before the emergency begins.

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

💬 Project Description

Every Diwali, India lights up — but inside hospitals, the lights burn for a different reason.
During major festivals like Diwali, Holi, and Ganesh Chaturthi, as well as pollution spikes and epidemic seasons, hospital admissions in Indian cities can surge by 40–60%, overwhelming healthcare workers and resources.
Doctors stretch double shifts, small clinics run out of supplies, and patients wait for hours — not because the system doesn’t care, but because it can’t see it coming.

That’s the challenge of Predictive Hospital Management in India — and it’s exactly what we set out to solve.

Introducing Swasthya Sentinel — an Agentic AI-powered hospital management network that helps healthcare centers predict surges, plan proactively, and collaborate effectively during high-demand periods.

⚙️ How Our Solution is Different

We didn’t just build another hospital dashboard — we built an agentic AI ecosystem that learns, reasons, and acts across India’s healthcare network.

Agentic Intelligence — Each hospital hosts a local orchestrator composed of AI agents for staffing, supply management, patient routing, and advisory generation. These agents use frameworks like LangChain and AutoGen to reason and communicate autonomously.

Central–Local Coordination — A regional orchestrator connects hospitals, enabling real-time collaboration during surges caused by festivals, pollution peaks, or epidemics.

Predictive Foresight — The system analyzes live and historical data from festival calendars, pollution/weather APIs, and EHRs to forecast patient load and resource needs with confidence scoring.

Proactive Action Loop — Before a surge hits, the system triggers early alerts, optimizes staff scheduling, automates supply chain restocking, and guides patients to less crowded hospitals.

Multilingual Voice & SMS Agent — Delivers localized patient advisories in regional languages through WhatsApp, SMS, or voice — ensuring accessibility across India.

Explainable & Trustworthy AI — Every prediction and recommendation includes transparent reasoning (via SHAP/LIME) to build trust with doctors and administrators.

Rural-Ready Resilience — Operates reliably even during low connectivity or power outages with offline caching and decentralized learning.

🌍 Impact

By integrating predictive intelligence into hospital operations, Swasthya Sentinel enables Indian healthcare centers to:

Reduce patient waiting times by up to 35%,

Prevent supply and staff shortages during surges,

Deliver timely, multilingual advisories to millions,

Empower rural and semi-urban hospitals with real-time preparedness tools.

In short — Swasthya Sentinel turns India’s healthcare from reactive to proactive, building a more resilient, collaborative, and human-centered system ready for every festival, pollution spike, or epidemic.

**Description of your solution**

In today’s digital world, misinformation is everywhere. It’s no longer just fake news—it includes deepfakes, AI-generated images and videos, misleading statistics, staged photos, and fake social media accounts. This makes it incredibly hard for people to know what’s real and what’s not.

TruthLens is an autonomous AI-powered platform that helps users see the truth in real-time. It scans content across multiple formats—text, images, videos, and social media profiles—and identifies misleading or fake information. Using advanced AI techniques, it not only detects fake content but also explains why it may be false, provides trustworthy sources, and learns from user interactions to continuously improve its detection capabilities.

For example, if someone shares a suspicious video or post, TruthLens can highlight manipulated parts, flag AI-generated content, or warn if a social profile is likely fake. It also provides a dashboard to visualize trends in misinformation, helping users and organizations stay aware of what’s spreading online.

The system is designed to be proactive, adaptive, and easy to use. Through its browser extension or mobile app, users get real-time alerts without needing to dig through endless sources. By combining text analysis, computer vision, social media scanning, and autonomous learning, TruthLens empowers people to make informed decisions and see the digital world more clearly.

**Description of your solution**

**Quantum Veil: Autonomous Financial Intelligence 🛡️**


The Quantum Veil is a revolutionary multi-agent AI platform designed to provide proactive, hyper-personalized financial coaching while simultaneously establishing the highest standard of future-proof data security in the finance sector. It specifically targets the complex financial challenges faced by individuals with highly variable incomes, such such as gig workers and informal sector employees.

**Problem Statement**

Current financial solutions are fundamentally flawed for two reasons:

   **Lack of Adaptability**  : They rely on rigid, retrospective budgeting (e.g., tracking last month's spending) that fails to account for the unpredictable cash flow and income variability of the gig economy. Users are constantly reacting to their finances instead of planning proactively.

  **Imminent Security Threat**  : Sensitive financial data (transactions, account details, PII) is currently secured by classical cryptography (RSA, ECC) that is known to be vulnerable to powerful, forthcoming quantum computers. This poses an existential "Harvest Now, Decrypt Later" threat to financial privacy.

**Proposed Solution** : The Quantum Veil Architecture

The  **Quantum Veil**  is built on a dual-pillar architecture, ensuring both maximum intelligence and maximum security:

**Pillar 1: The Agentic Intelligence Core (Intelligence Unveiled)** 

A hierarchy of specialized AI Agents works autonomously to analyze data, predict volatility, and generate real-time, actionable advice:

  **Data Ingestion Agent** : Integrates with banking/transaction APIs (simulated using mock data) to ingest real-time income, expenses, and savings data.

**Volatilty Forecasting Agent** : Utilizes advanced Time-Series Machine Learning Models (like Prophet or ARIMA) specifically tuned to variable income streams. It predicts future cash flow events, identifies potential shortfalls, and forecasts optimal times for saving or investing.

**Coaching & Strategy Agent (Orchestrator)** : The brain of the operation. It synthesizes the forecast with the user's defined financial goals (e.g., save ₹1 lakh for a down payment by year-end) and risk profile. It then translates complex data into simple, proactive instructions:

**Action Alert** : Based on projected income dip next week, shift ₹3,000 from your liquid savings to the dedicated Shortfall Buffer today."

**Goal Update** : You are ahead of schedule. Increase your monthly allocation to the high-yield investment by 5%."

**Compliance Agent** : Ensures all recommendations and data handling practices adhere to simulated regulatory guidelines for personal financial advisors.

**Pillar 2: The Post-Quantum Security Layer (Quantum-Sealed)** 

All user data transmitted, processed, and stored within the platform is protected by cryptography designed to resist future quantum attacks. This is the Quantum Veil itself:

**Hybrid Encryption** : All persistent sensitive data is secured using a hybrid scheme that combines the current gold-standard classical encryption (e.g., AES-256) with an implementation of a NIST-approved Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) algorithm, such as CRYSTALS-Kyber for key encapsulation.

**Data Vault** : This specialized, secured database ensures that even if quantum computers become viable, data harvested today will remain indecipherable.

**Crypto-Agility** : The platform is engineered to be crypto-agile, allowing for rapid, seamless swapping or updating of cryptographic protocols as PQC standards evolve without disrupting user experience or system functionality.

**Expected Outcomes & Impact**

**Empowering the Informal Economy** : Provides essential, high-quality, and personalized financial planning to the millions in the gig and informal economy, helping them manage volatility and build sustainable wealth.

***Setting a New Security Standard*** : Establishes a leading precedent for PQC adoption in FinTech, moving cybersecurity from a reactive defense to a proactive, future-proof feature.

**Proactive Financial Health** : Converts passive budget-tracking into an active, automated coaching process, improving financial resilience and goal attainment for every user.

**Quantum Veil**  delivers true  **financial peace of mind** —not just by optimizing money, but by protecting the integrity of the data itself

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

The **Quantum Veil**  project aligns perfectly with the MumbaiHacks FinTech track and its emphasis on Agentic AI, while setting a new standard for data security that addresses a critical future challenge.

**1. Core Alignment: Solving the FinTech Track Problem**

The FinTech Track problem statement specifically challenges participants to **"Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively."**

**Quantum Veil** is a direct and complete solution to this mandate:

**Targeting Variable Income**: Our system’s **Volatility Forecasting Agent** is explicitly designed to analyze and predict the unpredictable cash flow of **gig workers and informal sector employees** using advanced Time-Series ML models (like ARIMA or Prophet). This is the key requirement often missed by static budgeting apps.

    Agentic & Proactive: Our Coaching & Strategy Agent is the autonomous engine. It doesn't just track history; it synthesizes predictions and user goals to issue proactive, actionable instructions (e.g., “Transfer ₹X to your buffer now”), effectively moving the user from reactive budgeting to automated strategic planning.

**2. Excellence in the Overarching Theme: Agentic AI**

The hackathon's core theme is **Agentic AI** . The Quantum Veil showcases a superior implementation of this theme:

**Multi-Agent Collaboration** : We don't rely on a single, monolithic LLM. Our solution uses a **hierarchy of specialized agents** (Ingestion, Forecasting, Orchestration, Compliance). This demonstrates a technically robust and scalable Agentic design pattern where specialized AI "team members" collaborate to solve a complex, multi-faceted problem.

**Tool-Augmented Intelligence** : Our agents are empowered with specialized tools—specifically the **Time-Series Forecasting Engine** and the **Post-Quantum Cryptography library** —proving they can execute complex, real-world financial tasks beyond simple text generation.

**3. Competitive Edge: The Future-Proof Innovation**

We go beyond the challenge's functional requirements by integrating an essential component for the future of FinTech, providing a clear competitive advantage:

 **Addressing Quantum Risk** : The Quantum Veil is the industry's first attempt to combine autonomous financial coaching with **Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC)** . By encrypting all user data using NIST-approved PQC algorithms (like CRYSTALS-Kyber), we directly address the "Harvest Now, Decrypt Later" threat.

 **Setting a New Standard**: This feature positions **Quantum Veil** as a pioneer in **future-proof financial security** , demonstrating awareness of the most significant long-term cyber threat facing the financial industry today.

**Description of your solution**

**Project Sentinel AI: An Autonomous AI Engine for Real-Time Truth Verification**

**The Problem:**
During critical events like natural disasters or public safety incidents, misinformation spreads faster than truth. This creates confusion, panic, and risk. The public is left without a trusted, single source to understand what is happening in real-time.

**Our Solution: An Agentic AI Approach**
Project Sentinel AI is an autonomous system designed to combat misinformation by creating a continuously updated, verified timeline of events called the Veritas Timeline. Our solution consists of two core components:

**Sentinel AI (The Engine):** An agentic AI backend that proactively scans the digital landscape (news sites, official social media) to identify specific, verifiable claims.

**Veritas Timeline**
A public-facing web application that serves as a central dashboard. It presents verified information in a clear, chronological narrative, allowing anyone to follow a crisis as it unfolds with confidence.

**How It Works:** The Automated Verification Pipeline
Our system processes information through a structured, five-step pipeline:

1. Ingestion: AI "Scanners" constantly monitor predefined sources for keywords related to an active crisis.

2. Claim Extraction: A specialized "Sorter" agent analyzes the raw data to distinguish actionable claims (e.g., "A specific bridge is closed") from general noise.

3. Agentic Verification: The claim is passed to a "cognitive architecture" built with LangGraph. This orchestrator deploys a team of specialized AI agents in parallel to cross-reference official sources, check media reports, and search for existing debunks.

4. Synthesis: A final "Synthesizer" agent analyzes all collected evidence to assign a status (VERIFIED, DEBUNKED, or UNCONFIRMED), write a neutral summary, and compile the sources.

5. Dissemination: The verified information is instantly saved and pushed in real-time to the Veritas Timeline. Simultaneously, our notification engine sends customized email alerts to subscribed users, with urgent notifications for debunked critical misinformation.

**Uniqueness & Innovation**
From Reactive Tools to a Proactive Agent
Current fact-checking platforms suffer from three critical flaws: they are reactive, requiring manual submission of claims; they are slow, unable to keep pace with the speed of viral misinformation; and they are fragmented, forcing users to hunt for answers across multiple sites.

Sentinel AI solves these problems through its core innovation: a proactive, agentic architecture that functions like an autonomous team of expert researchers.

**The Sentinel AI Advantage: Solving Core Fact-Checking Failures**

Problem: Slowness → Solution: Autonomous, 24/7 Speed. Unlike human-powered teams, our AI agents operate around the clock at machine speed, capable of ingesting and verifying claims faster than they can go viral.

Problem: Reactive Nature → Solution: Proactive Vigilance. Sentinel AI doesn't wait for a dangerous claim to be reported. Its scanners are constantly hunting for emerging narratives, allowing it to get ahead of misinformation.

Problem: Fragmentation → Solution: A Centralized Dashboard. The Veritas Timeline acts as the user's single source of truth. Instead of opening multiple tabs to track official accounts and news sites, the main page is a comprehensive dashboard displaying all verified updates, their sources, and their status in one clean interface.

Our system's "brain" is a LangGraph orchestrator that manages the specialized agent team, including The Official Checker (for authoritative sources), The Media Cross-Referencer (for journalistic corroboration), and The Debunker (to identify known hoaxes). This foundation enables complex reasoning, allowing the system to weigh evidence and alter its strategy based on incoming data—a significant leap beyond simple API calls.

**Personalized & Actionable Intelligence**

Beyond the public dashboard, Sentinel AI delivers personalized intelligence. Users can "follow" specific events and receive tailored email updates on their timeline. Crucially, when a dangerous piece of misinformation is DEBUNKED, the system pushes an immediate, high-priority alert to all followers of that event, actively correcting the record and ensuring public safety.

This multi-agent system transforms fact-checking from a passive, human-gated process into an active, automated service that delivers speed, trust, and autonomy when it is needed most.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

**Project Name: Sentinel AI**

**Track: Misinformation**

**Project Alignment with Track Goals:**

Project Sentinel AI is engineered from the ground up to be the definitive solution for the Misinformation track. Our project directly addresses every requirement of the challenge by implementing a sophisticated, proactive, and fully autonomous system.

**1. Agentic AI System**

At its core, Sentinel AI is a proactive agentic system. Unlike passive, human-gated tools, it autonomously hunts for, analyzes, and acts on information without needing manual intervention. This embodies the primary requirement of the track by creating an intelligent agent that actively participates in the information ecosystem.

**2. Continuous Multi-Source Scanning**

Our AI "Scanners" are designed to perpetually monitor a diverse and expanding range of information sources in real-time. This includes official government and police social media accounts, alongside trusted national and international news APIs, ensuring comprehensive and continuous coverage during a crisis.

**3. Automated Fact Detection and Verification**

The system's "cognitive architecture," built with LangGraph, deploys a team of specialized agents to robustly verify facts. The Official Checker, Media Cross-Referencer, and Debunker agents work in concert to cross-reference claims, find corroboration, and identify known hoaxes with machine speed and precision, moving far beyond manual verification.

**4. Clear, Contextual Public Updates**

All verified findings are published to the Veritas Timeline, a clean, chronological dashboard that serves as a single, trusted source of truth for the public. This is supplemented by real-time email notifications for subscribed users, with high-priority alerts issued for debunked dangerous misinformation, ensuring the public receives clear, contextual, and actionable updates during a crisis.

**Description of your solution**

TruthFlow: AI-Powered Misinformation Detection for Crisis Response
What We're Building
TruthFlow is an autonomous AI system that catches and stops misinformation before it goes viral—especially during crises when false information can literally cost lives. Think natural disasters, health emergencies, or election periods where panic spreads faster than facts.

The core idea is simple: use multiple AI agents working together to monitor social media 24/7, predict which false claims will explode, verify them automatically, and communicate the truth in plain language that anyone can understand.

How It Actually Works
The Agent Team: We've designed five specialized AI agents that work like a coordinated newsroom. The Sentiment Classifier spots emotionally charged claims (outrage and fear make things go viral 6x faster). The Context Tracker follows how information mutates as it spreads—catching when true news gets twisted into something misleading. The Evidence Analyzer cross-checks claims against Wikipedia, news sources, and official websites in real-time. The Network Mapper identifies which accounts are spreading misinformation fastest. And the Recommendation Agent tells crisis managers exactly what to do about it.

These agents communicate through LangGraph framework, sharing everything they learn instantly. No silos, no delays.

Early Warning System: Here's where we get innovative. Instead of debunking viral misinformation (which rarely works because damage is done), we predict what will go viral while it's still small. Using epidemic modeling—the same math that predicts disease spread—we assign a Viral Risk Score to emerging claims. If something has only 50 shares but our model says it'll hit 100,000 in the next 24 hours, we flag it immediately.

Verification Pipeline: Our system processes claims through four validation layers: machine learning text analysis trained on millions of verified statements, Wikipedia fact-checking for named entities and dates, logical coherence testing using large language models, and web scraping of authoritative sources. The agents vote on the final verdict, weighted by their accuracy track records. This achieves 95.3% accuracy without a single point of failure.

Public Communication: We translate complex verification into three colors anyone understands. Green means verified true. Yellow means partially true but missing context—with a clear explanation of what's missing. Red means false—with a simple explanation of why it's wrong and links to correct information. Every debunk includes pre-written text people can copy-paste to correct misinformation in their own networks.

Technical Foundation
The system runs on BERT + BiLSTM models for natural language processing, Neo4j graph database for mapping viral spread networks, and real-time scrapers monitoring Twitter, Facebook, WhatsApp forwards (via user submissions), and Telegram. Everything is built with LangGraph for agent coordination and deployed to handle thousands of claims per hour.

Crisis Dashboard
For emergency response teams, we provide a live dashboard showing: active false claims currently spreading, predicted viral threats (6-18 hours before they explode), specific recommended interventions, and effectiveness metrics showing which counter-measures are working. This gives crisis managers the lead time they desperately need during emergencies.

Why This Matters
During the 2024 health crisis, false medical advice reached millions within hours. During natural disasters, fake evacuation notices create chaos that blocks actual rescue efforts. During elections, coordinated disinformation campaigns undermine democracy itself.

TruthFlow doesn't just flag suspicious content—it autonomously detects, verifies, predicts spread patterns, and helps coordinate response. We're giving truth the speed and scale it needs to compete with lies in the digital age.

The system combines cutting-edge AI with human oversight for edge cases, ensuring both speed and accuracy. It's built to scale automatically when misinformation volume spikes during crises, exactly when human fact-checkers get overwhelmed.

This is agentic AI solving a problem that costs societies billions and endangers lives every single day.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

The Problem We're Tackling
During crises whether it's a natural disaster, health emergency, or political tension false information spreads faster than truth. People panic, share without verifying, and suddenly millions believe something that could harm them or others. The problem statement asks for an agentic AI that continuously monitors, detects, verifies, and communicates. That's exactly what TruthFlow does.

Our Four-Pillar Solution
1. Continuous Multi-Source Scanning
TruthFlow runs 24/7 across Twitter, Facebook, WhatsApp, Telegram, and news websites simultaneously. We're not talking about basic keyword monitoring—our five specialized AI agents work like a coordinated team, each with specific responsibilities but sharing everything they learn through the Model Context Protocol. While human fact-checkers might review 50-100 claims daily, TruthFlow processes thousands per hour. During a crisis when every minute counts, this speed difference saves lives.

2. Detecting Emerging Misinformation Early
Here's where we get innovative. Instead of waiting for something to go viral (when damage is already done), we predict which claims will explode before they reach 1,000 shares. Our system uses epidemic modeling—the same math scientists use to predict disease spread—to assign a Viral Risk Score to every emerging claim.

The Sentiment Classifier Agent identifies emotional triggers. Claims that provoke outrage or fear spread 6x faster than neutral information, so we flag those immediately. Our Context Preservation System tracks how true information gets twisted as it spreads—catching when legitimate news gets reframed with misleading headlines.

3. Autonomous Fact Verification
Our multi-agent pipeline works like an automated newsroom. The Machine Learning Classifier analyzes text patterns trained on millions of verified statements. The Wikipedia Knowledge Checker cross-references factual claims instantly. The Coherence Detection Agent uses large language models to verify logical consistency. The Web-Scraped Evidence Analyzer searches authoritative sources in real-time.

These agents vote on final determinations, weighted by their track records, achieving 95.3% accuracy. This isn't just flagging suspicious content—it's actual verification with evidence.

4. Easy-to-Understand Public Communication
We designed a three-color system anyone can understand:

🟢 Green: Verified true by multiple sources

🟡 Yellow: Partially true but missing context + plain explanation

🔴 Red: False + why it's false + correct information

Instead of just marking things "FALSE," we explain why in simple language. For example: "This image is real, but it's from 2018 floods in Kerala, not today's situation". Every debunk includes share-ready text people can copy-paste to correct misinformation in their networks.

Crisis-Specific Design
Speed: We detect and verify within 5 minutes. False claims can reach 100,000 people in an hour—we catch them at 50-200 people.

Predictive Power: Our Viral Pathway Tracker shows which narratives are gaining momentum 6-18 hours before they explode, giving response teams time to prepare counter-messaging.

Network Mapping: We identify super-spreaders who consistently share misinformation, helping prevent organized campaigns during crises.

Crisis Dashboard: Shows active false claims, predicted viral threats, and recommended interventions—who to contact, what platforms to alert, when to issue official statements.

Why This Works
TruthFlow combines agentic AI's autonomous decision-making with human oversight for complex cases. The technology stack—LangGraph for agent coordination, BERT + BiLSTM models for text analysis, Neo4j for network mapping is proven and scalable.

We're not just building impressive AI. We're building a tool that gives truth a fighting chance when it matters most—saving lives by preventing false evacuation rumors, protecting health by debunking medical misinformation, and safeguarding democracy by catching election interference early.

This is agentic AI solving real problems for real people during their most vulnerable moments.

- Monthly Reports & Insights: Transforms financial data into visual, easy-to-read charts and summaries.
- Offline Mode: Enables expense tracking even without internet — ideal for informal sector users.

- Community Challenges: Encourages saving through gamified streaks, leaderboards, and group challenges.
- Spending Heatmaps: Highlights spending-heavy days or categories visually for quick self-assessment.
- Emergency Fund Predictor: AI recommends when and how much to set aside based on lifestyle and earnings.
